description: Select one of the 30 most skillful drivers of all time and boost your way to the top in F-Zero Pocket, a racing fan game made as a tribute to both the GameBoy Color and the F-Zero series.

title: FNaF World: Outplay
description: FNaF World: Outplay is a Five Nights at Freddy's fan game about to recreate the FNaF World from an RPG format to a Sonic-like platformer format with fast-paced gameplay.

title: Bub's Big Blowout!
description:
Bub and his friends seem to have found themselves lost in a strange new world! Everything is so familiar, yet so different! Will you be able to help Bub and his friends find their way home?

Welcome to "Bub's Big Blowout!", A 3D reimagining of the Bubble Bobble arcade game! Here you can jump, blow bubbles, and burst baddies as bub or one of his 3 friends! Collect fruit, Extend Bubbles, and other collectibles for the best possible score!

title: Choujin Sentai Jetman
description:
Two years have passed since the Jetman triumphed over the evil Vyram faction and saved the Earth. Humanity has flourished again, but peace is fragile, however, one night that peace was destroyed. A remnant of Vyram, hidden in the darkest corners of the universe, has returned to Earth. Renegades and resentful, this group has developed powerful mechanical giants that are wreaking havoc on humanity. They have issued a chilling ultimatum: if the sun goes down, the giants will devastate the world and there will be no hope.​

Faced with this desperate situation, the Choujin Sentai Jetman are forced to meet again to face the greatest threat they have ever known.

title: Space Quest: Incinerations
description: Space Quest: Incineration is a 2012 fan-made sequel to the Space Quest series, created by Chris Ushko. It had been previously started in 1999 as a team project, cancelled, and then revived again as an almost completely different game. Information for both versions of the game are kept on this page.

title: Cave Story: The Desolate
description: Cave Story: The Desolate is a fangame based off of the Cave Story Beta.

title: Super Mario Bros. Star Scramble DX
description: Super Mario Bros. Star Scramble DX is a fan-made remake of the flash game Super Mario Bros. Star Scramble.

title: Sonic Encore
description: Sonic Encore is a fan game that re-imagines some of the classic levels from the Sonic 2D era into a more modern 3D environmental setting.

title: Acceleration of Suguri: Y-Edition
description: Acceleration of Suguri Y-Edition is a fan-made remake of Acceleration of SUGURI. The speed has been cranked up, gameplay and visuals have been polished, along with a more balanced cast and rollback netcode!

title: Supra Smash Bross Devolution
description: Supra Smash Bross Devolution is a satirical take on the Smash Bros. series, with hilariously terrible graphics yet surprisingly deep gameplay.

title: Hot Wheels Unleashed: AcceleRacers Bassline
description: Make some noise for Bassline! Its huge rear speakers and subwoofers will spread the perfect soundtrack… for your tracks! And whoever tries to stop you, will have to face the music!

title: Chital's Mini Adventure
description: Small Indie Platformer that started a Game Jam entry in 2022, now polished a little and released! A Single-Level game where you must collect Jewels and defeat a Boss!

title: Girl Travels Forest of Dream
description: Let's start the journey with the girl who picks up machete and eats grilled fish! please remember. What is needed to save the world is 'recipes to try', 'border privet', and 'balanced diet'. Needless to say, the smell of cat paws and the warmth of loved ones!

title: Star Realms: High Alert - Heroes
description: The Star Realms: High Alert Heroes expansion contains 12 new multi-faction Heroes. This expansion also includes campaign chapter 25, which has 7 new missions!

title: Bingo Pinball Gameroom: United Starlet
description: Simulation of an electromechanical Bingo Pinball machine, model Starlet. Manufactured by United in 1955.

title: Golf Evolution Simulation
description: 30 Main stunt missions, 15 Parking missions, a fun test course map and a complete all-in-one game with all golf carts and modifiability. A different experience with a mix of Arcade and Simulation.

title: Schwarzerblitz: 8-Colors Star Guardians Collaboration Costumes - Chapter 1
description: Go, go, go, Star Guardians! This official collaboration between Schwarzerblitz and 8-Colors Star Guardians Plus brings a superheroic spin to your matches! Get 6 new cosplay costumes inspired by 8CSG and start fighting for Earth now! The DLC includes a stage and a new song for the jukebox/Free Match.

title: Elephant Rave 2
description: The rave goes on! 14 years after his first rave, the elephant has returned for monumental challenge: avoiding very, very deadly beams of light

title: Tappump
description:
Tappump is a fast-paced one-button game.

You control the circle. Your goal is to move forward while avoiding mines and staying within the horizontal boundaries of the screen. Press the button to jump, hold the button to increase range. Collect coins to earn points.

If you hit a mine or go beyond the top or bottom of the screen, the game is over.

title: Sakura School Love
description: The background of the game is an interesting story that happened in the small town of Sakura on the campus. You can also learn more knowledge and experience various daily activities, waiting for players to explore in the game.

title: Hot Wheels Unleashed: AcceleRacers Hollowback
description: Metal Maniacs rejoice! Here is the legendary car of Tork Maddox, a muscle car super modified to resist everything! Hollowback is made of pure solidity and will leave a void behind! A must-have for all fans!

title: Wormhole: Battle for Planet Earth
description: Wormhole: Battle for Planet Earth - This is a fantastic third-person action game. In the game you are waiting for aliens, teleporters, dark matter and hurricane action.

title: Hyperdrive Inn
description: Dive into the mysteries of an infinite hotel. Unveil an ever-shifting adventure where every playthrough is unique. Immerse in fabric-crafted visuals, guided by an enchanting score inspired by Finnish folk music. Hyperdrive Inn is a point-and-click journey like no other.

title: Saga of Weil
description: Saga of Weil is an old school side scrolling adventure with some souls-like style combat

title: Duskborn
description: Duskborn is a 3rd-person rouge-like game. Descend into the Abyss as fast as possible, level up by defeating various enemies, collect and combine items to upgrade your player. Maneuver through the Abyss with your jetpack and grappling hook. The race against time is on.

title: Robospital
description: Become a doctor in Robospital and fix robots. Learn programming, write code, and test your code. With vibrant graphics, coding challenges, and a narrative, embark on an undercover mission. Dive into a game where coding meets adventure!

title: Simulator of Ukraine 1991
description: This game is a global strategy, which is primarily focused on Ukraine after leaving the Soviet occupation. Here you will be given control of Ukraine with the opportunity to change history and intervene in the events of that time.

title: Screamdown
description: Scream through your mic at opponents to send them flying into the void in this PvP horror game.

title: A Lively Haunt
description: Are you bold enough to enter A Lively Haunt alone? Or must you join a friend to investigate this 2-player, old-school, text parser adventure game?

title: Magic Force
description: Magic Force is a 3D adventure game. You have to take on the role of a traveler who went in search of new adventures. Explore a mysterious continent that has been poisoned and help the locals find an antidote.

title: Karen's Fault
description: Join Karen in her uphill battle. But remember, there will be a lot of anger in this adventure...

title: Burger Shop 3
description: Make tasty food items to serve hungry customers in this fast-paced sequel to the amazing food making games Burger Shop 1 & 2!

title: Woodland Isle
description: Explore the enchanting world of Woodland Isle, a captivating exploration game that invites you to embark on a tranquil journey through a lush, mysterious island. Uncover hidden locations, from ancient campsites to majestic trees and the remains of giants.

title: Becca
description: Becca is a short point-and-click, interactive story book.

title: One Night: Burlesque
description: Step into the smoky, seductive world of the Angels Den, a luxurious burlesque club. Get into the high heels of Holly, a talented dancer graced with a unique gift of telepathy. Help her on a desperate mission to save a friend from certain doom.

title: Vadi
description: Build your own kingdom in the dark valley where zombies rule and stay safe from zombies. It is up to you to survive in this valley.

title: Slime Alchemist
description: Turn-based tactics and roguelike deckbuilding with a twist! Forge your path across a procedural overworld, spend time as a resource to play cards, and build your deck from the techniques of vanquished foes. Hone your strategy and become the greatest slime of all!

title: Chained Together
description: From the depths of hell, climb chained to your friends through diverse worlds. Solo or co-op, try to reach the summit and discover what awaits you there...

title: Departed Away
description: Discover 'Departed Away,' a captivating visual novel where friendship intertwines with mystery. Uncover secrets, engage in verbal duels, and make choices that shape your story. Delve into emotional depth and intricate connections in this unique story.

title: Secret of the Vikings 2: The World Tree
description: Inexplicable disasters haunt the Vikings. Help Valkyrie Fenja and Raven Yorin rebuild the destroyed village and find out what is behind the mysterious events.

title: Deadpoint
description: "Deadpoint" is an engaging third-person survival game set in an apocalyptic world overrun by zombies. Players take on the role of a resourceful scavenger, tasked with navigating the dangerous landscape and ensuring their survival amid the hordes of undead.

title: Louma
description: Louma is a Roguelike Dungeon Crawler. Fight through the procedural generated floors and save the World of Louma.

title: World War 1: Ruined - Part 2
description: Ruined Part 2 DLC: Free, Thrilling, and Here! Explore 3 new maps, experience an innovative game mode, and enjoy enhanced visuals/audio. Your journey continues with an epic storyline. Let's dive in! - RonStar Studios

title: FolcDark: Part I
description: FolcDark: Part I is the sequel to the prologue of a third-person dark fantasy action-adventure game, with a story and characters focused on Brazilian folklore.

title: Xaphan: Battle Simulator
description: Xaphan is a third person shooter mixed with sandbox battle simulator featuring zombies, huge insects, medieval knights, animals and monsters.

title: Exit the Backrooms
description: Embark on a journey through 8 meticulously crafted levels that blur the line between the mundane and the surreal. Each environment, designed to captivate the senses, pushes the boundaries of what you thought you knew.

title: Matchpoop
description: Step into a world overrun by mischievous poops! Rally allies, employ match-N mechanics to battle and flush them down the drain. Conquer poop overlords, reclaim the bathroom in this addicting game!

title: Semu
description: Space adventure can be scary, so that's why we at InkForge Studios have developed the most advanced Space Suit ever - the Semu suit. Standing for Survival Extra-vehicular Mobility Unit, it will keep you safe as you journey the cosmos. With survival guaranteed, what else is there to worry about?

title: The Johnny Papa
description: The Johnny Papa is a strategic multiplayer horror game with 3 main characters, 5 side characters and 1 murderer. Welcome to the village of Agris.

title: Gem
description: This is a 2D science fiction casual game, where players can gain increasingly fulfillment by collecting and exploring in the universe. The non-competitive game mode can also bring relaxation to users.

title: The Adventures of Bunny and Pig
description: Narrative game where Bunny heals an injured Pig and then together they fight against monsters. Psychological healing theme with a cute art style.

title: Unexpected Visitors
description: Step back in time to the 1950s and immerse yourself in a chilling tale shrouded in mystery in "Unexpected Visitors." Play as Barbara Clark, a housewife whose picturesque life takes a nightmarish turn when she returns home to find her children and babysitter mysteriously vanished.

title: Mahjick: The Realm Taker
description: "Mahjick - The Realm Taker" is a turn-based strategy game combining Roguelike and Mahjong Elements. Embark into this epic journey of taking the throne and to become the Keeper by defeating enemies for Enchantments and Skills, and Ronning your tiles for Attribute and Talent skills.

title: Ultradian
description: Ultradian is an intense JRPG adventure featuring turn-based combat, Survival Horror elements, and resource management. You must escape the war-torn town of Lgov within 24 hours before a devastating nuclear bomb is unleashed! But beware, falling asleep means certain death!

title: God's Forest
description: God's Forest is a Roguelite Bullet-Hell. Gather powerful items and weapons, battle the guardians of the dungeon, and maybe even make a few friends along the way!

title: Survival on a Deserted Island
description: The players of 'Survival on a deserted island' are immersed in a challenging and adventurous desert island. We need to constantly explore islands, find resources to manage our hunger, thirst, and physical strength, and build shelters to resist the threat of terrifying skeletons wandering around.

title: Paint Desk Simulator
description: Welcome to Paint Desk Simulator! In this game, you own a small paint-mixing company. As you rise through the ranks, you will start to be able to automate the paint mixing process. You need to strategize your days and always think ahead. Good luck, and all hail Radiant.

title: Shinogi Chess Club 2: Resistance
description: As Himiko Masaki continues the search for her mother, the resistance to change ever marches on when new rebellion groups challenge the city's obsession with Shinogi Chess, and the struggle for truth envelops Yoshino High School. Every move counts in Shinogi Chess Club 2: Resistance!

title: Little Monkey King's Big Quest
description: Welcome to "Little Monkey King's Big Quest"! Exciting adventures await you alongside the Little Monkey King.

title: Let Him Cook
description: Let Him Cook is a top-down action roguelite where you play as a food industry professional fighting in bullet hell's kitchen. When food fights back, you gotta cook. Jam to the music, hire assistants, and face against all kinds of live food puns!

title: Dungeon Create
description: Roused from sleep, I'm in a dusty cave, named the master of a dungeon!? I'm "forced" to manage it... Defend against daring adventurers!

title: Evil Snowmen 2
description: Evil Snowmen 2 - This is an improved port of the mobile game with a nice winter atmosphere and evil enemies snowmen. The game is not long, the average passage of the story will take about 30 minutes.

title: Island Hopper
description: Oh no! Your island got hit by a tornado. Can you rebuild your island and help out your friends? Enjoy randomly generated islands with different biomes to collect the resources you need to upgrade your gear and save your home. But don't leave the enemies out of your sight!

title: Blue Cradle: Signifie
description: A novel game with a fully voiced story about everyday or extraordinary stories.

title: Invert by SlushyRh
description: Embark on a precision platformer journey to the moon! You'll climb, fall, then cry and do it all again.

title: Unnamed Experiment
description: What could be more disorienting than finding yourself in a point-and-click puzzle game with no words at all? You wake up in a cell, surrounded by symbols and traces that make no sense. An atmospheric journey awaits. Immerse yourself in piecing clues together, but don't get lost in the surreal world.

title: Dadlympics
description: Engage in physics-based fun! Conquer hilarious dad-worthy challenges with friends in the DADLYMPICS. Are you ready to claim the title of ultimate dad?

title: Tax Evasion
description: An action filled roguelike, where you climb the floors of the IRS headquarters to reclaim what is rightfully yours... Your money. Take down your enemies. Buy items with their money. And climb the floors. Unlock new characters and abilities to approach this office building in many different ways.

title: Slime Experiments
description: A 2D top down puzzle game where you play as a slime that must go through various experiments after finding yourself captured by some sort of slime researcher.

title: Manor of Mysteries
description: Manor of Mysteries is a horror-puzzle multiplayer game. Explore a manor full of randomized rooms! Solve puzzles, survive monsters, escape traps. Work with your friends to solve this manor's mysteries! Can you survive 100 rooms? Or will you be another lost victim to the manor?

title: Stellario
description: In a large star field, the Spirit flies around and absorbs stars to build up mass and take on a different appearance. But you have to be careful on the journey - there are black holes scattered around the field, and also spaceships flying at unthinkable speeds.

title: Hover Shooting Defence
description: Aliens have invaded for Earth's resources. They dominated nature and made them attack mankind. Humanity on the verge of extinction has gathered the last of its strength and developed a superconducting hovertank that can stand against them. Now our counterattack begins.

title: Hajikise!
description:
Released in 2009, Hajikise! is a turn-based RPG for Windows PC.
It was developed and released by Hachimitsu Kumasan, a doujin game developer.

Hajikise! is a traditional Japanese RPG that uses two-dimensional top-down view.
Characters can be customized from a number of different classes and their skills.

title: Roaming Backrooms
description: This is a back room style game. There are many rooms in the game, like a maze, where players need to find a way out. Mainly focused on exploration, with some frightening elements. There may be monsters waiting for players around the corner, or chasing them. There is no bloody content.

title: Murder Miners X
description: The long-awaited sequel to the #1 rated Xbox Live Indie Game is not here yet, but it will be (Believe). Classic FPS gunplay with awesome parkour. Online, 4 player Splitscreen! Block-based destructible maps. Vehicles. Zombies. PVP Infection: Devour your victims, get new zombie powers!

title: Games Advent Calendar: 25 Days - 25 Surprises
description: In Games advent calendar, immerse yourself in that fantastic Christmas spirit, an exciting new game, every day for 25 days!

title: Bingo Pinball Gameroom: United Rio
description: Simulation of an electromechanical Bingo Pinball machine, model Rio. Manufactured by United in 1953.

title: Bingo Pinball Gameroom: United Mexico
description: Simulation of an electromechanical Bingo Pinball machine, model Mexico. Manufactured by United in 1954.

title: Bingo Pinball Gameroom: United Manhattan
description: Simulation of an electromechanical Bingo Pinball machine, model Manhattan. Manufactured by United in 1955.

title: Bingo Pinball Gameroom: United Hawaii
description: Simulation of an electromechanical Bingo Pinball machine, model Hawaii. Manufactured by United in 1954.

title: Bingo Pinball Gameroom: United Caravan
description: Simulation of an electromechanical Bingo Pinball machine, model Caravan. Manufactured by United in 1956.

title: Bingo Pinball Gameroom: United Brazil
description: Simulation of an electromechanical Bingo Pinball machine, model Brazil. Manufactured by United in 1956.

title: Bingo Pinball Gameroom: Agogo
description: Simulation of an imaginary electromechanical Bingo Pinball machine, model Agogo. Created in 2017. Machine never really manufactured though.

title: Bingo Pinball Gameroom: Bally Yacht Club
description: Simulation of an electromechanical Bingo Pinball machine, model Yacht Club. Manufactured by Bally in 1953.

title: Bingo Pinball Gameroom: Bally Acapulco
description: Simulation of an electromechanical Bingo Pinball machine, model Acapulco. Manufactured by Bally in 1961.

title: Bingo Pinball Gameroom: Bally Atlantic City
description: Simulation of an electromechanical Bingo Pinball machine, model Atlantic City. Manufactured by Bally in 1952.

title: Bingo Pinball Gameroom: Bally Bali
description: Simulation of an electromechanical Bingo Pinball machine, model Bali. Manufactured by Bally in 1974.

title: Bingo Pinball Gameroom: Bally Ballerina
description: Simulation of an electromechanical Bingo Pinball machine, model Ballerina. Manufactured by Bally in 1959.

title: Bingo Pinball Gameroom: Bally Beach Beauty
description: Simulation of an electromechanical Bingo Pinball machine, model Beach Beauty. Manufactured by Bally in 1955.

title: Bingo Pinball Gameroom: Bally Beach Time
description: Simulation of an electromechanical Bingo Pinball machine, model Beach Time. Manufactured by Bally in 1958.

title: Bingo Pinball Gameroom: Bally Beach Club
description: Simulation of an electromechanical Bingo Pinball machine, model Beach Club. Manufactured by Bally in 1953.

title: BlooDooMoon Survivor
description: Welcome to this survival sandbox game! Your plane made a forced landing during the Bermuda storm. You will need to establish your own survival base from scratch, collect materials, make tools, build towns, manufacture weapons, explore unknown fields. Will you conquer the challenges?

title: Hilda and the Tower of Lust
description: The mightiest female warrior, Hilda, will face a tower teeming with monsters... Can she defeat the demon king without letting down the hero?

title: Pinocchio: Interactive Book
description: Pinocchio. Interactive classic stories for all ages.

title: Desktop Pet
description: Desktop Pet is a life simulation game where you can take care of cute creatures while working or playing on your computer. Write documents, play games, watch videos, all together with your little companion.

title: Heartium
description: A fantasy SRPG.

title: Mr. Platformer
description: Run! Jump? Swim?! Mr. Platformer can do it all!

title: Mind Puzzle 2023
description: Mind Puzzle 2023: Dive into a world where physics reigns and every level offers endless possibilities. With just rectangles and circles at your disposal, discover your unique solution in this riveting casual game. Challenge the usual, embrace the extraordinary!

title: Monolith O Pesadelo
description: First person horror, Simple short game, look for keys, unlock passages. Be in an unknown location with a Dark atmosphere. In each phase there will be a different challenge, survive and advance while you try not to get caught. Avoid Scares.

title: Juicy Retro Style!: Bloodhound
description: Bring the Bloodhound world fully into the retro dimension ️ and enjoy juicy old-style gameplay!

title: Crimson Needle 3
description: Play as The Kid, and traverse a vast world of profoundly challenging platforming with a wide variety of atmospheres and visual styles.

title: WannaFest 22
description:
After the events of I Wanna Be The Guy, The Kid is invited to a game show hosted by an imposing figure! Fight your way through several game challenges to compete for a high score. Do you have what it takes to master these games and win the grand prize?

Developed by Cherry Treehouse for Fangame Marathon 2022's Blind Adventure event, WannaFest 22 is a fast-paced rollercoaster through hidden gaming gems of the past!

title: The Bowyage
description:
The Bowyage is a low fantasy platformer inspired by the NES Castlevania games, where you control Yew Bowman, a member of the low nobility and a longbowman, in his journey of conquests against his other two elder brothers.
Yew, lacking resources, figured that he needs to gain power to fend off against his two more powerful brothers, so with his trusty bow and arrow and his loyal army, he marches towards the path of conquest.

title: Sonic Test Labs
description:
Here at Hedgehog Testing Inc., we take the matter of rogue and spikey rodents very seriously. They're a threat and a menace to society!

So what have we decided to do? Take matters into our own hands by capturing these creatures and studying them to their fullest extent. All sponsored by G.U.N. of course!

title: Break Arts III
description: Freely customize your own robots to win high-speed matches! With the brand new Co-op Mode and Diorama Mode, this game is a fresh new addition to the series.

title: Fight Crab 2
description: Flip your opponents on their backs in this crustacean wrestling fighting game! Come up with your own strategies and use the deceivingly deep physics engine to your advantage. Challenge mighty foes in Career Mode, or pit your crab against others in online multiplayer.

title: Great Wall March
description: A turn-based fantasy JRPG.

title: Evil Girls Party!
description: Evil Girls Party is a dark fantasy dungeon-exploration RPG. In the world of Filtwiz, humans and demons are locked in relentless conflict— yet a new, threatening third force quietly rises: the Erosion, In the vast labyrinth, the feast of evil girls opens wide… the adventure begins!

title: Pokémon Mino
description: At the beginning of their journey, the trainer and sailor go to the Hishout Dungeon to see the very rare Pokémon, Graykid. When Team Digital arrives has a plan to steal the Pokémon, Graykid. Even though who's gonna stop Team Digital? Their good friends Damian and Skyla are the adventurous trainers in a whole wide world.

title: Rocher no Nagai Yoru
description: A turn-based fantasy JRPG.

title: Misty no Kira-kira Hanjouki
description: A turn-based fantasy JRPG.

title: Pokémon: Burning Lotus
description: The game takes place in a new region called Lotus, a region that is filled with Pokémon from every previous generation, including new species as well. You take control as either a male or female protagonist, and the region has eight gym leaders who are all returning leaders from previous games.

title: Sparkster PC
description: A reimagined version of the Genesis version of Sparkster that aims to create something new and exciting with its existing ideas and assets.

title: Megaman X in Sonic Blasting Adventure
description: A fan game that adds X and Zero from the Mega Man X series into Sonic Blasting Adventure.

title: Sonic Colors Demastered
description:
Sonic Colors Demastered is a 2D reimagining of Sonic Colors for the Nintendo Wii and Nintendo DS. The game features gameplay inspired by the Sonic Rush series and a fully original level design and soundtrack.

Join Sonic, Tails, and a colorful cast of aliens to put a stop to Eggman’s plans for interstellar domination! Use Sonic’s signature suite of abilities, including the boost, grind, and homing attack, to make your way through exhilarating, high-speed 2D platforming challenges!

title: Sonic Colors VN
description: Sonic Colors VN is a remake of Sonic Colors DS in a Visual Novel format using the Ren'Py game engine. This project bridges the gap between all versions of the tale, stringing their plot threads together.

title: Sonic 04
description: A loving tribute to the good old days when Sonic fangames were worse than the official onres.

title: Mekanikko
description: Mekanikko is an RPG that takes place in the world of modern steampunk. Explore the world of automatons, as weird things are always about to happen. Meet wacky characters with each of their own story tell. Solve cases with your sugar-freak partner, and find out the truth of this mechanical city.

title: Hot Job 94'
description: Hot Job 94 is a 3D action platformer inspired by the early 2000's GameCube games such as Sonic Adventure and Super Mario Sunshine. Control 5 different characters with unique attributes like speed, flight, shooting, and combat.

title: Funtography: A Gameboy Cameradventure
description: In Funtography, enjoy looking at 100+ Gameboy Camera pictures as you explore various urban vistas to solve the mystery of a missing video game prototype.

title: Sonic McOrigins Plus
description: An update to Sonic McOrigins that adds Shadow Hockey, Amy/Rouge Volleyball, and Shadow Basketball.

title: EdelSuche
description: EdelSuche is a Rockman-style-doujin-ish-action-platformer game where you play as Cecilia Wonderwand, a mage apprentice who finds herself in need to save the world from "The Rot".

title: Beep Bap The Beep Boop
description: Beep Bap The Beep Boop is a 3D platformer inspired by Spyro, Banjo and Zelda! Explore colorful worlds and talk to a variety of charming NPCs! Use your surroundings to aid in combat & use shields to block and parry enemy attacks!

title: Rocket League: Season 12
description:
Home to Rocket League’s opening day, Neo Tokyo’s megalithic tech scene and neon-soaked cityscape make for a landmark Arena setting. But fanged rumors lurk amongst the roots of these glittering towers. Notorious hacktivist Zero-Day has gained access to the city's digital infrastructure, and although their motives remain unclear, the city's underbelly buzzes with anticipation of what’s to come.

How will you survive this world of digital disruption? Override your Garage with the Porsche 911 Turbo, go incognito with Rocket Pass rewards, and play Soccer in Zero-Day’s corrupted vision of Neo Tokyo.

Season 12 begins on September 6, no password required!

title: One Tap
description: "One Tap" is a high-octane first-person shooter game that delivers an immersive and competitive gaming experience. It's all about the thrill of the game, the strategy, and the skill. The unique twist? You get to choose an in-game asset with special abilities that can turn the tide of the battle. The special characters in the game are digital assets or "NFT" stored using blockchain technology.

title: Beautiful Sakura: Surfing Club
description: A visual novel focused on mental health and personal identity. Help your character fit into the new city you moved to and find new friends. As part of your journey, you will be able to listen to the people around you and learn to surf for the first time. Player choice affects how the narrative will progress, including special dialogue to discover for key scenes.

title: eFootball 2024: Leo Messi Edition
description: Messi, the living legend, is joining your team. Introducing the special boosted edition of "eFootball" - No better time to start playing eFootball than now!

title: Amorphous
description: Amorphous is a 4v1 multiplayer experience where one player takes control of the elusive shape-shifting slime, seeking to consume and contaminate various locations across space and time. Meanwhile, the team of 4 relentless Cleaners unite and attempt to eradicate the ever-evolving threat.

title: Willow Guard
description: Willow Guard is a single player story-driven fantasy RPG that combines dungeon-crawling action gameplay with a choice-based interactive fiction.

title: Wisp Child
description: Join Mylo in this coming of age adventure as they explore magical woods, hone their alchemy skills, and repair their troubled relationship with Ademia. Unravel the secrets of wisps, and even learn to control them. Meet fun and quirky characters, and find your place in the village.

title: Wreckage
description: A classic car combat game set in a post-apocalyptic sunny south Florida. Fast-paced gameplay, a wide variety of vehicles and weapons to choose from, and killer stories for each and every driver.

title: Zbuki Zoo Strategic Comedy
description: Humorous strategy with unique set of characters: buff genius, precious kung fu lady, half-ton puppy, cool spitter and much more. Plus some non-standard structures to build and quirky maps to explore. You can find these only in Zbukiland.

title: Candy Crisis
description: Candy Crisis is an exciting combination of pure action and puzzle gaming! The game features twelve unique stages, complete with its own character and individual technique. Also, you can pair off against a friend, and even specify a handicap so that both players are evenly matched. And if you don't want to play against an opponent, Solitaire Crisis mode allows you to practice without having to compete against an opponent. A tutorial is included with the game as well, so even puzzle novices can become Candy Crisis champions in no time.

title: Vampire's Kiss
description: Unleash your lust and your thirst in a battle for the soul of London! Will passion lead you back to humanity, or will you embrace the night as a vampire?

title: Up Against Aliens
description: Navigate cosmic debris using time-bending tech in this 3D platformer. Solve puzzles and thwart the alien threat across shifting landscapes. Will you be Earth's unexpected savior when you go Up Against Aliens?

title: Tom the Postgirl
description: Join Tom, the village’s new postgirl, and get to know the locals, perhaps a little too well. Her method, although controversial, is highly effective: intense, obsessive stalking.

title: Too Shroom!
description: Slash your way through hoards of hellish shrooms, defending your once peaceful land, or attacking the infinite procedural enemy fortress! Choose upgrades that synergize with your build to survive as long as possible against the infinitely scaling waves of monsters attempting to overwhelm you!

title: Towerbolt
description: Towerbolt is a fast paced vertical platformer set in the year 239X. Race to the top of a cyberpunk Megatower while outrunning lethal security lasers on every floor!

title: They Come In Waves
description: Forge your path through unending zombie swarms! Craft inferno-spewing flamethrowers & explosive rocket launchers for ultimate undead domination. How long will you survive?

title: ThinkExplosive
description: ThinkExplosive is a first-person puzzle-platformer about bombs! Throw bombs to overcome obstacles - or launch yourself to new heights! Explore the corridors of an abandoned facility and discover new game mechanics.

title: The Weird Dream
description: The Wierd Dream is a hand-drawn anime style 2D horizontal action-adventure Metroidvania game. You play as a mysterious Rabbit in the middle of a destroyed city. Defeat residents who have been alienated and continue to improve yourself to finally unlock the ultimate secret behind.

title: The Last Braincell
description: Do you ever want to revisit the good old days of bouncing screen savers? Well not only can you do that you can also add whatever images you'd like to it, customize its background to whatever you'd want it to be, and even play around with them as you brain blast your last few brain cells!

title: The Rabbit Haul
description: The Rabbit Haul is a tower defense farming game with roguelite elements where you grow a healthy ecosystem of plants that yield crops during the day and that will help defend your farm from the Trash Panda Posse at night.

title: The Last General
description: Lead your army through raging conflicts in this massive RTS modern war game. Execute tactics and conquer the resources you need to achieve your goals. Take the enemy territory, perform assassinations, lead insurrections, rescue your stranded troops and much more, in millions of different missions.

title: Telebbit
description: No future for mankind. Now, rabbits rule the world. A fast-paced platform game using teleporters.

title: The Amazing Crackpots Club!
description: The Amazing Crackpots Club! is a fast-paced, action-packed magic duel in a 2D arena, where wizards throw powerful spells trying to destroy the opponent’s pots, while using mobility and defensive abilities to protect their own pots from incoming attacks.

title: The Backrooms: Unbounded
description: The Backrooms: Unbounded is a Free single player first person body camera horror game based on the backrooms. You take the role of a police officer who noclips out of reality while on duty. Will you make it out alive?

title: The Attic
description: Visual Novel and Walking Simulator style game with multiple endings. A love letter to the classical horror stories about old haunted houses, basements and ofcourse attics. Psychological horror inspired by author's experience with OCD-like symptoms and intrusive thoughts.

title: The Garden of Silvergrass
description: The main character, Naho, meets a mysterious fox spirit named Semi in a silver grass field. Fall into her lovely charm. The closer you get to her, the more you will face her and your dark past. Can your choice create a new future?

title: Stormworks: Space
description: Stormworks: Space is the space mechanics and moon location expansion for Stormworks. This expansion includes the vacuum of space, the moon, and all new space-grade components and equipment.

title: Starship Troopers: Terran Command - Raising Hell
description: A series of 7 new missions tell the story of the struggle on planet Gehenna - an unforgiving hellscape engulfed in molten lava, volcanic eruptions, and hordes of Arachnids.

title: Square City Builder
description: Build the small pixel city of your dreams! From classic city-building games, Square City Builder offers various ways to customize your gameplay, from constructing houses, farms, or roads to facing random events. In this game, you're in control!

title: Shutdown.
description:
Play as a Doll on the operating table. You have mere minutes before you're disassembled and dead... But who is that, picking away at your rivets.?

☆1000 words, 1 sprite, 1 background, 1 song, 1 sound effect, 4 endings and a single shared fate.

title: Side by Size
description: Side by Size is a puzzle game where taking damage and healing changes the puzzle layout. Purposefully get hurt to open the way to the exit in 100 hand crafted puzzles!

title: Slime Masters
description: In Slime Masters, defend the town from menacing monsters as a valiant hero. Choose from 5+ unique characters, level up, acquire powers, and embark on quests. Unleash strategic combat and become the legendary Slime Master in this endless adventure of bravery and heroism.

title: Secrets of the Haunted Mansion
description: "Secrets of the Haunted Mansion" is an immersive interactive adventure game that transports players into the dark and mysterious world of an abandoned and haunted estate. Step into the shoes of an explorer, ready to unearth forgotten secrets and unravel intriguing puzzles.

title: Seer's Gambit
description: Seer's Gambit is a strategic, semi-auto battler that rewards smart positioning, player agency and building a team that plays to each character’s strength. Explore a perilous world to unlock new heroes for the perfect team composition or upgrade nodes for powerful group buffs.

title: Sex Story: Cuckold Life - Episode 3
description: A steamy Visual Novel featuring high-definition graphics and realistic-looking characters set in beautiful decor. The story continues with Nikki going to the gym on a Saturday morning, attempting to seduce her new smoking hot trainer for a quickie, despite her husband’s reluctance.

title: Raioh
description: Raioh is a retro style shot and bomb style vertical scroll shmup.

title: Samawa Idle
description: Unleash the power of specialized towers to annihilate hordes of monsters in this idle game with roguelike elements. Collect gold, level up your towers, face powerful bosses, and refine your strategy with an evolving skill tree.

title: Royal Romances: Endless Winter - Collector's Edition
description:
Sometimes saving one life can change the fate of many. Can you melt the ice in people's hearts?
The Collector’s Edition includes:
An all-new story in the bonus chapter!
Replay your favorite mini-games and hidden-object scenes whenever you want!
Tons of achievements to unlock!
Keep an eye out for secret collectibles and morphing objects!

title: Realm of Dread
description: Take a step into the Realm of Dread's world of horror and suspense. Explore mysterious locations, fight for survival within the realm of supernatural entities and uncover the secrets hidden in the shadows. This journey through darkness requires courage and intellect. Are you ready?

title: Project Otherside
description: Project Otherside is a horror exploration game. Where players will be transported to an otherworldly dimension where they must navigate through endless spaces while being pursued by nightmarish entities..

title: Wild Wild Eden
description: Survive a primitive fantasy world in Wild Wild Eden, an open-world survival crafting game where monsters are family. Pet, feed, and protect your companions. As a tribal chief, raise your monster friends, build a thriving base, and explore a harsh yet heartwarming world together.

title: Open Hunting XL
description: Open Hunting XL is a hunting simulator focused on creating a customizable experience. Hunt small game with engaging systems tailored to those animals. Go after deer with challenging realistic gameplay or go for a casual day out hunting after tweaking your experience to what you enjoy.

title: Operation Noogy
description: Dive into a rhythmic shooting range adventure where precision meets melody. Unlock diverse firearms, ascend the ranks, and groove to the beats in this captivating casual shooter. Challenge your aim, reward your skill, and immerse yourself in the ultimate aim-and-groove experience!

title: Ooze: The Great and Powerful
description: Ooze: The Great and Powerful - is a puzzle platformer without the ability to jump. In this adventure, you will learn the story of classic monsters who are trying to get along with each other by playing for the Ooze Cube guarding the dungeon.

title: My Legend of Immortal Cultivation
description: Immortal cultivation hanging game, with a rich system, experience the world of immortal cultivation

title: My Father's House
description: My Father's House is a first-person indie survival horror game. The father’s old mansion becomes a maze of nightmares when the secrets of the past are released. Survive, save resources, solve puzzles and stay in the shadows. Ingenuity and tactics are your only way to escape.

title: Milky Way Jigsaw Puzzles
description: Embark on a cosmic journey with "Milky Way Jigsaw Puzzles". Solve puzzles featuring stars, galaxies, and celestial wonders while unlocking Steam Achievements. Dive deep into the universe, learn astronomical facts, and connect with fellow puzzle enthusiasts. Your galactic adventure awaits!

title: Monument Village
description: Monument village is a turn-based pacific medieval city-builder. Optimize the placement of each building to grow your village while fulfilling mandatory resource requests. When you are ready, gather workers and materials and finally build the monument of your dream.

title: Modulor
description: A perma-death action rogue-like FPS, where you get gun modules, create crazy combinations and bulid a unique gun every run to shoot through procedurally generated dungeons and slay bosses.

title: Missile Dancer 2
description: Missile Dancer 2 is a new sprite scaler shmup that combines rail shooter and caravan STG.

title: MimiCries
description: Investigate the mysteries of a haunted mansion as you solve various challenging puzzles in this Victorian-inspired, narrative-driven escape room game. With only your wit and a lantern to light the way forward, will the choices you make seal your fate, or open the path to freedom?

title: Midnight at the Disco
description: Annihilate massive hordes of evil alien eyeball monsters as you struggle to survive a full day on the dance floor. Choose from a diverse set of character traits, weapons and upgrades to create unique builds on each run to blast the baddies into oblivion.

title: Metal Bringer
description: In this roguelike action-adventure, control humanoid "Labor" and giant "Arms" to uncover the mysteries of the world. Create fully-customizable robots, strengthen them, and take down hordes of enemies!

title: MannaRites Gold
description: Gold edition of the warmly received fantasy 2.5D hack-n-slash / RPG - MannaRites! Cut your way through enemy troops, explore open map, find and equip legendary weapons, armor and artifacts, level up your hero! Defend your lands from invaders!

title: Manhattan Dolls
description: "Manhattan Dolls" is a point-and-click adventure game with RPG and dating sim elements. Play as either a lesbian woman or as a straight man and romance your way around The Big Apple. Meet beautiful women and see what crazy adventures lie in store for you on this epic night about town!

title: Mature Comedy Visual Novel
description: Experience a world filled with awful people - and you're one of them! You embark on a journey to get your awful catgirl girlfriend some illicit materials, intense and prolonged misery immediately ensues.

title: Maid Cafe: Maid Girls Comics
description: New content in the form of comics to collect and read in game, new desserts and new in-game content are added with this DLC. Enjoy the fully uncensored comics within the game at any time as you play via the in-game phone.

title: Maid Cafe: Monstrous Beauties Comics
description: New content in the form of comics to collect and read in game, new desserts and new in-game content are added with this DLC. Enjoy the fully uncensored comics within the game at any time as you play via the in-game phone.

title: UnReaMod
description: Experience Lumina Leap: Leap to the beat of neon through dazzling levels.Master the jumps, shine on the leaderboards.Dive into the light action!

title: Locura
description: Locura is a first-person immersive horror game. It is a thrilling journey into the unknown. Prepare for moral ambiguity where the line between light and darkness blurs.

title: Little Dew Drop
description: Little Dew Drop is a small, relaxing and slow-paced 2D platformer. Enjoy the original soundtrack while travelling through six increasingly challenging levels.

title: Line Time
description: 《Line Time》is a puzzle game based on “controlling the timeline”.

title: Life Museum
description: A side-scrolling puzzle game in line style. You take on the role of an office worker who, after working day after day, decides to explore the city. Play with keyboard or Xbox controller.

title: Lawin Catch The Kim
description: Lawin Catch The Kim is a fun puzzle game~Chicken Kim never eats and runs wild outside every day. As Kim's good friend, you need to take them all back to the chicken coop and eat obediently! The game is always given 20 levels.Take all Kim home!

title: Kill a Million Rats
description: A roguelite bullet-heaven RTS, set in a forest invaded by an endless horde of Rats. As the Spirit of Vengeance, you must save the adorable, innocent animals. Explore a randomly generated world, harvest resources, rebuild the Hidden Village, recruit allies, and Kill a Million Rats!

title: IronWolf: Free Non-VR Edition
description: This is the Free Non-VR version of IronWolf VR. A co-op submarine game with a light touch on realism, making the submarine sim genre accessible to a wider audience.

title: Jewel Match Atlantis Solitaire 4: Collector's Edition
description: Immerse yourself in the enchanting depths of the mystical underwater realm of Atlantis Solitaire! Delve into numerous intricate underwater levels and build stunning aquatic landscapes. Tackle the latest Supersize, Challenge, and Match-2 levels as you unlock a multitude of new solitaire variations.

title: Jump Malcolm Jump
description: Embark on a jump-filled odyssey in "Jump Malcolm Jump," a 3D platformer that blends arcade excitement with daring dashes. Collect Energy Orbs across stunning worlds and dash past obstacles. Casual fun meets high-flying action!

title: Gloomy Village
description: Gloomy Village is an erotic adventure with elements of survival. You are in the role of a big-breasted treasure hunter and adventurer - Evelyn.

title: Flips¿de
description: Flips¿de is an RPG where Sam and her roommates are getting ready to move out of their apartment, but the night before they leave, a mysterious leak leads to a strange world with even stranger people. Can Sam navigate this world, fix the leak, and get her security deposit back?

title: Gobs and Gods
description: The tactical RPG going full Goblin mode! Hire a band of almost-heroic goblins to fight and die for you in tactical turn-based battles, accomplish silly quests for the weird inhabitants of this fantastic world, and truly become a god - at least by goblin standards.

title: Hero or Villain: Genesis - Supercharged!
description: Over 40 new powers! Five new side missions to patrol the streets, go skiing with your favorite characters or discover the legacy of vampire hunters!

title: Hoops World
description: Relax and shoot some hoops around the world!

title: Harem! Ranch Life
description: This is a relaxing farm RPG game where you can earn money by collecting and raising livestock! Interact with adorable villagers to increase your popularity in the village through chatting and giving gifts. Please enjoy a cozy farm life in this small village!

title: Heroes & Redemption
description: Heroes & Redemption is a rogue-lite bullet-hell where you face hordes of enemies, annihilate them, learn new abilities and enhance your skills. Explore different regions, acquire new companions and embark on adventures again and again.

title: Grunenberg
description: "Grunenberg" is a single-player horror game that utilizes the visual and sound design of VHS tapes. The protagonist, Jimmy Solomon, comes to the abandoned area named Grunenberg to find his grandfather and captures everything he sees on the camera as his grandfather's request.

title: Enigmatic Worlds
description: Explore strange and abstract worlds filled with equally unusual but deadly beings of many types. Enigmatic Worlds is an FPS inspired by obscure retro-styled FPS games and Amiga games.

title: Duckball
description: Duckball is an action-packed battle royale game where up to 100 players compete to be the last duck standing. Play with friends online and collect wacky items to knock your opponents off the stage in an ever changing 3D environment. Do you have what it takes to be truly glorious?

title: Dualis
description: Dualis is a sci-fi horror thriller whose story takes you to an underground research complex. You will have to fight not only for your life, but also to understand if you really exist. What is consciousness and personality are the questions you will have to ask yourself.

title: DropingBalls
description: This is a simple casual game for avoiding falling balls. You can move the protagonist through AWSD to exercise your reaction and planning abilities while resting. It comes with a maximum survival time recording mechanism.

title: Fate of Aruna
description: A science fiction and high fantasy role playing game which takes place amid the ruins of a shattered planet.

title: Fate and Life: The Mystery of Vaulinhorn
description: Fate and Life: The Mystery of Vaulinhorn is a visual novel game set in an enigmatic city rife with mystery and lust. Navigate the intertwining paths of fate and desire, unearth the haunting secrets of Vaulinhorn, and revel in the thrill of its sensual encounters.

title: Farther Forest
description: Farther forest - is a 2D platform game with RPG elements. Kill different enemies with your weapons! Complete different tasks and deal with the monsters that stand in your way, and beware of deadly traps.

title: Estate Agent Simulator
description: Estate Agent Simulator lets you enter the exciting world of the real estate market. You can buy, decorate, advertise, rent or sell houses. You can buy vacant land and build houses. Environmental factors will affect the rental prices of houses.

title: Escape Escape
description: You awaken in a mysterious room and promptly clear items from the desk. The individual behind this watches in surprise on the monitor. "Hey! What are you doing? Let me play my game!" "Escape Escape" is an adventure where you explore, interact, and advance through maps and characters.

title: Eon Rush
description: Eon Rush - a real-time action RPG that combines the best of endgame PvE and PvP thrills, skipping the filler and getting straight into the fun. Players dive into a variety of trials, including taking down colossal monsters, competing in challenging gauntlets, and engaging in heart-pounding battles.

title: DMVR
description: I taught myself how to drive by making this game.

title: Draco and the Seven Scales
description: Take on the role of a pirate captain as he sets sail to save his greatest treasure of all. Draco and the Seven Scales is a retro-inspired adventure that hearkens back to an age of top-down dungeon crawlers and lovable, crunchy pixel art. Melodic shanties will guide your way through this sprawling world full of dangerous enemies, items to collect, and a dark force that seeks to corrupt. Will you break free from a kraken's dooming bargain, or be another victim?

title: Carnival Survivors The Parade
description: A musical rogue-like adventure where you lead a band of adorable cats. Feel the rhythm-based abilities to unlock new band members, levels, and songs. Each member brings unique instruments and abilities, allowing you to overcome the hordes of enemies with the power of music!

title: Dark Age
description: Dark Age is a futuristic 3D action game with refined low poly design. Enjoy this frenetic Beat 'em up.

title: Descentia
description: We fused card games and open-world rpg together to make the best single player open world deckbuilder we could. Build your party with different races, craft a unique deck, encounter bizarre creatures, complete the quests and get ready for a breathtaking adventure

title: Crowned Control
description: A couch co-op multiplayer game, where the goal is to grab the crown and keep it on your head for as long as possible to win the game!

title: Crimson Crisis
description: Embrace the chaos… Battle aliens, shoot guns and, above all else, survive to work anotherday in Crimson Crisis, a sci-fi action-roguelite set in a post-apocalyptic universe.

title: Cozy Fishing
description: Cozy Fishing is a game where you can chill and fish to grow your aquarium fish collection in chilling environments and a relaxing atmosphere.

title: Cosmorists
description: Explore, and exploit your surroundings to advance! Unlock crafting recipes in a tech tree via research, and crafting science. Explore the surface, or deep in the caves, and protecting yourself against the elements in dangerous areas, or relaxing in safe areas!

title: Code, Solve, Revolt!
description: "Code, Solve, Revolt!" is a puzzle game where you solve factory tasks through intuitive drag-and-drop programming. Write code for your robot to clear each level, delve deeper into the factory, encounter new puzzle concepts and data-structure creatures, and uncover the truth.

title: Bounty Hunters
description: Fight in a top down 2d shooter adventure with resource gathering / bullet heaven/hell mechanics.

title: Blue Ridge Hunting
description: Blue Ridge Hunting is a co-op horror game where you and your friends investigate, document, and hunt cryptids in the Appalachian Mountains.

title: Broken Life
description: BROKEN LIFE is an atmospheric, fully voiced point-and-click adventure set in a war-torn world. Follow Leo, a former soldier, as he returns to his hometown to uncover the fate of his family, restore his home, and confront the dark secrets hidden within.

title: Brews & Bastards
description: Brews & Bastards is a chaotic co-op dungeon crawler for 1-4 players, overflowing with action-packed combat, magical brews and outlandish tavern games. Select from a group of distinct heroes and blast your way through hordes of drunken demons in search of the stolen Brew Stone.

title: Bright Side: Riddles & Puzzles
description: Who is lying? Who will survive? Which way is safe? Watch unusual stories and solve tricky riddles with your friends or solo!

title: Bunny's Pizza Tycoon
description: Open and customize an old restaurant! Inspired by the fnaf series, you play the role of a company owner during the day and a worker during the night. Buy Items during the day and maybe make a little bonus cash during the nights so you can make money the next day!

title: Bunny Bond
description: Bunny Bond is a steamy visual novel where you can chat, flirt, and fall in love with 6 handsome guys! Enjoy fun interactions with the group, send DMs to whoever catches your eye, and collect all of the sexy pictures they send to you!

title: Bump and Run Racing
description: Get ready to tear up the streets and smash your way to the finish line! Bump & Run Racing is an ode to classic arcade racers where crashing opponents is not only allowed, but encouraged.

title: Buhei
description: Dive into an action-packed Twin Stick Party Shooter! Grab your friends and engage in explosive multiplayer battles, whether you're playing right next to them on the couch or from a distance.

title: Coke Bugs
description: A hallucinatory bender of a late night road trip sketched in nervous lines of arcade action and exploration.

title: Chaos Crafters
description: Learn, craft and test spells on any element of the game! Solve puzzles or fight enemies alone or in co-op. Be careful, your friends are not immune to your magic and one wrong move could cause total chaos.

title: Cadde
description: Are you ready to let it rip in the streets of İstanbul? Cadde combines fun physics, realistic sound design and the atmospheric air of İstanbul.

title: C.I.E.B The Backrooms Project
description: Prepare. Explore. Survive. Extract. Profit. You will explore the infinite backrooms and bring back proof of your journey. In return I will allow you to browse a catalog so our scientist can increase your odds at survival. You will have to cover some expenses like body upkeep and so forth. Good Luck.

title: Age of Goblins
description: Conquer caves, farms and towers to expand your might and raise your tribe of goblins to the heights it deserves. Age of Goblins is a real-time strategy (RTS) game with simplified mechanics where your goal is to dominate the entire map and subdue your rival tribes.

title: Adventure Story
description: Play the role of the Adventure Guild President of the Magic World. Manage and utilize every resource at hand. Dig out legendary stories from various regions and spread your guild name throughout the entire empire. Finally, obtain powerful artifacts hidden around the world.

title: Blood, Fuel, Ammo & Speed
description: Blood, Fuel, Ammo & Speed is a Fast Paced Rogue-lite Action Fps Game. Pour Out Fuel and Ammo and Dance In Blood With Speed. KILL THE DEMONS.

title: Beyond Hanwell
description: Step into Hanwell and discover a world beyond it. Set in the deeper parts of London, explore Westminster and uncover the truth about the enigmatic stranger known as The Director. Fight with whatever you can find or use the environment to take out Anomolies.

title: Beasts of Steel
description: Beasts of Steel is a semi-realistic WWII game that combines FPS and Strategy where you can battle solo or online. Experience intense combat as an infantryman, tank crew, or take to the skies as a pilot. Unleash chaos and dominate the battlefield!

title: Bancroft Academy
description: "Bancroft Academy" plunges you into the vibrant and unpredictable world of college life, with an enchanting twist. In this adult visual novel, every choice you make shapes the narrative, leading you down thrilling paths of romance, mystery, and magic.

title: Athos
description: Welcome to a captivating journey into the world of Athos. Build a formidable base to protect yourself from the wild and unpredictable environment, and master the art of taming mighty dinosaurs to be your loyal companions. Welcome to a world where survival is not just a choice but a way of life!

title: Maid Cafe
description: Meet over 30 cute girls and win their hearts. Experience sexy sequences. Become the best pastry chef at a bake-off competition. Use your tips to take girls out on dates. Make your own choices at the Maid Cafe!

title: Gelluloid Domination: SpaceLab Simulator
description: Run a spaceship's lab module all by yourself while trying to find a cure for close-to-extinct humanity. Make repairs to various systems of the ship, solve technical problems, perform maintenance, and upgrade tools that will help you to overcome the most unusual challenges.

title: Honey's Sweet Revenge
description: Honey's Sweet Revenge is a metroidvania with mechanics inspired by platform fighters. Customize your item loadout and defeat enemies and bosses.

title: 3am in Leicester
description: Walk the streets of Leicester City and collect food. Become sober. Stay alert. There are ghosts. Made with the Godot Engine.

title: Crystal Ball Critters
description: Crystal Ball Critters is a multiplayer ball-racing game, in which you race your friends through our antagonist's carefully thought out multiverse of adventures! Play by yourself or against up to 4 of your friends to find out who can beat each stage first.

title: Stations in Seoul: Open World Card RPG
description: Immerse yourself in the captivating universe of our enthralling prequel to Find with Seoul. This game beautifully weaves together the exciting elements of a card game RPG with a fascinating narrative that propels you on a quest for continuous development.

title: In the Same Boat
description: Embark on an adventure across the ocean! In this captivating cooperative sailing game, one player commands the ship, while the other is confined to the captain's cabin, solely navigating with the map. Successfully delivering goods on time will demand the crew's adept communication and skill.

title: Red Lightning
description: A retro style, 2D top-down action/adventure game in the vein of NES archetypes. Couch style local co-op or solo.

title: Japanese Rural Life Adventure
description: Experience countryside living in Japanese Rural Life Adventure. "View the cherry blossoms in the spring, attend the festival in the summer, eat roasted sweet potatoes in the fall, hear the temple bell ring in winter, and then it's time for the first shrine visit of the New Year."

title: Tower Pets
description: Build the perfect team and compete with other players to win the tournament!

title: Froggies at the Zoo
description: Dive into a whimsical world of hopping fun and ribbiting excitement in Froggies at the Zoo! Join our charming amphibian friends on a delightful adventure that will have you leaping with joy.

title: Shadows of Revenge
description: Shadows of Revenge puts you into the sinister heart of a mafia-dominated Manhattan. As the boss of a once-proud family now fallen into disgrace, your journey to reclaim the city will test your wit, resourcefulness and determination.

title: Little Mages
description: Defend your castle from various hordes of enemies that seek to invade it! Little Mages is a casual pixel art game with roguelite elements where you accumulate knowledge and learn powerful spells of your choice to defeat all your enemies.

title: Armored Souls
description: Armored Souls is a 2D Soulslike Action game with Roguelike elements and challenging boss fights set in a machine-driven dystopia. Navigate a beautifully desolate world, scrap enemies for parts and return to your foundry to assemble a variety of game-changing skills, programs and mechanical upgrades.

title: Zombies, Aliens and Guns
description: Earth’s last hope against an invasion is a band of military rebels Zombies! Aliens! Guns! Enough said.

title: Adventurer Farmer: Save my Son!
description: Use the dynamics of movement with the rope to take the character to the rescue of his son, who accidentally fell out of the plane, while traveling from the farm to the city. Take advantage of the boosts provided by the physics on the map and stay away from dangerous obstacles. Save the farmer's son!

title: Blitz Runner
description: In Blitz Runner, you'll dash through colorful landscapes, collecting dazzling gems that not only increase your score but also your speed! The more gems you collect, the faster you run, making every game a unique and exhilarating journey.

title: Evil Diary
description: Evil diary is a shooting game where you control the character Eve with a mission to escape the city to survive in this apocalyptic world.

title: The Bearer & The Last Flame
description: The Bearer & The Last Flame is a dark fantasy action adventure. In a realm where death is rampant, a living soul has received his commission, to carry the last flame and light the lands of the night, the dark lands.

title: Pedro of Brazil
description: Delve into the epic saga of the Brazilian Empire in "Pedro of Brazil". Master gunfights, swordplay, and hand-to-hand combat. Play as historic figures and immerse yourself in events like the Brazilian Independence and the Paraguayan War. Relive the glory and challenges of an era!

title: A Nutritious Boyfriend
description: Amazing! You have just started a new position as a professional trainer at the prestigious Squirrel Fitness Club, a club for dedicated squirrels! Motivate and coach squirrel members until you stumble upon love with fun obstacles along the way.

title: Mononeko
description: In Mononeko, you weave attacks into the music, chain together movements and race against time to capture the kitten killers who are hiding a dark truth. It’s a quest for justice, set to the beat of your bravery.

title: Soul Drifter
description: Soar into a gravity-defying parkour adventure. Run, jump, and glide through surreal landscapes and deadly factories on a mission to liberate captive souls.

title: Warcana
description: Warcana is a fantasy inspired base defence, RTS game with a deck-building mechanic. Face hundreds of thousands of unrelenting monsters in a battle royale between 30 other mighty magicians. Build your deck. Prepare your defences. Summon your armies. Survive the onslaught. Be the last one standing.

title: Illuminary
description: You find yourself catapulted back in time to the beginning of existence, and into the darkness where everything began. The Universe is yet to be born from a glimmer of light. You are called to discover and co-create a new existence with the help of colours and sound.

title: Black Jackal
description: Pilot your way through the deadly remains of derelict spacecraft, solve their mysteries, and get out with everything that isn't nailed down.

title: Century of Anticipation
description: Locked away at home, time slows to a crawl, your only company is yourself. In this short adventure, your challenge might be the toughest of all: make time pass again!

title: Axembler
description: Axembler is a collection of single-level games developed in a single application.

title: Hooked
description: Escape the chaos of modern life in Rosewood, a quaint town nestled in the heart of nature. With nothing but a patch of land by the lake and a burning passion for fishing, are you ready to seize the opportunity and build a thriving business that rivals even the biggest city corporations?

title: You've been ReMaid!
description: Run for your life as you try to survive the night while being stalked by a cute maid who is dead set on teaching you some manners. Uncover secrets, outsmart your enemies, and embrace the absurd. Will you make it through the night?

title: Neo Dance
description: Discover Neo Dance, the exciting 4-point music game! Immerse yourself in a dystopian cyberpunk world and face, to the rhythm of music, hundreds of robots in this unique experience. Are you ready for the rhythmic battle?

title: Bunraku
description: Experience the ancient art of Bunraku theater in fast-paced puppet battles between up to 8 players. Dash through your opponents, master the art of parrying and use all kinds of jutsus and shinobi tools to perform the best ninja show.

title: Mecha Knights: Nightmare - Operation Ascalon Expansion
description: Echo Team will be sent on a dangerous mission deep behind enemy lines. Uncover a new chapter in the game's story, featuring seven missions and a new tier of advanced parts and weapons.

title: Split Echo
description: Split Echo is a Co-op only game, two players require their own copy of the game. The game also relies on communicating with each other.

title: Samira's House
description: Uncover the dark secrets of Samira´s House! Explore a haunted house, solve puzzles, and confront ghosts. Can you escape in time?

title: Olho Spectral
description: An RPG game following the style of the nineties classics. Turn-based battles, 3D scenery and pixelated graphics. Two worlds in parallel dimension to be explored. Dungeons full of puzzles and sinister monsters to defeat.

description: It will be a journey from scratch where you'll need to tend to your farm with a lot of hard work while striving on a mission to reestablish the city's guild for gaining recognition and respect.

title: Shadows Are Alive
description: Enter the ever-changing world of Shadows Are Alive! Team up, channel epic alter-egos, and outwit "The Shift" in a shape-shifting haunted mansion. Relentless suspense, vibrant visuals, and unmatched strategy. Can you escape the mansion before time runs out?

title: Quadrilla
description: Quadrilla is about high scores, big combos and simple arcade fun. Dig out and re-arrange blocks, clear lines, carve a path!

title: GallowsHill
description: GallowsHill is a test of wit. A unique falling block puzzle, you command cells, aligning color and frame to trigger effects. Your goal? Erase the star and claim victory. GallowsHill is a battlefield for thinkers, a challenge of intellect. Are you ready to carve your path of victory?

title: Hunters: Uprising
description: Hunters: Uprising is a hardcore, tactical PvPvE first-person shooter. Track and kill dangerous alpha monsters in the infested zones around the world, kill nightmarish monsters and outwit other players - alone or in a group. Then rest in the safe zone, upgrade your base, hunt, fish and survive.

title: Repair Adventure
description: "An adventure to fix a 34 year old car"

title: School Labyrinth
description: School Labyrinth is a co-op horror survival game for max 4 players. You can join your friends and try to escape from the process-generated school maze.

title: Bearnard
description:
"Bearnard" is a captivating single-player adventure game where you step into the furry paws of Bearnard, a valiant archer-bear on a mission to reclaim a legendary bow and protect his beloved forest from threats. This journey takes players through diverse biomes, including dense forests, dark mines, snowy mountains, abandoned castles, and mysterious dungeons, each presenting unique challenges and enemies.

The game features a core turn-based battle system where strategic card use is essential for victory. Mastering tactical combat aspects, players will rely on archery as their primary weapon. Collecting and strategically deploying a variety of cards, ranging from common to legendary, is crucial. These cards offer powers like healing, defense, and enemy control, enabling powerful combos. As players explore, battle opponents, and uncover secrets, they'll enhance their archery skills, expand their deck, and unlock the full potential of Bearnard's quest. Engage in this rich, story-driven experience, where wit and strategy pave the path to victory.

title: A Song of Sunlight
description: An RPG set in a distant, lonely future. Follow Arem, a young man lured from his small island community to explore the desolate megastructure beneath it: “The Well.” With the simple goal of finding the exit, Arem will burden himself with something more terrible than he ever thought possible.

title: Boyfriend Exorcist
description: You were meant to exorcise the ghost, not flirt with him! Choose your soulmate from ghost enthusiasts – dead or alive – and unravel the conspiracy lurking beneath the haunting in this exorcist dating sim.

title: Only Multiplayer: Up!
description: Get set to defy gravity, leap like never before, and experience the exhilarating world of parkour in a whole new light! This isn’t just your ordinary parkour jump simulator - it’s a dynamic ONLINE MULTIPLAYER adventure that transforms your every move into a gravity-defying spectacle.

description: Use your Match 3 skills for seeking hidden treasures on an uninhabited island!

title: Backrooms: The Phobolore
description: Backrooms: The Phobolore is a cooperative multiplayer online horror game for 1-4 players. In this game you will take control of a character who woke up in an unknown place and does not remember anything, your task will be to pass the game levels trying to remember who you are...

title: Flaw
description: Find a way out of here and get back to earth in FLAW, a retro-FPS inspired by cult classics: Unreal, Quake 2, Half-Life and many others. You and the Flaming Dawn’s passengers were looking for a better life among the stars, you have yet found only despair and darkness.

title: SauceLore
description: Embark on a silly little adventure through the wonderful Kingdom of Daanco! Help Saucey and friends save the kingdom from evil in this Turn-Based Combat RPG!

title: Tradesman: Deal to Dealer
description: TRADESMAN: Deal to Dealer is a game about a merchant who rides around in his horse-drawn (or bear-drawn) cart. Starting his journey in his home village of Grampstead, the Tradesman heads off to the other towns and villages of the world. Stock up on marine morsels in Fishpool, quench your thirst at Grubgrog Village's renowned tavern, sell basic necessities in Hoboken, and trample the dirt in Normingham, the capital of these lands!

title: Parking World: Build & Manage
description: The hunt for the ultimate parking space will never be more fun than with Parking World. Create your parking garage and carefully manage its operations and staff, overcome dynamic events, use the latest technology, and get ready to discover what perfect parking really looks like. From festival lined grass and mud lots to VIP valet parking and the hustle and bustle of a multistoried airport parking garage, the quest for the ideal space is detailed and varied.

title: Miyu's Cursed Store
description: Step into the shoes of a young shopkeeper in this unique RPG sim. Thrive in commerce and battles, defining your legacy in the underworld.

description: Oni Station is a horror game with roguelike and arcade elements where you pilot a train to outrun the creature chasing you. Carefully plan which stations to stop, search for resources and, above all, how far can you survive?

description: Welcome to the Sandbox World! Here, you bring your ideas to life: create tanks, airplanes, ships, and anything else – with over 120 unique blocks at your disposal. Engage, defend, and showcase your masterpieces in exhilarating battles that await you!

title: Paver Simulator
description: Did you ever dream to become a paving artist? Perform tasks, during which the most important thing is creativity and precision. According to your design you lay different types of paving stones, so you earn money and raise the level of your reputation. Test your skills in the Paver Simulator

description: Prepare to embark on an adrenaline-fueled journey through the chaotic realms of the apocalypse in this intense bullet hell. In a world teetering on the edge of oblivion, you must harness your reflexes, strategic prowess, and sheer determination to survive the onslaught of otherworldly adversaries.

title: Simulakros
description:
Fight the evil CORP from the inside. Confront deadly robots in this fast-paced third person shooter with rogue-lite elements.

Defy the CORP by using their own creation against them, the Simulakros Unit, equipped with advanced weapons and abilities to wreak havoc to their facilities.

Inside the CORP facilities you will discover powerful chips that you can equip to permanently improve your ability to control Simulakros Units. Each run will grant you experience, allowing you to equip more and more!

Learn survival skills, build relationships and face tough choices as each passing day brings new tragedies and destruction to your childhood home.

description: Drăculești is a villain-focused reimagining of the classic novel Dracula that shines a light on the shadowy figures of Renfield, Dracula's Brides, and Dracula himself. Be enthralled by the residents of Castle Dracula, and thrill at a dark narrative with strong LGBTQI+ themes.

title: Pawafuru Puroyakyu: Eikan Nine Crossroad
description:
Eikan Nine is a mode in which you become a high school baseball coach, train your team, and lead them to the Koshien Japan National High School Baseball Tournament.

Powerful Pro Baseball Eikan Nine Crossroad retains the traditional Eikan Nine setup, but adds new elements for even deeper team building, including “Scholarship Students,” “Growth Board,” and “Rival Schools.”

title: Snowdrop the Blade Master
description: It's a deck building roguelike game with a feature, where the card you played leave a shard that can be used as an extra assistance that will help you to reach your goal.

title: Little Loki & The Yggdrasil Maze
description: A hundred years ago, the defeated Demon Lord Loki has now been resurrected! Disregarding the dissuasion of his former subordinates, Loki is determined to reach the Yggdrasil. Faced with powerful enemies, will Loki be able to succeed in seeking revenge?
