description: Hunt down tax-evading mutant billionaires and reinvest in society in this narrative Action Rogue-lite meets Political Sim.

title: Lovanium: The Rising Suns
description: Find a way to escape Lovanium before it's too late. Extract resources, trade them, confront the wildest and most dangerous enemies, and fully harness the power of the suns. Are you up for it?

title: Thunder War Rabbit Alien Fight
description: A Cosmic Battle Begins: Thunder War Rabbit to the Rescue!

title: Horses
description: In Horses, you will take on the role of a summer worker taking a break from his college studies. You will be responsible for taking care of the farm and its animals for a fortnight. Each day, as you explore the farm, you'll encounter many "surprises," peeling back the layers of the farm's unsettling mysteries.

title: WiZmans World ReTry
description: This is a remaster of Jaleco’s RPG WiZmans World released in 2010 on Nintendo DS, now in HD with a 16:9 screen ratio.

title: The Fox Awaits Me Hana
description: In "The Fox Awaits Me Hana," players take on the role of a young man named Takahiro who, after getting lost in the mountains, stumbles upon a mysterious shrine dedicated to the fox deity. He is then suddenly transported to a mystical world where he meets a beautiful fox girl named Hana. As the story progresses, Takahiro learns more about Hana and her past, and the player's choices will determine the outcome of the game.

title: Pettson o Findus i Snickarbon
description: Pettson o Findus i snickarbon is an edutainment game with a collection of mini-games situated in Pettson's workshop. Players will choose a guard for their treasure chest and then will be able to collect gold feathers for every completed activity within the game. Other things can also be collected if found like pieces of a map.

title: Cypher 007
description: Cypher 007 is a top-down mobile action game published by Tilting Point. Inspired by 60 years of Spycraft and Cypher 007, players will experience the world of Agent 007 to revisit Bond's most iconic moments and locations. Players are tasked with defeating criminal mastermind Blofeld, head of Spectre, by gathering intel, uncovering secrets, and overcoming immersive levels filled with obstacles, opponents, and objectives that increase in difficulty as they progress. Compete against other 007 agents worldwide via leaderboards to prove who is on top.

title: Address1
description: 2D style shoot'em up in which close combat is the primary attack method. With two large swords in her hands, cut her way through enemy bullets and enemy units in a post-apocalyptic world.

description: Match blobs together, create chain reactions and don't run out of time!

description: Blast off into space! Help Monica and her team explore the galaxy, fight off hordes of enemies, and clean up the mysterious cosmic gel in this retro-arcade inspired action shooter!

title: Crazy Kitchen
description: Hordes of Hungrys are coming in waves. Protect the Kitchen and its precious snacks at all costs!

description: Mow down all who stand in the way of your Crusade. Become a benevolent conqueror, or a brutal oppressor to those you achieve victory over. Your actions decide the fate of the planet.

Woody's Incredible Journey to the Escape from Eternal Terror

description: Relive the classic gameplay of an old-school MMORPG. Select a class that suits your style and join your friends to explore the vast world of Trimurti Online. Enhance your equipment and maximize your skills to complete quests, confront monsters and bosses, conquer dungeons, and fight other players!

title: Donny Donut: Dokrats
description:
Donny, Donno and Donna were invited to the ceremony of collaboration with Candy-Land and an other continent, Food-City. Everything was going perfect until a strange wizard, named Brook, enters the President's Palace. He wants to conquer the world and shape it at his mind, with the power of the Dokrats Relics. These are ancient relics from an old civilization, the Dokrats. They are the ancestors of our heroes.
The relics contents an unlimited power that only a pure soul can handle at perfection. Your quest is to get all of the Dokrats Relics and stop Brook. Will you save the world before the revival of the Demon Golem ?

title: Arena Kingdoms
description: Arena Kingdoms is a community battle game where Discord servers play together, compete, and represent their server's HOUSE in weekly Arena Tournaments.

title: Zorropa y La Torre de las Sombras
description:
Zorropa is a young fox that has to leave his house due to some spiky plants growing all over the island, it is at this moment that your adventure begins.
Use your abilities to make your way into towers that behold the power of the sun, maybe with this power you can save the island, or start an adventure and save the world.

title: Candy Rangers
description: Go on a single player, On-Rails Shooter Adventure in Candy Rangers and match 4 colors with 4 rangers! Each ranger can take down enemies that match their color, and it's up to you to use each one accordingly! Can you match them all?

title: Jimmy's Lost Fruits Journey 2: Veggocalypse
description: Jimmy's Lost Fruits Journey 2: Veggocalypse is an Earthworm Jim and Jazz Jackrabbit 2-inspired shoot-em-up platformer with fluent & wacky animation, high-speed moveset, and lots of fruit-filled action!

description:
Use your tongue to pull, sling and swing acrobatically to get around the hazardous underground.
The game focuses on simple platforming gameplay combined with spectacular aerial acrobatics and a cute cartoony artstyle.
It's pure fun for the whole family (it's singleplayer so you're going to have to take turns sorry).

The trio will have to put their skills to the test to conquer many challenges, defeat countless foes, and explore exotic locations with their various abilities and the help of Elemental Charges!

title: Harrow
description: Harrow is a culmination of several nightmares. All of these nightmares were in an old 1995-1998 horror video game setting. It's also heavily inspired by the Silent Hill series, as that has been an influence for many of my nightmares. That's why the game is themed the way that it is. By entering this game, you are entering the embodiment of the nightmares, and because of this, you should proceed with caution.

title: Honey Bunny
description: Honey Bunny is a bartender at Lucky Rabbit's Foot Casino, the cutest casino in all of Starlight City! She's busy at work when the no-good gang, The Cool Cats, steals away the casino and the entire city's supply of cocktail cherries. Chase them down as Honey Bunny using your ears to headbutt enemies, grab items, and platform around the city as you recover as many cherries as possible!

title: Dirappen Restoration
description: The planet has been overrun! Play as the lone Dirappen Soldier Unit D6-4 in its epic quest to defeat the alien invaders and restore the planet of Darptha to the rightful rule of King Darpon.

title: Anjelo's Province
description: Anjelo's Province is a fan-made remake of Anjelo's Land.

title: Meander Land
description: Meander Land is a remake of Anjelo's Province with new original characters, a new story, and a ton of quality-of-life improvements.

title: The Sims 4: Poolside Splash Kit
description: Turn heads at the pool with bright and playful swimwear from The Sims 4 Poolside Splash Kit.

title: Tower of Dreams
description: Climb your way to the top of the tower in this vertical platforming roguelike! Bound off walls, discover fantastical items, and make use of Dream Knight's sword to bounce off of obstacles!

title: The Sims 4: Modern Luxe Kit
description: Treat yourself to luxurious modern furniture that says “I made it” with The Sims 4 Modern Luxe Kit.

title: Arcade Archives: Zing Zing Zip
description:
"ZING ZING ZIP" is a shooter released by ALLUMER in 1992.
Operate the 1P aircraft with fast vertical movement speed or the 2P aircraft with fast horizontal movement speed to defeat the evil empire.
Aim to clear the screen by making full use of various items and rolling special moves that make you invincible or power up while activated

title: Puzzle Journey
description: Puzzle Journey - Go on a Journey, it will be your best relaxing holiday.

title: 2044 Moto Racer: Cyber Racing Simulator
description: Unleash Your Inner Speed Demon in the Neon-Lit Streets!

title: Rally Racing: Cars & Drift Mania
description: Rev up your engines in Rally Racing.

title: Teocida + Estigma
description: Enter the surrealistic horror world of Teocida+Estigma!

title: Isonzo: First Wave
description: Enhance your Isonzo experience by requisitioning a variety of cosmetic Unit Pack DLCs with the Wave sets! First Wave includes all the core Isonzo Unit Pack DLCs: the Reserve Units, Veteran Units, Elite Units, and Alpine Units.

title: Train Simulator: Norfolk Southern SD70ACU
description: Now, you can climb aboard the powerful Norfolk Southern SD70ACU, as created by developer Travel by Train, to haul heavy tonnage in Train Simulator Classic!

title: Hotel Renovator: Disco Room & Furniture Set
description: Get ready to boogie down and transform your hotel into dazzling disco paradises with the Disco Room & Furniture Set for Hotel Renovator! Step into the glitzy world of disco with this sizzling hot DLC that adds a burst of retro energy to your hotel renovations.

title: BobsleighX
description: You will feel the thrill of speed in the BobsleighX.

title: DNF Duel: DLC 2 - Brawler
description: 'Brawler' can be used in DNF Duel.

title: Red Tie Runner
description: Red Tie Runner is a simple but challenging 2D platformer. Put on a red tie and step into stick-figure shoes to navigate through 30 levels so intense you might just forget about the impending heat death of the universe.

title: Travis' Coward Combustion
description:
In this fast-paced action platformer, you delve into Lost Angeles, a city plagued by supernatural parasites called "wisps". Aside from looking suspiciously cute and marketable, wisps can possess human hosts and give them supernatural abilities in exchange for the person's free will. When a wisp gets bored enough, it breaks the connection to find a new host, leaving the current one behind with severe injuries in the process.

In order to protect the city, a governmental organization was created: P.C.E., which exists to Protect, Contain and Exterminate this threat and keep Lost Angeles at peace.

But what happens when someone is unfortunate enough to be possessed by no mere wisp, but one megalomaniac enough to drag its host around in a rampage quest?

title: Susan Taxpayer
description: Susan Taxpayer is a free 2D platformer made in the SMBX2 engine, meant to imitate the likes of the later Wario Land games, with music by the Super Lesbian Animal RPG Composer, Beatrix Quinn! Follow Susan and her coworker Franky as she powers through the worst workday ever. Help her platform through a myriad of office-themed levels, from orientation videos to mailrooms to forests made of printer paper!

title: The Moshpit Tournament
description:
"The Moshpit" is a Horde Mode TPS Single Player game, where you gun down waves of enemy Cyphers that assault you from every side!

Waves ​have a fixed set of points to be won. The faster you complete the wave & squash your opponents, the MORE points you'll WIN!

title: Spasms of Stupidity
description: PC wargame-Roguelike, inspired from DragonForce(Saturn)

title: 100 Halloweens
description: Trapped in a mansion filled with 100 years of darkness... Fight or hide, stay alive and set things right.

title: Nextbots In The Backrooms
description: They only look ridiculous at first glance, but they're not! Run. Don't stop, don't try to hide, just run!

title: CryptoClash
description: Welcome to CryptoClash, the ultimate free-to-play multiplayer shooter that thrusts you into a cyberpunk world like no other. Are you ready to dominate the neon-soaked chaos and emerge as a legendary champion?

title: City Ambulance Car Driving
description: Take ill people to emergency hospital in this ambulance game. If you like to play simulation games, this ambulance game is for you.

title: GravytX The Gravytoid
description: Play as GravytX an alien who has the ability to control objects remotely and manipulate gravity. Travel the universe to save the peoples who are under the domination of the Vodouas (Malicious beings who want to conquer the universe) and bring peace to their Planets.

title: NBA 2K24: 25th Anniversary Edition
description: Grab your squad and experience the past, present, and future of hoops culture in NBA 2K24. Enjoy loads of pure, authentic action and limitless personalized MyPlayer options in MyCareer. Collect an impressive array of legends and build your perfect lineup in MyTEAM. Feel more responsive gameplay and polished visuals while playing with your favorite NBA and WNBA teams.

title: I Can Transform
description: In this game you will use your special costume which allows you to transform into mechanical objects (car, rocket, helicopter, magnet, motorcycle, ...) to avoid obstacles, collect vortex gems in levels and defeat the Assas (the bad guys who want to destroy the world).

title: Light and Shadows: Pocket Islands
description: Light and Shadows: Pocket Islands is a spin-off made for fun, inspired by the retro game of peak 8 where the levels are only simple and challenging while progressing​.

title: ScooMart
description: ScooMart is an indie horror game that plunges you into a meticulously crafted world filled with dread and suspense. As the protagonist, you stumble upon the gas station while on a dreaded road trip. What begins as a routine stop for gas quickly turns into a nightmare of supernatural proportions.

title: Jammo
description: This was an individual project to learn about game development. The game is a third person shooter with some platforming. As you progress through the levels, you will be able to access an array of guns and abilities to help through the game.

title: Hentai Vivian
description: What could be more beautiful than hentai?

title: Scary Maze Game
description: You and up to 5 friends need to find the exit of a maze, beware of the monster that lurks in the shadows.

title: Escape from Toilets
description: Escape from Toilets is a coop horror game 1 to 4 players in a session. Go through strange rooms, escape from toilets that want to kill you and other dangers in the form of challenges and puzzles. Realistic graphics, easy controls and creepy atmosphere will immerse you in the game.

title: Play Minigames with Reiko
description: Build an unbreakable friendship with Reiko as you earn tickets and have fun with over 30 minigames in the exciting world of 'Play Minigames with Reiko'.

title: Dreamsweeper
description:
The floor isn’t lava, it’s Minesweeper!
A Dungeon Crawler x Minesweeper Roguelike and a lo-fi musical experience like no other game before.
Navigate worlds by solving Minesweeper rooms and fight your anxieties with the power of lo-fi music. This is the story of a girl who goes to sleep listening to music every night, and awakens in a dream world to face her nightmarish anxieties.

title: Hunt: Showdown 1896 - When Shadows Dance
description: This DLC contains one Legendary Hunter, two Legendary Weapons, and one Legendary consumable: Hayalî (Legendary Hunter), Karagöz (Legendary Springfield 1866) , Hacivat (Legendary Scottfield Model 3 Swift) & Lamba (Legendary Alert Trip Mine)

title: Black Smith 4
description: You are a blacksmith in a small rural village. You steadfastly earn your living by hammering out products daily, but at night, you take your earnings and go to town to seek out innocent and cute girls. Continue improving your experience and skills, so that you can raise the price of your products.

title: College Sex Party
description: Welcome to the world of College Sex Party - an exciting visual novel that immerses you in an unforgettable and enticing student life!

title: Froggin' Around
description: A little frog in a little pond eatin' bugs, takin' naps, and just froggin' around.

title: Hot Lap Racing
description: Awaken Your Inner Champion! Hot Lap Racing is a simcade racing game where you will discover the history of motorsport from GT Cross to Formula 1 and race against your friends or compete against players online!

title: Degradation: Kyomu's Fury
description: Fight viruses, survive insane waves of rays and bullets, and find out more about the inhabitants of the Network in this mix of exploration and 3D bullet-hell/FPS game.

title: Paraido
description: Paraido is a unique and relaxing puzzle game. Complete levels by moving and rotating hexagonal-shapes into their correct positions.

title: Secrets of the Room 3: The Girl Group Back to the Night
description: Wake up to attach themselves to love beans, it is said that our group to collapse the house? Return to the night, but the sound source was stolen by hackers; Female group members black material scandal is constantly exposed; A thrilling bureau in the bureau, launched at this point......

title: Close to Flight
description: Grab your grappling hook and pack your bag and swing through the skies, filled with floating islands and colourful characters eagerly awaiting new adventures!

title: Barbarian Saga: The Beastmaster
description: A classic hand-drawn 2D Metroidvania action game, it's time for revenge! Use your Beastmaster skills to unleash your inner beast, fight with your heart-devouring sword and end the threat to Arborea, you decide the ending.

title: Yeon-oh and Seo
description: Success and failure, love and friendship, dream and reality. The story about our choices in the meantime. A real passionate romance interactive game.

title: The Boy and the Cathedral
description: Drawn to a mysterious cathedral, a boy sets out to unlock its secret.

title: Hana Exposure! A Blooming Flower
description: Hana Exposure! is an exhibitionism focused narrative RPG. Follow Hana as she works and spends time in River Town, where she will get into embarrassing situations, unintentionally become exposed, wear revealing outfits, and slowly awaken her exhibitionist side!

title: How to Lose One's Virginity
description: "How to Lose One's Virginity" is an adult visual novel that describes the process of self-discovery... and hot beauties. Playing the role of a loser, are you able to change your life and become someone women are very fond of and build your own harem?

title: Spirit of the Island: Adventureland
description: Rejoice, Adventurers: A brand new way to entertain your guests is coming up to the tropical world of Spirit of the Island. Please welcome: Adventureland! Are you ready to build your own tropical amusement park?

title: Myth or Reality: Mystery of the Lake - Collector's Edition
description: Follow the footsteps of the Loch Ness monster and reveal the secret of the legendary Loch Ness Lake! Better be careful to avoid being another appetizer for Nessie…

title: Rubinite
description: "Rubinite" is a dark fantasy boss rush action game that utilizes the unique mechanic "Focus" to pinpoint enemies' weaknesses and execute thrust attacks. Follow Ruby, a princess who has escaped from the Scarlet Kingdom, embarking on a journey of revenge to reclaim her kingdom.

title: Highway Getway
description: "Highway Getway" is a car parkour type game. The player controls a car to drive on the highway. There is a lot of game money on the road. The player can get the game money when he controls the car.

title: Aboriginal
description: Embark on an epic adventure in "Aboriginal," tapping into inherited powers and unraveling ancestral mysteries. Traverse India and the mystic Tiroti Islands, inspired by the real-life isolated Sentinel Island in the Indian Ocean, on a journey of self-discovery and redemption.

title: Endless RPG: Untold Tales
description: Craft a party of diverse characters, each with customizable skills and looks. Explore a living world with dynamic day-night cycles, changing seasons, and diverse biomes. Embark on an epic journey where you shape your destiny as the director of your unique story.

title: Unparalleled
description: This is a wonderful little game.

title: Sanguo's Ambition 4: Three Kingdoms
description: The world's first competitive SLG strategy game with real-time matchmaking for multiplayer battles. In 《Three Kingdoms Ambition 4》 you can experience the unique journey of starting as a small faction and growing into a powerful warlord during the turbulent Three Kingdoms era.

title: Chroma Wars
description: A retro, turn-based strategy game on a square-map where you engage in techno-fantasy warfare! Command magical armies, repel abyssal foes, and conquer the world in high-skill strategic battles.

title: Freaky Trip
description: Put your imagination to the test and go on a freaky rescue trip. Help rescue Salcy’s beloved cockapoo from unknown danger in which she was sure to find herself. In Freaky Trip you will encounter many logical puzzles, which you can find everywhere.

title: Eden's Guardian
description: Where shadow falls, it begins. Dive into Eden's Guardian, a challenging metroidvania experience with handmade pixel art set in a world with medieval and fantasy aesthetics devastated by conflict where the history of Gods and humans intertwine.

title: School Girl Simulator
description: School Girl Simulator game has two players in a high-security school - a fragile and brash student against a strict and fierce teacher. The student's task is to find a way to pass the exams and not be caught, while the teacher has to catch her and punish her.

title: Survivors
description: Break through the siege and welcome the dawn of victory! Eight skills, twelve maps, three hundred talents, top-down survival Roguelike game! Through repeated battles, the character becomes stronger and more fearless, surrounded by monsters.

title: Liminal Border Part I
description: First game of a four-part visual novel series. Nerdy Itsuki Ninomae accidentally creates a “digital hypnotism movie.” Showing it to his neighbor causes him to learn her and a classmate’s dark secret, dragging him into the underbelly of society.

title: Trials of Randoom
description: Trials Of Randoom is a unique puzzle game with immense challenges and great mysteries. Each level is unique and your experience will be unforgettable as you solve the puzzles to advance through the different levels.

title: Malkin
description: Malkin is a 2D, hand-drawn, atmospheric RPG. A quest to find the blood of a murderer leads a witch into ever deeper mysteries. Expect intricate storylines with multiple endings and combat that poses a balanced challenge.

title: Silent Paws: Winter Quest
description: Embark on an enchanting journey with Silent Paws: Winter Quest, where the fate of a mystical world rests in your paws. As a cunning fox, you must venture forth into a breathtakingly immersive landscape teetering on the brink of eternal winter.

title: Necroslayer
description: Necroslayer is a dark fantasy styled, open world roguelite game. Play as one of several characters unlocked through the story, in first person action combat, with meta progression to improve stats and survivability each play through.

title: Jackpot 3
description: Jackpot 3 is a casual game. Before starting the game, you need to bet first. After the bet, the small ball will start to turn again. When the small ball stops on a certain number, that number is the winning number.

title: The Merlies
description: Meet the Merlies, a tiny birds community trying to find harmony in a world where the remains of an ancient civilisation are still visible. Build your village ingeniously, gather your birdies and explore this way-too-big world in this cute post-apocalyptic adventure ! Ready to spread your wings?

title: Relight The Dark
description: Relight The Dark is a short horror experience about a girl living with her abusive mother. After finding some dark secrets about her mother, the girl has to find a way to escape the house and get to safety.

title: The Expanse: A Telltale Series - Episode 1: Archer's Paradox
description: Experience the exciting universe of The Expanse like never before in Telltale’s latest adventure, The Expanse: A Telltale Series. Follow Cara Gee, who reprises her role as Camina Drummer, and explore the dangerous and uncharted edges of the Belt aboard the the Artemis. From scavenging wrecked ships in a zero-g environment, to surviving a mutiny, to combating fearsome pirates, you make the difficult choices and reveal Camina Drummer’s resolve in this latest Telltale adventure.

title: Milu Milan
description: Milu Milan is a casual game of architectural maze exploration and puzzle solving.

title: Playtown
description: Playtown is a horror game set in a kid's abandoned indoor playground. Roam the abandoned kids play areas to uncover and find your daughter's necklace, while unraveling the mystery surrounding the once happy place. Remember, you are not alone - as danger can be lurking at every corner.

title: Live Hard, Die Hard
description: I can't live like this! But, I won't die like this either! Do you want a mix of hard battles and cutting-edge medical treatment?! Then Live Hard, Die Hard is the strategy game for you! Use violence and science to stop the invasion and get those pesky aliens off of our planet!

title: Crisol: Theater of Idols
description: What would you do if your blood were your only weapon? How much would you sacrifice your life? Experience the unholy island of Tormentosa in this twisted first-person adventure full of horror and action where only your blood can be used to defeat the impious creatures that roam therein.

title: Fishyphus
description: Traverse an impressionistic sea, listening for predator and prey. Cast a lure and feel their cues to reel them in. The reaper slowly tracks your movements, who you must outmaneuver to survive.

title: Mineral Madness
description: Mineral Madness is a fast-paced battle arena where you go head-to-head against rival moles as you race to collect the most minerals. Create mayhem as you blast your way through the fully destructible underground to become the number one mole miner!

title: The Expanse: A Telltale Series - Episode 2: Hunting Grounds
description: Experience the exciting universe of The Expanse like never before in Telltale’s latest adventure, The Expanse: A Telltale Series. Follow Cara Gee, who reprises her role as Camina Drummer, and explore the dangerous and uncharted edges of the Belt aboard the the Artemis. From scavenging wrecked ships in a zero-g environment, to surviving a mutiny, to combating fearsome pirates, you make the difficult choices and reveal Camina Drummer’s resolve in this latest Telltale adventure.

title: The Expanse: A Telltale Series - Episode 3: First Ones
description: Experience the exciting universe of The Expanse like never before in Telltale’s latest adventure, The Expanse: A Telltale Series. Follow Cara Gee, who reprises her role as Camina Drummer, and explore the dangerous and uncharted edges of the Belt aboard the the Artemis. From scavenging wrecked ships in a zero-g environment, to surviving a mutiny, to combating fearsome pirates, you make the difficult choices and reveal Camina Drummer’s resolve in this latest Telltale adventure.

title: The Expanse: A Telltale Series - Episode 4: Impossible Objects
description: Experience the exciting universe of The Expanse like never before in Telltale’s latest adventure, The Expanse: A Telltale Series. Follow Cara Gee, who reprises her role as Camina Drummer, and explore the dangerous and uncharted edges of the Belt aboard the the Artemis. From scavenging wrecked ships in a zero-g environment, to surviving a mutiny, to combating fearsome pirates, you make the difficult choices and reveal Camina Drummer’s resolve in this latest Telltale adventure.

title: The Expanse: A Telltale Series - Episode 5: Europa's Folly
description: Immerse yourself in the role of Camina Drummer, the Executive Officer aboard the Artemis, a scavenging ship hunting for a big score in the outer regions of the Belt. You must corral a crew rife with tense relationships and powerful personalities, and make tough decisions that will decide everyone’s fate.

title: The Expanse: A Telltale Series - Archangel Bonus Episode
description: A bonus DLC episode for The Expanse announced as part of its Deluxe Edition and set to be released after the 5 episode story is finished in September.

title: Kill The Topulus
description: Kill The Topulus is a simple first person shooter, shoot accurately to survive the attacks of giant rats and become a master of the Topulus by completing all the challenges in each level.

title: Hansel and Gretel: Interactive Book
description: Hansel and Gretel. Interactive classic stories that always surprise you.

title: Cube Merge 2048
description: Welcome to Cube Merge 2048: Your Mystical Forest Puzzle Sensation! Embark on a captivating journey through the heart of a mystical magical forest, where the power of merging and strategy collide in the ultimate puzzle adventure.

description:
Two people rather than playing alone
more than playing together

title: League of Champions Soccer 2024
description: Live the new Champions European League Soccer Competition like real players do. Choose your team and play the matches of the real draw until the final.

title: Another Reverie
description: A small game about moving on.

title: Lylia's Deadline
description: Lylia's Deadline is an action-platformer inspired by games such as Mega Man X, focusing on new mechanics and movements.

title: Mr. Triangle Mania 2
description: Mr. Triangle Mania 2 is a platformer-shooter game with a stupid and wacky meme filled plot.

title: HooperVania
description: Welcome to HooperVania, a free and non-profit French fan game celebrating Castlevania, the French videomaker Hooper, his community, and video games as a whole! Navigate through various stages using the famous Vampire Killer to defeat numerous enemies, and large bosses and ultimately vanquish Dracula himself!

title: The Chronos Event
description: The Chronos Event is a fast-paced third-person shooter that emphasizes the tactics of time travel and fast, aggressive play. Players rewind time, battling alongside their younger selves against overwhelming opposition.

title: Superior Relatives
description: Superior Relatives is a couch-based multiplayer fighting game. Choose from a variety of balls and battle it out with up to four players in online multiplayer. Enjoy a variety of maps and characters, as you battle it out to be the ultimate champion.

title: Foxes Need to Eat
description: Control an adorable fox in scenarios full of traps and obstacles.

title: Cosmic Cowabunnies
description: Play as "Sauce," the Grey Alien, on a critical mission to hide alien evidence from humanity. Abduct, rescue, mine, and unravel Earth's mysteries. Battle formidable foes and prove your skills on the intergalactic leaderboard. Prevent disclosure, or the truth is out!

title: Sex Story: Cuckold Life - Episode 6
description: A steamy Visual Novel featuring high-definition graphics and realistic-looking characters set in beautiful decor. The story continues with Nikki accepting an invitation from her friend Sienna to go out drinking in a club, only to end up fucked in the restroom by the blonde's cocky boyfriend.

title: Golf With Your Friends: Peaceful Pines Course
description: Become one with nature with the new Peaceful Pines Pack.

title: Hotel: Lake Edition
description: The Lake Edition adds an additional resort location: an idyllic lake and the surrounding forest. A true haven of tranquillity, it's an ideal place to build a hotel for holidaymakers seeking nature and the great outdoors.

title: EXE Clash
description: A platform fighting game featuring many spooky video game creepypastas.

title: SMB RMX Land
description: One Day In Sarasaland, Mario (Or Whoever You Are Playing As) is running through the desert and Encounters Thicc Boi Who Is Wielding The Phantom Ruby. The Hero Gets Teleported Away To Another Part Of The Desert And Meets A Wiggler Named Harold And A Snorpler Named Gerald. The Two Siblings Are Trying To Stop Thicc Boi From Destroying The Fabric Of Reality. The Hero And The Two Worm Brothers Set Out Two Stop Thicc Boi Before It Is Too Late...

title: Super Smash Bros. CMC+
description: CMC+ (stands for Character Making Community) is the biggest official modpack to date, including many, many character and stage mods both released here and exclusive to the modpack itself, as well as a myriad of perks and features that the other builds currently doesn't allow for (an all new Assist system, the ability to assign stages to characters for them to appear in in Classic Mode, alongside many more!).

title: Transylmania Deluxe
description:
Vampy is back with a remake of the classic Flash game! Relive your childhood and revisit the castle!
Transylmania Deluxe is a remake of Transylmania, a game once available on Zeeks and Funschool.

title: Swolemochao 1 & 2: Gym of the Year Edition
description:
Ready to get swole? Swolemochao has a workout routine for you! But, it seems there's something odd about him, as if he's testing you more than training you. Find out the truth! Afterwards, find out what happened when Dr. Robotnik finds the fate of Swolemochao's mission. A depressed Player encounters Dr. Robotnik's newest scheme, the Mean Muscle Machine! Can you succeed with the perils that unfold?

Slapped together in a single package, Swolemochao 1 & 2: Gym of the Year Edition offers both games for you with remastered art and updated gameplay changes to improve upon the original 12 hour made first game, and extra bells and whistles for the not-made-in-12-hours sequel!

title: Luigi and the Quest for Nothing 2
description: After the events of Luigi and the Quest for Nothing, a mysterious figure snags the Nothing away from Luigi. I think he didn't like that. So off he went again to find this figure, along with his friend, the Green Toad. But little did both Luigi and this mysterious figure know of the importance of "The Nothing"... As you go through the worlds you will meet new unlikely allys, who will tell you about what exactly is happening in the world... or worlds... or universe?

title: Sonic Arena
description: Sonic Arena is a Fighting game that was finished after 17 years.

title: Monster World IV Regenesis
description: Monster World IV Regenesis is a fan-made role-playing game to celebrate the 35th anniversary of Wonder Boy. It features combat that expands on the original Monster World IV formula along with combat directly inspired by the popular ATB (Active Time Battle) system introduced in Final Fantasy IV, but with its own unique gimmicks.

title: Mario and Luigi: Superstar Simulator
description: Mario and Luigi: Superstar Simulator focuses on the battle elements of the Mario and Luigi series and enhances them with new enemies to fight and characters to play as. The playable characters range from the usual such as Mario, Luigi, and Bowser, but there are also some characters you wouldn't expect in this format such as Paper Mario, Sonic, or even Peppino from Pizza Tower. Each battle has something special and unique to bring to the table, like a new mechanic while dodging or a phase 2 that changes things up. There are some extra things to do as well, like playing minigames or going on bounty missions by collecting wanted posters in the overworld/HUB area.

title: Wario in Generic RPG: Chapter 2
description: Wario in Generic RPG follows Wario, as he is thrust into being the hero of an entire kingdom, trying to find pieces of an ancient artifact to save the kingdom from an unknown enemy. The game pokes fun at common RPG tropes, while also including a surprisingly deep story at its core. In the upcoming chapter 2, he meets an eccentric ringleader, who needs help reuniting his circus troupe to put on one, last show. Will you be the hero the kingdom needs?

title: Sonic LaserDisc
description: Sonic LaserDisc is a fangame that tributes to Sonic CD, focused on exploration and puzzles based on time travel.

title: Tails Adventure Remake
description: Tails Adventure Remake is a fan-made remake of the Game Gear game for modern platforms, adding 16:9 widescreen, high refresh rate support, improved physics, controls, and enemies' behavior.

title: Sonic Horizons
description: Sonic Horizons is an open-zone fangame inspired by Sonic Frontiers that aims to take the foundation of the open-zone formula that Frontiers established and expand on it in a different direction, focusing more on physics-based platforming/exploration, thinking outside the box, and generally forging your own path along the journey.

title: Sonic the Hedgehog RPG: Gearhead
description: Sonic the Hedgehog RPG: Gearhead is the fourth episode of the Sonic the Hedgehog RPG series,

title: Battle Cross Fever

title: Sonic Treading Power
description: Sonic Treading Power is a fan game made for SAGE 2023.

title: Éclipse The Cat
description: ​Éclipse The Cat is a semi-linear platform game that focuses on the variety of situations. Over the course of fast-paced levels, the player will unlock power-ups (running, dashing, flying, etc.) that will help them defeat the game's many bosses.​

title: Super Mario Bros. Friends
description: Join Mario and the kids from Mushroom Heights to rescue his brother Luigi!!!

title: Freedom Planet: Shang Mu Architect
description: Freedom Planet: Shang Mu Architect is an unofficial stage builder fan game set after the events of the first Freedom Planet, featuring its own campaign mode to showcase the capabilities of the editor.

title: Rushdown Rivals
description: Drive back evil robotic versions of several NG characters as your own NG icon. Stylishly dance through them as Cassette Girl, shoot them with Hank's personal arsenal, unleash Girlfriend's inner demon, and so much more in this tough-as-nails action game

title: Wilfred the Hero, Part 1
description: Game created for RPG Maker 2003 by Brandon Abley and Teo Mathlein with the initial objective of making a console-style RPG unlike any other created with the engine. Features 100% user-created content and no RPG Maker 2003-default game systems.

title: MicroSstep
description: "MicroSStep" is an exhilarating 2D action roguelite where you control "Cross", a dual-wielding girl who becomes infinitely stronger, and defeats monsters. Create the strongest swordsman by combining the items and skills you get each time you level up or clear a stage.

title: Experiment
description: You don't know where you are but you know you need to get out. Figuring how, managing your resources, solving puzzles and fighting/avoiding enemies.

title: Kitsunetsuki Project
description: Multiplayer-focused arena third-person shooter (TPS) game in anime style

title: Snakes LTD
description: Casual Snakes Combat. Kill other snakes and grow as much as you can.

title: Beat 'Em All
description: Beat 'Em All is a very crazy, fast, and weird platformer in which you need to beat everyone in your way!

title: Esper Girls
description: Esper Girls is a 2D action platformer game inspired by the many Japanese retro, actiony, and arcadey types of games that populated consoles like the Sega Genesis and Playstation, and a little bit of GBA as well.

title: Tacti-Cat
description: Tacti-Cat is a fast paced, momentum based, platformer where you play as Ellie the cat and use fish guns to save the world from an evil wizard invasion!

title: Fuu3's Fuun Journey
description: Fuu3's Fuun Journey is a 2D platformer that stars the titular Fuu3 on an adventure he’s clearly not ready for, but he’s gonna do it. Someone has to! Joined with his friends Fuu6 and Fuu9, he must make his way through weird and unknown locations in order to stop the nefarious Minus3 and his dastardly team from finding and controlling the remaining paloomanium, an element thought to grant the user powers beyond reality. Will you have the upper hand? Or will you fail and suffer under the might of Minus3? Only one way to find out: BE THERE OR BE SQUARE!

title: Welcome to the Game 2+
description: Welcome to the Game 2+ is a mod for Welcome to the Game 2 that adds a ton of new websites, new enemies, new items, new modes, twitch integration and more.

title: Fix the Lab!
description: Lucas, a newly hired young scientist's assistant, accidentally turns the lab into chaos! Now he must retrieve the gears to fix the machines before his boss returns.

title: Nicolás the Sea Urchin
description:
One day, Nicolás was hungry, so he decides to make a seaweed burger, but something he didn't know is that the burger was the most perfect burger that was ever cooked.
Suddenly, Loquendumbo breaks into his house and steals the burger! Don't let that bastard easily get away with your burger, control Nicolás and travel through the inmense and amazing underwater world!

title: Galactic Blasters D2: Brilliant Supernova
description: Galactic Blasters D2 - Brilliant Supernova is the fifth entry in the horizontal space shooter game series Galactic Blasters.

title: Veredilia: The Sacred Forest
description: Veredilia: The Sacred Forest is a 2D platforming game that takes inspiration from classic platformers such as Sonic, and fighting games like Mortal Kombat. The game aims to be a combination of classic 2D platforming with 1v1 fighting whilst also exploring the large forest of Veredilia across various locales with a wide range of characters, technical movesets, and flashy combos. You can take control of one of 3 characters, each with their own special moves, combos, and super moves. Solve puzzles, uncover secrets, and kick, punch, and slash your way to victory, before it's too late. Do you have what it takes?

title: Geno 2 the Generals' Orders
description: Take out demonic generals that have taken over the planet! Destroy giga robots, save the cities, give the citizens their homes back, and stop the reign of terror from the 6 masterminds. Collect power orbs to unlock new areas and explore the open world of each location.

title: Terry's Treasure Trouble!
description:
Terry T. Cat is back, and he's going to hop-and-bop and cartwheel his way through the Feyside Islands in search of a mysterious lost treasure!
After finding a treasure map on the beach, our old cartoon cat Terry decides to go off to a land of adventure. However, a gang of pirates, led by the notorious Grand Beard, are also in pursuit of this legendary treasure, and will stop at nothing to get it.
Along the way, Terry will find Star Fairies willing to take a hit for him, ladders and bars to hang on to, bouncy springs, ridable vehicles, Mode 7 Special Stages, and minigames. Oh, and coins. Lots and lots of coins.

title: Charade Maniacs: Limited Edition
description:
Limited edition of Charade Maniacs. Comes with:
- Charade Maniacs game
- Award Booklet
= Drama CD "Find the Memories!"

title: Mortal Kombat 1: Shang Tsung
description:
Play as the powerful sorcerer Shang Tsung.

included as a pre-order bonus for the game and available 5 days early with the Premium or Kollector's Edition of the game.

title: Russian Roulette
description:
Russian Roulette is a 3D action game, and the first game published by Buka, formerly only a distributor in Russia.

A ring of planets, connected by galactic portals has become lost in space. The planets are devastated and the portals have been disassembled. It is up to you to you to find the missing parts of the portals so they can be reactivated.

You can exit and enter any vehicle you encounter at will, and many have turrets that can rotate independently. In some levels you will be accompanied by an NPC who will guide you to the next portal part.

title: Russian Roulette II: The Next Worlds
description:
Russian Roulette II: The Next Worlds is a 3D shooter and sequel to Russian Roulette.

In the game you have to, again, unite six planets through the activation of galactic portals. Each of the planets features a completely different theme, ranging from prehistoric, to medieval and futuristic.

You can move around the worlds freely, both on foot or using the various vehicles available to you, including tanks, jeeps, space ships, or even live dragons or giant grasshoppers.

title: Road Wars
description: Self billed as the "most realistic combat racing sim ever created", Road Wars is a driving and shooting game where twelve different characters race their armed and armored vehicles across a dozen assorted tracks. Although the emphasis is on racing and completing laps, cars are equipped with a variety of weapons to impede the progress of the other drivers including gatling guns, missiles, oil slicks, and land mines. Individual drivers also have personal advantages such as cheaper repairs or better traction. Players can compete in single races or three different league circuits of increasing difficulty. Each league season consists of eight races where drivers use their cash winnings for repairs and upgrades between the stages.

title: Click For Cash: Cashed Out
description:
it's time to click till you're filthy rich... again!

Welcome to Click For Cash: Cashed Out, the best idle clicker game about yellow buttons since the original Click For Cash! This sequel is filled to the brim with new features, customization, and polish. In this game you click a button for cash (real original, I know), purchase a variety of upgrades to get more money, and unlock achievements to become the richest person in the universe! at least in the game...

title: Rasen Reijoh Spiral Ojosama: Chohatsu no Makina
description: A "vertical roll, horizontal scroll" action game where you take control of Lady Makina, a young girl with martial arts and drill hair grappling powers, on a mission to rescue her father from haywire robots in a research facility.

title: Moorhuhn: Die ersten 10 Jahre
description: Moorhuhn: Die ersten 10 Jahre is a Action game bundle developed by Software Pyramide and published by phenomedia publishing gmbh in 2009.

title: Porterminus
description:
Porterminus is a spooky RPG.

It follows the story of a girl named Julie, her boyfriend Donnie, and a mysterious cat.

Warning: Although the graphics are all pixel art, it has rather intense body horror, please keep that in mind before deciding to play.

title: KilaFlow
description: Play as the mascot of a blazing fast (for it's time) antivirus software to clear out corruptions and viruses from various devices around a town.

title: Manufactur'inc.
description: Lead your new company to success in this industry management game. Blueprint and optimize your production; make ethical choices to influence your worker conditions, ecological impact, automation level, and more. Will you create a simple manuFactory or a beneFactory?

title: Nuclear Cheetah
description:
Bounce, pounce, and slide your way through fast-paced levels as Chaz, the radioactive cheetah! This retro platformer inspired by the likes of Sonic the Hedgehog and Jazz Jackrabbit features a high skill ceiling, crispy pixel art, and a bangin’ MIDI-styled soundtrack.

Nuclear Cheetah combines time attack platforming with a collect-a-thon progression system. Play through and master challenging stages, earn power orbs to unlock new areas of the castle, and save the princess; all while uncovering the story of how a once mild-mannered cheetah transformed into a green gangsta who eats toxic waste for breakfast.

title: Refind Self: The Personality Test Game
description:
All players approach games in varied ways, making different choices.

No one ever plays in exactly the same way. Indeed, how a person plays can be an indicator of their personality...

And Refind Self is a game where you can learn all about that personality.

title: The Detective Reaper Invites
description:
Invitation from the Detective Grim Reaper is a roguelite deduction game.
As the detective grim reaper, your job is to solve randomly generated murder cases, find the culprit, and execute them.

title: Outer Outage
description:
UH OH!! A little alien named Blemie got his ship stolen by the EVIL robot Retri whilst on vacation to the Planet Cluster! What will he do now!? Well he's gotta find the Outages, creatures that possess insane electrical energy and can take out the high tech security measures Retri has set up.

So now... jump, dash, drop and LAUNCH through all of Planet Cluster for these Outages! Game contains 13 whole open sandbox collectathon stages, 8 bossfights (3 mini bosses too) and fast paced, adrenaline pumping collectathon gameplay! All tied together with a vibrant, mixed media art style and a 2.5D, surreal aesthetic.

title: Star Cruiser
description:
Star Cruiser is a space shooter/adventure game with many distinct elements from a number of different genres. It focuses on exploration and is very story-driven, as the game takes the players through various star systems and planets to solve the mystery of the VOID attacks. On their way, the players will meet many peculiar characters, learn their stories and try to help with their problems whenever an opportunity presents itself.

Additionally, this port is somewhat more ‘mature’ if such a term could be used, due to its sense of humor and the depiction of alcohol. This version of the game is quite different from the Mega Drive port that is already available in English, but it’s similar to the original PC-88 release as far the mechanics are concerned (except for the character portraits and some other minor details). An interesting aspect of the game are the shops, which were not present in the MD port. There, just the equipment can be found, as the entire money system was scrapped. In the PC versions the players would get money for the missions instead, which in turn would allow them to buy better gear and additional resources.

The main story beats are the same, but there are many differences as far as the characters and events go, which gives this version its own identity. In fact, this is what makes the game quite different from the MD port in particular. For example, the final area in this version is massive, whereas in the MD port it was much smaller. What is more, some major characters have different roles in this version of the game, and some others only appear in the MD port.

title: Hugo Gold
description: Hugo Gold is a compilation video game developed and published by ITE Media in 1998. It is a collection of 12 minigames from the classic Hugo games, including a special version of Labyrinth from Skærmtrolden Hugo.

title: K.S.-n-Kickin
description:
K.S.-n-Kickin is a 3D action puzzle video game made by Artworld UK and Big Future Ltd. for Kinder Surprise, with music licensed from Telstar Records. It was released for Microsoft Windows. The game was a promotion by Ferrero to "strengthen their foothold in the younger age group market". The game features Kinder Surprise toys from the K00 series.

The game was not sold in stores, but was offered in exchange for Kinder Egg wrappers which were sent to Ferrero. The promotion was advertised via TV commercials. K.S.-n-Kickin has the same map layout and soundtrack as Gubble 2 (part of the Gubble video game series), but has different backgrounds, characters, and items.

title: Trudy's Time and Place House
description: Trudy's Time and Place House (aka Lisa: La maison du temps et de l'espace) is a video game published in 1995 on Windows by Edmark Corporation. It's an educational game, set in a math / logic and pre-school / toddler themes, and was also released on Windows 3.x.

title: Rise of a Hero
description: Clear the areas captured by terrorists in Syria from terrorists and rescue the hostages.

title: Pokémon Ancestral X
description: Ancestral X is a difficulty hack of Pokémon X, built primarily for Nuzlocking, and otherwise inspired by popular hacks from Drayano, Buffel, and NotSuicuu. This is intended to be a truly challenging experience, but you’ll also find features common to enhancement hacks throughout. All 721 Pokémon are available, the leveling curve has been revamped, quality of life improvements are in place, and trainer battles are custom built and significantly harder. Best of all, Ancestral X introduces a number of features never before seen in Gen 6 hacks, including the ORAS Megas, Mobile PC, Trainer Natures, and Custom AI!

title: Pokemon Black 2: DE
description: Pokemon Black 2: DE offers an authentic Unova experience with a region almost exclusively filled with double-battles, a "challenging-but-not-kaizo" difficulty level, balance changes to improve viability and variety, postgame and all-new content within the main adventure, and a bunch of quality-of-life improvements!

title: Amalgamation
description: A short space gothic diorama featuring the lesser known astronomical body, the brown dwarf. An atmospheric visual novel-type game.

title: It's Real And It Kills
description: 9 old school vanilla maps featuring Castlevania music and Realm667 textures.

title: Intrusion
description: Doomguy invades a techbase full of demons. This is my first map that uses custom textures, and used Essel's amazing pack.

title: Ruined District
description: Ruined District is a short city map for RAMP 2023 back in June, now revised and playing/looking a bit better than its first version. Adding traps to some areas and making the map just a tad harder overall.

title: The Green Machine
description: he Green Machine is a 12-level PK3 for Doom II that requires the GZDoom source port to play. It was the second mapset created by speedrunner Andrea Rovenski (Cyberdemon531), and features such additions as decorate monsters, 3D floors and scripted events. Released in November 2014 as part of her continuing SecretDoom series, The Green Machine features medium to hard maps, with improved atmosphere and level design over her initial offering, Disrepair.

title: Hell's Memento
description: Hell's Memento is a 12-Map GZDoom wad that has heavy inspiration from classic wads like "Memento Mori", "TNT Evilution", "Requiem", etc. with GZDoom features such as 3D Floors, ACS Scripts, and Decorate Powerups/Monsters.

title: Disrepair 2
description: Disrepair 2 is an 11 map episode for GZDoom that expands upon the ideas and themes of my original Secretdoom episode "Disrepair" and transforms it into a new expansive world. This mapset features new monster types, new music, new textures, and of course new maps .

title: A War On Christmas
description: After reports of a mass slaughtering of good little children by a crazed man in a Santa suit, you track them down to one final stand-off. This is A War On Christmas...

title: Existential Dread
description: Existential Dread was a warmup project, to get back into making doom maps and vanilla in particular.

title: Autophagy
description: Autophagy.WAD is an old school megawad aiming for a mixture of Evilution, Scythe, Demonfear, and other classic experiences. Levels range from very easy to moderately challenging. This should be played in dsda-doom -complevel 2. 33 retro maps with fast and intense action!

title: Guilty: Ashlar
description: This is an easy to get started role-playing, adventure and exploration single player game that tells the exciting story of several criminals who experience adventures in a desolate and forbidden world.

title: Ep. Kazoku
description: A first-person Japanese horror game.

title: Chilla's Art: The Kidnap
description: The Kidnap is a Japanese horror game about a kidnapping incident.

title: Persona 3 Reload: Persona 5 Royal Persona Set 2
description: Persona 3 Reload: Persona 5 Royal Persona Set 2 contains additional content that allows you to use Personas from Persona 5 Royal.

title: Persona 3 Reload: Persona 5 Royal Persona Set 1
description: Persona 3 Reload: Persona 5 Royal Persona Set 1 contains additional content that allows you to use Personas from Persona 5 Royal.

title: Zeitghast
description: Run, dash, shoot, and slash your way through a mechanized prehistoric world in this fast paced platformer-shooter. Keep your eye on the clock while trying to stop an evil mad scientist from disrupting the timeline!

title: Vampires' Melody 2
description: Emerald seas! Blue skies! Sandy beaches! An island adventure in the ocean sounds like a trip to paradise. However, the place is a nightmare with no one to provide any blood for Raylan to feed on after he turned into a vampire by accident, especially since he has another hungry vampire at his side.

title: Warrior Next
description: Few against many... Fight with a handful of Spartans to save Greece. Destroy hordes of enemies until the fight with creatures sent by the Gods. Lots of action for everyone!

title: What The Gravity
description: Prepare for the electrifying space adventure as a delivery specialist in the legendary United Space Force (USF). Embark on a high-octane delivery run, navigating treacherous space battlefields, and defying all odds to ensure the success of your critical mission - before the beer gets warm.

title: Where's My Loot?
description: Where's My Loot? is a hidden object game in a fantasy world. The loot from your last adventure was lost. Search around and find all your precious items back.

title: Whispers of an Elven Captor
description: Whispers of an Elven Captor is an erotic visual novel. As a captive, you're questioned by elven Ayelith, eager to prove herself and protect her realm. Reluctance sparks an intimate exchange of questions, escalating to daring demands over time. From reserved to explicit, Ayelith's journey unfolds.

title: Wings of Seduction : Bust 'em out!
description: Clothing Damage + Survivor + Gear Mods >>> A woman is in danger! Do what must be done… Rip her clothes off! Oh, get your mind out of the gutter, it's the only way to save the world! Grab awesome weapons, sick skills and gear, and get ready for a unique, roguelike shoot-em-up each time you play!

title: Tank Battle Resist
description: In the face of a large number of fierce enemy steel torrents, the real warrior is not afraid of danger. Come on, let's defeat the enemy and protect our camp together.

title: The Blogger
description: The Blogger is a third-person horror game focused on story, exploration, and solving simple puzzles to progress through a terrifying atmosphere. Take control of our protagonist, a young photographer for a horror blog.

title: Telluria: Forebodings Gear Minigame
description: Help Annelise open the doors of the water mill (1st Age) or the library (3rd Age) solving visual and textual riddles.

title: The Castle Mystery
description: A first-person horror game where you step into the shoes of a historian who, on a solo mission, receives a tempting invitation to explore a long-abandoned castle. Drawn by the promise of a generous reward, you accept the offer without hesitation.

title: Swordeye
description: A hardcore MMO slasher with brutal directional combat. Explore massive, persistent PvPvE dungeons where every fight matters. Fight your way to the top, or die trying.

title: SickOw
description: This is an RPG game where you will follow our protagonist to fight and save lives!

title: Soulstone of Hope
description: Embark on a heroic journey in this captivating fantasy turn-based JRPG. Choose your path as a fearless Warrior, cunning Rogue, or powerful Mage, each with unique abilities. Form unbreakable bonds with your companions and uncover the secrets of the forgotten catacombs.

title: Soulgasm
description: Come in, come in! Immerse yourself in a dating sim adventure filled with romance and intrigue. Wander through the Palace's hidden chambers, unravel its mysteries, build lasting bonds, and woo the ladies! Let your choices guide your path as you enhance your Eromancy skills. Your love story awaits!

title: Son of the Dragon King
description: Son of the Dragon King, a beat 'em up action saga, with captivating storytelling at its core, RPG-like character growth, and intricate crafting. Your path—a blend of honor and redemption—will decide feudal Japan's fate. Can you emerge as the champion, facing down the elemental warlords?

title: Smokey's Rescue Team
description: Smokey's Rescue Team is a cat rescue/adoption simulator that allows you to interact and look after cats that have been abandoned in front of your home. You will need to take care of all the cats and make sure they are fed and happy until you can find them a new home.

title: Six Ears
description: This is an RPG game where you will follow our protagonist to fight and save lives!

title: Space Mining Company
description: Dive into the exciting adventure and conquer your own business in Space Mining Company - a world of limitless possibilities! Prepare to scour the solar system for precious ores and sell them for profit.

title: Steampunk Jigsaw Puzzles: Samurai Clans
description: Revolution is afoot in the land of the rising sun. The shogun’s power is fading fast, while rival warlords muster their troops as they plot their ascent to the throne.

title: Steel Roamer
description: Immerse yourself in Steel Roamer's chilling experience, trapped in an RV, pitted against unimaginable terrors lurking outside. Driving is your only goal.

title: Super Retro Rec League Racing
description: Race against the clock in Super Retro Rec League Racing! Perfect your lines, optimize every turn, time your pits, and push yourself to absolute mastery.

title: Super Paul World
description: Experience a great adventure in "Super Paul World" where you defeat many enemies while trying to retrieve the Cookie Nexus Core for Baker Tim. Earn experience points (EXP) to acquire various cosmetic items.

title: Sushi for Empress Setsuko
description: “Sushi for Empress Setsuko” is a cozy fishing game, yuri dating sim, and point & click adventure set in a fantastical Japan-inspired land. Follow Mizumi Nagashima as she travels around the Empire, seeing gorgeous views, catching delicious fish, and charming beautiful women.

title: The Backrooms Recorded
description: Navigate a nightmarish labyrinth, avoid eerie entities, and uncover dark secrets in this liminality based horror game. Explore realistic levels, unravel secrets, and figure out life or death puzzles. Will you escape the madness? Brought to you by a solo 13 year old dev.

title: Project DarkHeaZ
description: Progress through short levels to face enemies and final bosses to save your life. Win and you'll level up, fail and you'll level down. The whole galaxy depends on you!.

title: Popucom
description: Venture together with your friends on an unknown planet. Use color switching, match-3 shooting, and artifact powers to overcome challenges and keep advancing. What lies ahead of you is an adventure filled with wonder, hope, and much more to discover!

title: Philna Fantasy
description: This is a pixel-art style action role-playing game with exciting storylines, different career choices, cute art style, lively battles, and rich character development.Let's go and start the adventure.

title: Petty's Adventure: Volcano
description: Petty's Adventure: Volcano is a colorful game with changing gravity in which you have collect crystals to complete a level.

title: Horrific Xanatorium
description: A world where Spilia, a virus that causes delusions and hallucinations, has become epidemic. A horror visual novel game set in a hospital where patients are isolated.

title: Mozzies
description: A colourful retro style matching game. Squash Mozzies and match splatter colours before time runs out.

title: Myriad Hotel
description: A silly hotel-management visual novel. Impress clients, earn money, and resolve issues for your staff to keep the hotel from going under.

title: Olive's Art-Venture
description: Olive's Art-Venture is a spell-slinging arena and mobbing game. Use the paper on the right side of the screen to draw shapes which then cast spells, damaging enemies and protecting you.

title: On a Cloudy Day
description: On a Cloudy Day is a short, autobiographical vignette game by Emperatriz Ung. It is an interactive memory that captures the loneliness experienced during the hospitalization intake process. Designed to narratively compliment & be played alongside with Carol Mertz's "I'll be here."

title: Swapdown
description:
Step into the pulsating world of Swapdown, where every second counts and your wits are tested to the limit! In this exhilarating "match three" extravaganza, players are given a thrilling 60 seconds to slide shapes in all directions - left, right, up, and down, with the goal of aligning the perfect trio of colors.

But that's not all! Feel the board has become too predictable? Hit the "Space Bar" and watch as Swapdown's dynamic arena reshuffles, throwing an array of fresh combinations your way. The clock is ticking, but if the pressure becomes too much, the trusty hint button awaits to give you that gentle nudge in the right direction.

Compete against friends or challenge yourself to beat your personal best. As the seconds dwindle, the pace intensifies, and the adrenaline soars. Only the sharpest eyes and quickest reflexes will emerge victorious with the highest score.

With vibrant visuals, an addictive soundtrack, and nail-biting gameplay, Swapdown guarantees a heart-racing experience from start to finish.

Are you geared up for a minute of mayhem? Dive into Swapdown, where the clock is your biggest rival, and glory awaits the swiftest swiper!

title: A Belief in a Perfect Today
description:
This is the story of a day that we wanted to be perfect. A bank holiday trip to Brighton with friends. A chance to see the ocean, to see a band, to see slot machines and eat doughnuts.

This is a story of a day that wasn't perfect. A day of fighting through hangovers, of trying to have a good time, of putting up with bad weather, of trying not to snap.

This is a story. It focuses on the cracks.

title: I'm Yearning for a Train Journey
description: I haven't taken this kind of journey for a long time

title: Princess Bubble Story
description: Bubble puzzler full of magic!

title: Candlebook Island
description: Make friends with your coworkers, discover their lives and history, treat sick monsters, and research mysterious illnesses!

title: Nathan Jones and The Eternal Myth
description: Follow Nathan Jones on his epic quest through magical worlds and emotional challenges to unlock the secrets of an ancient myth and save the World.

title: Word Quest
description: A fast-paced action typing game where you cast spells against hordes of monsters! Complete quests, unlock abilities and repay your debt to the merchant to be set free! Put your typing skills to the test in this challenging fantasy game.

title: The Jumping Food Memory
description:
Embark on an unforgettable card memory adventure!

Dive into the fascinating world of our brand new card memory video game developed by the creators of "The Jumping Food" Games. We proudly present an exciting gameplay with a homage to our Jumping Games and a pinch of challenge that will keep you hooked for a long time.

Each of our three kitchens holds unique levels full of tricky card pairs. Find the right combinations to unlock the next level and put your memory skills to the test.

title: Turbo Dash Kart 2023 Racing
description: Race to Glory, Race to Win – it's time to conquer the track!

title: Mudness Offroad 2
description: Unleash Your Off-Road Passion and Leave Rivals in Your Dust!

title: Loinkham TD
description: A tower defense game set in the village of Loinkham. Use towers and various interactable objects in the environment to protect your little oinkers and their assests! Each map offers something new to help you with your journey. Unlock new towers and maps as you play.

title: Fair and Square
description: Fair and Square is a fast-paced bullet hell platformer roguelike where everything revolves around squares. Survive relentless enemy waves, upgrade your skills in the shop, and face epic bosses. Customize your playstyle, adapt on the fly, and prove your mastery in this chaotic challenge!

title: Ghost Tag
description: It's the classic game of tag, but for ghosts! In this multiplayer party game, you can use spectral super powers like vanishing and possessing objects to gain an edge on your opponents and be the tag champion!

title: Keo and the Cosmic Crystals
description: Keo and the Cosmic Crystals is a 2D platform game with colorful and cute graphics, featuring high difficulty and precision challenges.

title: Arena 9th
description: Welcome to the AUTO-CARD Competition of The Ninth Universe. You can show your skills, enter a higher level of competition, and strive to win the glory of the universe championship.

title: A Night at the Watermill
description: You wake up in an old watermill in the middle of the night ... and can't remember anything. Examine the surroundings in this thrilling point&click adventure and find out what happened.

title: Demon Slayer Shion
description: When her fellow Demon Slayer, Ayano, disappears in the depths of an enormous dungeon, Shion and her friends take it upon themselves to find her.

title: Mannequin
description: Play as a clothing store worker who is just finishing up her shift and preparing to go home. However, as you make your way towards the exit, the power suddenly goes out, leaving you trapped inside the store.

title: Death Lease
description: You will die.

title: 4D Games
description: 4D Shapes, 4D Chess and 4D Mazes!? Take a deep dive into the world of Four Dimensions, with more control than ever before!

title: Die in the Dungeon: Origins
description: Fight your way through a mysterious dungeon in this deck-building, turn-based roguelike where you don't use cards, but dice! Deal with enemies by combining dice on your board, boost their effects with magical relics, and discover the story behind Die in the Dungeon!

title: 3D Chess Online
description: 3D Chess Online combines the magical world of chess with a modern and three-dimensional experience! Determine your strategy and fight against your opponents worldwide in this simulator equipped with realistic graphics.

title: Halloween Naughty Girls
description: Halloween Naughty Girls is a collection of adult visual novels inspired by classic horror movies from the 80s and 90s.

title: Hidden Glade
description: Hidden Glade is a 2D simulation role-playing video game set in a fantastic world of mysteries and unexplored worlds. Go on a new adventure together with Tobi. Develop your new home, find answers to your questions and go to your goal.

title: Enemy Trench
description: Enemy Trench is a Roguelike set during the First World War. You play as a British soldier fighting your way through enemy lines hoping to survive. You must contend with an onslaught of enemy soldiers, deadly terrain, gas attacks and more. Do you have what it takes to survive in the Enemy Trench?

title: Kitten's Wardrobe
description: This is a relaxing casual game. Take a walk in Dessert Town, explore more areas, and meet new friends. The Kitten has the ability to turn the stuff in the painting into reality. Help it gather new clothing through drawing!

title: Last Lesson
description: It's your first night as the caretaker of a scary quest. The last visitors have gone home. You need to turn off the lights, check the equipment and not die of horror, because someone or something suddenly starts a nightmarish game. With you in the lead.

title: Eyewinder
description: Run, glide, and grapple across an open world filled with floating islands. Armed with an Eye that gives you the power to rewind and accelerate time, use it to solve puzzles, fight enemies, and rescue your dragon friends.

title: Butterfly again
description: In a world where not everyone has magic, the kingdom is suffering from an infestation known as "Insect Demon". But only those who can use magic can see the Insect Demon...

title: Minute
description: A 3D action platformer where you play as a wind-up toy in a Tinkerer's workshop set in the Victorian Age. As a small wind-up toy, you must rely on your wind-up key to embark on an arduous journey. Defeat enemies and uncover a dark secret within the rooms.

title: Helle's Undersea City Project: Bringing Air to The Garden
description: Grow and expand the land with air, aiming to rebuild the undersea city with a lone girl, Hele! A new type of undersea city-building simulation game!

title: Crystalish
description: Crystalish - A side-view game with a physical world where the player must destroy blocks in a certain amount while controlling the balance of the fish and not allowing it to fall off the screen.

title: English Is Hard_
description: An arcade style typing game that evokes the nostalgia of Missile Command. Defend your cows, shoot aliens, and go for the high score!

title: Cropisle TD
description: After an earthquake, you're sent to an island for rebuilding. Face nightly critter attacks, set up towers, and farm. Your mission is to seal the island or secure crops before defenses are breached. Now, grab your shovel and hammer, and enter the defensive battle!

title: Harmonic Depths
description: Embark on a relaxing journey in an underwater realm. Glide through captivating environments, embracing the tranquility of exploration and survival found in these Harmonic Depths.

title: Mansion of Memories
description: Investigate the old manor, compete for the inheritance, or dive into mysteries left by your late aunt along with her will. Your choices decide whether other inhabitants of the mansion become your foes or friends… or someone special.

title: Little Green Girl
description: One day the protagonist meets an alien girl and the story turns...

title: Brick on the Head
description: As a manager of an hospital near bankrupt, you find that a brick on the head will give you patients. Also play on Hospital Mode where you can build your own hospital, take care of patients, protect him with security guards...

title: Baby Climbing
description: baby climbing is a 3d third person game where you control a baby in a dream where you have to climb platforms in order to reach the end. climb the platforms and complete the mission without falling and overcoming the obstacles

title: Marshmallow Imouto Succubus
description: Tsukikawa Keisuke had a strange dream. That dream involved his younger sister but instead of her usual, innocent self, she had lust in her eyes. So he finds out that a succubus lurks within her! How will he choose between his innocent sister and the allure of a lustful succubus?!

title: Get Me Out, Please
description: Work together with friends to escape an abandoned school in this horror escape action game for up to four players, but beware: one of you will become a monster.

title: Cataclysm Survivors
description: Cataclysm Survivors is an action packed roguelike in the survivors genre. With countless weapons and upgrades, play through endless waves of zombies and become INFINITELY POWERFUL. Thousands of Weapon and Upgrade combinations and TONS of enemies to slaughter with multiple classes and maps.

title: HBD-RPG
description: Interactive Role-Playing Game (RPG)

title: Maze Monsters
description: Maze Monsters is a procedurally generated, roguelike dungeon platformer where vicious threats and dangerous foes make for an original and action-packed adventure every time.

title: Asteroids Star Fields
description: It is an awesome space war game. It is a very simple game. Move the spaceship and shoot the asteroids. Try to make the highest score. It is an easy and time killing game. You can play to rest and relax between the big games you play.

title: Filled to the Limit
description: ​A newspaper ad inspires a girl to become a test subject for a tube-feeding machine, and must reach her full capacity!

title: Card Collector And Card Girls
description: Control: Keyboard arrow keys, A button = Z, B button = X This game has no story. You just have to defeat enemies and acquire skill cards to learn skills or acquire items to challenge stronger enemies. Battle is turn-based, Use your skills appropriately. Please have fun with these beauties.

title: Fly With The Yellow Crane
description: Soaring in the daytime, where are you going? This game will give a possibility. The night is long, and the road is full of branches. Good and evil are difficult to balance. Beauty is disaster or blessing? Regrets long live in the world. I can only imagine the utopia in the fairyland.

title: Fortress Defense
description: 'Fortress Defense' is a cartoon style defense game. Players can summon archers and upgrade to different roles to block the enemy's attack.

title: Corn Kidz 64
description: The unauthorized, kid-friendly version of the classic Stephen King thriller (or maybe not, maybe it's just a game about one-horned goatbabies)

title: Jump Queen
description: Get to the top in the really challenging platformer Jump Queen! You don't need a hot girl, she's already here. You just need to move up because the fall price is too high. Jump, collect coins, look for secrets and get to the top.

title: Brain Quiz
description: Brain Quiz crazy general quiz game... Challenge your brain, and your culture

title: Aerodangle
description: Aerodangle is a chaotic mix of high-speed flying, parkour with a grappling hook and a stream of airplanes falling apart in the air.

title: Knights of Grayfang
description:
The land of Eldraad is in the midst of a war between the humans, born from the Twilight Deity, and the monsters, born from the Nightfall Deity, to control all nine temples. King Edwahl wields twilight's might, turning humans into vampires via a ritual. Yet, a sinister force awakens among monsters. Will nightfall or twilight triumph?
One of the main characters, Thoma, wields a unique Blood Gauge, replacing HP and MP. Using this gauge, characters can activate Bloodthirst, granting new skills and appearances. Equip bats found in dungeons for passive effects like protection from ailments and boosted attack power. Seize victory by claiming all nine temples. Unravel the mysteries and battle the monsters within to conquer them!

title: Jackpot 2
description: Jackpot 2 is a casual game. After starting the game, it has three wheels to turn. When the wheel stops, the icon stopped at the winning line matches the winning pattern, and the player will get the winning amount indicated by the winning pattern.

title: OMSI 2: Agora Bus Family Citybus Vol. 1
description: Plunge into the middle of the urban hustle and bustle with the Renault Agora DLC for OMSI 2. Explore the narrow streets, master the challenges of traffic and feel the adrenaline of rush hour - all with the comfort of your passengers in mind.

title: Assetto Corsa EVO
description: Assetto Corsa EVO is the sequel to 2014’s racing simulator Assetto Corsa, which featured a range of road, track, racing, historic and drift cars as well as laser-scanned tracks

title: Pokémon Myth
description: Embark on an epic adventure in Pokémon Myth, where you'll rise from a 15-year-old villager to a legendary Champion. Unravel the sinister plot of Team Corrupt, an enigmatic organization seeking to harness the power of Arceus and Mew, the region's legendary Pokémon. Discover the groundbreaking "Infusion Types," a new mechanic that empowers your Pokémon with type-specific DNA, boosting their attacks and adding a strategic layer to battles. Encounter intriguing factions like the research-driven Team Rose/Infusion Inc. and the formidable Team Astra, hailing from the Serene region. Explore two vast regions, plus Sinnoh and Unova, teeming with new Mega Evolutions, regional forms, and a plethora of Fakemon, including unique Star-Face shiny variants.
