description: Seed in is a vibrant, 2D, puzzle game that challenges you to dig your way out of ingenious and fun levels! Along the way, you’ll enjoy a relaxing, adorable, and quirky story with memorable and lovable characters!

title: Xanthaphobia
description: Xanthaphobia presents an immersive experience that blends elements of puzzles, mystery, and horror.

title: JJJ
description: "A normal vacation" the three friends were thinking, when they were drawn into a macabre ending.

description: A first Person Lovecraftian Survival Horror game, inspired by the work of HP Lovecraft. Explore uncharted subterranean territory, document your findings and survive the horrors that you uncover.

title: Plant Therapy: Queens
description: Plant Therapy: Queens is full of new content to make your cozy Plant Therapy experience even more plantastic! Features a new apartment with stunning city views, new plants and artwork and upgraded watering can and fertilizer options.

title: ZXC
description: In a small notebook, an abandoned character was drawn without any story. For a long time, the character lived lonely and trapped in the notebook, but one day, the character gathered courage and decided to escape the notebook.

description: Roulette Simulator 2024 presents players with the greatest modern Roulette gambling simulation. Experience the highs and the lows in real time as you try to beat the roulette wheel during the intensity of each spin!

title: The Snow Reach
description: "The Snow Reach!" is a highly customizable CCG tactical strategy game. You can combine various unique abilities to create your own personalized followers. The game focuses on Roguelike elements and player versus player battles.

title: Riot of Willy

title: Super Jigsaw Puzzle: Generations - Portugal
description: Puzzles of Portugal!

title: Kamla
description: Play as an Indian exorcist who is tasked with banishing the evil spirit that’s taken over a newly-wed woman named Kamla, in this first person horror game inspired by Indian traditions and folklore.

title: Legendary Slide 2: Platinum Edition

description: One Piece: Pirate Warriors 4 is the latest evolution of Pirate Warriors action! Based on the concept of 'experiencing a real One Piece battlefield,' buildings will come crashing down during the action and attacks will throw up smoke and dust, placing you in the thick of the One Piece world!

description: Gunbrella is a gritty noir-punk action-adventure set in a world dependent on a rapidly diminishing natural resource. The deluxe edition contains the game, the Gunbrella soundtrack and the exclusive Gunbrella digital comic.

title: Dagon: The Railway Horror
description:
Have you ever wondered what the master of weird fiction and cosmic horror might have dreamt about?

Now you have the opportunity to immerse yourself in one of H. P. Lovecraft’s nightmares, which he described in 1927 in a letter to Donald Wandrei - a co-founder of the famous Arkham House publishing house.

So validate your ticket and find a comfortable seat - the motorman will be arriving shortly.

title: Icarus: Arcticus Outpost
description: High in the mountains, on terraced cliffs or a large flat frozen lake give you a range of altitudes in which to build your perfect winter retreat.

title: Rally Ar
description: Argentinian Rally Simulator.

title: Disney Dreamlight Valley: Enchanted Adventure
description: This update for Dreamlight Valley adds a Beauty and the Beast Realm to the game, two new characters (Belle and the Beast), new quests for The Forgotten, the Haunted Holiday Star Path and the return of Halloween Dreamlight Duties.

title: Games for Stream!
description: An exhilarating chat interactive game, where the chat becomes your co-pilot, shaping the course of the game in real-time. Engage with your favorite streamers and viewers like never before as you type commands, make choices, and influence the game's outcomes directly through chat.

title: State of Decay 2: Curveball Update
description:
How do you meaningfully add to a game that’s been in players’ hands for five years? In the case of State of Decay 2, you throw a curveball. Although this is the 34th update for State of Decay 2, Curveball represents a significant overhaul. This new update, coming to players for free on September 18, is a landmark moment for the game – not just offering a swathe of new content for the game’s most dedicated players and newcomers alike, but marking a new era in State of Decay 2’s development through the work of Wushu Studios.

Wushu, from Liverpool, England, will continue providing support to State of Decay 2 as much of original studio Undead Labs transitions to work on the next entry in the series – but where you might expect that support to be incremental, Wushu is making a very big splash. Curveball is a major update, touching almost every element of the game, and designed to consistently offer brand new challenges, even to those who have been playing State of Decay 2 since release.

Available after the fifth in-game day, curveballs can change the world around your settlement in some very interesting ways. Housed in a new menu, curveballs will periodically appear – each with their own narrative attached – offering new objectives, rewards, enemy types and much more. Curveballs can be positive (like finding increased loot) or negative (like buffing regular zombies in multiple ways); they can be timed or objective based; they can affect enemies, your survivors, or other NPCs. Effectively, any element of the game you may have gotten comfortable with can, and often will, change.

title: Resident Evil 4: The Mercenaries - Separate Ways Update
description:
A free update for The Mercenaries mode released alongside the Separate Ways expansion that added 4 new characters and the Docks stage, unlocked after beating the Island stage once.

Ada Wong is available by default while Albert Wesker is unlocked with an A rank on any stage using Ada. The update also added 2 variant characters with Leon (Pinstripe) and Ada (Dress) unlocked with an S rank or higher on all stages using their base character.

title: Endrays
description:
Wield a piercing laser without inhibition at the tip of your fingers - your mouse.
Indulge in Endrays, a devastating weapon of mass destruction, and drive the resistance of humanity into merciless extinction.
What awaits you when this battle comes to an end...?

The second release from the 2022 New Hire Onboarding Program at Bandai Namco Studios!

title: Final Fantasy XI: Rhapsodies of Vana'diel
description: Released across the May, August, and November 2015 version updates, Rhapsodies of Vana'diel is designed to be the conclusion of the main scenario missions of Final Fantasy XI, tying together plotlines and characters from across the game's previous stories. Completing the missions requires registration of and progression through all previous expansion packs. Other additions include the new areas Escha and Reisenjima and new trusts.

title: Fawning Over a Corpse
description: "Nothing is wrong with my deerly beloved; she's just hungry."

title: Excycle
description:
Drag your friends into this mischievous four-player unicycle racing game!
Get your unicycle rolling with the mouse wheel and cruise your way through hazardous obstacles and racetracks, all while ramming into your rivals!
Push, shove, and kick up a fuss in EXCYCLE!

The third release from the 2022 New Hire Onboarding Program at Bandai Namco Studios!

title: Pokémon: Close Combat
description: A Fast Paced, 2D Pokémon Fighting Fangame, where you duke it out in local or online matches as your favorite fighting type Pokémon from across the series!

title: Shigeru Planet
description:
A boisterous and bizarre commotion! Overrun the planet with chatter-plants!
Propagate these eccentric yet endearing chatter-plants, only if you dare! Operate a UFO and strive to spawn as many of them as you can before time runs out. Revel in the outlandish frenzy that can only be experienced here on Shigeru Planet!

The fourth release from the 2022 New Hire Onboarding Program at Bandai Namco Studios!

title: Super Freaks 1 Remastered
description: Super Freaks 1 Remastered is a remastered version of The Search of Tikiman made to celebrate the original game's 10th anniversary. It also served as a soft reboot of the series and introduced the modern characters/designs.

title: Chordosis
description: Chordosis invites you to experience a unique cosmic survival sci-fi horror game centered around alien abductions. Immerse yourself in the small village of Dunahont, Hungary, and uncover its chilling mysteries.

title: Heart Cage
description:
You are a detective who has just moved to a new town. You are involved in a serial killer case, and three mysterious residents (Or more?!) are approaching you!

Don't trust anyone! But... can you?

title: OhMyWitch!
description:
It is the first year I have had the chance to join the Halloween parade. But why the monster kidnapped me to the other world?! And this charming monster wants me to be his Witch. What do you think I should do?!

On the other hand, I also met the cat I lost. But why did he suddenly become a human?!

title: Lilith Hall
description: 080 is the pride of Lilith Hall. She does exactly as she's told, she get's perfect grades, and she's never lost a single battle. All her life she was taught the only thing that matters is her future Ringmaster; but when an outsider is brought in, she gets a taste of what the outside world looks like. She must choose between a temptation she's never known, or the life she's always wanted.

title: Final Justice
description: Japanese indie beat'em up for PC.

title: Payday 3: Silver Edition
description: Payday3 is the much anticipated sequel to one of the most popular co-op shooters ever. Since its release, Payday-players have been reveling in the thrill of a perfectly planned and executed heist. That's what makes Payday a high-octane, co-op FPS experience without equal.

title: Lifeless Horizon
description: In this intense and thrilling zombie survival game, players must use their wits and quick reflexes to stay alive in a world overrun by the undead. With limited resources and endless hordes of zombies, players must scavenge for supplies, build their defenses, and work together with other survivors to stay alive. But beware, as danger lurks around every corner and any misstep can mean certain death. Will you be able to survive the zombie apocalypse?

title: Grinlox is here
description:
You want to go to work, but a nasty surprise awaits you there.
This game was created with GameGuru MAX.

title: Super Peko 35
description: A 2D pixel shooter hololive fan game!

title: SkibidiVerse
description: SkibidiVerse is a captivating game where you will take on the role of the camzeraman tasked with saving the planet.

title: Dicey Dungeons: Halloween Special
description: Dicey Dungeons: Halloween Special is a extra levelpack containing three episodes. Halloween Special sees Warrior, Inventor and Witch back into a new horror themed dungeon, with three new enemies, returning enemies with new costumes, two new locations, and new scary music.

title: Mixed Feelings 2: Elysium
description: Upon meeting Ezra, Zale, and Dandy, you discover that you don't remember who you are, where you came from, or why you're even there. The story unfolds as the residents of the town try and help you remember, and you learn what it truly means to be yourself.

title: Akumajyo Dracula Peke
description:
Akumajyo Dracula Peke is a hidden minigame that came included with Castlevania: Rondo of Blood. It is also known as Stage X "The Fate of Blood Must be Cut with the SUPER CD-ROM² ROM" (血の因縁はSUPER CD・ROM²でなければ断てない, Chi no Innen ha Super CD-ROM² ROM de Nakereba Tatenai). This minigame played instead of Rondo of Blood if the user was using the wrong kind of System Card.

The game has been included in all conversions of Rondo of Blood, only differing on the methods of unlocking it between platforms.

title: My Little Karaoke: Singing is Magic
description: My Little Karaoke: Singing is Magic is an unofficial My Little Pony karaoke game for Windows, Mac and Linux. The game features music from the Friendship is Magic series, alongside various fanmade songs from the community.

title: Metroid: Eternal
description:
A 2020 April Fools "update" to the critically acclaimed fangame 'AM2R: Return of Samus'.

After exterminating the Metroids, Metroid: Eternal follows Samus as she returns to SR-388 to eliminate the Septogg threat as well, on the Galactic Federation's orders. This title is played from an old-school arcade perspective, with quick reflexes, item collection and strategic reloading being the main focus of the game.

title: Around us: Zombie shooter
description: Around us: Zombie shooter is a multiplayer cooperative zombie shooting game. There are various kinds of zombies and bosses. A lot of weapons and upgrades are waiting for you to unlock via waves. Try to survive the highest wave that no one ever reaches!

title: Lunar Depot 38
description: Oh, no! Angels are pouring down from space, interfering with the creative process and also threatening to burst through this strange door... Better get out your fish gun and lend a hand!

title: Perchance to Dream
description:
You awake after dreaming of a mysterious voice...but where are you?
Let's find out!

title: T.N.Terminus
description: This tells a short story about a marine who got into the trouble at the TNT corporation base. It consists of three levels, the first of which is a short intro.

title: Super Freaks: The Demo
description: Super Freaks: The Demo is not actually a demo, it was initially the testing ground for gameplay and features meant for the long-awaited Super Freaks 4ever but it was submitted to SAGE 2016 and later included in the Classic Pack as it was complete enough.

title: Neurotypical
description: You wake up as a teenager named Neo in a strange place, apparently in someones mind, and they want your help?! Collect items, fight enemies, and try not to get yourself annihilated! But always remember, nothing in this game is as "typical" as it seems.

title: Strato-Scruffy
description: Long awaited since 2009, Strato-Scruffy has now been finished. It's a Fantasy Zone-style shmup game with fancy graphics and bosses for its time.

title: Project N3T
description: Take control of a test subject tasked with testing out a new device that functions as a powerful magnet. Complete a few tests by moving metal objects and using the magnet as a grappling hook in this short single-player experience.

title: Multiverser
description: Multiverser is an action game with rouglike elements, in which you defeat hordes of enemies who precede clashes with bosses. After each skirmish you gain currency, which makes you develop your characters stronger. All this to save the multiverse and clean it from all sorts of monsters.

title: Meurtre Au Florian
description: Immerse yourself in the captivating world of Meurtre Au Florian! This game features real actors bringing captivating characters to life. This innovative experience transports you into the mysterious world of an enigmatic murder.

title: Spellbound Shuffle
description: Tactical roguelike deckbuilding game in a funky post apocalyptic far west. Pick a hero, build your own deck and cleanse the world from the evil. On top of regular attacks and defenses, make good use of movement and positioning on the grid to stay alive !

title: Stand Your Ground
description: Defend attacks from enemies from all directions within a limited time. Only by making full use of the differences in each tower and choosing appropriate random rewards can you survive.

title: NeverRage
description: NeverRage is a third-person online role-playing game, with action & tab-targeting combat that combines theme-park and open-world experiences.

title: Bad Dreams: Free Dive
description: Bad Dreams is a Solo VR Horror game with immersive gameplay based on real gesture. A unique experience, where nightmares become reality.Fight, Run, Jump, Wipe your eyes, Cover your ears... while avoiding the game's traps and puzzles, you won't come out unscathed!

title: KimodameshiGolf
description: Kimodameshi Golf is a horror golf game based on golf!

title: Shards of the Past
description: A trading trip with a nearby village turns into an epic adventure when you discover a hidden truth about your world. You will meet new friends and foes, explore amazing places, and face a choice that will shape the future. Your actions and choices will determine the outcome of this story.

title: Foxcrate
description:
Made in 72 hours for Ludum Dare 53 game jam, "Delivery"

You are the newest employee of Foxcrate, a delivery service. Make sure everyone receives their packages on time!

title: Bug Heroes: Tower Defense
description: Help the Bug Heroes defend their food stash from hordes of enemies! Control powerful heroes, build your defenses, level up your heroes and towers, equip upgrades, and more!

title: Unknown Dungeon
description: Explore randomly generated maze with lots of treasures, puzzles and monsters. Help people, do quests, explore the dungeon, obtain treasures, gain experience and find out the history of the world!

title: Two Climbers
description: Two Climbers embark on a journey to climb a mountain, TOGETHER! This game requires 2 players who own the game to play!

title: Idle Space Navy
description: A sci-fi idler. Upgrade your ships, get new items, and conquer the stars.

title: Final Exerion
description: Call on CELLs, change your weapon, and shoot however you want!

title: Kosmocean: The Endless Sea
description: Adventure and submarine exploration game. Control your Bathyscaphe with the help of a logbook. Through the game puzzles, bullet-hell sequences, and skill-based challenges, you will be plunged miles and miles into the depths where the ocean seems to have no end.

title: Cactus Simulator 2
description: Cactus Simulator 2 is a game in which you can become a cactus.

title: Halloween Games for Toddlers and Kids
description: A lovingly designed Halloween puzzle learning game for small preschool children. It contains an animal memory find the pairs game that you can play against a cat as your opponent. For fearless children or you have your diaper ready!

title: Lucia and the Possessed World
description: The Latina fighting Satina in Hell! Blast your way through demons to save your famiily!

title: My Ex-future Family: Premium Edition
description:
This version contains two additional features:
1) Cheats — you may control changeable parameters of character and girls with legal tool. It helps to open all pathes and scenes.
2) Events — when you play MEFF you would have your favourite scenes. This feature helps you to repeat all sex events from the game per one click.
3) Walkthrough (in game folder)

title: Mafia Online
description:
Mafia Online Game by MafiaInLT is the first entertainment Mafia platform built for emotions, intuition, and the thrill of the bluff — playable by anyone, from first-timers to seasoned players.

Up to 10 players join a session and are secretly assigned roles: Mafia, Doctor, Sheriff, Lawyer, or Civilian. Every game plays out in real time — live video and audio for every participant, directly in the browser via WebRTC. Players vote, target, and interact by clicking on live video feeds. Faces, reactions, and hesitation are part of the game.

The platform is visually illustrated with crafted art and atmosphere designed to make each session feel like an event. The experience is built around entertainment, social connection, and the raw human dynamics of trust and deception.

title: Dark Conflict
description: Welcome to "Dark Conflict"! This is a game full of strategy and war elements, allowing you to play as a leader, constructing buildings, assembling armies, and developing resources to compete for the glory of victory.

title: Missing Stars
description: Missing Stars is a visual novel that aims to depict mental disorders and the people who live with them in a realistic, but sensitive and respectful light.

title: Enigma Quest
description: Explore an enigmatic museum, solve intricate puzzles, and uncover lost secrets in this immersive puzzle-adventure game.

title: Drive Up
description: Embark on a thrilling journey in 'Drive Up.' Scale the floating objects on a mysterious island in the ocean. There are no saves; one fall, and you're back to square one. How high can you climb?

title: Game Store Simulator
description: Buy and sell video games, upgrade your shop,load the cargo in your vehicle and take it to your store. Sell them to customers, make improvements and purchase new items to increase customer satisfaction and earn your place in the video game sales empire.

title: Kinky Fight Club 2
description: Join the Kinky Fight Club, where sex is a competitive sport! Set the rules, customize your appereance, abilities and skills and get ready for intense matches to wrestle and seduce your way to the top and become the champion!

title: Asterix & Obelix: Heroes
description: Original gameplay combining deck building and turn-based combat. 24 heroes from the comic series available for you in this original adventure. To foil Caesar's plans, upgrade your deck and make the right tactical decisions!

title: Shadow Rebirth
description: Shadow Rebirth is a classic top-down ninja game with an exciting story, dungeon exploration, monster and ninja fights.

title: Beatmons 2
description: Do not die ! Do not die ! Do not die ! Do not die ! Do not die ! Do not die ! Do not die ! Do not die ! Do not die ! Do not die ! Do not die ! Do not die ! Do not die ! Do not die ! Do not die ! Do not die ! Do not die ! Do not die ! I don't want to die

title: Rake Remastered
description: Survive the pursuit of a monstrous predator in "Rake Remastered," a tribute to the 2015 original. Uncover mysteries armed with traps and cameras. Outsmart the Rake, survive the nightmare.

title: Kizuyami
description: Kizuyami is an atmospheric psychological horror game. You find yourself in a never-ending Japanese street that you cannot exit wherever you go. You stumble upon the same house over and over again, which calls for you in inexplicable ways. Will you be able to find your way out?

title: Garnouille Must Live!
description: Help Garnouille. In a magical world full of dangers, Garnouille, an intrepid frog, embarks on a quest to save his habitat from imminent destruction. To do this, Garnouille must navigate through levels riddled with deadly traps using his special “dash” ability.

title: MechWarrior 5: Clans
description: MechWarrior 5: Clans follows a Star of Clan Smoke Jaguar warriors during Operation Revival, a full-scale invasion of the Inner Sphere. Armed with an arsenal of cutting-edge BattleMechs, meticulously designed maps and missions deliver immersive and intricate tactical gameplay and combat experiences.

title: Volatile Particle
description: Play as a particle with the power to manipulate your electronic charge. Leverage the laws of physics to complete levels, collect gems and set records.

title: Rockets, Planes, Soldiers
description: A relaxing rock-paper-scissors mechanic, turn-based strategy on a hex-grid.

title: The Order of the Snake Scale
description: Inspired by Lovecraft, a psychological survival horror game set in a dystopian, alternative universe. Discover the mystery of the woman's death and learn the dark secrets of the Happy Rock. Are you ready? Demo available in February 2024.

title: Neon Marble Rust
description: Play as one of 3 Houses: Neon, Marble, or Rust! Each faction is completely unique: buildings, units, even resources are unique to each House. A two-state rollback system ensures smooth online gameplay, while a mix of challenging mechanics and automation allow you to play (and win) how you want!

title: Warlords Battle Simulator
description: Test yourself as a commander in a tactical game where you will have to choose the right units to defeat the enemy forces. Test combinations of different units in over 100 fun levels as you fight disciplined Undead, fast Barbarians and strong Orcs.

title: The Sun Shines Over Us
description: An award-winning visual novel that dives into the lives and minds of high school students. While focusing on the stories of victims of bullying, The Sun Shines Over Us also explores the social, mental and emotional issues facing modern teenagers.

title: Boundless Paths
description: A tower-defense roguelike with an emphasis on exploration - reveal monster paths, bonus resources, and sites to place towers. Tackle unique quests and unlock new options across endless procedurally generated maps!

title: The Lost Ashford Ring
description: "The Lost Ashford Ring," a captivating hidden object adventure set in the enchanting world of Victorian England. In this immersive game, you step into the shoes of a brilliant detective, hired to unravel a mesmerizing mystery that will test your keen eye and sharp wit.

title: Cryoterror
description: A space horror game with retro-like pixelation and dithering effects, where you explore a desolate spacecraft and its mysteries.

title: The Local
description: A fast-paced parkour game set in the Australian outback. Rail grind around the long abandoned country to complete orders or compete in timed courses. Master the movement mechanics and conquer the leaderboards.

title: Lonely Turret 2
description: Build up your defense turret with unique attachments to survive waves of enemies and bosses. With 5 unique levels each with their own endless mode and over 50 attachments to try out and upgrade, the fun never ends.

title: Ataraxie
description: Ataraxie, in the pure style of retro games, ties itself with the SNES Gaming era and embrace difficulty, for it wishes to give experienced gamers/players the test they are really looking for!

title: Monotonia
description: In Monotonia, you take on the role of a worker with a simple mission: press a button to dodge resistances and generate as much energy as possible, without succumbing to resource scarcity, exhaustion, or insanity. How far will you be able to go?

title: My Douchey Boss Has a Gentle Twin Brother?!
description: Kyle's new boss, Vincent, is mischievous and eccentric. One day, Kyle bumps into his boss after work and is surprised when his superior acts kind. Later, he finds out he'd actually met his boss' twin brother, Vernon. The brothers are estranged, but what happens when they fall for the same person?

title: Geist
description: The Empire has enlisted you in the Geist Squad. Complete missions based on WWII in order to fulfill the Empire. Each one will be harder than the last in this WWII FPS. You the Player will have to fight through the enemies of the Empire. You will face heavily armed soldiers based on events in WWII.

title: Move The Chains: Season 1
description: Move The Chains is a choice-driven adult visual novel that puts you into the shoes of a hot-button athlete who finds himself being given a second chance after spending a year behind bars. The road to redemption is a long one, but it's packed with girls, love, drama, and of course, sex.

title: Caesar's Revenge
description: Caesar’s Revenge is a single-player retro FPS set in classical antiquity. Bring retribution to the greedy senator’s that betrayed you. Become the fall of Rome.

title: SpaceDRG
description: SpaceDRG is a high-octane, motion sickness inducing action game featuring cute pixel art graphics. Fight against the letters D, R & G in a space themed 1980s retro arcade environment.

title: Squeaky Squad
description: The Squeaky Squad struck again! Fight an army of rodents in this roguelite platformer.

title: Tank War Shooting Simulator
description: Experience the excitement of tank wars with the Tank War Shooting Simulator! Feel like a tank driver with realistic graphics and various game modes.

title: Mandela Syndrome
description: A horror puzzle game about keeping the world from being forgotten, one box at a time. Control multiple switchboards, solve puzzle minigames and survive the horrors of this strange Association.

title: Orbital Defense Force
description: Orbital Defense Force (O.D.F) is a multiplayer shoot 'em up co-op rogue-like game. play as mercenaries working for the O.D.F., accepting contracts to defend planets from invaders and earn precious scrap that can be used to upgrade their ship to take on more difficult contracts.

title: Telegraphist 1920: Beats of War
description: A narrative rhythm game that takes you back to 1920. See, hear and feel the Battle of Warsaw from a novel perspective - a war telegraphist, the crucial bond between soldiers and commanders.

title: Slimedrop Laboratory
description: It’s war under your microscope: bacteria will devour your Slime cells if you don't help! In this casual strategy game grow your cell sample, guide them to stay out of bacteria’s reach, boost your cells power, and watch them use unique abilities for survival.

title: Subenishiki
description: This is a shooting action game in the style of Metroidvania. It is not a very complex maze, and the emphasis is on shooting combat. There are several types of weapons that can be used, and maintaining firepower is an important key to the strategy.

title: P.R.O.T.O.C.O.O.L.
description: P.R.O.T.O.C.O.O.L. It is a multiplayer TPS game with fantastic and colorful graphics, developed by a small team. Fight across multiple game modes and ever-growing maps. Take to the Field, Fight and Survive!

title: Bubu Kong Goes Bananas
description: "Bubu Kong Goes Bananas" is a modern solo adventure, blending classic Arcade game nostalgia with dynamic environments and epic boss battles for a thrilling banana-collecting experience.

title: The King In Yellow: Escape Room
description: You have been sent to investigate a spaceship whose members have inexplicably disappeared and there is a strange symbol everywhere. In this escape room you will have to solve puzzles as you get closer to the truth behind the mystery.

title: My Furry Protogen 2
description: After every night comes a new dawn, full of hope and light. As the adventure of our heroes continues, let's see what lies ahead!

title: Days of Haze
description: Days of Haze is a puzzle filled climate simulated action RPG where your actions affect the weather and temperature. Coated in the exakt NES palette. it's insides reveal a deep survival lite action RPG

title: Mukke
description: Mukke City is about to take its musical turn! Help the new music scene by getting your self-created music on the radio, rocking the local music venues and hanging out with your newfound friends! MUKKE lets you make your own way between laid-back everyday life and gripping intrigue!

title: Spy Racing
description: A "driving" game of sorts. You can move left and right, and a bit forward and back. Don't collide with other cars, and collect as many disks as you can.

title: I Commissioned Some Cats 3
description: I paid artists to hide cats and wool in 15 pieces of artwork. Can you find them all? Warning: Relaxing.

title: Restless Voronezh
description: Restless Voronezh - A game in the Top Down Shooter genre, where the player controls a hero and, using various available means, deals with his enemies in cramped rooms of a huge building, clearing floor after floor.

title: Telescape
description: Telescape is a horror / puzzle game consisting of multiple sagas that each have a different goal and add extra mechanics. Find items, solve puzzles and change the direction of gravity while teleporting a monster to a random location as your only means of defense.

title: The Arrogant Kaiju Princess and The Detective Servant
description: Living as a slave to the Monster Princess in a colorful cohabitation lifestyle! An enriching and exciting time management love development game.

title: Running Fox
description: A sweet little indie game where you need to run with the little fox through a whole level of ups and downs. To complete the game, you need to collect all of the 100 gems. You may need to keep your eyes open to even find the hardest hideouts. Can you do so?

title: Only Wish
description: Dive into Only Wish, where doors reveal secrets, chairs become treasures, and cars drive you into a vertical world of endless wonder!

title: Rust Rails
description: Rust Rails is a 2D roguelike platformer. You have to travel by train through randomly generated locations, collect resources, craft equipment, and fight enemies. On your journey you will be helped by a mysterious robot and other inhabitants of this world.

title: Pixel Puzzles World War II Jigsaws: Battle of Hürtgen Forest
description: Pixel Puzzles World War II, merging history with the definitive jigsaw puzzler on the PC platform.

title: Tentacle Prawn: (Actually) A Cthulhu Dating Sim - The Myth & Legend of Marauder Shields
description: New story content! Two new Magnusball co-captains!

title: Slow Rise
description: A small adventure.The road ahead is difficult, moving and jumping.Carefully reach the finish line.Once you make a mistake, go back to the starting point.

title: Trapped in a Cage
description: Trapped in a Cage is a text adventure game developed by Disposable Club, where players will witness various events beyond human rationality that occur in an anti utopian prison. This is a small incision in a turbulent world, and also a brief moment of endless human nature.

title: Hundred
description: Let's set up our items and defeat monsters!!! Sorry, that's all there is!!!

title: Civilization Simulator
description: "Civilization Simulator": A casual simulation game that lets you control the fate of civilizations. Every click will impact the course of civilization. Whether it's prosperous trade or unexpected disasters, each turn presents a brand new challenge!

title: Island Clash
description: Island Clash is an adrenaline-pumping, fast-paced first-person shooter game! Unlock brand new weapons every time you eliminate enemies, with no ammunition limits, delivering a completely different shooting experience! Are you ready to take on the hail of bullets?

title: Cube Battlefield: 2048
description: A rogue-like top-down shooting game with infinitely generated levels. Grow a army of cubes with different abilities to break down enemies into smaller units. Make your cube army more powerful each time you are reborn.

title: The Scourge
description: The Scourge game tells stories revolving around urban legends from the 1990s in Saigon, Vietnam. The male protagonist is trapped by past sins caused by his and his family's mistakes. Now, he must confront and overcome the consequences to find a path to redemption, and you are him.

title: The Nights on Arcade
description: In The Nights on Arcade, Axel searches for his sister in the spooky Arcade World. Face your fears and reveal dark secrets in this nightmare.

title: Three Goblin Wobblin'
description: Goblins are prohibited from entering a local tavern, but luckily, they hatched a cunning plan. Move and balance the three goblins to help them quench their thirst and end goblin discrimination in this cute casual wobbling simulator.

title: Leap to the Top+
description: You are a frog, leaping automatically every second to the top. But can you beat all 7 of the grueling levels along with defeating powerful foes to learn how to Leap to the Top? Can you get the best times for true mastery along with collecting all of the hidden collectables in each stage?

title: Cum & Climb
description: The higher you climb, the more undressed your companion will be! Choose one of the two and start to Cum and Climb! The most realistic animations and 3D models are waiting for you!

title: Infernae
description: Fear is not a shield. Only those who face it will survive this adrenaline-pumping bullet hell boss rush.

title: Wizardry: Proving Grounds of the Mad Overlord
description:
The so-called "New & Improved Version" was a later, updated release of the original Apple II and PC Booter release from the early 80's. Unlike to original release, featured a larger graphic window and slightly more colors, depending on the computer.

Rather infamously, the MS-DOS version introduces a bug where upon leveling up, there was a small chance a characters stats would decrease.

title: Quantum Tripper: Math
description:
Purchasing this DLC enables the Math map to be fully playable.
When computational advancements render human sapience obsolete.

title: Your Train 2
description: You can operate trains more and more with your own train schedule! Train routes all over Japan and Taiwan, with a total of more than 50 routes!

title: All one click
description: Prove yourself against thousands of enemies in seemingly endless waves. Upgrade your skills from fighting with an ordinary bow up to casting powerful magic spells. "All one click" is an Action-RPG that reduces player input to the most existing part of every RPG: the level-up.

title: Bozalleth's Curse
description: Nightmares that wake you up in cold sweat. The world of dreams hides secrets and your sins. The game 'Bozalleth's Curse' tells you the story of Mary, who had an unfortunate accident eight years ago.

title: Fusing Noracam
description: Climb the mysterious tower to get the legendary treasure said to be at the top. The controls are simple, but if you make even one mistake, you will fall. You can also connect to the internet and climb with someone.

title: Pantheon: Card Game of Hentai - Part 1
description: Throw yourself into a fascinating adventure on the beach where you will meet mysterious goddesses! Defeat your opponents to win their favor and discover the secrets of their magical world.

title: Bombabomb!
description: Bombabomb! is a by old pre-installed games inspired game, where you light the bombs with matching neighbors to detonate them. The game is only complete when all the bombs have been detonated! When you say you can remove all the bombs easily, walk the talk!

title: The Windows Are Gone
description: Haunted by grief and guilt after a tragic accident, you start seeing a house in your dreams. No matter what you do, you can't get its image out of your mind. You feel it calling for you, so you answer it.

title: House 2
description:
As a terrible storm approaches, two young girls spend a fateful night watching TV and playing games…

House 2 is the sequel to the hit indie horror game, House. In House 2, you play as Tabby & Melody, finally free from their cursed home, in the next chapter of the House saga.

title: Wildlands Resurgence
description: section for a game where players need to survive from both other players and wildlife, mine resources, craft items and structures, and even form tribes:

title: Noah's Descent into Madness
description: Noah's Descent into Madness is a short horror-themed adventure and puzzle game. Make your way through a dark forest of unknown horrors while trying your best to escape the nightmare you've found yourself in.

title: Alice in the Nightmare Land
description: This is an escape adventure game. Within a building full of traps and mechanisms, your goal is to find the exit. Players will play as Alice, navigating through sealed rooms using click-based interactions to find items and solve the mechanisms to advance to the next stage.

title: Cyber Tower
description: Cyber Tower is a 3D cyberpunk Tower Defense game. Defend the city against virus-infected autonomous vehicles across 40 missions. Strategically place towers to eliminate enemies efficiently.

title: Blitz Guard

Once inside however, he is incapable of purchasing the food and his mind transforms the shop into a dungeon where he has to fight cans of soft drinks and hot dogs. The game consists of four main dungeons with a final boss and alternate endings based on some decisions in the game.

The character's basic attack is screaming, but after gaining experience he can learn new talents. While walking around he is dragged into random battles where he can also choose to run away. The statistics are based on energy and stamina. Saving is done by writing a livejournal blog entry and he shop online at Amazon. There are also some vending machines to buy drinks that replenish stamina. Other statistics are confidence, willpower and mindpower, he can wear weapons in his left and right hand (initially a fist of dork), a hat, a shirt and other accessories.

The game is very difficult. Some of the graphics are done by Paul Robertson, famous for the animated film Pirate Baby's Cabana Battle Street Fight 2006.

description: Emzombed - You must kill all of the Zombies and solve the mystery of the island.

title: Disco Samurai
description: Disco Samurai is a unique rhythm combat game in a cyberpunk setting. Challenge your skills by smoothly combining attacks, parries, dashes and other abilities to the beat of the electronic music. Crank up the volume and seize the rhythm of the electrifying soundscape of synthwave and rock!

description: Build. Expand. Upgrade. Defend. Combine TD and RTS mechanics to defend your growing economy.

description: Ambusher is a tower defense game. Set your traps. Build your towers. Prepare your defense and survive until sunrise.

title: Adventures of Deliveryman
description: Prepare for your first day of work as a delivery man, ride your bike, make deliveries, meet new people. Enjoy a delivery-filled story driven adventure in the not-too-distant future and discover the true nature of city's existence.

title: Apex Heroines
description: Hack&Slash – Beat'em all! Six heroines, five types of weapons and adrenaline-pumping levels create an adrenaline rush you can't resist. Easy to learn and hard to master. 4K/120Hz & SteamDeck-ready. Everyone can enjoy the game!

title: Bloxtacle Course
description: Bloxtacle Course is a block breaker game where you are given nearly full control over the ball itself.

title: Cat Life Simulator
description: Cat Life Simulator is a realistic simulation game that allows you to see the world through the eyes of a cat. Explore the world, interact with the environment, and create your own cat's story. Your adventure begins in a domestic setting, but over time, you will discover many other places.

title: Bob the Elementalist
description: The magical power of the elements is our last hope for survival! Master the four elements in this indie puzzle platforming challenge.

title: Bob's Mansion
description: Bob's Mansion is a First-Person, Survival Horror, Adventure game where you use your skills to Run, Hide, Fight and Survive the darkness within your family home.

title: OMSI 2: Hohenkirchen
description: Welcome to the Hohenkirchen expansion for OMSI 2 - Experience the diversity of Thuringia with this add-on in an OMSI map that has been deliberately optimised for a fluid gaming experience!

description: Eat the World!

title: Friday Night Funkin': Skibidi Invasion
description: Friday Night Funkin': Skibidi Invasion is a mod for Friday Night Funkin' based on the Skibidi Toilet series.

title: LEGO Technic Bionicle Nestlé
description:
In 2001, LEGO System A/S publishes LEGO Technic Bionicle Nestlé on Windows. This action game is now abandonware and is set in a licensed title, platform and promotional themes.

It's a side-scrolling platform game where the player can play as any of the six colored original Bionicle.

title: Magic: The Gathering 7th Edition Starter
description:
Introductory game to help new players learn how to play Magic the Gathering.
This game was developed by Coresoft Inc. and published by Wizards of the Coast.

It was included in the 2-Player Duel Sets of the 7th Edition Core Set of Magic the Gathering in 2001.

title: SAS: Zombie Assault
description: The world is being taken over by bloodthirsty zombies. Be brave, hide behind the barricades and face them.

title: A Vampire Romance: Paris Stories
description:
A young art student moves to Paris and falls in love with a young and enigmatic man. When her new love suddenly disappears, she must travel the city, solve a mystery, and discover her lover's secrets in this thrilling adventure!

Investigate the Seine river banks, the Pére Lachaise Cementery and more as you uncover clues and determine your destiny.

title: Nova
description:
Nova is essentially an RPG with horizontal Level Scaling, which means that any advantages players get over other players are temporary, with skill and game-knowledge being the primary determining factors in player success.

When a player logs into the game, they are presented with 5 points of interest: The Courtyard, the Kingdom, the Desert, the Forest, and the Dungeon. These locations' unique objectives and loot combined with their varying aesthetics and purposes give them each a unique personality.

There are 5 classes in Nova: Fire, Frost, Shadow, Nature, and Storm. Because of the bifurcated class structure and the unique synergies of the elements, there are essentially 10 fun and interesting classes. Each element entails 7 unique abilities that can be cast at any time with the only limitation being mana costs. This leads to 10 very different elemental combinations, all with access to unique Talents and Augments.

title: AFL Live: Premiership Edition
description: Released for Microsoft Windows, PlayStation 2 and Xbox on 29 April 2004. The game is based on the 2004 AFL season with team rosters based on that year. It was developed by IR Gurus and was the final AFL game to be published by Acclaim Entertainment, before their bankruptcy on 1 September 2004.

title: Balvenie's Birthday Party
description: Balvenie's subjects are preparing a party for her birthday, you must help her getting ready for it.

title: Tomb Raider: Legend Demake - Chapter One
description:
Tomb Raider: Legend Demake is a fan-made reimagining of Tomb Raider: Legend using the classic Tomb Raider engine. Originally released in 2006 and developed by Crystal Dynamics, Tomb Raider: Legend has been adapted here by Delca using an enhanced version of the Tomb Raider IV engine (TRNG). The gameplay and environments have been reinterpreted to reflect the style and design typical of Core Design's work in the late 1990s, often referred to as the "classic" era.

Chapter One features four levels: Croft Manor, Bolivia, Peru, and Japan. A follow-up containing the second half of the game is currently in development.

The story centers on Lara’s search for her mother and the mythical sword Excalibur, with some narrative elements reworked and simplified for this version.

Cutscenes are voiced in French, with English subtitles provided.

title: Nobunaga's Ambition: Ranseiki
description: The ninth title in the Nobunaga no Yabou series, this game returned to province-taking battles, and a system of varying powers was introduced.

description: Created by Sylvie & Aria, featuring music by Frédéric Chopin and 煉獄庭園 (Rengoku Teien) The difficulty is extremely high. Controls: Figure it out yourself!

description: Claustrophobic Nights is a complete reimagining of a VR game called Crawlspace 2 in the style of FNaF Help Wanted with multiplayer included. In the game, you crawl through tight spaces and solve various puzzles whilst evading animatronics in order to beat the night.

title: Hot Dog Reporter
description:
Hot Dog Reporter is a (very early access) game about a hot dog in a hurry.

It's a fast paced platformer with a speedrun mode that will eventually turn into a metroidvania with a mystery to solve and charmingly weird characters to meet (and a speedrun mode). Once the linear levels are iterated on enough to finalize Hot Dog Reporter's mechanics, gameplay will begin to spill onto the sprawling, interconnected city streets of New Yorkshire City.

title: Bloktris

A Tetris clone for 8-bit computers and consoles.

Based on the original DOS version, play the classic block matching game now with the classic background images.

description: Find the objects that are hidden on the map.

description: Find the objects that are hidden on the map.

Harness the power of magnets and the environment to wield as your weapon: defeat opponents by physically manipulating objects and the enemy itself.

title: Abandon: The Town
description:
A Source 2013 mod with a focus on gunplay over puzzles or story. Weapons feel better, enemies are a lot tougher, and the player can no longer quick save to try and cheese their way through situations. Play this if you're looking for a mod that actually makes some changes to the game rather than just a pack of maps set in the Half Life universe, but be sure to expect a challenge!

The mod is basically 100% focused on combat and is in some ways more of a proof of concept than a full game. So in other words there isn't really a story to speak of and it ends a bit abruptly. That being said more content is in development and everything I'm developing in this will be put to use in future work so look forward to that.

I'm currently very open to any assistance from experienced developers. I have very specific goals in mind so if you're looking for a project that isn't going to wander into the unrealistic territory that kills a lot of mods, this is it.

Small cars, big fun!
Playroom Racer is a 3D toy car racer for all ages.

title: Synergia: NextGen Edition
description: At the end of the world, love is sometimes the ultimate crime. Now remastered in high resolution, also featuring the SUNRISE expansion and bonus OST and in-game Artbook.

title: Boykisser Mayhem
description: After being sucked inside of the internet, Boyfriend has to face another dead meme again, it's Boykisser! They shall both get into a rap fight to see who is the ultimate Boykisser!

title: Helion
description: Are you ready to embark on an intergalactic journey like never before? Step into the thrilling world of "Helion," where tactical teamwork, role-based strategy, and stunning stylized graphics collide in an epic sci-fi adventure. Get ready to experience the future of team-based third-person shooters!

title: Luntik Learns Numbers
description: Curious Luntik invites girls and boys to fun counting lessons! Together with Luntik, other characters from the cartoon “Moon Guest” will find themselves at the epicenter of incredible events: the grasshopper Kuzya, the worm Korney Korneich and two hooligans - the caterpillars Pupsen and Vupsen. Favorite characters will challenge your child to complete a series of fun tasks to demonstrate their knowledge of numbers. If the baby fails to pass the test, he will have another, simpler one.

title: Paper Beast: Enhanced Edition
description:
Embark on an extraordinary adventure and help a living world.

Paper Beast Enhanced Edition Improvements:
- Smooth locomotion.
- HDR image fine-tuned specifically for PS VR2, for vibrant colors and smooth nuances.
- 4K rendering.
- Detailed textures and high-resolution shadows.
- Light shaft effects.
- Extremely precise sand and water physics.
- Sandbox: The terrain is more expansive, with an increased number of creatures and trees that become even more stunning over time.
- Option of playing without a VR headset.

title: Luntik Knows the World
description:
Luntik invites the kids for a walk through a bright fairy-tale world!

Together with the inquisitive lunar guest and his friends, little players will visit meadows and fields, forests and lakes, learn the names of many animals, plants, birds and fish, learn to determine which category this or that object belongs to, and visit Kapa and Shera will get acquainted with the features of some professions.

For each topic, you need to complete several interesting tasks, and if the child fails, the heroes will offer him a simpler test. At the end of the baby's adventures, a surprise awaits you - a new series of cartoons about the adventures of the lunar guest, as well as a certificate as a World Knowledge Specialist.

title: Luntik Learns Letters
description: Our favorite character, as well as the favorite of many modern children, Luntik, invites all young children to go with him on an exciting journey, during which he will conduct very unusual reading lessons. If your child thinks that memorizing letters is a rather boring activity, then this game will definitely change his opinion by turning learning into an exciting game. General Sher, Little Bee, Kuzya and Mila will help Luntik teach your children to read.

title: Honkai: Star Rail - Jolted Awake From a Winter Dream
description:
Version 1.4 of Honkai: Star Rail, featuring:
• New characters: Jingliu, Topaz & Numby and Guinaifen
• New main story quest
• New areas: Old Weapon Testing Ground and Pillars of Creation
• New companion missions
• New main event: Aetherium Wars
• …and more!

title: Monster Hearts R
description: Strange shooting game for PC.

title: The Legend of Legacy: HD Remastered
description:
RPG fans rejoice as the classic adventure, The Legend of Legacy is remastered in HD!

The unique stories of 7 heroes spring to life as you explore the mystical land of Avalon and face unknown dangers along the way. Classic RPG gameplay has never felt more engaging with features such as battle formations, combat roles, and forging contracts to channel the power of elementals. An adventure unlike any other awaits you!

title: Phobos Massacre
description: A replacement for Episode 1 of DOOM, in E1 style. This wad is an attempt to capture the atmosphere of "Knee Deep in the Dead" and to evoke nostalgia in players who enjoyed the original DOOM levels.

title: Vordakk's Keep
description: This wad is a replacement for Map 01 of DOOM2, and is my attempt at a Plutonia-style level. Expect a very challenging adventure with some nasty battles and rather unfair ambushes, all in the spirit of The Plutonia Experiment.

title: The Voice: La Plus Belle Voix
description: A video game adaptation of the French version of The Voice.

title: Ultimate Knight Windom XP
description:
Ultimate Knight Windom XP is a 2008 3D arena combat game featuring mecha inspired by various Windows and Linux operating systems originally developed by Y. Kamada for Microsoft Windows.

Windom XP supports singleplayer, local PVP, online PVP, and LAN PVP.

title: La Voz: Quiero tu Voz
description: Grab the mic and follow each beat and musical note, while the score counter multiplies with each matched melody.

title: Strato-Spear
description: Strato-Spear is an 3d character action/hack and slash game, with freeform combos and movement. It is inspired by games like Devil May Cry and Super Smash Bros.

title: Nyan Nyan Tower
description: Doujin stage ascending game.

title: Zombiezz
description: Step into the undead frenzy of Zombiezz! Experience a one-of-a-kind retro arcade adventure where you obliterate hordes of zombies. With a top-down forced perspective, plunge into action-packed gameplay that pits you against relentless waves of the undead. Can you survive the zombie onslaught and emerge as the ultimate survivor?

title: Tsumera
description: Taiwanese PC Pinball game.

title: Traumatarium
description: A randomly generated dungeon crawler in the style of Fighting Fantasy, featuring some of the most brutal 4 color dungeons!

title: Tenebrum
description: A heretic megawad containing total 35 levels, including secret levels. Intended to be played as a campaign. Also contains around 30 new monsters and 8 bosses.

title: Sinful Discharge
description: An episode for Heretic

title: Templum Dormiens Dei
description: A single level for Heretic, which requires ZDoom 2.8.1 or later. This map is meant to follow the events of Dark Deity's Bastion, and serve as an ending to the storyline which began with that level.

title: Shadowcaster
description: A 21st century Heretic episode covering many styles of level, both traditional and unusual as well.

title: Virtual Mom: Job Simulator Manager
description: You are a true superhero, balancing between raising children and a successful career. You'll have to overcome numerous challenges, starting from the moment the morning sun rises...

title: Reclamation
description: An ancient sanctuary has been corrupted by the minions of evil; reclaim the church and make the bastards pay.

title: Torture
description: A small map inspired by the style of the levels in the alpha

title: Thief: The Trail of the Arch-Heretic
description: A moody, ambient WAD intended to put some of the feeling of "Thief: the Dark Project" into Heretic. It's a reworking of my own njthief WAD for Doom2.

title: Where Serpents Ever Dwell
description:
After the lifeless bodies of D'sparils body guards crumble and fall to the ground, for the first time in ages you feel a sense a sense of relief... as you enter the portal that finally takes you... home?

This is a challenging map for Heretic, and your gonna need to keep moving as well as taking full advantage of artifacts if you want to survive.

title: The Sewers of D'Sparil
description:
"Even underwater cities like D'Sparil's Dome need sewers"

A collection of speed maps made in 100 minutes.

title: Love Kuesuto
description: Take on the role of an old man whose life is flashing before his eyes. As you awaken, the goddess Aphrodite guides you through four game boards full of romantic trauma and relationship dilemmas.

title: The Crypts
description: This large map is a remake of E1M7 (The Crypts).

title: Foot Clinic
description:
Step into the shoes of a doctor and podiatrist as you indulge in the foot clinic experience. Scrub, scrape, pluck, and pull all kinds of feet.

Perform foot treatments for conditions like calluses, corns and ingrown toenails. Each patient presents a new problem, so you'll never get bored of your work!

title: The History of Fruit
description:
This is a 9 level Heretic wad designed for single/cooperative play.
In an epic turn of events, the Overlords of Fruit have rallied their unequaled forces of ferocity and badness and meanness and have struck back. It's up to the heretics to fight them back to the last bastion in The History of Fruit!

title: Water Castle
description: This map is the sequel to Water City, and as such picks up where that map left off.

title: The Fiery Crater
description: After you entered the core of the volcano in Fiery Descent, you found yourself in the middle of a smoldering crater on the other side. This map picks up where that one left off, as you journey deeper into it, discovering an ancient fortress built into the side of the lava mountain.

title: The Fiery Descent
description: A short map, set inside a great volcano.

title: Crazy Bus
description: Fill up the Bus!

title: Puzzle Balls
description: Solve the puzzle to release the blue ball

title: Battle Sea
description: Captain, it's your time to shine! Rule the seas in Battle Sea – a new version of the classic game 'Battleship'!

title: AirJet Fighter Sky Dominators: Aerial Assault
description: Get ready to dive into the heart-pounding world of high-flying action in "AirJet Fighter Sky Dominators: Aerial Assault" This adrenaline-pumping airjet game combines strategic shooting and explosive chaos, challenging players to become the ultimate

title: Sudoku for Kids
description: Start your journey in the unlimited world of numbers!

title: Platypus Evolution
description: Platypus Evolution is a mobile clicker game for Android and iOS where you evolve platypuses into various different crazy creatures and document them in your Platypedia. It is part of Tapps Games' evolution series.

title: Defense of Nations
description: A base defense shooter in the vein of flash game classics like "Elona Shooter" and "Defend Your Castle" but with a satirical, political-sim twist. Shoot hordes of monsters, negotiate your operating budget, and navigate international rivalries, all for The Good of Humanity️!

title: Get Out of My Store!
description:
Your store is being invaded by some weird invaders during the end of October... Beats me! Who knows what these thugs are up to!?

8 different type of monsters are waiting to haunt you and eat your food. Disaster!

Unlock better weapons, and fight protecting your burgers!

Shoot them up, and try to survive all 20 nights!

Get Out Of My Store! is an arcade inspired top-down shooter where the objective is to survive enemy raids and get to the end. Every night is more difficult than the last, and new wacky monsters keep appearing until the very end.

Can you survive all the nights? Refine your abilities, beat your hi-score, and triumphantly defend your store!

title: Paddock Note '95
description: The game simulates building up a career for horse racing. As the manager, the player can choose the winning horse, the rider and how many meters racetrack, which is done by navigating multiple menus. In the Strand Yard office, the player has access to plenty of information for the available horses and riders before making decisions. Further learning can be done at the Horse Museum.

title: Mahou City
description: 3D Action Battle City like game.

title: Disgaea 7: Glasses Costumes Set
description: Adds a set of 7 unique character costumes (glasses).

title: Urban Flow: Elite Edition
description:
This bundle includes base game, Winter Expansion Pack and Streets Supplement with:
• 7 new vehicles
• 20 new levels!
• winter theme and new music!

title: Pixel Paint 2: Special Edition
description:
Pixel Paint 2 is a sequel to an extremely popular game by the same name. The rules are quite simple. Put your mind at ease, follow the numbers, and fill out every last pixel with the right color.

It's your first step in becoming an amazing pixel artist. Choose a theme you like and sink into the wonderful world of pixels.

Choose from a wide range of drawings, and expand your pixel art gallery with the Health DLC!

title: S.N.I.P.E.R.: Hunter Scope - Elite Edition
description: This bundle includes base game, Expansion pack, Weaponry Upgrade and Target Acquired.

title: Portals of Phereon
description: Portals of Phereon is a turn-based tactical role-playing roguelike monster-girl creature-collector by erotic artist Syvaron. Select from one of three distinct protagonists, each with unique skill trees and specialties, and embark on expeditions through the Portals of Phereon to accrue enough strength to tackle the final mission before time runs out.

title: Naruto x Boruto: Ultimate Ninja Storm Connections - Ultimate Edition
description:
The Ultimate Edition includes:
• Main Game
• Season Pass
• Naruto Uzumaki (The Great Ninja War: End)
• Kakashi Hatake (Maskless)
• Costume & Accessory Pack

title: Mixx Island: Remix Plus - Definitive Edition
description: In this bundle, in addition to the main game, you will get access to a new Spring and Winter Islands.

title: Mario + Rabbids Sparks of Hope: + Rayman Edition
description:
The + Rayman Edition of the game includes:

- The base game.
- DLC 3: Rayman in the Phantom Show.

title: Captain Tsubasa: Rise of New Champions - Ultimate Edition
description:
The Ultimate Edition includes:
• Base Game
• Character Pass
• Character Mission Pass
• New Champions Uniform Set
• V Jump Accessories
• Shutetsu Uniform
• Tsubasa's Challenge Ball + Meiwa FC
• All-Japan Junior Youth Uniform
• Open Sky Uniform Set
• Hawk Uniform Set
• 2 goal performances

title: Dragon Quest Monsters: The Dark Prince - Digital Deluxe Edition
Draw and Color: Kawaii - Magnificent Edition
Fashion Princess: Ultimate Edition
description: This bundle includes base game and both DLC: Extra Levels and Special Levels with additional levels! New adventures! New fun!

title: Food Truck Tycoon: GOTY Edition
description:
Test your skills and talent as owner of a busy food truck!

Your only job is to take orders, prepare food and serve to as many customers as possible.

Be careful not to burn the food!

title: For a Vast Future: Deluxe Edition
description:
Experience a dystopian future and bring down the government, evil cults, and even more villains standing in your way.
Sink into a classic RPG, and wait for your turn to stop Doomsday from happening!

The people of Seralia experienced a devastating war. While most of them fight over scraps, the corrupted government schemes to take revenge using a secret weapon – secret and deadly. Join a group of heroic outlaws and stop this madness.

title: Hentai Girls: Premium Edition
description: In this bundle, you will have lots of fun with Yui and Etsuko - two of the girls from the main game.

title: Hentai Stars: Deluxe Edition
description: This bundle includes Demoness Ayame DLC.

title: Hentai World: Legendary Edition
description: In this bundle, you will meet student Sayuri and Nanami in her new puppy look.

title: Hole io: Complete Edition
description: Hole io: Complete Edition features: 9 maps, 40 animated skins, 2 multiplayer modes, Endless mode, Powerups, Collecting themed stickers and easy controls.

title: Isle of Jura Fishing Trip: Complete Edition
Kitten's Head Football: Complete Edition
description:
This is exactly what you think, football with kittens, but not just that.
It’s not just a game about cutie kittens, they are real players, and you have to deal with them, because when these paws are on stadium - passion comes into play.

title: Dragon Quest Monsters: The Dark Prince - Treasure Trunks
Pipe Line Puzzle
description:
Connect the complex pipes by rotating them!
This simple yet deep puzzle game lets you twist the panels and create a flowing water path by connecting the pipes.

The controls are easy - just touch the panel you want to rotate.
Find the start and end points of the pipes and keep connecting them by rotating.

Earn 1 to 3 stars based on your completion time and aim for 3 stars on all stages!

title: Master Detective Archives: Rain Code - Ch. Halara: Raining Cats & Dog
description: The third DLC for Master Detective Archives: Rain Code is a substory that features protagonist Halara Nightmare, and allows players to control the Master Detective with the Forensic Forte "Postcognition."

title: Dragon Quest Monsters: The Dark Prince - Coach Joe's Dungeon Gym
Sid Meier's Civilization VI: Leader Pass
description: Return to rule with the Civilization VI: Leader Pass. Lead your people to greatness with 12 leaders brand new to Civilization VI and 6 new takes on classic Civilization leaders.

title: Cat's Cosmic Atlas: Solar System Map
description: Gaze upon the stars and other celestial bodies. Experience the most beautiful sights and learn even more with Solar System Map. Travel through our Solar System or stroll along the Southern and Northern sky. Your journey into space starts now!

title: Cat's Cosmic Atlas: Southern Sky Map
description: Gaze upon the stars and other celestial bodies. Experience the most beautiful sights and learn even more with Sorthern Sky Map. Travel through our Solar System or stroll along the Southern and Northern sky. Your journey into space starts now!

title: Dragon Quest Monsters: The Dark Prince - The Mole Hole
Hentai Stars: Night Rider Ran
description: Dive into the world of hentai stars and meet new Ran in her night rider look.

title: Cat's Cosmic Atlas: Northern Sky Map
description: Gaze upon the stars and other celestial bodies. Experience the most beautiful sights and learn even more with Northern Sky Map. Travel through our Solar System or stroll along the Southern and Northern sky. Your journey into space starts now!

title: One Piece: Pirate Warriors 4 - Yamato's Grand Tour Logbook & Soul Map 1
description: Yamato takes Oden's logbook as his personal bible. Set out with him on his own grand tour across various stages!

title: Foot Clinic: Feet the fish
description:
With this DLC you'll unlock:
- Fish tank tool
- Soap and flusher Pro skin
- Foot Care Cream Pro skin
- Thorn Tweezers Pro skin
- 2000 coins to upgrade your clinic faster

title: Foot Clinic: Smelly Feet
description:
With this DLC you'll unlock:
- Perfume premium tool
- Tweezers Pro skin
- Pedicure Pliers Pro skin
- Toenail Clippers Pro skin
- 2000 coins to upgrade your clinic faster

title: Hentai Stars: Idol Tsubaki
description: Dive into the world of hentai stars and meet new Tsubaki in her idol look.

title: LEGO 2K Drive: Premium Drive Pass Season 2
description: Premium Drive Pass for Season 2 unlocks the ability to earn a total of 103 Premium Rewards at your own pace, including 11 Vehicles, 10 Drivers, 27 Brick Packs, and more!

title: Let's Sing 2024 with International Hits
description: Step into the spotlight. | It's your time to shine!

title: Color Sense Challenge
description:
A brain-training art certification game that hones your mind.
It's a brain-training game where you can test your color perception with simple controls.

title: Hentai Stars: Demoness Ayame
description: Dive into the world of hentai stars and meet new Ayame in her demoness look.

title: Easy Red 2: Normandy
description: With Easy Red 2: Normandy you will experience the historic battles of the D-Day landings and beyond in immersive detail.

title: The 20 Heretics Challenge
description: 20 monster challenge from Doom but Heretic. Only 20 monsters per map. Period. Max 1 boss monster of any type

title: Heretic Upstart Mapping Project
description: The Heretic Upstart Mapping project was made to get people into mapping for heretic. It includes many maps by people who had never mapped for heretic before, and some older maps that authors had never published.

title: Heretic Upstart Mapping Project Mini
description: HUMP mini (short for Heretic Upstart Mapping Project mini) is a 2018 Heretic mappack, an offshoot of Heretic Upstart Mapping Project from the previous year. It was led by HexenMapper, but unlike the preceding effort which was meant for GZDoom, HUMP mini is instead built with vanilla compatibility in mind.

title: Sosuria
description:
Sosuria is a map made for SOSU's birthday.

Sosuria is a proud, peaceful village on the island of Khshayarsha, full of life and hospitality. That is, until one day an evil sorcerer ransacked the land with his army, taking most of the goods and resources for himself and turning the island into an uninhabitable volcanic landscape. Legend has it that a mythical being of wonder dwells in Sosuria's largest and most prominent building, the Temple of the Ancients. It is said that this creature has the ability to turn back time and undo the evil that was dealt to the village. There is only one way to find out if this is true...

title: Wrath of the Titans
description: A complete 9-level episode featuring some new textures and classic Heretic style with attention to Raven's mapping conventions. The set plays on the episode 2 slot. It includes 8 revised editions of ETTiNGRiNDER's prior released ﻿maps to update the visuals and gameplay, plus 1 never before released one (E2M2)

title: Blood, Fire, Death
description: You Akroxs, the archimagus of fire and ice. Long time ago you have called great demons, masters of fire for yourself in a service, in exchange for the soul. But when payment time has come, you have not wished to give the most valuable that is at you. And you have gone to their house to win them and not to be more dependent on them. Whether you will to win them? Or you will for ever doom the soul to a fiery torment?

title: Burial Ground
description: Burial Ground is a heavily gameplay-driven custom story that's built to emulate the feeling of playing Amnesia: The Bunker for the first time, with an emphasis on high randomness, replayability, and gameplay that rewards exploration and playstyle.

title: Dark Mountain
description: A graveyard is being harvested of corpses to create undead warriors. Fight your way into the caverns beneath the mountain to destroy the evil inhabitants.

title: Desert Crypt
description: While traveling through a desert region, you are ambushed and knocked unconscious by a group of golems. You wake up to find yourself inside a sarcophagus. You push the lid of off the coffin and climb out. You hear the sounds of stone debris being piled up outside the entrance to the tomb. They are sealing you in. At your feet you notice your crossbow. Whoever has put you in here has tossed your weapon on the tomb floor to be sealed in with you. You force the door open and begin fighting your way out of the crypt...

title: The Forgotten Portals
description: You're making your way through an icy region and are nearly crushed when some ice caverns collapse. Eventually you make your way out only to find yourself trapped in a long deserted temple complex. The gates are enchanted and cannot be opened. You decipher an inscription that tells you that you must pass through three portals to remove the barriers that will allow you to leave.

title: Recant
description: Recant is a fairly large level created by Dr. Sleep

title: Shadowy Forest
description: Battle your way through a forest at night.

title: The Subterranean River
description: A river running through an underground city. Fight your way through the docks, the throne room, the flooded temple, a cathedral, the crypts and much more in this massive level.

title: The Master's Domain
description: A full replacement, (9) levels for Episode 1.

title: Ye Olde Smudge
description: Ye Olde Smudge is a 1995 Heretic mapset by Christen Klie consisting of three levels.

title: The Indespensible T_DUNNxx.WAD Series : For Heretic
description: The Indespensible T_DUNNxx.WAD Series - For Heretic is a single-level PWAD for Heretic designed by Travers Dunne and Alister Dunne and released in 1997.

title: Dark Mountain II
description: Sequel to "Dark Mountain" (darkmtn.wad). This is a very large level with more detail in many places than the original Heretic engine can handle.

title: Heretic Speedmapping 1
description: A set of 4 Heretic speedmaps made during an 8 hour session that occured on 1/19/2018.

title: Heretic Speedmapping 2
description: A set of 4 Heretic speedmaps made during an 8 hour session that occured on 2/23/2018

title: Lucifer's Spell
description: New map for Heretic replacing E1M1. Its fairly large and straight forward in progression.

title: Candy choppers
description: The first released Heretic level for Paul Corfiatis, replaces E2M1 and is very small

title: Lost and Forgotten
description: After D'Sparil's defeat, Corvus thought he would be trapped forever. Not long after the decisive battle, Corvus was teleported to an unknown, snow covered region. He gathered what remained of his willpower and began his trek. Lost and Forgotten is a two map release for Heretic's E1M1 and E1M2.

title: Hoshigari Empusa!
description:
A dating simulator on PC and PS2.

You can choose any of the eight main characters as the protagonist and go after the characters of the opposite sex.

title: Go to Sleep
description: What began as a fun dream has turned into a waking nightmare. Now trapped in your room, you are stalked by a relentless demon. You must keep it at bay. Your only way through this nightmare? Close your eyes... and go to sleep.

title: Sweet Season
description: An adult visual novel released in 2002.

title: My Dear Brother Jeff
description:
My Dear Brother Jeff is a Horror experience based on a certain point of view of the story/Creepypasta named Jeff the Killer.

Immerse yourself as Liu, the brother of Jeff, the psychotic killer, face the tragedy of an entire family and discovers the terrible truth that hides behind this horrifiying event...

title: Yukigatari
description: A adult visual novel released in 2001.

title: Yukigatari Renewal
description:
The protagonist's little sister appears as a new character.
Scenarios have been remade since the Dreamcast release, and new event CGs and endings added.
This version also adds voices for the male characters which original only female characters were.

title: Timespinner 2: Unwoven Dream
description: Travel to the Tower in the Sea to avert the apocalypse, in this exploration action-platformer. Join Auria, a retired war hero, as she adventures through a beautiful and dangerous world to save her family and the fabric of reality itself!

title: 2048 3D
description: Control cubes and enjoy 2048 game in real 3D world! Be careful not to drop the cube outside the box!

title: Command & Conquer: Generals Evolution
description: A Red Alert 3 total conversion aiming to bring C&C Generals Zero Hour onto the new engine as well as to expand upon it.

title: Blasphemous Experiments
description: Blasphemous experiments is a complete first episode replacement for Heretic, using the Blasphemer texture pack.

title: The Village of Archensheen
description: A bite sized Heretic level with the restrictions of no more than 100 enemies, 100 sectors, and 1000 linedefs.

title: The Remote Outpost
description: Sarge Baldy's first released Heretic map, to be used as E2M1 of the FreeHeretic project. The overall theme is therefore vaguely similar to the original.

title: Quoth The Raven
description: Quoth the Raven is the 28th installment of the Pineapple Under the Sea Speedmapping series, created by BluePineapple72. The event ran during June of 2023, in which maps were created in a time limit of 8 hours or less. Mappers were to create Heretic maps using a custom texture pack and calling back to several of the design tropes from the original Heretic. It contains 3 episodes, with forced secret exits, for a total of 27 maps.

title: How to Disappear Completely
description: 3rd part of the river of fire series. this time it all takes place in a underground cave

title: Heart of Fire
description: This is the sequel of The River of Fire. This level is detailed and you start where you left on The River of Fire.

title: The River Of Fire
description: Find the way back to the surface.

title: Anthology of the Killer
description:
A paid compilation of the "Of The Killer" comedy-horror games. The compilation contains a loader for the games, bonus content, and controller support.

Join BB as she makes rent and zines in a world of drinky birds, secret rooms, dream resorts, bort dolls, waterparks, immersive theater, beachfront t-shirt stores, police men, art freeports and unorthodox medical treatment. Nobody gets out of here alive!!

title: Assassin's Creed Revelations: Special Edition
description:
A Europe and Japan-exclusive edition of Assassin's Creed Revelations that included:
The Game soundtrack CD
Two multiplayer characters (The Crusader and Ottoman Doctor)
The Singleplayer Turkish Assassin Armour
The short film Assassin's Creed Ember (Japan-version only)

title: Pleasuredromes Of Kubla Khan
description: Very important, historical Khan game. Step back into history with this extraordinary game.

title: SingStar MegaHits
description: A Spain-exclusive version of SingStar Ultimate Party, which contains Spanish music not found in the original game.

title: Dungeons and Monsters
description: An episode for Heretic replacing the original first for Limit-removing ports. Made on the basis of different images from google for the query "dungeons maps". There are some textures from Hexen, Hexen II, Heretic II, Witchaven and a few of their own.

title: The Mysteries of Underville
description: The level is direct continuation of the Heretic: Shadow of the Serpent Riders, with Corvus stepping through a portal after defeating all Maulotaurs in the fifth episode.

title: Quest for the Crystal Skulls
description:
Quest for the Crystal Skulls is a new action-packed episode for Heretic.
Corvus is confronted by a Heresiarch, a powerful minion of the Serpent Riders. This dark wizard has stolen three crystal skulls, using their power to open a portal to the underworld in the hopes of bringing about his master's return.
Corvus must collect the remaining six crystal skulls in order to unlock the celestial path and confront the Heresiarch before it's too late.

title: Masters of Chaos
