Like in most other games in the series, there are multiple dead ends and possible actions that lead to premature end of the game.

title: Fun Chess: Premium Edition
description:
Choose one of the heros and challenge other players in this family-friendly version of Chess. Thanks to the cartoony graphics, this variation can be enyojed by people of all ages.

This bundle includes the Ghost and Elf DLCs.

title: Farm Land: Complete Edition
description:
Start your farming adventure! Take care of the plants, watch them grow and harvest the crops!
Your quest is simple... sow the seeds, harvest the crops, sell your products to the merchants and expand your farm to become the best farmer you can be!

title: Knights & Guns: Gold Edition
description: This bundle includes base game, Expansion Pack #1 and Armor Pack #1.

title: Knights & Guns: Prime Edition
description:
This bundle includes base game, Expansion Pack #2 and Armor Pack #1 with:
- 10 new levels for you to bring back the peace
- 7 new armors to help you on your quest
- New enemies for that extra little kick

title: Noisz Re: Collection G
description: Noisz Re: Collection G is a massive all-in-one collection of Noisz content, featuring 40 action-packed stages and 3 story campaigns which mix the visual novel format with intense rhythm battles! It's time to face the music like never before.

title: Cat's Cosmic Atlas: Deluxe Edition
description:
Embrace the wonders of the night sky alongside an adorable kitten named Fellie.
Gaze upon the stars and other celestial bodies. Cat’s Cosmic Atlas takes you through the Southern and Northern skies. Experience the most beautiful sights and learn a thing or two about the vast Universe that surrounds us.

title: Comic Coloring Book: Complete Edition - Paint Special
description:
Many adventures await!
Once upon a time, two children, a boy, and a girl found two unique toys - a robot and an alpacorn. These magically came to life to become our heroes' best friends! Together they experience amazing stories about friendship, helping others, and the joy of life!

This bundle lets you try out the new whiteboard set and drawings.

title: Tenshi-tachi no Gogo III: Ribbon
description:
The third game in the Tenshitachi no Gogo series is not connected to its predecessors story-wise. In this installment, the player assumes the role of a male teacher in a high school. Many pretty female students (and pretty female teachers) surround the hero, but he only has one girl in mind: Haru Okamoto, whom he calls "his angel". In order to win her love, the hero will have to know her better - which also means knowing the secrets of students and teachers alike...

Tenshitachi no Gogo 3: Ribbon is a Japanese-style (puzzle-less) adventure game. The player interacts with the environment by choosing verb commands ("Look", "Ask", "Search", etc.), which lead to sub-menus with object choices. The game mostly advances in a linear way, but at certain points the story can end prematurely, depending on the player's choice.

title: Dateless Love: Love Story Behind the Restoration
description:
Time slipped during a school trip in Kyoto,
it is a love game at the end of Edo period with handsome guys.

title: Dark American Horror Stories
description: Discover American horror stories that fuse the unexplained and the sinister in haunting settings, revealing the dark secrets of American society.

title: Persona 5 Tactica: Digital Deluxe Edition
description:
Triple Threat Edition includes:

• Base Game
• Limited Edition Bonus - Raoul Picaro
• P5T: Repaint Your Heart Challenge Pack
• P5T: Weapon Pack
• P5T: Picaro Summoning Pack

title: Tenshi-tachi no Gogo Collection
description:
"Tenshi-tachi no Gogo Collection" contains three games, which are remakes of the first three entries in the Tenshi-tachi no Gogo series.
The remade versions were not released separately.

All the three games have updated graphics (some scenes were completely re-drawn), as well as interface changes. There is no text input and all the three remakes have a similar verb-based menu interface. The menus have been simplified, with less choices than in the original versions, removing most of the "useless" command combinations.

title: Pinball FX: South Park Pinball
description: It’s South Park, pinball style! Join Cartman, Stan, Kyle, Kenny and Butters in these totally sweet pinball adventures!

title: Pixel Game Maker Series: Ninja Runner
description: A ninja never stops training.

title: S.N.I.P.E.R.: Hunter Scope - Aniversary Edition
description: This bundle includes base game, Expansion Pack and Target Acquired.

title: Speediest: Car Racing Formula & Auto Sport
description: Rev up your engines and get ready for the ultimate racing experience in Speediest - Car Racing Formula & Auto Sport! Choose your path in the fast-paced world of motorsport as you take on the challenges of Formula and Autosport racing.

title: Zombies Wars
description: "Zombies Wars" is a shooting game.The terrifying zombie shooter game immerses players into places infested with horrifying zombies.

title: You Are Liam: Shadow Memories
description: You have done some things you're not proud of. Now you must enter your own mind to come to terms with the things you've done. Loop around rooms, solve puzzles and hide from different monsters as you uncover your own truth.

title: World war zombie
description: WorldWArZombie - another zombie game but with several maps and several fun and devastating accessories, only for real gamers

title: Worldcrusher
description: Travel in space and scrap other planets to rebuild your own homeworld in this simple clicker RPG.

title: Wipe Girls
description: Players will play as a bounty hunter and live and work in the city of dreams. Because of a chance commission, unveiled his revenge journey. This game has a total of four female characters on the scene.In addition to their apparent identities, there are other secrets hidden behind them.

title: Who is Abby
description: You play as Tom, searching for his missing sister in this stunning first-person walking sim meets point-and-click adventure. A psychological thriller where you unravel a mystery through exploration and puzzle-solving—no horror, just suspense and intrigue as you reveal more about her disappearance.

title: Until The Last Bullet
description: Until The Last Bullet is a unique combination of an FMV and rail-shooter game in which you navigate the winding halls of an abandoned factory, eliminating waves of bloodthirsty mutants.

title: The No-Name Project
description: Welcome to 'The No-Name Project,' where limitless freedom awaits! Adopt various characters, from animals to NPCs, even resurrecting them with necromancy. Explore, mine, and interact with the world's secrets. Frequent updates ensure endless adventures!

title: The Ruins
description: If you’re reading this I apologize. I will not reach an October release date, unfortunately my SSD containing all the game files for both the ruins and jumpah has failed. This is a very tough time for me I will try my best to get back on track. Thank you.

title: Throw Anything: Radiation Zombies
description: Complete missions to save a world devastated by zombies, utilizing Arm Units and special abilities! Throw Anything: Radiation Zombies is a third-person shooter 3D-action roguelite game set in a world overrun by zombies, where you survive by throwing objects around. Equip a powerful Arm Unit, enhance yourself with a personalized skill tree, and explore a maze-like world!

title: The Witches Story
description: The Witches Story is a visual novel for adults only. Eric, an ordinary man who has always laughed at tales about witches, finds himself in the center of the witches' magical world. He gets to meet the witches, get to know them from a different side and in different poses.

title: The Skyland Chronicles
description: You are a bloody pirate. Will you make the most of it in the new world and fulfill your destiny? This is your battle, where you'll come face to face with dark creatures from Slavic mythology. Take on the role of a legendary warrior and decide if the world is worth saving.

title: Tracks of the Arcana
description: A tarot-inspired adventure game where you travel the cosmos with your magical train, fighting enemies and crafting resources, all while drawing tarot cards that shape your destiny.

title: Tower Defense 3D Fusion
description: A unique and modern take on the tower defense genre.

title: Tower of Fire: The Sword of Unspoken Misc
description: Tower of Fire: The Sword of Unspoken Misc is two hour story-heavy adventure game with a strong Power Metal aesthetic.

title: Tomb Of AnuBI0S
description: Tomb of AnuBI0S is an unique 2D tower defense-platformer with an Egyptian Sci-fi setting. Defend the AI deity RAm from waves of undead "Organics." Upgrade your arsenal from weapons to walls, turrets, and your player capabilities. Immerse yourself in meticulously crafted levels and defend RAm!

title: Toi 2 Attack
description: Emperor Zaroc's forces invaded the planet Toi destroy the boss and regain control of the planet

title: TNMverse VIP
description: TNMverse VIP is an online multiplayer battle royale Game

title: Egyptian Myth
description: An excellent large Egyptian temple themed map that will keep you in the action almost the whole time.

title: Fearcraft
description: Three small-medium sized levels that are almost a horror Hexen2 theme. The setting is a dark fantasy castle showing hints of industrial growth, built upon terrain and cliffs, and disappearing into the void.

title: The Looming Madness
description: Large egyptian map with a unique mix of textures. Features a few custom monsters such as the SOA goblin and the Snakeman.

title: Brumal Quest
description: Large snowy medieval village, using Daikatana and Hexen2 textures, and coming with snow-themed monster skins.

title: Ultramarine
description: When the feelings fade away and the promises are forgotten, one is always tempted to move on or cheat. We are presenting you a story of four athletes who are going to surprise everyone around. Who is in true love? Who is cheating? Will there be some revenge?

title: Nihilore: The Mechanical Empire
description: Nihilore is a dark industrial two-map nightmare using a strong mix of custom textures. This Mechanical Empire is brought to life with rusting metal beams and buttresses holding together a brown brick city.

title: Necrobrood
description: Necrobrood is a three map pack with new monsters, textures and skins. The theme follows on from Permutations of the Rotten with a very dark and morbid metal style using grotty brownish modified ID textures.

title: Love: Spice!
description:
Love: Spice! is an otome/dating sim game created in two weeks for My First Game Jam: Summer 2023.

In a world where everybody (yes, everybody) is some kind of spice, a regular black pepper, weighed down by the mundanities of life, engages in an interesting hobby to destress: people -- no, spice watching. In a completely respectful manner, of course. It's always cathartic to see hot men just existing. But at some point, these men have begun to take an interest in our unassuming little black pepper! And maybe, just maybe, it'll develop into something more...

title: Sinister 625
description: Community mapping event in celebration of Quake's 25th anniversary: nine large levels in varying themes + a starting hub, all following the "625" rule of using only six different textures (6 for June), featuring two surprises and five enemy types (2 and 5 for 25 years of Quake).

title: Guncotton
description: Guncotton is an industrial/base styled two map pack (and start map). Architecturally very detailed, the maps are woven in modified Q2 Waste textures (MXoxide) and Than's Industrial set.

title: Re:Mobilize
description:
Re:Mobilize is a brand-new single-player Quake modification by EmeraldTiger and Inky that introduces three new movement-based mechanics to the game, opening up devious new challenges to players and a whole new dimension of possibilities for level designers.
Trampolines: Perform death-defying leaps of faith across even the most intimidating gaps and chasms.
Wiremeshes: Nothing can stop you, not even gravity itself. More than just simple ladders, these surfaces let you move up, down, sideways, and even hang from ceilings.
Lighthooks and Lightpanels: The lighthook's purely photonic composition allows it to instantly latch onto any visible lightpanel, regardless of distance. You'll be hooked in no time - literally.

title: The King's Wish
description:
It has been a hundred days since your father, the king, passed away. You have spent a hundred days in your high tower with the knight who ended his life, and who has sworn to end yours as well.

It's time to make a choice.

title: Rusty Barrel
description:
Rusty barrel is a short horror game in which you pilot a small, cramped and old submarine. You have to move through narrow openings in gorges on the ocean floor.

The game was made in 72 hours for Ludum Dare 54 on the theme "Limited Space". Inspired by the game Iron lung.

title: Imomushi
description: This is not "The Great Adventure of the Cute Caterpillar."

title: Cog: The Rogue Machine
description: Discover the secrets of a mysterious machine and the corporation excavating it for its precious resources in this rocket-fueled roguelike platformer!

title: Algor Pew Pew
description: One day, invaders from the other world attacked and kidnapped all ARPs. Your mission is to travel through parallel worlds, enjoy the rhythms, rescue the ARPs and survive until end. Let us dive you into the first rogue-lite survival game from Algorhythm Project.

title: A.I.Liens
description: A.I.LIENS - A 3rd Person Shooter RPG with Advanced A.I., Abilities, Player Stats, Inventory, Loot, Dialogue, Interaction, Firearms, Melee Weapons, Weapon Upgrades, Save/Load and much more

title: Aeterna Noctis: Virtuoso
description: Aeterna Noctis: Virtuoso is a boss rush mode that allows players to face the bosses they already defeated during the base game, but includes new difficulty modes, combat patterns, and behavior!

title: Adult Puzzle: My Pretty Neighbor Chloe
description: You should meet Chloe.Are you feeling stressed? Don't worry.I'm here to help you relax and brighten up your day with a classic puzzle game!

title: Abyss School
description: Solve hidden items and puzzles while avoiding abyssal zombies and traps at school.

title: 3D Puzzle: Harbor
description: Collect a 3D puzzle, transferring things to the right places to create a beautiful place.

title: 3D Puzzle: Building
description: Collect a 3D puzzle, transferring things to the right places to create a beautiful place.

title: Amazin' Mage
description: amazin' Mage is a top-down, randomly generated dungeon crawler with crafting and with excellent replay value!

title: Arcane Blast
description: Arcane Blast is a fast-paced, action-packed roguelike brimming with sorcery. Master the seven elements, combine them to achieve powerful reactions and face swarms of enemies to help feline Mage Adrian find his way home from a time dungeon.

title: Virtuar Z
description: A sci-fi Third Person Shooter with a background in the Indonesian city of Jakarta in the future, city full of conflict, Neo Jakarta 2150 once familiar city of Jakarta has been destroyed by civil war, The law of the jungle applies.

title: Unispies: Chapter 1 - Havana Cuba
description: A group of smart, latin american, attractive female hackers steal 2 billion of bitcoin from a communist dictator. Then their lives and family are targeted by the dictator for that crime. The team of girls are rescued by Omar, an ex Mi-6 British agent who runs the Spies for Hire team called Unico.

title: Undead Uprising
description: "Undead Uprising" immerses you in a post-apocalyptic world swarming with zombies. Battle through endless waves of the undead. Continuously evolving, the game offers regular updates and fresh content. The fate of humanity rests in your hands. Are you ready?

title: Ukemeowy
description: In the world of Ukemeowy, you play as an ukulele player, you can mix and match chords to your liking and create the tune you like. Enjoy the vast green scenery as you play the ukulele to your heart's content.

title: Tsugunohi: A Voice from Yesteryear
description: "Tsugunohi -A Voice from Yesteryear-" is one of the most popular titles in the "Tsugunohi" series. The game features a new route that can only be released after the game is cleared. In this realistic recreation of Japan's old-fashioned countryside, a number of terrifying events attack a young girl.

title: Tuzaq
description: Tuzaq is a non-linear visual novel in the genre of adventure.A sweet story about a cruel girl. Or... is it a cruel story that has disfigured a sweet girl?

title: The Shadow of the Evil Tower
description: This is a platform action game with various traps and tons of levels for players to challenge!

title: The InVincible Iron Ivy: Enter the Pretty, Pretty Princess
description: This game is a Soulslike Role-playing game that uses a progress system (“leveling system”) for measuring players’ rates of success. This version of the game is a single-player mode-only game.

title: The Cauldron Kids: The Summoning of Mr. Vermicelli
description: The Cauldron Kids is a pixel art short narrative RPG about two kid witches on their way to magical mischief and plushie bewitching, combining quirky and sweet dialogues and minigames. Featuring the small and cozy chalet the characters live in, players discover soon that the Cauldron Kids’ home is full of magical and playful surprises.

title: The Carrier and Crows
description: Crows have downed your plane and you are trapped at the far end of a remote peninsula in northern British Columbia. You must craft the necessary tools to contend with the local eccentrics and find your way back to civilization.

title: Telluria: Forebodings Gear Minigame - Final Stage
description: A puzzle-solving stage involving objects crafting and inventory use

title: Stolen Memories II
description: The emptiness of the chosen path entangles souls, preventing them from moving forward. The quiet, unbearably gentle withering continues, and only hope can stop it. Only hope can bring the smile to her face once more. "Stolen Memories" a non-linear visual novel with multiple endings.

title: Surf Park
description: A surfing game focused on smooth carving turns and realistic airs.

title: Super 10 Pin
description: Strike your way through a wild world of bowling in Super 10 Pin! Use special abilities to jump, boost, and explode your way down unbelievable N64-styled bowling lanes in this wacky arcade bowling game!

title: Suns of Wiraqocha
description: Help the God Wiraqocha to recover all the stolen suns that have been hidden in different dimensions, which you can access through the Great Gate of the Sun, to return light to the Milky Way.

title: Sunken Ships
description: Explore a little seaside coast of submerged ruins, sunken ships and lonely islands.

title: Super RPS
description: Super RPS is a tactical strategy game in which two players have a series of Rock, Paper, Scissors matches on 5 fields concurrently. Each player has a secondary deck of "Field Cards" that have special abilities that can turn the match in your favor.

title: Tale of Ren: Searching for Heart Droplets
description: Me...Mizu Ren Nanami… As a REN people, it's time to go on a mission to conquer the hearts of people in other realms. Then, the Rostania is the town where I was chosen to come here. to the pursuit of secrets that were never known before.

title: Steampunk Jigsaw Puzzles: Mediterranean City-States
description: It is often remarked that the balmy lands around the Mediterranean are living through a second renaissance. The spirit of Galileo certainly seems to endure, in this new era of mechanical and architectural splendour.

title: Steel Aces
description:
Introducing Steel Aces – The Free-to-Play Tank MMO with No Pay-to-Win Mechanics
Steel Aces offers a level playing field where skill, not premium purchases, determines your success. Our dynamic vehicle tech trees let you unlock new ammunition as you progress, while our Collector Tanks are carefully balanced, ensuring that all players compete on equal terms.

title: Spank It
description: SPANK IT - is the simplest 2D puzzle the final goal of which to give you pleasure!

title: Stamped: An Anti-travel Game
description: Stamped follows the journeys of six young travelers whose paths intersect across Asian urban landscapes. Bound by pleasure-fueled self-destruction, the group flounders from city to city, confronting the grief and discrimination that caused them to travel in the first place.

title: Starkheim Tournament
description: Starkheim Tournament is a simplified 2D fighting game set in fantasy universe with a pixel-art style. With only two primary attack buttons, and controls that do not require any complicated motions, Starkheim Tournament aims to be easy to pick up and only just moderate to master.

title: Sorrows End
description: A fantasy turn-based RPG, Made with RPG Maker MV. It utilizes a side view battle system, contains scenes that may be frightening and scenes of anguish. Sorrows End is a heart-wrenching tale of loss.

title: Slimewest
description: Face off against an invasion of slimes in this 2D roguelite with pixel art graphics. Play alone or with up to 4 friends and save the city from the devouring attack of these creatures. Get your weapon ready and embark on this bang bang western style adventure. Play now and prove your mettle!

title: Slav Junkie Simulator
description: You live in a small soviet slav eastern european cyberpunk city. You have severe heroin addiction that you need to sustain. Heroin is very expensive and earnings in a rural city are very small, barely enough for survival. Survive one week.

title: Six Sides Of Obscurity
description: Six sides of obscurity is a story-based RPG that you can play solo or with a team of up to 4 players. You will have endless build possibilities. Creating a character, increasing passive and active abilities according to class, producing equipment, adding tactical bonuses and runes, etc.

title: Soggy Beans
description: Fish will come, fish will go. Take photos, collect beans, decorate your seascape, then relax or do other things while your friends swim by in this calming side-idler.

title: Skibidi: Escape from Toilets
description: "Skibidi: Escape from Toilets" is a cooperative horror game for 1-4 players. TV MANs are trying to get through creepy and atmospheric locations that are filled with dangerous SKIBIDI TOILETS - they want to kill you! Free content updates with new levels and game modes - YES YES YES!

title: SD Dungeons
description: Create your own character and go on a great adventure! Randomly generated dungeons at each level and gates that affect the difficulty of where you go await you! Can you get powerful weapons and gems and escape without running out of power?

title: Scorching Desert
description: "Scorching Desert" is an open-world survival crafting game, where your main objective is to survive in a hot, unforgiving desert plagued by an ancient evil! You will need to gather resources, build a resillient shelter, stay hydrated & explore a massive 64km^2 Map!

title: Sex Lens: A Porn Story
description: Sex Lens: A Porn Story is a visual novel that places the keys to an intriguing cinematic world in your hands. You have the opportunity to participate in a luxurious and creative process, but be prepared for challenges that present you with difficult choices.

title: Shadows Of Deceit
description: Shadows of Deceit is a next-gen horror and psychological thriller game developed with Unreal Engine 5. While you are getting a chill down your spine with the impressive story and realistic locations, you will also witness the mystery behind Janet's story.

title: Sex Simulator: College Girls
description: A sex simulation game with visual novel elements where you play the role of a university professor who gets busy with his female students.

title: Sex Apocalypse 2
description: Conquering the apocalypse has never been so vivid and emotionally charged! Welcome to the world of Sex Apocalypse 2 – the second installment of a unique third-person shooter.

title: Sex Play: College Girls
description: A quick and dirty game made for your pleasure. Contains visual novel elements and a sex simulation part. Enjoy the story of two female students getting naughty in their dorm room.

title: Sirius-4
description: "Sirius-4" is a plot-oriented space simulator that gives the player complete freedom of action as a hired pilot of the "Sirius" unit. The action takes place on the outskirts of human space during a turbulent time for the galaxy after a global war.

title: Simply Moose
description: Reflex-based puzzle game based on Boulder Dash principles, but with its own unique style.

title: Rubicon: Cubindom
description: Rubicon is a turn-based puzzle game based on the principle of the Rubik's Cube. Use the game mechanics that the world has loved and our innovations to restore order to the inhabitants of Cubindom.

title: Road Rampage
description: Avoid all the cars and try not to crash in this fast paced endless highway game!

title: Rogue Nova
description: An intense, fast-paced real time strategy space opera, with a cast of colourful characters through a planet hopping adventure. Do you have what it takes to escape the relentless Baron protect of Princess Valeria?

title: Romance Club: Stories I Play
description: Immerse yourself in romantic visual stories where you control what happens!

title: Royale King
description: Win and be the royal king only you! Think right and jump at the right time.. Only one can win! Be it you!

Not on your side. It's just straight line from start to finish. And skill required to get through it. Party like 1989.

title: Avaris3
description: More than 12,000 units battle on the battlefield!

title: Finite State Automaton Challenges
description: In this game, we will play with the simplest automaton model, Finite State Automaton, and use it to cope with 30 challenges.

title: Dust Front RTS
description: Dust Front is a real-time strategy game that blends classic RTS mechanics with grand strategy elements. Players engage in military operations across barren battlefields using varied tactics from mass infantry deployment to strategic bombing raids. The game features a non-linear campaign where players choose their path through different military scenarios and strategic decisions.

title: Dawn of Insolence
description: A top-down roguelike with a deck-building system. Create your own unique deck of weapons, passive items and other upgrades. Each time you level up, you will be given random upgrades from your deck. Unlock new upgrade options to personalize your deck and survive the hordes of enemies.

title: Escape the Glubinka
description: December 6, 1994. the village of Glubnkovo. You were driving home after a very difficult day along an abandoned village and did not notice a tree peeking out ahead. In an instant, complete darkness overtook you and you passed out...

title: A Tale of Two Lovers
description: A Tale of Two Lovers store is a visual novel game for adults only. This game is about two young lovers who like to love each other after the day's rush.

title: Eros Lights: Strip-Club
description: Welcome to the world of intrigue and incredible adventures in Eros Lights: Strip-Club, a visual novel for adults that takes you to a mysterious and magical club where the true faces of mystery are revealed.

title: R-Type Final 2: Ultimate Edition
description: Soar to new heights and save big with the R-Type Final 2 Ultimate Edition which includes the base game, all DLC sets, Soundtrack, Art Book, and more.

title: Persona Collection
description: Experience the power of Persona today!

title: Sword Art Online: Last Recollection - Deluxe Edition
description: The culmination of the Sword Art Online game series, Last Recollection features the largest roster of SAO playable characters and sub scenarios!

title: Birch Simulator
description: The main characters of modern games can be very different. Brave knights, brilliant scientists or superheroes saving entire worlds. This game offers you a more unusual experience. Here you can become a Birch.

title: QuantAttack
description:
QuantAttack is an action puzzle game.
The rules are based on the theory of quantum computers, and you can learn how they work as you play.

title: DC Universe Online: Episode 46 - Justice League Dark
description: A powerful curse is burning through the world's most powerful magic users, escalating their powers to dangerously violent extremes! Hoping Batman can take on the hard work, John Constantine's transported his House of Mystery to overlook Gotham Cemetery, where he and it are now under attack. In Justice League Dark Cursed, players will join forces with Batman and members of the Justice League Dark to put an end to this threat to all magic.

title: DC Universe Online: Episode 1 - Fight for the light
description: The first DC Universe Online episode, Fight For The Light. This episode allowed players to embark on a new adventure with Green Lantern and Sinestro Corps as their battle becomes the forefront of the episode. Some of the key features of this episode include a new Tier 3 Duo in Ferris Aircraft, two Tier 2 Alerts with Oan Sciencells and S.T.A.R. Labs Research Facility, and a Tier 3 alert in Coast City. This episode also brought the new Controller powerset "Light", based on Green and Yellow lanterns for heroes and villains respectively

title: DC Universe Online: Episode 2 - Lightning Strikes
description: The second episode, Lightning Strikes, was released on December 6, 2011. This episode allowed players to battle through new open-world solo and group activities in a new high-level open-world map of Central City. Players can explore the origin of The Flash and take on some of his opponents in the villainous Rogues. Some of the key features of this episode include the open-world Central City map with daily Tier 3 missions, nine daily Tier 3 Bounties, and a Flashback Tier 2 Duo. Alongside this content came the new Healer power "Electricity"

title: DC Universe Online: Episode 3 - The Battle for Earth
description: On March 13, 2012, the third episode, The Battle for Earth, was released. This episode largely continued the story in the fight against Brainiac which was one of the main storylines in the DC Universe Online base game. Players would fight for the fate of the universe with cooperative gameplay against Braniac. Some of the key features of this episode include three Tier 2 Duos in Riverfront Center, Gotham Hospital, and Riverside Hotel, one Tier 3 Alert in South Gotham Courthouse, and two Tier 4 Raids in the Gates of Tartarus and The Prime Battleground. In addition, the new Tank power, "Earth" was added in and the Battle For South Gotham featured daily Tier 2 missions

title: DC Universe Online: Episode 4 - The Last Laugh
description: The fourth episode, The Last Laugh, was released on June 19, 2012. This episode focused on the Joker as he gained access to hero and villain safe houses to stir up additional controversy between the player factions. Some of the key features of this episode include one Tier 3 hero Duo in Shady Nightclub, and one Tier 3 villain Duo in Police Station. This marked the final performance of Arleen Sorkin before her retirement. This was also her final time voicing her iconic character Harley Quinn.

title: DC Universe Online: Episode 5 - Hand of Fate
description: On August 14, 2012, the fifth episode, Hand of Fate, was released. The episode revolved around DC hero Doctor Fate and would give players a chance to fight through new mystical story content. Some of the key features of this episode include two Tier 4 4-player Operations in Wayward Souls, and Soul Alchemy. In addition, this episode released four Tier 4 8-player Operations in With a Vengeance, A Black Dawn, Unpaid Dues, and Seeds of Rot.

title: DC Universe Online: Episode 6 - Home Turf
description: The sixth episode, Home Turf, was released on January 29, 2013. The episode focused on both new and iconic locations that DC fans would be familiar with as they battle through new objectives and missions. Some of the key features of this episode include two daily Tier 4 hero missions located at Ace Chemicals and Stryker's Island, two daily Tier 4 villain missions located at Steelworks and Arkham Island, and daily Tier 4 Bounties.

title: DC Universe Online: Episode 7 - Origin Crisis
description: On May 8, 2013, the seventh episode, Origin Crisis, was released. The episode continued the story from The Battle for Earth episode, as players travel through time to fight for control of space, time, and the universe itself. Some of the key features of this episode include two Tier 5 Challenges in Iconic Anomaly: The Hunt and Iconic Anomaly: Test Subject #1, two Tier 5 4-Player Operations in Brothers in Arms and Family Reunion, and two Tier 5 Raids in Nexus of Reality and Paradox Wave while introducing the new Controller power, Quantum, where players control time and space.

title: DC Universe Online: Episode 8 - Sons of Trigon
description: The eighth episode, Sons of Trigon, was released on August 29, 2013 for subscribers, and September 3, 2013 for those players who did not have an active subscription. The episode focused on going against DC villain Trigon as he takes over an alternate Gotham City. Some of the key features of this episode include a new location in Gotham Wastelands with daily Tier 5 missions, three Tier 5 Duos in Tunnel of Lust, Ruined Cathedral, and Knighsdome Arena, one Tier 5 Alert, and DC hero Raven featured as a weekly Tier 5 Bounty. Continuing the new trio of new powers, this episode brought the combo-based "Celestial" Healer power.

title: Suika Combination
description:
Can you combine them up to Suika?
Inspired by Suika Game

title: DC Universe Online: Episode 9 - War of the Light Part I
description: On January 22, 2014, the ninth episode, War of the Light Part I, was released. The episode revolved around the continuing battle between the Lantern Corps in Metropolis. Some of the key features of this episode include two Tier 5 4-Player Operations in Mist Recovery and Strike Team, one Tier 5 8-Player Operation in Assault and Battery, a new location in Downtown Metropolis Battlezone with weekly Tier 5 missions, and gave players access to either Ranx's Command Center or Mogo's Command Center. And finishing the new powers trio, it brought "Rage" as a tank power based on the Red Lanterns.

title: DC Universe Online: Episode 10 - Amazon Fury Part I
description: The tenth episode, Amazon Fury Part I, was released on April 30, 2014 for players with an active subscription, and May 6, 2014 for players who did not have an active subscription. The episode focused on the battle between DC hero Wonder Woman and her mother Queen Hippolyta. Some of the key features of this episode include two Tier 6 Challenges in Aegis of Truth and Circe's Trial, two Tier 6 Duos in Port of Paradise and Supply Lines, one Tier 6 Alert in Themyscira Divided, and a new location in Gotham Under Siege with daily Tier 6 missions.

title: Watch Your Nightmares
description: Watch Your Nightmares is a point-and-click survival horror video fangame creat of Sweetsylveon. The game is based on FNaF 4 with a concept of camera system, and is released on July 31st, 2018.

title: DC Universe Online: Episode 11 - Halls of Power Part I
description: On August 6, 2014, the eleventh episode, Halls of Power Part I, was released. The episode revolved around the New Gods of the Fourth World as they sought new ways to take control and engage in strategic battles on a cosmic level. Some of the key features of this episode include one Tier 6 4-Player Operation in Intergang Crime Wave, one Tier 6 Alert in Security Breach, one Tier 6 8-Player Operation in Artifacts from the Past, and two Tier 6 Raids in Relics of Urgrund and Lockdown.

title: DC Universe Online: Episode 12 - War of the Light Part II
description: The twelfth episode, War of the Light Part II, was released on November 11, 2014 for players who had an active subscription, and November 18, 2014 for players who did not have an active subscription. The episode revolved around continuing the story first started in War of the Light Part I and the battle between the Lantern Corps. Some of the key features of this episode include one Tier 6 Challenge in Spark of Parallax, one Tier 6 Duo in Spark of Ion, one Tier 6 Alert in Zamaron Conversion Chamber, two Tier 6 4-Player Operations in Avarice Impurity and Rage Impurity, one Tier 6 8-Player Operation in Love and War, and featured a return to the Downtown Metropolis Battlezone location.

title: DC Universe Online: Episode 13 - Amazon Fury Part II
description: On February 3, 2015 for members and February 12th, 2015 for non-members, the thirteenth episode Amazon Fury Part II, was released for players with an active subscription and players without respectively. The episode revolved around continuing the story first started in Amazon Fury Part I as players would continue the fight against the Amazon queen Hippolyta. Some of the key features of this episode include two Tier 6 Operations in Return to the Nexus and Act of Defiance, three Tier 6 Raids in Labyrinth of Lost Souls, Halls of Hades, and Throne of the Dead, in addition to a return to Gotham Under Siege location with daily Tier 6 missions.

title: DC Universe Online: Episode 14 - Halls of Power Part II
description: The fourteenth episode, Halls of Power Part II, was released on May 12, 2015 for players with an active subscription, and May 19, 2015 for players without an active subscription. The episode revolved around continuing the story first started in the Halls of Power Part I episode, as players would continue their battle against the New Gods. Some of the key features of this episode include two Tier 7 Duos in Resource Recovery and League Hall: Malfunction, one Tier 7 4-Player Operation in Fatal Exams, one Tier 7 8-Player Operation in New Genesis Now, one Tier 7 Raid in Happiness Home, and a new location in New Genesis which gave players access to daily Tier 7 missions.

title: DC Universe Online: Episode 15 - Bombshells Paradox & Corrupted Zamaron
description: On August 5, 2015 for members and August 12th, 2015 for non-members, the fifteenth episode Bombshells Paradox & Corrupted Zamaron, was released for players with an active subscription and without respectively. The episode revolved around players traveling to an alternate WW2-inspired universe where the DC Bombshells were faced with an infinite timeline war. Some of the core features of this episode include one Tier 7 8-Player Operation called The Bombshell Paradox, and one Tier 7 Duo in Corrupted Zamaron.

title: DC Universe Online: Episode 16 - Desecrated Cathedral and Oa Under Siege
description: The sixteenth episode, Desecrated Cathedral and Oa Under Siege, was released on September 2, 2015 for members, and September 9th, 2015 for non-members. The episode revolved around players defending OA as it faced a new threat from the Black Lantern Corps, and a new storyline with DC hero Raven. Some of the core features of this episode include one Tier 7 Alert in Desecrated Cathedral and one Tier 7 Challenge in Oa Under Siege.

title: DC Universe Online: Episode 17 - Unholy Matrimony & The Flash Museum Burglary
description: On October 7, 2015 for members and October 14th, 2015 for non-members, the seventeenth episode, Unholy Matrimony and The Flash Museum Burglary, was released. The episode revolved around players continuing the storyline told in Episode 16 Desecrated Catherdral and a continuation of the League of Assassins storyline that started in Episode 15 The Bombshells Paradox. Some of the core features of this episode include one Tier 7 8-Player Operation in Unholy Matrimony and one Tier 7 Duo in Flash Museum Burglary.

title: DC Universe Online: Episode 18 - The Demon's Pit and Blackest Day
description: The eighteenth episode, The Demon's Pit and Blackest Day, was released on November 4, 2015 for members, and November 11th, 2015 for non-members. The episode revolved around players finishing the War of the Light saga and combating the League of Assassins' interest in Central City. Some of the core features of this episode include one Tier 7 8-Player Operation in Blackest Day and one Tier 7 Duo in The Demon's Pit.

title: DC Universe Online: Episode 19 - The Demon's Plan and Deep Desires
description: On December 2, 2015 for members and December 9th, 2015 and non-members, the nineteenth episode, The Demon's Plan and Deep Desires, was released. The episode revolved around concluding the League of Assassins storyline and served as an epilogue to the Episode 17 Unholy Matrimony storyline. Some of the core features of this episode include one Tier 7 Alert in The Demon's Plan and one Tier 7 Duo in Deep Desires.

title: DC Universe Online: Episode 20 - Blackest Night & Wastelands Wonderland
description: The twentieth episode, Blackest Night and Wastelands Wonderland, was released on January 6, 2016 for members with a subscription, and January 13, 2016 for players without an active subscription. The episode revolved around players fighting The Blackest Night and dealing with the fallout from the War of the Light saga. Some of the core features of this episode include one Tier 7 8-Player Operation in Blackest Night and one Tier 7 Duo in Wastelands Wonderland.

title: DC Universe Online: Episode 21 - Prison Break and The First Piece
description: On February 4, 2016, and February 10, 2016, the twenty-first episode, Prison Break and The First Piece, was released. The episode revolved around working with a new stranger that asks the player to go on a couple of adventures. Some of the core features of this episode include one Tier 7 2-Player Operation in The First Piece and one Tier 7 8-Player Operation in Prison Break.

title: DC Universe Online: Episode 22 - Science Spire and The Phantom Zone
description: The twenty-second episode, Science Spire and The Phantom Zone, was released on March 2, 2016 for members and March 9th, 2016 for non-members. The episode revolved around dealing with Phantom Zone malfunctions and sightings of a mysterious figure near the Science Spire. Some of the core features of this episode include one Tier 7 Challenge in The Science Spire and one Tier 7 4-Player Operation in The Phantom Zone.

title: DC Universe Online: Episode 23 - The Will of Darkseid and Brainiac's Bottle Ship
description: On April 6, 2016 for members and April 13th, 2016 for non-members, the twenty-third episode, The Will of Darkseid and Brainiac's Bottle Ship, was released. The episode revolved around dealing with prisoners who had escaped from the Phantom Zone and a potential new invasion from Darkseid's forces. Some of the core features of this episode include one Tier 7 2-PLayer Operation in The Will of Darkseid and one Tier 7 8-Player Operation in Braniac's Bottle Ship.

title: Ame ni Utau Tanshikyoku: A Rainbow After the Rain
description:
Throughout the game you are presented with various flashbacks of a psychiatrist talking with a girl named Ame.

At the start of the story the protagonist lives with Chinatsu due to various happenings in his childhood that caused him to become an orphan, and as such mainly sees her as an older sister. The prologue basically starts out with Chinatsu telling the protagonist that 3 of her patients will come live with them for a few weeks as a part of their rehabilitation.

title: URBO
description: URBO is a relaxing and meditative city-building puzzle game. Begin with an empty grid of landscape, choose an architectural style and build. Aim to support the needs of your people and your own aesthetic tastes, and watch your city flourish.

title: ProtoViolence
description:
Can a scientist save a test subject from her life’s work?

All documents enclosed relate to ██. ██████ and █████████’s history within the Youth Training and Development Initiative (YTDI)’s child cybernetics and processing program. Unauthorized release of any information constitutes an unacceptable risk to stop’s reputation and will result in immediate termination and potential incarceration.

These documents were recovered from Stop backup servers from previously corrupted data. They pertain to the incident that occurred at YTDI Facility #001 on Oct. 1st, 207█, and record the events from ██. ██████'s first arrival at the facility to the date of the incident.

title: Flesharmonic
description: It's a 20-maps megawad of raw and grilled meat to satisfy your insatiable appetite for wads!

title: Bloody Slipgates
description: E1M1rmx with a twist: a certain amount of red keys scattered throughout the map have to be collected in order to proceed, making the gameplay largely non-linear.

title: Numb Nimbus
description: Large brick/metal void map.

title: Biotoxin
description: czg's entry for the second 100brush contest: a small industrial map with Quake2 textures.

title: Februus Depth
description: Large underground catacomb level.

title: The Slipgate Duplex
description: Professionally constructed remake of E1M1 with some additional areas.

title: Witch House Mixtape
description: Small to medium-sized wiztech level, industrial structures and crumbling brick buildings blending together.

title: Slipgate to a Lost Dimension
description: A small single classic-style map inspired by id base maps but with some eldritch monsters.

title: Slip Tripping
description: Retro style speedmap about dimension traversal for vanilla Quake.

title: Quad Run
description: An assorted pack of 15 levels made in 48 hours for a community speedmapping jam, all centered around the Quad Damage powerup.

title: Prototype Jam 3
description: 28 levels + custom start map, offering a variety of map sizes and gameplay themes. All maps were made in 1-2 weeks, using the Prototype textures by Khreathor. Built on Copper v1.19

title: Ceremonial Speedmaps
description: 13 SP maps inspired by Ceremonial Circles.

title: Coffee Quake 2: Double Shot
description: 132 short speed-maps + custom start map and end map, each made in two hours by 36 mappers for vanilla Quake. There were four episodic themes: Egypt, Runic, Koohoo, and Elder, and each episode is accessible from the start map hub.

title: Quake Brutalist Jam
description: 35 "concrete murderzones" inspired by modernist architecture, all made over 2.5 weeks by a variety of first-time mappers and veterans. Most maps make heavy use of Makkon textures. Built on Copper 1.19

title: Sewer Jam 2
description: 17 stinky sewer-themed maps (+ custom start map) running on a pre-release version of Alkaline 1.2 (already included), "created by a bunch of cool people" over a 4-week period.

title: 37th Relic Retrieval
description: Huge nonlinear IKbase level with over 900 enemies.

title: Armageddon 2
description: Small Metal level.

title: A Past and Future Secret
description: Medium-sized medieval stronghold surrounded by rocks and lava. A classic-style level in the spirit of Beyond Belief.

title: Awoken Madness
description: Huge metal/runic fortress built into the mountains, with a high monster count.

title: The Putrid Pumps
description: Large metal/runic industrial slime temple.

title: 28 Pixels Later
description:
In this short parody survival horror game, you'll solve puzzles, smoke plants to restore health, and, of course, blow zombies to pieces with a good old shotgun.

You will have to do all this in second person (from the eyes of the zombies you are killing)

title: Ciudad Anómala de Buenos Aires
description: Ciudad Anómala de Buenos Aires is an interactive narrative of strange but true stories that took place in the Autonomous City of Buenos Aires. It has several mini games, humor, and constant interaction with mysterious and ghostly characters. Moreover, it is riddled with references to Argentine culture (from Borges to Cha Cha Cha) and the video games that shaped us.

title: Cozy Keep: Farm, Craft, Manage
description: Experience the daily life of a shopkeeper! Clean and decorate the place, pay taxes, gather resources and craft products that can be sold for maximum profits! Explore the world, hunt, and cultivate the land! Own the best shop in the region and save your father from the wrath of the King!

title: Livid Meadow
description: Livid Meadow is a short, story driven action platformer.

title: Luce's Journey: A Victorian Trading Tale
description:
Embark on a journey through the Victorian era as Luce, a young child determined to survive the harsh winter months.
In this survival experience, you'll need to manage your resources carefully, keeping track of hunger, cold, money, and, of course, your most valuable resource – matches.
You'll need to make strategic decisions about when to trade your matches. Buying them at a low price and selling them at a higher price is key to your success. But be warned – the market can be unpredictable, and you'll need to keep an eye on the daily match price.
Experience the thrill of the trade as you work to survive and thrive in this harsh and cruel society.

title: The Widow's Shadow
description:
Following her late husband’s funeral, a widow laments her loss. The townsfolk's whispers surround her every time she leaves the house, rumours she cannot avoid no matter how she tries.

Yet one night, everything she wishes to ignore will be laid bare as she steps into a twisted reality — one borne from her own heart.

title: Pac-Man Mega Tunnel Battle: Chomp Champs
description: Pac-Man Mega Tunnel Battle: Chomp Champs is an online-only Pac-Man eating competition! Eat your way through multiple interconnected mazes using Power Pellets and a variety of Power Items to chomp the Ghosts and opponent PAC-MAN players! Be the last Pac standing at the end of each match in this 64-player Battle Royale to be the Chomp Champ!

title: Pokémon Unbreakable Ties
description: In the vibrant Akebia region, your childhood dream of becoming a Pokémon Master is reignited. But this isn't your typical journey. Uncover the secrets of the Royal Family's grip on the region, unravel Professor Alama's mysterious past, and protect the legendary Eon Pokémon from their grasp. With stunning visuals, engaging characters, and a gripping story, Pokémon Unbreakable Ties offers a fresh take on the classic Pokémon experience. Explore the region, challenge Gym Leaders, and forge unbreakable bonds with your team as you unravel a conspiracy that threatens to shatter the peace.

title: Crack in the Sky
description: Medium-sized floating castle ruins map ("15-20 minutes") with an interconnected layout inspired by level design tropes in From Software's games. Requires Copper v1.20+

title: Retro Jam 1
description: Impromptu map jam following a "retro" medieval/castle theme: five small maps by ericw, mfx, Scampie, Skacky and sock. It comes with optional medieval-style item models, and the map sources are included.

title: Arlyeh Center for Heart Diseases
description: A rebalanced version of mfx's map from Retro Jam 1: a medieval building nestled in a rocky cavern and fronted by a lake of slime. Features traps and tough comba

title: Dysnystaxis (...A Chance Meeting With Somnus)
description: A fixed version of Skacky's map from Retro Jam 1 (fixes an issue that made it impossible to load saved games): A small map set in a medieval courtyard and the surrounding buildings. Features somewhat non-linear gameplay.

title: Fallen from Grace
description:
Small medieval map, set in a courtyard and surrounding buildings.
An expanded version of Sock's map from Retro Jam 1, featuring bug fixes, a skill selection section, additional areas and gameplay, and more secrets than the original version of the map.

title: Moving parts
description: Seven smallish maps with moving objects. They are based on the Copper mod (included) and come with custom skyboxes and two music tracks.

title: Disposal Of Otherworldly Monsters
description: A large Doom themed map, using the SMEJ2 progs (already included). Contains music from Doom 2 OST.

title: Squire of Time
description: Episode with eight mostly small oldschool levels including a start map, each in various classic Quake themes. It comes with custom music tracks by Alientale.

title: The Dark Triad
description: Short episode with custom start map + 3 small / medium sized levels of various themes, with custom weapons and monsters. Some textures from Doom, some custom music sampled from Nine Inch Nails.

title: GoblinAmerica
description: goblinAmerica is a squirmy, bouncy shooting game filled with lovely sights and horrible places. Careen across the planet, blast yourself to new heights, and discover the dark tunnels and deep places of a world beneath our own.

title: Fhtagn Nagh
description: Large tower temple map "built entirely on the 64-unit grid. A brushwork experiment taken to strange extremes." Requires Copper v1.20+ (NOT included). Custom music by Pantheist

title: Xmas Jam 2017
description: Func Xmas Jam 2017 - a community project at Func_Msgboard. This pack features 11 small AD maps in varied styles where all gameplay takes place within a 1024x1024x1024 space. It comes with a few custom skyboxes, sounds, and a music track

title: Der Wanderer über dem Säuremeer
description: Small and tight vertical runic level.

title: Chainmap Chaos
description: Four chainmaps by various authors, each one following a Honey, Zendar, Egyptian and Knave theme.

title: Luna in Silver Shards
description: Small Hexen2-textured 100 brush map. Comes with a custom skybox.

title: Quakeguy Goes to White Castle
description: 15 speedjam SP levels, five custom skyboxes, a music track, and some map sources.

title: Contract Revoked: The Lost Chapters
description: Hub-based SP episode with 9 medium to large levels (including start and secret maps). Uses Knave textures and features new monsters/powerups
"Speedmapping" jam pack 198: 16 SP levels + a start map. Also includes two custom skyboxes and music tracks as well as the map sources.

title: Oozing Blasphemy
description: Large challenging dark industrial runic map with 16 secrets and custom sounds, built for Arcane Dimensions 1.81

title: Only You Can Prevent Containment Breaches
description: Medium to large, semi-linear level with a dungeon ruin inside an underground base. Includes some custom audio and music.

title: This Onion
description: Large medieval castle in an underground cave with DKTe3 textures, a couple of new monsters and (optional) background music.

title: A Roaming Wildebeest In Spain
description: Based on Tronyn's scrapped Roman Wilderness of Pain maps, this level represents another sort of Metagyptian environment. It abounds with typical Quake monster fights and should give an experienced Quaker about 25 minutes of good quality fraggin'. A large open Egyptian temple framed by mountains

title: Once Upon Atrocity
description: Large, spacious Q3Gothic-style fortress in a blood canyon, featuring some modified monsters and an evil dragon boss.

title: For My Babies 8
description: Based on Tronyn's Runezig map, this level represent a sort of Metagyptian environment. Medium to large Egyptian temple.

title: Ambush Keen Pilgrims
description: Fairly small egypt style map with excellent brushwork and great gameplay! Created from Pingu's deathmatch map A2: Return to Atlantis.

title: Adamantine Cruelty
description: A large brick/metal sewer-type map with an optional secret area. Comes with an extra skill selection map.

title: Head Reattachment Trauma
description: Small short linear single player sci-fi base map with Makkon textures.

title: The Stars We Lost To Grief
description: A small wizard / runic themed map built within a 1024x1024x1024 volume.

title: Antediluvian
description: Medium sized Metal level inspired by "The Wind Tunnels" (e3m5), already started in 2001 but only finished four years later. A map with a strong old-school flair.

title: Special Ops
description: Introducing the "Special Ops Trilogy" - an epic collection of three high-octane special forces games that will test your mettle and stealth skills to the limit.

title: Yatzi
description: It's quite tricky to roll a YATZI: Roll five dice with the same number in three tries. Skillful combination is half the battle! This classic dice game thrills players thanks to its simple game rules and exciting gameplay. You can’t be sure who has the most points until the very end.

title: High Cars
description: Dangerous driving high in the sky!

title: Domino Draw
description: Draw the domino path!

title: Jigsaw Ice Princess
description: Solve 45 beautiful princess jigsaws in a magical ice world

title: Loot Box Quest: Mystic Maidens
description:
The mystic anime maidens are waiting for you.
Don't let them wait for too long.

title: Submersible Simulator: Discover the Titanic into Ocean
description: Riddles of the deep sea await you. Become the number one underwater explorer!

title: Treasure Of The Giantess
description: Third-person adventure, dark atmospheric puzzle game

title: Zero Conflict TD
description: Fight alien invasion through 30 regions and save the planet. Each level will test you in new and challenging ways. Test your skill and stop the invasion once and for all.

title: Torque Drift 2
description: From the colourful drift scene of Tokyo streets to professional competitions sponsored by global brands, Torque Drift 2 invokes all aspects of drift culture and offers an experience as diverse and dynamic as the motorsport itself.

title: RoboCop: Rogue City - Alex Murphy Edition
description: Pre-purchase now to get the blue version of the hero's armour from RoboCop 2 and a "Pitch Black" version of your Auto-9 weapon.

title: Annihilith Of Abhorration
description: Small Zerstörer-themed level.

title: Conference of the Shamblers
description: Huge Knave-style fortress with many enemies and secrets. The map source is included.

title: Warmth Of A Dying Sun
description: Medium-sized Egyptian-style level. Comes with a custom desert skybox.

title: Cloisterfuck
description: Large cloister/castle map combining Wizard/Medieval/Metal textures. Somewhat inspired by E2M5. It comes with a custom skybox.

title: Six textures
description: Comes with two custom skyboxes and a music track. Some map sources are included.

title: Organic Dissociation
description: Medium-sized toxic sewer/industrial base map.

title: A Quick One Before Azathoth Devours Fodrian
description: Small to medium-sized Knave-themed level. The map source and a texture wad are included.

title: The Anomaly
description: Medium-sized base map with a unique twist: 'anomalies' have warped several areas which now play tricks on the player's mind and perception.

title: The Anomaly 2: Water
description: Large brick/metal complex where reality is twisted and many optical illusions occur. Nonlinear, explorational gameplay with puzzles and a great number of secret areas. The sequel to digs05.

title: The Parallel Worlds
description: A huge and highly detailed base map with a unique twist - it is actually three levels in one, to be played in succession. Each exit leads to a different version of the same map with modified layouts/routes and monster placement.

title: Digs03

description: Large ruined subterranean library with tight corridors, bloodfalls and eerie atmosphere. The map source is included.

description: Small base/industrial-style map. A reinterpretation of the original DM5 - part of than's ongoing DMxRMX series. The map source is included.

description: A remake/remix of DM6 'The Dark Zone': Quake's stock deathmatch level turned into a large, industrial base-style singleplayer map. The map source is included.

title: A Quick Trip to the Old World
description: Small 768*768 speedmap

title: The Battery
description: Medium-sized military base with an artillery battery. Comes with a custom skybox. The map source is included.

description: Large Wizard-textured castle.

title: Greymoor

description: Medium / large base map with lots of lava. Built on progs_dump 3.0 (already included). Custom music is "Scratch My Surface" by Verbum Mentis. Map source is included.

title: The Rust Forge
description: Medium / large runic base map with "void vibes", built on progs_dump 3.0 (already included). Some sounds from Arcane Dimensions, custom music "Yss Éskiuth" by Immorpher. Map source is included.

description: Large Knave-textured underground lava fortress. It is based on the Progs_dump mod (included) and comes with a few new models, sounds, and a custom music track. The map and qc sources are included.

description: "A large tower-like Quoth single player map with an unusual texture theme and independent puzzles/traps routes," originally started for the Vertical Competition (=768*768 base with unlimited vertical height, no player teleportation).

description: Q3stone/metal styled fortress of epic scale, with a few new monsters in lots of horde combat (about 300 monsters in total) and othe custom gameplay additions.

title: Mayan
description: Mayan / 4 SP maps / Artistical, Breezeep, JCR, negke impersonating Shambler

description: Small medieval puzzle map based on the work of M.C. Escher. Gameplay focuses on finding keys and following hints to discover secret areas, which may prove frustrating for some players. The map source is included.

title: Bad Dark Cistern
description: Medium-sized brick/cistern-themed level for single player and deathmatch, based on Quake's stock levels DM5 and DM6, with an underwater DM4 below. The GPL map source is included.

title: Escape from Actaltraz
description: Medium sized based map, escape from prison theme.

title: Runic Recycling
description: Medium-sized metal/runic style level with classic gameplay, a built-in skill-selection room and an additional alternative game mode.

title: Red Slammer
description: Medium-sized terracotta style map with classic gameplay, a built-in skill selection room and an additional alternative game mode.

title: Lower Forecourt
description: A big, open, twisted, confusing, hard and unconventional coagula map. Sweet id texturing and a lot of fresh gameplay ideas. Can be frustating.

title: Down the Ratbit Hole
description: Medium sized medieval library map using Knave textures - made for the SM100 turtlemap event.

title: LazyTown: Festival
description: LazyTown: Festival is an edutainment game based on the TV show LazyTown

title: Legendary Creatures 2
description: Sequel to the acclaimed Legendary Creatures, created by HideChara, and a fun treat combining both roguelike and auto-battler gameplay. Recruit and evolve a large array of troops, creatures, and an arsenal of weapons, to defeat the demon lord spreading corruption across the land.

title: Slay the Minotaur
description: Slay the Minotaur is a challenging roguelike dungeon crawler set in ancient Greece. Survive the onslaught of the labyrinth. Upgrade your skills, earn ranks, and face the Minotaur in the ultimate game of cat and mouse!

title: Roll Me Home
description: Roll the character with the rudder and jump. As usual, it's a space bar It has simple manipulation, but it's not going to be an easy challenge Understand the physics of things and explore the silhouette.

title: Dragon of Saiyu
description: Dragon of Saiyu retells the classic tale of Journey To The West in Retro 2D platformer style . Play as the young aspiring monk, Sanzang, and defeat strong foes in his quest of attaining the legendary scrolls from the Buddha of far west.

title: The Unlife of Gorlak
description: The Unlife of Gorlak is an RPG Where you play as a dragon who died but got better (or is at least trying to). You have been resurrected as a skeletal dragon by a necromancer. As you returned to the living world you felt the presence of the hero who had slain you has given chase. You have one month to prepare for his arrival so you can tell him how you really feel about him!

title: Correction
description:
The game is a training simulator for shooting. Teaches players the correct aim.

The game has game modes in which there is a battle between players, success points, and music drops. All this in correction

title: Tekken 8: Premium Collector's Edition
description:
The Premium Collector's Edition Includes:
• TEKKEN 8
• Playable Character Year 1 Pass
• Character Costume: Gold Suit Pack
• Avatar Costume (x32)
• Avatar-Skins (x3)
• Burning chain metal plate
• Corporation stickers
• Premium Box
• Special Face-Off Steelbook
• Glossy Collectible Cards (x8)
• Leroy Smith Metal Ring with Velvet Pouch
• Arcade Token
• Exclusive Jin Electrified Figurine (25cm)

title: Head Over Heels: Monster Girl Dating Sim
description: A dullahan goes to a speed-dating event: Will she fall head over heels or trip up on her chances for love?

title: L.O.L. Surprise! Roller Dreams Racing
description: Race your friends in L.O.L. Surprise! Roller Dreams Racing, a roller-skating racing game based on L.O.L. Surprise! Players can choose one of their favorite characters, and race in a variety of tracks and modes with up to 4 players! Explore popular L.O.L. Surprise! themes including delectable sweets, Route 707, outer space and beyond. With each race you will earn Glitter Points to open L.O.L. Surprise! Balls and unlock different surprises like stickers and accessories to use in future races.

title: The Silent Swan: Rising in the Mist Edition
Half-Life 2: MMod - Half-Life 2: Episode One
description:
This mod allows Half-Life 2: Episode One to be run under MMod.

The goal of Half-Life 2: MMod is to enhance and expand gunplay, combat mechanics and the immersion factor by giving the Player more options and combat opportunities as well as refine how the Player handles his arsenal. Half-Life 2: MMod also offers minor AI enhancements, extended abilities for combine soldiers ( dynamic jumping, firing smg1 underbarrel grenades, shotgunner double blast, etc. ), multiple bug fixes, enhanced visuals, VFX re-design, sound redesign and much much more, while keeping nearly every new feature in the mod totally optional.

title: Half-Life 2: MMod - Half-Life 2: Episode Two
description:
This mod allows Episode Two to be run under MMod.

The goal of Half-Life 2: MMod is to enhance and expand gunplay, combat mechanics and the immersion factor by giving the Player more options and combat opportunities as well as refine how the Player handles his arsenal. Half-Life 2: MMod also offers minor AI enhancements, extended abilities for combine soldiers ( dynamic jumping, firing smg1 underbarrel grenades, shotgunner double blast, etc. ), multiple bug fixes, enhanced visuals, VFX re-design, sound redesign and much much more, while keeping nearly every new feature in the mod totally optional.

title: Star Wars: Movie Battles II
description:
Movie Battles II is a fast-paced, action packed mod for the award winning Jedi Knight Jedi Academy game, that lets players play and fight in the most iconic battles seen throughout the entire saga!
Choose from a range of 12 distinct classes, each with their own strengths, weapons, and abilities. Play on over 40 maps from across the Star Wars universe, inspired by scenarios in the movies and legends.

title: Railway: Koko ni Aru Yume
description:
A small port town with mountains on the back and the sea in the front. Main character returns to this town for the first time in 8 years after leaving it because of parents divorce.
Now grandmother invites him to help with the coffee shop "Railway" that got its name due to being set up at an abandoned train locomotive on the outskirts of the town.
Meeting old friends, recovering old memories... it's a place where dreams come true.

title: Hauma: A Detective Noir Story - Prologue
description: Hauma is a deduction visual novel set in Munich. Discover a conspiracy amongst the upper echelons of society alongside former detective Judith, while visiting real locations in a comic-inspired look. This is a free prologue of the full game.

title: Blue-Sky-Blue(s): Sora o Mau Tsubasa
description:
The protagonist's mom passed away 10 years ago and the father-son relationship is a strained one. When poppy's work as a weatherman and new marriage sends them to Hokkaido, the player enters a new school and joins up with a group of student's whose passion is the sky - with the belief that people come from the sky and will eventually return to the sky...

Six girls are available for the romancing including honor student Kasumi Itimatsu, school director's granddaughter Fuuka Mitsuba and assistant teacher Tomomi Shinose.

title: Tenshi-tachi no Gogo IV: Yuuko
description:
The Catholic high school for girls, St. Sophia, has a reputation of a very traditional establishment with strict rules. However, there are also rumors that after midnight, something mysterious happens to the school, and everything inside it changes... When the protagonist, a substitute teacher, arrives at St. Sophia for a three months teaching job, he quickly discovers that the behavior of the school inhabitants is anything but compatible with the Christian morals...

Tenshitachi no Gogo 4, like most other games in the series, is a fresh start story-wise; from gameplay point of view, it plays just like its predecessors: it is a traditional Japanese adventure, without puzzles and with menu-based interactions, with verb commands and sub-menus of objects. Usually the game allows the player to advance only upon depletion of all the possible commands. There are, however, right and wrong decisions, including story branches that will end in a Game Over.

title: Don't Scream
description:
If you scream, you restart. Don't Scream is an Unreal Engine 5 short horror experience inspired by '90s camcorder found footage. Made by two indie devs. The challenge is simple: explore the mysterious Pineview Forest for 18 minutes without screaming.

Sounds easy, right? But there's a catch. Time only progresses as you move, and you cannot predict the scares. You must calibrate your microphone in-game so that every whimper, jump, or even a minor squeak is registered as a scream, increasing the challenge. With dozens of dynamic scares, each playthrough offers a unique experience.

title: Witcharoo
description: Your life as a cat is turned upside down after being kidnapped by a crazy witch..!

title: Un Lugar Otro Que El Cielo
description: Large abstract floating ikwhite level. Comes with a new model, sounds, a custom skybox and a music track. The map source is included.

title: The Dreamer's Demesne
description: Medium-sized blue desert castle, made for Arcane Dimensions v1.81+

title: Apinaraivo

title: Arrogant Erratum & The Kuras Stronghold
description: Two medium/large blue-themed maps plus a start map and a battle arena, featuring elements from some of the original Quake levels and certain old custom maps. Comes with three music tracks. The map sources are included.

title: Precipice Continuum

title: Coagula

An elegant map in a unique texture theme (a white version of ikblue) with some nice brushwork and good exploration/secrets.
Memorable primarily for its Taj-Mahal-like ambience, but also fun to play.

description: Small terracotta-colored Coagula-style space map.

title: Midnight Stalker
description: Medium-sized metal dungeon in E3M6 mashup style with a built-in skill selection room. It also features custom item boxes. The map source is included in the PAK.

title: Retrojam 3
description: Map-Center’s Quake Retrojam 3 contains 15 maps to play through, a beautiful hub to explore and loads of enemies to kill!

description: Three vertical metal/runic-themed maps - late entries to Retro Jam 3, ironically labeled "DLC". The map sources are included.

title: 1024 Units

title: Off Base
description: Around medium-sized idbase map.

title: The Circulation of Shadows
description: Large underground industrial base with rocket silos and conveyor belts; and a small start map. It was originally started in 2005 for a Nehahra addon episode. It uses Daikatana textures and runs on the Rubicon 2 mod (included), featuring new and modified enemies and effects. Also comes with a music track and a custom skybox.

title: Gomenne Angel: Yokohama Monogatari
description: One day the hero picks up a notebook and it turns out to be a possession of a girl student of St. Francis girls academy where his fiance is teaching. All three of them meet in a cafe, but girl looks very anxious. Her sister disappeared. And we'll help to find her.

title: Bug & Seek
description: Catch bugs and clues in this cozy bug-catching simulator, styled like an 8-bit classic. You’ve bought the local bug museum, abandoned after a mysterious robbery. Fill orders, build your collection, and upgrade your skills and equipment while exploring Buggburg and uncovering its secrets.

title: Forza Motorsport: Deluxe Edition
description: Race over 500 real-world cars including modern race cars and more than 100 cars new to Forza Motorsport. Make every lap count across 20 living environments with fan-favorite locations and multiple track layouts to master, each featuring live on-track scoring, fully dynamic time-of-day with weather and unique driving conditions that ensure no two laps ever look or play the same.

title: Arcade Archives: Guttang Gottong
description: A fun railway trip!

title: Are you yet Living?
description: Medium sized, somewhat nonlinear map using Knave textures.

title: Moldy Tower
description: A medium-sized vertical map. It starts with a moldy green area from which you ascend into a mechanical exploratory part. After surpassing this you are awarded a tense boss fight. Lots of novel atmospheric effects thanks to the use of Quoth.

title: The Living End & Elder World Waystation

description: Maps made in 4 hours or less / 9 SP maps / dantescanline, Danzadan, dumptruck_ds, ing-ing, JCR, Naitelveni, Newhouse, prengle

title: Nastrond
description: Very large and detailed Knave fortress.

title: Solarfall
description: Large Wizard/Ebon Fortress level. Comes with a start map.

title: The Elder Reality
description: Medium-sized Elder World-style map that features at least one room from each level in the fourth episode of Quake (except for E4M1). An expanded version of the author's Retro Jam 4 entry.

title: The Lair of DOOMestic Animals
description: Small Metal/runic level. A polished and extended version of PuLSaR's SM57 map.

description: Nine small / medium maps made in a week using MachineGames' new textures for the rerelease. A variety of themes and styles, has something for everyone.

title: The Rats in the Walls
description: Small oldschool brick level with a few DOOM textures.

title: Crescendo Of Dreams + Surmounting Terror
description: Medium sized green DOOM marble/ wood level with a small end battle map.

title: Candles of the Damned
description: Remake of E1M2 from Quake: a medium-sized medieval castle with many candles. The map was previously released as part of Halloween Jam 2. Among other things, this version features even more candles! Comes with a new bat model and some ambient sounds.

title: The Lima Project
description: Medium-sized industrial facility using cr8 and Doom 3 textures. It comes with a custom skybox and a music track.

title: Deep Research
description: Small base map using Speedbase textures. Comes with a new skybox and a custom music track.

title: The Vigil
description: Small Medieval map with focus on arena combat.

title: Subterranean Siege
description: Evolved from a speedmapping session, this is a large-ish Q1SP decked out mainly in IDbase textures with plenty of natural rocky sections. A chain map by Misyu, Vigil, necros and Xen. The map source is included.

title: At the Gates of Midian
description: Two maps: a large Metal/Wood fortress in the mountains and a small end battle arena, featuring some modified Fiends and Shamblers. Conveys a certain DOOM-like atmosphere.

title: The Coagula Contest
description: This contest was run mid-September to mid-November of 2001, with the goal of creating maps in the tradition of Tim Elek's 'Coagula' series of maps - a series of structures floating in the void. There were 5 entries: Tronyn(2), Fat Controller, Dilvish, and Necros. In addition, a start map created by Tronyn is included, as well as the original Coagula series by Tim Elek.

title: Coagula3: Bone
description: Small blue/red space level using Daikatana textures.

title: Corruption Catharsis: Try To Act Normal
description: The ranger has been called to Ranger Station Theta as a precaution as scientists there have reported an anomaly with their slip-tech that would indicate a malevolant force has been trying to exploit the station. They could get a handle on the slip gate interdimensional array and use it as a back-door that would allow them to take control of some of Earth's remote facilities. Your breifing was to investigate the disturbance and eradicate any compromised forces or opposition that you encounter.

title: Stark Monstrosity
description: A rather unlinear huge base map with outdoor parts.

title: Slave to a Machine
description: A large tech/industrial base map using Daikatana, Doom3 and Half-Life textures.

title: The Hand That Feeds You
description: Large, interconnected base in the mountains with a lava cave beneath. It comes with a custom skybox.

title: I am an Air Traffic Controller: Airport Hero Haneda - Allstars
Three Towers And A Sick Base
description: Large open base map set inside a lava canyon.
