title: Bendy: The Cage
description:
Test your sanity as you take control of Henry in this third person horror experience taking place during the events of Bendy and the Dark Revival.

Condemned to the Keeper prison known as "The Pit", Henry must survive the horrific inmates and mangled experiments set loose to devour him. A labyrinth of steel industrial dread lay before him as his mind is invaded by the past.

Discover the hidden blood-stained truth behind the monsters as you explore the dark levels of The Pit, slowly making your way to the very top of the facility.

Take on the darkness with your axe in brutal melee combat: Unleash fast and heavy strikes, block and parry incoming attacks, shove foes away, stomp on enemies with a vengeance, and time dodges to avoid being torn apart by the things that hunt you. Dive into the shadows for limited supplies as you embark on a twisted tale of Henry's self discovery while facing down new and familiar creatures of the ink.

Find the maestro. Escape the prison. Fight the madness.

title: Funky Cards Arena
description: A deck builder game which consists of utilizing your cards to destroy the opposing orb. It is a large crossover of many franchises, you can make Garfield battle Neymar from Fortnite, Goku battle Dora and there are even original characters. You will be able to unlock them all in the Funky Packs.

title: Model Employee
description:
Model Employee is a corporate horror visual novel where players take control of the latest individual amongst millions to start working in one of Tethys' online shopping labyrinthine warehouses. Just discharged from the hospital and massively in debt for their life-saving cybernetics, the player-character must adapt to the "extreme" work-life balance of a Tethys Team Member- but they have help.

Penny, the artificial personality that controls all security, waste disposal, and employee surveillance in the facility, specializes in reinforcing an especially cutthroat variety of workplace culture- and she's taken an interest in you.

With a vibrant cast, PC-98 inspired visuals and multiple endings, Model Employee is a modern horror story that'll stick with you long after you've clocked out of your shift.

If you want to get ahead in your career, you gotta be willing to take some risks.

title: A Little Walk in the Woods
description: Embark on an enchanting adventure with our 2D platform game, where a courageous girl sets off on a delightful stroll through the woods in search of hidden treasure. With its captivating pixel art style, immerse yourself in a world filled with charming landscapes and intricate obstacles. Traverse through 25 captivating levels, each brimming with challenges and surprises. Will you help the girl find the treasure and return home safely?

title: Whispered Flight
description: Embark upon a whimsical voyage as a radiant sphere of luminescence, gracefully soaring over the placid waters of a lake cradled within the ancient boughs of a mystical woodland. In pursuit of ethereal lumens, gather your scores under the watchful eyes of the stars, whilst evading the malevolent dark skulls seeking to quench your luminous essence. With a trinity of cherished lives, navigate through the verdant whispers of the old trees, to the gentle cadence of tranquility that accompanies your flight. Delight in the quaint, animated tapestry of nature’s hues as you partake in a casual contest of valor with fellow wanderers upon the leaderboard, in this gentle ballet of light against the encroaching shadow.

title: I Can Destroy Everything!!!
description: In this game, you can destroy all objects on the map! It's a fun and relaxing way to relieve stress and entertain yourself. Give this game a try to unwind!

title: Perfect Heist 2: Historic Characters DLC
description: Plan your heist with 6 brand-new historic characters! Perfect your robber strategy with Einstein, Al Capone, and Karl Marx. Or try to catch the robbers with Marie Curie, Caesar, and Queen Elizabeth I.

title: Deadliest Demolition
description: A 11-map Vanilla Dehacked mapset loosely inspired by the 1995 Cabal series, originally created for NaNoWADMo 2022. This mod contains numerous gameplay changes to your weapons. After a humiliating defeat, your supervisor saw it fit to demote you from a cyberdemon to a mere human, so that you can learn to maximize your combat potential instead of squandering your superior firepower. But there's no force in hell that could ever make you part with your beloved weapon...

title: Bloodbaths Terrible Vacation
description: Bloodbath's Terrible Vacation is about my bad experience on a doomed vacation. This wad consists of four small island maps with lots of action. The chaingun, rocket launcher, and plasma gun have all received an upgrade for the adventure. MAP01 is a thrill-seeking adventure to a tropical island, with lots of unsightly guests to contend with. MAP02 is a bit more chill, but still has enough heat so your chaingun does not freeze over. MAP03 is a romp through one of the hottest vacation spots imaginable. MAP04 is a look into how this adventure was booked in the first place.

title: Hotel of the Dead
description: You come to your senses on the street outside the hotel building and suddenly find crowds of demonic creatures all around you. You realize that you need to get out of the place as quickly as possible. But there's HE waiting outside the main gate. Knowing that you are incapable of confronting this horror now, you have no choice but to take refuge in the hotel building itself. There is no easy way out...

title: Ciudad Empresarial
description: Ciudad Empresarial is a vanilla map inspired by the early city levels of A.L.T. and my own previous works, most notably El Viaje de Diciembre. The map takes you through some kind of apartment complex, up onto the roof, down into the parking lot and finally out on the avenue. It's a mostly straightforward layout, and should take you about 20 minutes to beat blind. ﻿There's a catch though: I've added three new monsters through DeHackEd!

title: Jigsaw Together
description: jigsaw Together is a jigsaw puzzle game that supports custom materials. In this game, you can customize the number of puzzle pieces and use local images, MP4 videos, or specify web pages as background materials for playing.

title: Lust Bunker
description: Welcome to "Lust Bunker" – an enthralling adult visual novel that will immerse you in an underground world where intrigue, choices, and passion shape your destiny.

title: Dice Up
description: Dice Up is a puzzle platformer where you eat food to gain powers. Eat a large block of food to get a single use strong effect, or dice your food up into smaller pieces to gain a weaker effect that you can use multiple times. Determine how to dice up each food to reach the exit.

title: My Next Life as a Bird
description: "My Next Life as a Bird" is a speedrun platformer game. Players can customize various mechanics using "Bird Coins," evade incoming magical projectiles, and aim to reach the finish line as quickly as possible, creating their own fastest completion journey.

title: 18 Minutes
description: 18 Minutes is a single player FPS that combines stealthy precision with heart-pounding action. Engage in intense firefights, strategically infiltrate enemy base, and make split- second decision to outmaneuver enemy. Get ready for a gaming experience that offers the best of stealth and FPS action

title: Your House
description: A narrative puzzle-thriller that blurs the lines between games and books, reality and fiction, puzzles and storytelling.

title: Delivery INC: Large Cargo
description: Expand your fleet with trucks and conquer the large cargo market. Pursue new lucrative contracts, hire delivery assistants, and enjoy a new campaign scenario taking place in Stockholm, Sweden. Large Cargo is coming!

title: House with Puzzles
description: An unexpected inheritance has forced you to come to your grandfather's mansion. Grandfather was not an ordinary man, but a former NKVD officer. The house is filled with various puzzles. And to find the will you need to solve all of them.

title: Omnivael: Chronicles of the realm
description: Dive into Omnivael's enchanting world on PC! Master magic, embark on quests, and explore diverse realms. Uncover mysteries today!

title: Untamed Kingdom
description: Shadow Stalk Studios is an indie company creating Untamed Kingdom. We want to create a space for everyone to enjoy and explore with friends. Come join us as we adventure through the wilderness!

title: New Zealand Jigsaw Puzzles
description: Explore New Zealand's stunning landscapes in a captivating jigsaw puzzle adventure. Unravel the beauty piece by piece!

title: Torbaci Oyunu
description: Get ready to be the hero of your own city

title: Dungeon Core Master
description: Adult-Only Fantasy Visual Novel featuring 3 girls, a variety of choices, comedy, and sex in an exciting story with different endings!

title: Ertugrul
description: Survive the chaos of the medieval era and set out on a mysterious journey to become the hero of the innocent. Live the life like a true Turkish warrior in this semi open-world action adventure game.

title: Dawn of Anarchy
description: In Dawn of Anarchy, your skills, determination, and combat prowess will be put to the ultimate test. Will you be the hero the world needs to quell the uprising and bring an end to mechanical tyranny? Prepare for the battle of a lifetime amidst the dawn of anarchy.

title: IFU
description: IFU is a psychological horror about a young guy who is forcibly locked in an abandoned mansion of a dead surgeon along with his restless soul.

title: JailBreaker
description: A punishing, one-button platformer about escaping prison. Test your skills and intellect as you ascend a tower of hand-crafted challenges. Jump, fly, slide up walls, float in bubbles and perform somersaults; all with the press of a single button. Reach the paramount. Reach.

title: CastingPlz
description: CastingPlz is a 2-player cooperative roguelike game where players take on the roles of two characters with distinct responsibilities: one for attacking and the other for movement.

title: Dragonero
description: Dragonero is an immersive turn-based combat RPG set in a vast and savage fantasy world. Guide the heroes through trap-strewn dungeons, dozens of enemies and embark on your journeys with strategy. Protect the Erondár and defeat the Necromancer!

title: Cake Game
description: Strategize, combine cakes, and bake your way to victory!

title: Hot And Lovely: Tease
description: Hot And Lovely: Tease is a classic matching game. Slide the blocks to make three or more adjacent blocks of the same pattern disappear. After eliminating specific blocks, you can enter the next level. The game is easy to operate and easy to play.

title: Spellarium 10
description: Play Match 3, grow the elemental crystals, and place them in a secure location! If you get tired of Match 3, there are some extras to entertain you!

title: Shadow Of Sound
description: Traditional 4k drop style music game —— "Shadow Of Sound".

title: Dark Gem Tower Defense
description: Atmospheric tower defense. How many waves can you defend? Basic tower defense in a fantasy setting with gems.

title: YAR: Forgotten Throne
description: This is a role-playing game with RPG-survival elements, based on an alternative history of ancient Slavs. You'll also find numerous references and plots based on Slavic mythology and fairy tales. Explore the open game world on your own or with friends.

title: Kerker
description: Kerker is a procedurally generated dungeon crawler FPS roguelike that challenges the player with its varying cast of enemies, exclusive weapons and different dungeon types. Fight your way to riches by slaying foes, obtaining/combining unique abilities and finding forgotten treasures.

title: Homage: Godless Grotto
description: Venture into the unforgiving caverns under the mountain on an impossible quest in this high-fantasy split screen roleplaying game.

title: SCP: Containment Chaos
description: SCP: Containment Chaos is a co-op horror survival game for 1-4 players. Become SCP Foundation agents tasked with containing and researching anomalous entities in parallel universes.

title: Rivers of Blood
description: Alice suffers an accident and wakes up in a parallel world created by her unconscious in a state of coma. Now she needs to find the strength and means to survive and return to the real world, in this new reality that is completely different and much more terrifying than any nightmare.

title: Pools
description: Liminal space game with focus on eerie exploration and immersion instead of typical horror. Navigate through endless alike rooms. Explore, orient, get out.

title: 3Paths
description: It's up to you to decide the fate of 3 girls! What choice will you make in this story of love, friendship and sadness? Adventure through alternate times in this visual novel that gives you a different experience every time you play it again!

title: Cooktopia
description: Cook and serve your delicious orders as fast as you can. A must try cooking simulator with endless fun!

title: Hermit Simulator
description: Being a hermit is not easy, but it is the way to freedom, where you have to survive and build a new home. Farming, hunting, fishing, gathering, building, crafting, trading and exploration await you in the hermit simulator! Will you be able to survive on your way and become the master of the forest?

title: Mecha Blitz
description: Build mechs and fight in this fast-paced, anime-inspired isometric top down shooter with online multiplayer PvP and single player PvE game modes. Customize your robot fighter with a variety of parts, weapons and cosmetics. Upgrade your equipment, abilities and stats. Battle and win in the arena!

title: Auroria
description: Welcome to Auroria, an open-world, multiplayer, and cooperative sandbox game. Design the Base, survive with your pals, and start your own interstellar travel in a relaxed and fun way.

title: FreeChicken
description: A 3D adventure single-player game for freedom! Test your agility to avoid traps and obstacles as you embark on a journey for freedom! Don't worry, there's a game save function, so start playing right away! Our game supports both English and Korean.

title: Block Catching
description: An online game of block catching with a twist. The catcher is not your friend.

title: Volkolak: The Will of Gods
description: Volkolak: The Will of Gods is an epic 2D soulsvania in a dark Slavic fantasy setting, with hand-drawn animation. Explore an enchanted world full of secrets and enemies. Your choices will lead to several endings: become a warrior, a werewolf, or join the darkness.

title: Side To Side
description: ¡Immerse yourself in this incredible universe and get ready for a challenge by pushing your skills to the limit... Let yourself be carried away by its dazzling effects according to the music!

title: To Infinity
description: To Infinity tells the adventures of a schizophrenic astronaut. The astronaut escapes from the world and goes to search for other planets where he can live with his spaceship, and in the meantime, he constantly makes parkour, witnessing the epic view of the universe.

title: Amber
description: Join Amber on a whimsical journey through the 5 kingdoms: Candy, Cake, Story, Rainbow, and Crystal. Spread love, restore balance with Amber Crystals, confront rulers, and set things right using the Mallet, Chocolate Staff, and Bubblegum Wand. Glide with the Rainbow Umbrella!

title: Endless Maze
description: This is a first-person 3D maze-themed casual game. The game features many different interesting mazes, each with its own characteristics. Each level is relatively short, focusing on the fun of the maze. Additionally, it also offers randomly generated traditional mazes of selectable sizes.

title: Vague
description: Vague is a first-person psychological horror inspired by early 2000s classic horror titles. Experience the unsettling atmosphere as you follow Raymond K. Fisher in his search for his missing family.

title: Summer of Love
description: In Summer of Love, you can have a happy ending (Romance Ending or Harem Ending), a neutral ending (Swinging Ending) or a sad ending (Netorare Ending) depending on how you play.

title: Monster Coming
description: "Monster Coming" is a fast-paced survivor roguelite game. Dark cracks suddenly appeared in the sky, and a tide of beasts emerged from them to invade humans. You stand up as one of the braves, face the menacing beast tide, choose your equipment, formulate tactics, and feel unparalleled.

title: Watcher Of The Abyss
description: "One day, a mysterious abyssal vortex appeared, unleashing countless monsters set on world destruction. Choose your warriors to guard the abyss. Collect tokens from fallen foes, buy nodes, and strategically place them for ultimate power. Reclaim abyss-covered areas."

title: Type Your Fate
description: Type your fate. Arm yourself with your keyboard and your wits, and try to escape from the abandoned house where you are. Unfortunately, you won't be alone...

title: Rotten Flesh
description: Rotten Flesh is a cosmic horror survival game where you have just lost your dog named Roy and you have to find him by shouting for "Roy" on your microphone. Venture deep into the sewers where your dog was lost - however, something else can also hear your screams in the tunnels.

title: Covert Ultra
description: Covert Ultra is an arcade-style tactical shooter, and every level is a lone-wolf terrorist hunt. Play as a high-tech hitman for hire with spider-like abilities and compete to achieve each mission's best time and highest rank. Efficiency is your only priority.

title: Redrum Hotel
description: Redrum Hotel is a short, first-person horror adventure game. Roam around the haunted hotel, collecting strangely scattered notes and avoiding the evil presence that seeks to rid you of your sanity.

title: Alice and The Ancients
description: Advance forward, surpassing all the Ancients on the battlefield!

title: Snake Crush Survivors
description: This is a Roguelite game that combines the gameplay of Snake with survivor mechanics. You will play as a large snake roaming above the city, clearing countless small monsters and spirits attracted by spiritual energy, as well as those frenzied large monsters.

title: Rewind And Reclaim
description: Rewind and Reclaim is a turn-based adventure inspired by 90's horror movies. Explore different B movie scenarios by creating scenes in which victims outsmart villains. Investigate their terrifying behind the scenes to unfold the story linking them all.

title: Apex Legends: Ignite
description:
Rowenna grew up amidst a war, but in a move that turned the tide, one Monarch Titan sacrificed itself to end the fighting. In the years after, her home planet of Nexus established ties across the Outlands, introducing Rowenna to the Apex Games. The Games represented everything she aspired to–heroism, hard work, sacrifice—and she became a dedicated fan.

When her elder sister Diwa suffered a terrible injury at work, Rowenna resolved to support her family no matter what. She stole the battery from the Monarch, still rusting on the hill, and had a combat rig built with its battery at the core. She used it to qualify for the Apex Games, and even though the battery exposes her to poisonous radiation, she refuses to give up. No one else was going to get hurt to support her family. Rowenna’s choosing to have hope for her dreams or die trying. Now, it’s Conduit’s chance for a day in the sun.

title: Remnant II: The Awakened King
description:
The One True King has awakened and is out for blood. Corrupted by the Root during his near-death slumber, the mad king sees betrayal at every turn and is on a rampage of revenge. Since his castle first arrived in a Dran coastal town, the tides are angry and the weather is chaotic, surfacing all manner of creatures from the depths and leaving many mysteries in its wake.

This DLC adds the Ritualist archetyp, a new storyline, dungeons and area based in the world of Losomn. It includes a wide array of new weapons, modifications, amulets, and rings along with new bosses, characters and fearsome creatures to encounter.

title: TSR Halloween Party
description: The cast of The Smoke Room prepare for a Halloween corn maze in a modern day AU.

title: Honkai: Star Rail - The Crepuscule Zone
description:
Version 1.5 of Honkai: Star Rail, which includes:
• New characters: Huohuo, Argenti and Hanya
• New area: Fyxestroll Garden
• New trailblaze mission
• New companion mission for Argenti
• Simulated Universe update (World 8) and new enemies
• New main event: A Foxian Tale of the Haunted
• …and more!

title: Filthy Us: Complete Edition
description: Filthy Us: Complete Edition is an original horror adventure game with a dark story and puzzle elements. The game not only contains a large number of Buddhist and oriental elements, but also the horrifying customs of the people who used to live in that world.

title: Dinobreak Strange Mutations Collection
description: Get ready to return to the world of survival horror as you fight through dinosaurs and the undead across the entire Dinobreak and Outbreak series!

title: Sonic Dream Team
description: In this all-new Sonic adventure, the evil Dr. Eggman has discovered The Reverie, an ancient device with the power to manifest dreams in the real world. Navigate twisted dreamscapes, rescue your friends, and put a stop to Dr. Eggman’s nightmarish dreams of world domination!

title: Coke
description: Developed by Swift Software and released in 1989, the goal is to shoot Coke cans to score points before the "Thirst" counter reaches 9.

title: Baker Street Breakouts
description:
"Baker Street Breakouts" combines the thrill of an Escape Room with the storytelling of an Adventure. Use your superior deduction skills in this story-driven mystery to help Sherlock deducing his way through an old film studio to finally face his arch nemesis Moriarty. Become a Master of Deduction!

"Baker Street Breakouts" focusses on puzzles and deduction. Instead of combat or grinding, the game challenges players to use their superior deduction skills and the ability to combine items in order to solve riddles and progress through the game. Explore, investigate, combine, deduce!

title: Hop Man
description: Are you sick of walking? Do better and just jump. Go on a Castle adventure in Hop Man with your pals! You must overcome the traps by yourself to see what lies behind them, but keep in mind that there are no shortcuts to the castle.

title: Maido Manie
description: White Rabbit Maid Café, owned by Iiko Shinkaichi, is losing money because there is a better Maid Café next door! What would be a better idea than to send her feminine younger brother to work there as a maid to find out their secrets?

title: Space Rescue in Jupiter
description:
In the year 2070, the Earth's energy resources are not sufficient for the great demand of a booming overpopulation; new technologies and materials have allowed the extraction of energy in the upper layers of Jupiter's atmosphere. From time to time, accidents occur in the mining-energy complexes that exist around the planet. Your mission is to rescue the miners if necessary. Control the descent of your ship, avoiding the clouds of overheated plasma, to land on the platforms and collect the capsules to take them to the space station.

This game has a basic concept, it is made in Basic 1.0 with additions of machine subroutines, it consists of 5 levels and has an ending.

title: Wormwood: Expanded Universe
description: A sequel to 2019's Wormwood, Expanded Universe is another Halloween-themed collaboration between Grain of Salt and Ribbiks

title: Wormwood III: The Horror
description: A sequel to Wormwood: Expanded Universe by Grain of Salt and Ribbiks.

title: Wormwood IV: The Final Chapter
description: A 10-level Halloween-themed wad for Doom II, Wormwood IV features maps by Ribbiks, Grain of Salt, and dannebubinga.

title: Wormwood V
description: The fifth entry in the Wormwood series of Doom II wads, featuring maps by Grain of Salt and Ribbiks.

title: The Police Mystery
description: The police have arrested dangerous criminals from the neighborhood and sent them to jail. During their time in jail, one of them was a witch who casted a spell to shrink many police officers to the size of an ant. The tinies now need to get a giantess police woman's attention before it's too late.

title: Grove
description: Nurture a small forest under siege by lumberjacks in this cozy tower defense game. Plant and upgrade trees with unique abilities to protect your grove, customize and decorate your forest, and unwind with the soothing escape of building a natural haven from a single sapling.

title: Euro Truck Simulator 2: Greece
description: Explore the charm of inland Greece and discover enchanting islands, with approx. 14 cities waiting to be discovered. Picture yourself cruising through postcard-perfect villages, navigating winding roads, and passing iconic landmarks, immersing yourself in the centuries-old tapestry of Greek culture.

title: Mistonia's Hope: The Lost Delight
description: A fairy tale of love, obsession, and emotion woven together by descendants of fairies.

title: Otome Daoshi Fighting For Love
description: Welcome to Kayu, where every citizen, both man and woman, young and old alike, enjoy martial arts. Living in that kingdom as a Daoist priestess in training, you made your way to the Tournament of Valor to root for your childhood friend.

title: Mix Dunk: King of Basketball
description: A new project in collaboration between B.LEAGUE’s professional basketball club Kawasaki Brave Thunders, the idol group AKB48, and the otome game brand Otomate.

title: Over Requiemz
description:
“Whatever pain awaits, I won’t regret this choice.”

A dark fantasy game about overcoming grief as you wander into the “Land of Oz.”

title: Trouble Magia: Wakeari Shoujo ha Mirai wo Kachitoru Tame ni Ikoku no Mahou Gakkou he Ryuugaku Shimasu
description:
Girl meets boy in this adolescent tale of magic. Your year to seize the future is about to begin!

In search of clues to break the curse that causes her to abruptly transform into an animal, the protagonist decides to study abroad at the Reveal Academy of Magic. Will she be able to break the curse while dealing with all sorts of trouble?

title: Bubblegum Crisis: Crime Wave
description: A game for PC-88 & 98, set in Megatokyo and featuring Knight Sabers as the main characters.

title: Friday Night Funkin': vs. Impostor - Human Hijinks
description: Friday Night Funkin': vs. Impostor - Human Hijinks is a re-envisioning of Friday Night Funkin': vs. Impostor by Clowfoe, turning the Among Us crewmates and impostors into humans.

title: Sumo Tatami
description: Welcome to the uproarious world of Sumo Tatami, where bumbling sumo wrestlers take center stage in a plethora of zany and competitive platformer modes! Brace yourself for a side-splitting, body-slamming adventure as you go head-to-head with your friends and adversaries in races, king-of-the-hill battles, duels, bowling, golf, and more.

title: Hitman 3: Ambrose Island
description:
Ambrose Island is a brand new location for HITMAN 3, and a major release as part of our ‘Year 2‘ plans. It’s available now as a free download, included with the July Patch.

Embark on a new adventure with Agent 47 to a secluded island in the Andaman Sea. Located north from the Strait of Malacca, Ambrose Island is an isolated harbour packed full of dense vegetation, hidden coves, twisting paths and perilous bridges.

From the lit torches that illuminate narrow passageways, to the neon lights that flicker over the bustle of Farah’s bar, there’s a sense of discovery around every corner.

title: Arcade Archives: Daioh
description: Arcade Archives: Daioh is a 1993 vertical scrolling shooter featuring traditional shoot-em-up mechanics with challenging gameplay. Players pilot spacecraft through enemy-filled stages, utilizing various weapon systems to defeat waves of opponents and large boss encounters. The game includes two versions: a Japanese version with 2-button controls where weapons switch by collecting items, and an International version offering direct selection from six different weapons using dedicated buttons.

title: Sunland Town
description: Welcome to Sunland Town a serene and mystical walking simulator. Explore a captivating world as you search for hidden items, unlock secrets, and immerse yourself in the beauty of this unique town!

title: OhMyRace!
description: OhMyRun! is a competitive platformer game playable up to 10 players. Face off against your friends in wacky races using powers and be the first to finish in a frenzied competition!

title: Hypnosis Card
description: Hypnosis Cards is a deck-building game that introduces a novel concept of parts. Players can use numerous cards to engage in card battles with five girls.

title: CoinBlock Clicker
description: CoinBlock Clicker is an idle clicker with a unique way of merging idle and clicker fun into one game! You simply click thousands of times on the coinblock and make those coins fly all over your screen!

title: Last Hour of an Epic to the Moon RPG
description: You like RPGs, but don't have time to play it all. . . We like RPGs, but don't have time to make it all. . . So here's (only) the last hour of an Epic RPG !!

title: Dark Age Gladiator
description: Dark Age Gladiator is a dark fantasy world where you live as a gladiator fighting in the arena for wealth and fame. The opponents are not limited to humans, but also include a variety of monsters.

title: Don't Shoot Us
description: Don't Shoot Us is a solo FPS that tells the story of a tactical soldier from the point of view of his body camera. Try to survive as long as possible against the hordes of infected of all kinds.

title: Legend of Inca: Mystical Culture
description: Countless secrets entwine around the mystical people of the Incas ... Create an Inca settlement and build all the vital structures and production facilities!

title: Retro Rally!
description: Get ready to embark on a nostalgic journey back to the golden era of arcade gaming with Retro Rally! This top-down racing game pays homage to the classic arcade racers of yesteryears, offering an adrenaline-pumping experience that will have you hooked from the moment you hit the accelerator.

title: Stories in Glass: Winter
description: Piece together winter magic in 40 stained-glass puzzles.

title: Let's Catapult
description: Let's Catapult is an exciting game that brings back the nostalgia of childhood memories.

title: Battle Poet
description: Battle demons with poetry to reclaim the Holy Mountain in this Strategy Roguelike about combining lines of poetry in turn-based combat.

title: Magic Cards Solitaire 2: The Fountain of Life
description: Experience a new, exciting solitaire adventure with Wizard Knoxford - now in the land of the elves! A life-giving artifact, the "Source of Life", is slowly losing its magic and threatens to go out. Unimagined effects on the inhabitants of the elven land would be the result.

title: Anaphora
description: Anaphora is a miniature movement shooter with rogue-lite elements that takes place in a single small arena.

title: Visual novel for the kids: Lumi And Baby - Hamster And Baby Dragon
description: Read an interactive bedtime story with your children, a tale of a positive hamster called Lumi and his friend a baby dragon. Lumi and Baby lost their homes and all the animals in the forest help them. Made for children aged 5-8.

title: The OG Cake Factory
description: You've woken up in this magnificent cake factory, but soon realize that a crazy chef is after you… Have fun baking cakes in this stressful Point-and-click Horror game!

title: Savanna Story Diamond Edition
description: The fate of Savannah is in your hands!

title: Run and Hide
description: The player needs to hide in objects from the hunter. Each item has a lifetime, when the item dies the player is thrown out of it.

title: Grandma's House: College Days
description: MC goes back to college and has some sex. Your standard cookie-cutter college game with all the staples you've come to expect like walking down a hallway, sleeping in a dorm room and the classic "banging your bully's girlfriend" scene. A prequel short story to Grandma's House

title: Saraman Union
description: Territory Management x Strategy SLG You, a very ordinary traveling merchant, unexpectedly inherited land one day from your aristocratic uncle who passed away suddenly. Now, you have become the lord of that land. However, it was not a territory governed by humans, but...

title: Loca Deserta: Odesa
description: Take on the role of a simple Cossack who helps to build the economy of a new region. Find all treasures and place them on the Hill of Glory!

title: My Train Arrives: Sea and Mountains
description: In this extension you will build a railway net on a large map with a mountain range and several rivers. If you like long train trips, this map is for you.An exciting journey in picturesque mountain scenery along a sea shore is waiting for you.

title: Zombie City Rescue
description: Imagine being trapped in a city full of zombies, with life and death in front of you! Don't worry, you will become one of the survivors! Quick reaction and precise shooting are your survival rules, but don't forget to stay calm, because every step can be your last! Are you ready?

title: Battle Junk
description: This game is a 3D bullet hell action game. You can possess enemy characters and switch them with your own. Featuring 3D graphics with a pixel art aesthetic!

title: Survive Planet Yubglub
description: Survive Planet Yubglub is a survival rouge-lite, where Earth Representatives must hurl dodgeballs while evading toxic slime aliens and their lethal projectiles. The Earth Reps. must carefully navigate through the harsh environment of planet Yubglub. Choose your character, and Survive Planet Yubglub!

title: Touch Force
description: Most unique top down shooter. Bring hell to insectoid robot invasion.

title: Nut City Blues
description: A comedy-mystery visual novel about Captain Fox, Detective Raccoon and the danger of pineapple pizza.

title: Wizards Quest: Adventure in the Kingdom
description: A faraway kingdom is shaken to its foundations when the prince is accidentally turned into a dragon. It's up to you to rebuild the city and restore it to its former glory!

title: Wretched Flesh
description: Wretched Flesh is a set of 5 boom-compatible (-complevel 9) maps. The .wad includes a dehacked file that makes the combat slightly faster paced. All of the maps are mostly linear. Combat ranges from cramped brawls to wide open skirmishes.

title: 3Xtinction
description: 3Xtinction is an Online Co-op Top Down Shooter with tactical and strategic elements. You and your friends will have to cooperate in order to complete missions.

title: Delta MMORPG
description: Online MMO RPG filled with adventure & action. Slash enemies or use magic to conquer. Embark on quests, delve into stories, encounter dragons, orcs, elves & more. Choose your class: Warrior (Guardian/Knight), Archer (Hunter/Ranger), Mage (Wizard/Archmage), or Priest (Druid/Cleric).

title: Synami's Speedmaps
description: 19 total speedmaps with minimal gameplay changes, such as making the pistol not entirely useless and buffs to the shotgun, chaingun and plasma rifle being present.

title: Project Subtrahend
description: Project Subtrahend is a choose-your-own-adventure visual novel, where you’ll have the chance to get to know the stories, pasts, and personalities of nine unique characters. Choices matter in this game, and it's up to you who lives or dies as you explore what it means to be human.

title: Encore
description: A 5-fret rhythm game with support for instrument controllers and traditional gamepads.

title: Animal Arena
description: Animal Arena is a wacky local multiplayer battle game for 1-4 players featuring cute animals and simple one button controls. Fight across unique arenas, collect weapon power-ups, and stomp opponents to win! Earn points by battling to unlock more playable animals!

title: Brain Hotel: Remodeled
description:
A comic book-inspired point-and-click adventure game. You play as delivery man, Ed Arnold, who has the misfortune of delivering a package to the Brain Hotel on the eve of their annual super-villain convention.

Brain Hotel: Remodeled is a complete remake of the original 2004 Flash-based game, updated to take advantage of modern technology.

title: Bomber Party: Anime Avatars
description: Give your Bomber Party profile a unique touch with the Bomber Party Anime Avatars DLC! This DLC includes 199 anime avatars, consisting of 100 anime boys and 99 anime girls, perfect for serving as profile pictures. Infuse your individual style and love for anime aesthetics into your player profile.

title: Color Bomb!
description: Color Bomb!: Just a simple color-matching game.

title: Forza Motorsport 2017: Jackie Chan DC Racing Oreca 07
description: Forza Motorsport 2017 Oreca #38 Jackie Chan DC Racing Oreca 07

title: No Pressure: Hive War
description: Experience a challenging and fun top-down space shooter. Play as the sole survivor of the Human Alliance Federation's space fleet, battling the menacing hive. Defeat the Hive Ship to save the planet and compete on the leaderboard for an exciting and nostalgic adventure.

title: TagTime
description: TagTime is a 2v6 asymmetric online party game, where a team of monsters hunts a team of runts trying to escape their impending doom. Kill, survive, cooperate or die in thrilling multiplayer action set in a fairytale world where mythical creatures brawl.

title: Ninja Forest Maze
description: Help me test the ninja of the cat tribe. Move the blocks on the screen to create a path. You can move the block by scrolling the mouse. If an emergency quest occurs in the middle, you must use it to create a path. If you click on an empty space without a photo, the quest window will disappear.

title: Gemaboy Zero X
description: Gemaboy Zero X is an action, exploration, and platform Cyberpunk Ploidmania videogame. It is the latest installment in the PLOIDS saga in which Omega will have to travel through time to preserve it and rescue his beloved Alpha!

title: Stardust Rain
description: Enter the world of the year 2431!

title: Strange World
description: This is a game of drawing lines and receiving water.

title: Wolf The Lone Hunt
description: Play as wolf with the ability to transform into a werewolf. Explore, hunt your prey and overpower mighty foes.

title: Tunnel Adventure
description: Tunnel Adventure is an exciting and addictive game that challenges players to guide a paper airplane through a perilous tunnel.

title: Lewd Cell
description: Hello to Lewd Cell, the first game from independent developer Lewd Leech. Losing in games has never been this fun. It aims to draw the player into a different atmosphere by combining sexuality in this 2D action platform genre.

title: Call of FireWork
description: Just Play the Fireworks. Use fireworks to defeat your enemies, resist the Creator of FWM, or... join him? A first person shooting game.

title: Fishing Online

description:
Five Nights at Treasure Island: Sister Location (also known as Oblitus Casa Troll Demo) is a Five Nights at Freddy's fangame released by Radiance Team under the disguise of a Oblitus Casa demo.
The game was intended to be a joke and not to be taken seriously.

Golden Feather Inugami will become your best adventure companion!

description:
Discover Adventure Starter Package exclusive to Steam.
Packed with items that will help your Summoner and Monsters develop faster than anyone else.

title: Hareshi Moyakana
description: This game was developed for those who are "very lucky", "like roguelikes" and "like beautiful girls" and fit these three elements. This game is your most coveted game. By the way, a cute girl has been waiting for you for a long time, so let's start the game!

Only available after finishing the game and loading the "clear save".

description: WYzards is an upcoming multiplayer extraction game with a bit of roguelike. Explore dungeons, use your elemental abilities, and go on insane adventures online!

description: My Trailer Park Life is a single-player, permadeath, open world, urban survival, life simulator. Play the character who lives in an RV, where your choices shape the story. Manage your wellbeing, work to earn money, buy food and supplies, or steal to survive. Enjoy the beauty of the ordinary.

title: Doppelgänger
description: This is a short game that focuses on light, darkness, and sound. Please experience it in a dark, quiet place and with headphones or earphones on.

title: Cats on Streets
description: Cats on Streets invites players to spot and uncover hidden feline friends in cities like Tokyo, Paris, and London. Unleash your inner detective and embark on this charming cat-hunting adventure!

title: Village Tycoon: Farm City Simulator
description: Village Tycoon: Farm City Simulator is a fun and addictive farming simulation game that challenges players to develop their farming capabilities and turn their small village into a bustling metropolis. With beautiful and fun buildings, expansions, and a variety of crops to grow, players must manage their farmfields, produce goods, and deliver orders to their citizens and neighbors to keep them happy and earn cash and XP.

title: Polyturbo Drift Racing Simulator
description: "Polyturbo Drift Racing Simulator" offers a heart-racing blend of simulation and racing, providing hours of excitement for players of all skill levels. This game promises thrilling competition and intense action. Take the wheel and prove you're the ultimate racing champion!

title: TT Isle of Man: Collection
description: Experience the best of the Isle of Man Tourist Trophy, the ultimate and world's most dangerous motorbike road race, with the TT Collection.

description: Part 3 of a Reality single play FPS game set in World War II! The upcoming operation is D-Day on the beaches of Normandy! Defeat your enemies and get your weapons!

description: Erogods: Olympus - is a dating simulator with feminized Greek gods.

Zombie Defense: Definitive Edition

title: Comic Coloring Book: Complete Edition - Colors Special
Gremlore
description:
As David Gilmour of Pink Floyd once said: "We all have our dark side to say the least."

Gremlor is no exception. He's a living being just like you and me. Although what you consider to be a "dark side" is definitely different than what he thinks. Is this a game? An experience? Who knows! It might be both!

Help Gremlor rescue the princess from the evil turtle king in this iconic 2D platformer!!!!!!!!

title: Back from Void
description: Collect magic shards and solve different puzzles with your elemental magic and your mind.Listen to local residents and help them so you can get Back from Void.

title: Gray Zone Warfare
description: Enter a high-stakes PvE-first open-world tactical shooter set on a quarantined Southeast Asian island torn apart by faction warfare. Deploy as an elite operator, fight solo or with your squad to carry out missions, earn reputation, and explore the truth behind the Event igniting the conflict.

title: Galacticverse
description: Galacticverse is an open-world, multiplayer game where players can embark on a cosmic adventure of exploration, space mining, and social interaction.

title: Please, Touch The Artwork 2
description: A handpainted cozy hidden object adventure. Explore a surreal world. Collect items for its quirky inhabitants. Fix damaged paintings and solve casual puzzles. Help a lost skeleton painter find his way home. This game is short but 100% FREE (no ads, no dlc's).

title: Big Klondike: Pyramid
description: Support Big Klondike and unlock Pyramid.

title: Deep Treasure
description: A 3D third-person dungeon crawling game. Arm yourself with useful equipment and items to find the hidden deep treasure.

title: Slip & Skid
description: Race against your friends and alter the track by placing obstacles after each lap. Change the rules mid-game with roguelike modifiers. Shove your opponents off the track, drift, boost and jump. Up to 4 players online and local split-screen.

title: The Sims 4: For Rent
description: Bring the neighbours together (literally) and experience multi-family lots as a tenant or property owner in The Sims 4 For Rent Expansion Pack. Purchase now to get bonus items** to bring the Night Market home for your Sims.

title: Tiny Balls
description: Tiny Balls is a multiplayer party game in which up to 16 friends can play against each other. In the three modes, players control a marble and must either push their friends off the track in a heated race, play a game of tag, or be the last to survive on a platform by pushing their friends off.

title: La Malédiction
description: La malédiction is a French adventure video game developed by Fabien Privat for the Amstrad CPC and published in 1991 by Lankhor. In the game, a wizard named Xarton casts a curse upon the forest of Enar. The game was met with polarized reviews upon release.

title: Cozy Space Survivors
description: A cozy time survival roguelite in space. You steer the shippy while the shooting happens automatically. Meet cute NPCs, solve small quests, and fight quirky enemies with satisfying weapons. A short experience for people who don't have much time but love playing (and finishing) games.

title: Hyper Mirror Run
description: Race head-to-head in the exciting world of HYPER MIRROR RUN. Compete locally with your friends or challenge an AI opponent. Navigate through mirrored worlds, mastering precision jumps and wielding weapons to triumph over foes. Dive into this 2D platformer for fast-action and a lot of fun!

title: Spotless
description: Clean, Clash, and Collect across the crummiest corners of this Single-Player Rogue-Lite. Spend your meager earnings wisely on both permanent and temporary upgrades, so that even the thriving haunts of cute and creepy creatures can’t stop you from cleaning until everything is Spotless!

title: Minesweeper Collector 2
description: Minesweeper with a story and detailed tutorials! Each level you pass is an item that changes the game world and advances you through the storyline. You will find collections, crafting and level chains, it will be fun!

title: To the Basement
description: "To the Basement" offers an exciting journey in the world of robots, where players can explore mysterious locations, overcome difficulties on their way and fight with hostile machines.

title: Space Strider
description: Space Strider is a 2D Sidescroller Shoot 'em up with Roguelite elements, where you beat hordes of enemies and defeat unique bosses. Unlock, upgrade and level up your Spaceships to become the ultimate Space Strider!

title: Vangaro Tactics
description: Command colorful troops into tactical turn-based battles in Vangaro Tactics! Infiltrate enemy outposts on the Stealth Missions: mine, recruit, move wisely, and you'll stand a chance. Know your commanders and exclusive units to make the most of each faction.

title: Crossing Frontier: Fate Foretold
description: Crossing Frontier is a side-scroll action game with brawling elements, , featuring multiplayer PVP content and the thrilling combat! Bring your A-Game and join the fight!

description: Backwoods Town is an atmospheric forest survival simulator. Build your base, grow crops, fight bosses and rebuild the destroyed settlement, finding all its inhabitants along the way.

description: Arts & Hearts Academy: first dark academia romantic visual novel with a detective storyline, where you play as an architecture student, and your goal is to win an architectural competition, uncover a mysterious crime at the academy, and find love. Are you ready? Let's get started!

description: The Brazil Fencing Club has nine world-class foil fencers ready to challenge you. Test your fencing skill and see if it holds up against these wacky fencers. Use actual real world fencing skills in a virtual reality game that closely simulates actual real world foil fencing.

title: Daria: A Kingdom Simulator
description: Daria: A Kingdom Simulator is an epic 125,000-word interactive fantasy novel by Mike Walter, where your choices control the story. It's entirely text-based—without graphics or sound effects—and fueled by the vast, unstoppable power of your imagination.

title: Welcome to Primrose Lake 2
description: The mystery continues in the highly anticipated sequel to Welcome to Primrose Lake!

title: FireChess
description: Unleash a new level of chess tactics with mage pieces that create fires, fog of war, portals, freeze opponents, and much more. Strengthen your army by purchasing additional pieces (standard or mage) when you earn income from occupying gold spaces.

title: ArenaWar
description: FPS Arena Competitive multiplayer

title: Ballapalooza
description: Roll around and collect rings to progress through several levels with various abilities. Become a true baller!

title: Bulletz
description: Bulletz is a chaotic local multiplayer twin stick shooter with over 40 guns and levels. You play a series of rounds in destructible levels trying to kill your opponents with guns that randomly spawn. The first player to 10 kills wins the match!

title: The Puzzle Maker: Cebba's Odyssey
description: Solve and create fantastical puzzles in The Puzzle Maker: Cebba's Odyssey! Follow the tale of Cebba the Puzzle Maker as you take on her many trials to inherit her title. Use the unique abilities of friendly units to manipulate and destroy enemy monsters. Become the next great Puzzle Maker!

title: Otherlights
description: Otherlights is an action-RPG game with roguelike tendencies designed for 1 to 4 players. In this sunless world, unlock many heroes and develop their destinies to try to access the solar fragment guarded by the powerful Exharques.

title: Brotherhood
description: An old-school shooter inspired by Wolfenstein 3D. You are one of the prisoners of an ancient prison. There is no one to help you. You only have yourself to rely on. Your shotgun. Against hordes of enemies. Animal rage and the desire to kill. Destroy Them All!

title: Art of Rally: Australia
description: Jump back behind the wheel with the Art of Rally: Australia DLC, and buckle up for a memorable off-road adventure as we take you on a tour down under. 6 rally stages & 1 freeroam location. 4 new cars, 2 new tunes.

title: Uki-Uki-Tengoku 2

description: Ever dreamed of contributing to the exploration of the universe? Then add the Spaceport Expansion to your Construction Simulator!

description: This is a turn-based puzzle board game where you need to cleverly navigate your character through guards and various obstacles to reach the endpoint! Additionally, you can use the level editor to create your own levels and share them with the community or download levels created by other players!

title: Summer Fantasy
description: It is a story of going forward together with childhood sweetheart monsters and saving each other, accompanying each other to experience those sparkling youthful times that are both troublesome and joyful. There is unparalleled passion and warmth in the daily life of fighting and teasing each other.

title: Power Punch
description: Power Punch is a local multiplayer (max 4 players) party fighting game where the longer you charge you punch the strong and faster it becomes when you release.

title: Bragnarok
description: Dance in the spotlight and push others out of it!

title: Golfing In Aether: Dustbowl
description: The fourth free expansion to Golfing in Aether, introducing a sandy, dusty environment along with several new levels.

title: Moi Moi Heroes
description: Moi Moi Heroes offers a wacky adventure on Moi Moi Island! Team up for wild co-op puzzles to reach King Moi Moi's crown, engage in royal tag battles to steal it from your friends, and return it to the King to score. Become the ultimate "Moi Moi Hero" in this uproarious showdown!

title: Vitrified
description: Vitrified is a post-apocalyptic metroidvania where progress depends on teamwork with your robot pal ALAN. Explore a mysterious mutant wasteland and upgrade ALAN with abilities to unlock new areas.

title: Path of Dragoon
description: Path of Dragoon is a Fantasy RPG that is inspired by Dragon Warrior and Final Fantasy. When not completing the Main Quest, you can restore the Kingdom by completing quests for villagers. You can Mine, Fish, and Explore the world to discover powerful items and abilities.

title: Is This Game Trying to Kill Me?
description:
An old shack deep in a dense forest, a strange computer and a game that's trying to kill you!

Is this Game Trying to Kill Me? - it is a mix of horror and first-person puzzle. You are trapped inside a cabin deep in the forest, and its owner offers to play a computer game in exchange for freedom. But the cabin and the game are much more connected than you might think. Traps from the game begin to appear in reality, and your actions in the cabin affect the computer game. And very soon you realize that the stake in this game is your life!

title: Trophy Hunt
description: Trophy Hunt is a silly multiplayer game all about stealing and defending trophies from your friends!

title: Deadly Contagion
description: In 2006, three forest rangers and a mysterious ABIN agent are sent to a mansion in a small town. Upon arrival, strange events begin to unfold. Manage your inventory, investigate the mysteries of the mansion, and survive if you can.

title: Office Nightmare: Chapter 1
description: Your boss trapped you in your office and you need to escape so you need to find a way out by solving puzzles, exploring the place, fight monsters, finding keys and more

title: Disney Dreamlight Valley: A Rift in Time
description: Expand your journey to Eternity Isle, where more adventures await!

title: Track Racing: The Holy Rosary
description: Drive along the race tracks and do some parkour in first person to get your objective. Try to pass all the obstacles in parkour to reach to the objective. God Loves you :)

description: Escort's Secrets 18+ is a captivating visual novel that follows the story of Hensel, a complete underachiever and a cheerful adventurer, who possesses an extraordinary talent for charming and doing the opposite.

title: Whispers of the Citadel
description: Immerse yourself in a kingdom's turmoil. Love, power, and destiny intertwine as you, a valiant soldier gifted with the citadel, navigate a precarious path to the throne. With the king's demise and no heir in sight, you must find a bride in just one month. Choose from five captivating partners.

title: Cosplay Relaxation
description: A massage parlor where your "relationship points" change the services available. There's an outfit for each "treatment" plan you need the most!

title: Lilim Wants to Lv Up
description: One night a beautiful girl suddenly appeared in my room, not only dressed in cool and sexy clothes, but also with horns and a tail.The self-proclaimed succubus Lilim came to the human world to become stronger, and my hoarded sexual desire was the perfect target for her.

title: Wild Horse Racing
description: Wild Horse Racing is a fast-paced arcade horse racing game where timing is everything! Master the rhythm-based controls, leap over big jumps, and race through hand-crafted tracks around the world. Climb the leagues, manage your horse, and gallop from bronze to gold!

title: Fortnite: Chapter 4 - Season OG
description:
Drop in the original Island once again in Fortnite Battle Royale Chapter 4 Season OG. Throughout “Fortnite OG,” each major update will bring a different phase of Battle Royale’s past, starting with Chapter 1 Season 5. That means Shopping Carts, ATKs, the Assault Rifle, Pump Shotgun, and more in both Battle Royale and Zero Build!

Go back in time Season by Season. Some of the unvaulted gear in each update will remain for that update, be in more than one update, or stay for the rest of Fortnite OG!

title: Miss Paint: Part 1
description:
To start us off, a bit of Athenian trivia. "Peristeri" is a real area of Athens, and the Greek word for "pigeon".

You will find pigeons in this fictional version of Peristeri - or, rather, they will find you - but were we to name this godforsaken place after the creature that populates it most densely, we really should call it "Cops".

Cops are a part of this story. Homeless men are a part of this story. Young artists who suffer menial part-time jobs to fund their creative pursuits are a part of this story. The protagonist of this story, however, is a middle-aged woman named Iris.

You would call Iris a protagonist, but you would never call her a hero, especially not to her face. If you called Iris a hero, she might actually die. Why? Because, God, she's no hero, am I? I mean, is she? Let me answer that: she's not. In fact, she's nobody, really. A totally unexceptional, deeply conservative, borderline detached shadow of a person who'd just like some paint. Pai--? Sorry, I meant paint. No. Not paint. I was gonna say she just wants some--

P a i n t.

title: The Smiling Man: Remake
description:
It's back! In this remake you can play through the real story told by Blue Tidal, as well as the alternative story, which is a recreation of the first game. In this remake too, the music and sounds have been recreated, with each ending having its own music.

The suspense part of the game was inspired by some famous horror movies from the 80s/90s.

As the main story is based on the real story of Blue Tidal, it ends up being very short, unlike the alternative story which is a recreation and reimagining of the first game.

title: Dead or Alive 5: Last Round - Core Fighters Character: Honoka
description: This DLC will unlock a new character: Honoka!

description: Celebrate the ultimate My Time at Sandrock experience with the exclusive Bundle!

description: Sora to Kimi Iro is a visual novel with a trial version released for PC on November 3, 2023.

description: A steamy Visual Novel featuring HD graphics in beautiful decor. Tony embarks on his wild Sex Adventure as he rediscovers life as a single guy. Episode 1 brings him to the local gay bar, to check it out, only to end up taking the cute bartender home after messing with him in the bar's toilet.

description:
Adventure RPG game of Abe, Bambo, Cici against the dark witch Indra who will resurrect the 1000 year old Demon. Interesting story, exciting battles, animated with Indonesian language, fun to play.

description: Overwatch 2 Season 8: Call of the Hunt adds the newest tank Hero, Mauga, along with Beast Hunter-themed skins in a new Battle Pass.

title: Diablo IV: Vessel of Hatred
description:
The battle against Hatred has only just begun.
Journey into the new region of Nahantu in search of Neyrelle, who is both suffering the fate of her choice to imprison the Prime Evil Mephisto, and seeking a means to destroy him.
Become the apex predator of the jungle as the all-new Spiritborn class. Recruit Mercenaries to aid you in combat, fight together in a new PvE co-op activity, & more.

title: Hearthstone: Showdown in the Badlands
description: The Bloodrock Mining Company found powerful Azerite in the Badlands. They’re digging deep and bleeding the land dry, disrupting the Badlands and awakening slumbering elementals! Now mysterious outlaws are riding into town to set things right. Tumbleweeds roll by and high noon looms. Grab your horse and your hat, it’s nearly time for a Showdown in the Badlands

title: World of Warcraft: Cataclysm Classic
description: The World-changing Cataclysm arrives in World of Warcraft Classic, with changes made from the original release based on fan feedback.

title: World of Warcraft Classic: Season of Discovery
description: Seasonal content arrives to World of Warcraft Classic, adding new playstyles to previous classes, reimagined instances, new PvP areas, and more.

title: World of Warcraft: The War Within
description:
Journey through never-before-seen subterranean worlds filled with hidden wonders and lurking perils, down to the dark depths of the nerubian empire, where the malicious Harbinger of the Void is gathering arachnid forces to bring Azeroth to its knees.

Deep beneath the surface lies treasure vaults waiting to be discovered with Delves. Explore these world instances solo or with up to four friends, along with an NPC companion, to defeat bosses and gain epic end-game loot.

Expand the potential of your alternate characters with account-wide progression across your family of characters on your Battle.net account with Warbands. Share your Warband Bank access, War Within Renown, achievements, collections, and more.

Rise to new heights of power with new Hero Talent trees. Each class specialization has access to two choices of self-contained Hero Talent trees inspired by iconic Warcraft universe archetypes.

title: World of Warcraft: Midnight
description:

Introducing Housing!
Before you put down roots in your own cozy corner of Azeroth later this year, jump into our virtual tour for an early glimpse at the customization options that await you.

Explore New and Reimagined Zones

- Eversong

- Dungeons and Raids

title: World of Warcraft: The Last Titan
description: The third of three announced expansions of the Worldsoul Saga.

title: Power Rangers: Lightspeed Rescue
description:
The Windows/Mac version of Power Rangers Lightspeed Rescue was more like an activity center. The game uses interactive CD-ROMs called Datazords that provide a virtual interactive Power Rangers experience.

Originally it was released on 6 CDs, bundled in complete with Power Rangers figure toys (one CD for each figure).

description: FreeJack is a classic free-to-play multiplayer parkour racing game.

description: Single map for Ultimate Doom created for the first Battle of the Bits Doom compo. In this spectacular adventure, you must wage a one-man war against a thorn bush in your backyard that happens to accidentally contain a portal to spiky hell. Time to break out the metaphorical weed whacker!

title: Malleable Intent
description: All is not well within the confines of the UAC, but what else is new. Hidden high atop a remote plateau, sinister machinations unfurl themselves inside this facility's walls. The demonic threat is present once again, but this time it seems that someone at the top was keeping fevered secrets well before their arrival. What price did they pay for progress? You'll have to procure your answers, and your equipment, on-site, but nothing should prove too elusive for a seasoned hellwalker like yourself. Leave no stone unturned, no evil unpurged, and dismantle the mechanisms behind this malleable intent.

title: A Stygian Anguish
description: The hellspawn spilled out of the UAC's hidden plateau base in a deluge of blood and fire, but that was only the beginning. It's clear now that the perpetuating evil took advantage of the Director's malleable intent; otherwise the assumption is that the UAC actually had the hubris to meddle with those otherworldly forces when the inevitable outcome has been laid bare time and again. As you step into the cargo lift and descend into the depths of the caverns beneath the plateau, you wonder what was worth burying under all this rock and stone. If the malice you faced to get here was just scratching the surface, what lies in wait in the darkness below? You steel yourself for what is to come, for anything given this much effort to conceal can result in nothing less than A Stygian Anguish.

title: Light Path
description: This is a casual racing game. You drove a big truck to a coastal city and had a car race in the city.

description: Bichiro, don't go there!

title: CodeRed: Battle for Earth
description: Standalone 3D first-person shooter running on Quake II's engine. Your mission is to defend the earth from the alien invasion and to discover the URF commanders secrets.
