description: Bat Blast! is a 2D game about magical bats. Take control of one of many magical fruit bats, and blast your way upwards through the minions of 'The Master' as you strive to escape his tower.

title: Banana Co.
description: Banana Co. is a first person horror game in which you're placed into a terrifying banana factory where you have to avoid the dangers that await you. You're given no instructions but to collect bananas around the factory.

title: Ashes of Sombtir
description: Ashes of Sombtir, the rpg where you follow the rules.

title: Ammossum
description: Build an endlessly upgradable weapon! Evolve projectiles into unstoppable firepower in this action roguelike. Fight through hordes of infected beasts, save your family, and feel the thrill of bloody shootouts filled with bullets, explosions, and acid. Can you survive the madness?

title: Truck Simulator Collection
description:
Here's the biggest truck collection you've been waiting for!
Hop behind the wheel, choose a mission and deliver your client's cargo on time!

title: The Smurfs: Learn and Play
description: Discover the world and learn by playing with Smurfs!

title: The Smurfs: Colorful Stories
description: Hop into the wonderful world of Smurfs and check what stories are waiting for you!

title: MechanixMind: IQ Puzzle Adventure
description: Dive into a world where physics reigns and every level offers endless possibilities.

title: Adventure Word: Around the World
description: World Trip using English words! Solve unique and thrilling English word puzzles operated with your fingers and adventure on hundreds of stages around the world!

title: Wingspan + European Expansion + Oceania Expansion
description:
This bundle includes:
WINGSPAN
WINGSPAN: European Expansion
WINGSPAN: Oceania Expansion

title: Smash Balls
description:
Test your aim and timing in this fun and fast game

Take out all of the red enemies without running out of ammo

Build up a frenzy to unleash hellfire on the enemies

Smash everything and watch it crumble away!

title: Rogue Glitch Ultra
description: A roguelite action platformer in a vibrant glitch-ridden world. Amass a huge arsenal from over 150 weapon options and face hordes of enemies and tough boss fights.

title: Outbreak: Co-Op Collection
description: Is a bundle of survival horror games from developer Dead Drop Studios.

title: Suspicious Person Information
description: A short horror game set in Japan. There are two possible endings.

title: Five Nights At Freddy's: Nightshift
description: The Gameplay Consists of a quick and smooth movement alongside responsive controls as well giving it some style in the game.

title: Cold Abyss
description: COLD ABYSS is a relaxing and atmospheric exploration game where you repair internet cables on the bottom of the ocean.There are no enemies or other forms of danger down there. Just you.

title: LBreakout2
description: The successor to LBreakout offers you a new challenge in more than 50 levels with loads of new bonuses (goldshower, joker, explosive balls, bonus magnet ...), maluses (chaos, darkness, weak balls, malus magnet ...) and special bricks (growing bricks, explosive bricks, regenerative bricks ...). If you are hungry for more you can create your own levelsets with the integrated level editor. There is also an experimental two player mode (via LAN) available.

title: Meeting Myself
description:
It is a 3D first-person puzzle game, in which, the player must deal with, some, "diseases" by overcoming cryptic levels and grasping the meaning of them.
Meeting myself is a game that wants to reach out and raise awareness about certain moments in life and give a boost to those who are in a difficult time.

title: Drawing with Nat: Dream Diary
description:
Drawing with Nat: Dream Diary is a Yume Nikki styled exploration game featuring Nat!
Explore various dream locations to collect "Inspiration" which can be used to create drawings and also collect "Forms" which can grant you different abilities and change Nat's appearance.

title: A Twisted Path To Renown
description:
A Twisted Path To Renown: is a Multiplayer, loot-focused, PvEvP extraction shooter, set in the rugged 1899 United States!
Strap on your holster, assemble a posse, and get ready for a rootin'-tooting good time!
Roam the savage lands of the United States during the 1890s and live out your Western dream!
Fight against vicious bandits, or become one yourself as you loot and pillage from the Hills of Tennessee to the Pine forests of Arizona. Fight various factions in an unforgiving land for fame, and fortune!
Stay alert for ferocious wild boars, and bandits who will tan your hide for a chance to steal your precious loot!
Evade the resourceful and cunning Indigenous Peoples of early America to fight another day or attack against all odds for your chance at Legend!

title: The Lord of the Rings Online: Minas Morgul
description: The Lord of the Rings Online: Minas Morgul is the seventh expansion. It raised the game's level cap from 120 to 130 and added the Morgul Vale and dead city of Minas Morgul as well as seven new group instances and a new raid set in Shelob's lair. The expansion also introduced the seventh playable race of Stout-Axe Dwarves, whom players who pre-ordered it could access prior to the release date.

title: The Lord of the Rings Online: War of Three Peaks
description: The Lord of the Rings Online: War of Three Peaks is the eighth expansion for the MMORPG The Lord of the Rings Online. Announced as a "mini-expansion pack", it is smaller than other expansions in both scope and price, comparable to 2009's Siege of Mirkwood. Unlike all previous expansions, it did not raise the game's level cap. Instead, a new type of quests called "Missions" was introduced, which scale to the player character's level, allowing players across all levels to participate.

title: The Lord of the Rings Online: Fate of Gundabad
description: The Lord of the Rings Online: Fate of Gundabad is the ninth expansion for the MMORPG The Lord of the Rings Online. It is a direct sequel to the previous year's War of Three Peaks expansion and concludes the storyline that has been developing over several updates. The expansion raised the level cap to 140, added the region of Gundabad, a new Brawler class and brought a major change to the Legendary Item system introduced in the Mines of Moria.

title: The Lord of the Rings Online: Before the Shadow
description: The Lord of the Rings Online: Before the Shadow is the tenth expansion for the MMORPG The Lord of the Rings Online. It did not raise the game's level cap or advance the current storyline, but instead added a new starting zone for the new player experience, with a storyline set prior to that of the Shadows of Angmar.

title: The Lord of the Rings Online: Corsairs of Umbar
description: The Lord of the Rings Online: Corsairs of Umbar is the eleventh expansion for the MMORPG The Lord of the Rings Online. Corsairs of Umbar introduces the new innovative New Mariner Class, a fearless swordfighter with a unique balance system. Players can unleash powerful skill sequences in their swordplay to create powerful skill chains that leave their enemies in a daze and allies in awe. Slash through foes with slick swordplay, belt out rousing sea-shanties, and pull off crafty moves that will have enemies spinning in confusion.

title: Chikn Nuggit Nightmare Fwiends
description: You're now dreaming of your worst nightmare, that Chikn Nuggit and his fwiends are gonna kill you! You have to collect all the 10 Chicken Nuggets and then get out of this maze!

title: AirKano: Dr. M no Yabou
description: A Mega Man-like game released by Keio Digital Vertex, featuring characters from the Kanon and AIR visual novels.

title: Null Gravity Labyrinth
description:
Find the golden cube to exit this abstract labyrinth.
When touching a spinning cube all elements with the same color will disappear and new paths will form.
When you touch a portal it will teleport you to another portal of the same color.

title: Extreme Skyway Racer Simulator
description: Get ready for a thrilling 3D gaming experience that will push your skills to the edge! Extreme Skyway Racer Simulator puts you in the driver's seat as you navigate precarious platforms suspended in the sky. Your mission: to race across these dizzying heights while maintaining your balance and avoiding a nerve-wracking plunge.

title: Domino: The Little One
description: Domino, an hand-drawn 2D adventure game, invites you to traverse a realm where the perils of global warming and ecological catastrophe manifest as monstrous entities, and the only weapon at your disposal is your wit and will to make a change.

title: Flowereverie
description: Flowereverie is a peaceful flower-laden puzzle game where, to perform any action you must first spell it, by arranging letters like flowers in a vase. Cast spells, spell spells, become the land's most prolific flower arranger, and you might be able to discover the dark secrets of the town proper.

title: Vicera
description: Vicera is an online co-op game. Play as relic hunters, solving enigmatic mysteries and escaping a terrifying monster. Will you dare to face the darkness to find the cursed relics?

title: Idle Progress
description: Idle Progress - A free idle game where your task is to produce as many resources as possible, improve your weapons and armor for good attacks, create good fishing rods for a good catch and get legendary items by completing legendary quests.

title: Doomer Farm
description: Doomer Farm - is a farm simulator set in a doomer post-punk atmosphere. Manage the farm, build factories, and avoid health inspectors.

title: Deep Sleep
description: A horror game about infinite dreams, where you need to constantly find abnormal places in the room to stay awake, otherwise you will fall into terrifying dreams

title: Criminal Behavior
description: Use your thinking and analytical abilities to solve crimes scenes. There is a burglar on the loose, and he is breaking into all types of buildings in order to steal expensive items. We need you to find clues and piece together a cohesive picture of each crime scene.

title: Kryh Explorer
description: Explore the world of the crystal-mining creatures, the Kryh, Meet other alien races, improve your equipments and customize your burrow. Great adventures are waiting in Kryh Explorer!

title: Hidden World 8 Top-Down 3D
description: Find the objects that are hidden on the map.

title: Bwudaling: Da Fight for da Bwudahood
description: The game nobody wanted but everyone needed. The evil Twent has attacked, bringing his minions with him, as well as hundreds of saws to block your path. Dodge, duck, dip, dive, and dodge to prove your love for Bwuda as you track Twent down to his evil lair, and finish him once and for all.

title: The Unvisited Grandma
description: How long have you been visiting your grandmother?

title: Invasion: Tales of Tower Defense
description: Can you defeat an enemy that learns from you? Invasion it's a strategy game in which the enemy learns from you and implements changes to the attacks so they can win the upcoming war. During this journey, you have to unlock different towers and upgrade them to stop the invasion

title: Magic Architect: Into Disaster
description: "Embark on a journey to master your magical build! Will you choose 3-Way, Spread, or Rapid Fire? This is a one-man army shooter! Cultivate your magic, sell it off, and rake in the profits! You can choose your character and the magic you want to grow. Get rich in the blink of an eye!"

title: Statera: Aurum
description: In a time of peace and prosperity, life thrived on the island of Miralis and the port city of the same name. The island, known for its flourishing gold veins and fertile soil, gained fame through trade and the eager gold seekers who flocked to the mines to find their fortune.

title: Omurice Next Time
description: Finn and Gray have been together for five years now. Two men, simple living, and their biggest hobby is just eating for fun. Explore their husband & husband life, joy and love, hopes and dreams, and casual awkwardness and embarrassment in this slice of life interactive storybook.

title: Simple Stock Trading Simulator
description: Dive into the world of day trading with 'Simple Stock Trading Simulator.' Easy-to-play, yet challenging. Test your skills, reach goals, and experience the thrill!

title: Blood Lily Loop
description: Your bestie seems to be hiding something. There's something about your world that seems odd as well, like it has...secrets. Dive into the time loop of this horror game and witness a "friendship" that rewrites the world.

title: Mysterious Legend
description: This is a very adventurous exploration game.

title: Cards of Clotho
description: Cards of Clotho is a roguelite autobattler where you summon legendary heroes and conquer mythical realms! Weave your strategy and hold the Fates of Gods in your hands!

title: Devilish Blind Date
description: This game is heavily inspired by『Vampire Survivors』 You are summoned into an Isekai and fighting monsters with a mysterious girl, Nanako.

title: Neon Fuga
description: The spaceship pulls into a kaleidoscope of bizarre and dangerous worlds full of aggressive creatures. Will it be possible to break through the waves of enemies, and return back to the familiar space?

title: Hedra
description: Hedra is an early access, Unreal Engine 5-powered sandbox focused on geometric play and a community-driven design experiment. Manipulate a world through diverse modes like survival and puzzles. Your actions and feedback not only shape the world but also its ongoing development.

title: Sir Bob: Squire for Hire
description: In the legends of King Arthur... nobles, soldiers, and the Lady of the Lake all say you're too wimpy to become a Knight. Prove them wrong!

title: Dark Lord
description: Unleash your power in Dark Lord, a roguelike RPG filled with strategy, adventure, and sardonic wit. Rule your growing realm with an iron fist, fortify the stronghold, and avoid getting stabbed in the back by your advisors!

title: Legend of Egypt: Jewels of the Gods
description: Thabit mercilessly rules his kingdom in the land of Egypt, until one day he is struck by a heavy blow of fate. The gods Isis and Osiris take pity on the young pharaoh: by building a magnificent city that offers shelter to many contented inhabitants, Thabit can change his fate.

title: Crisis Survivors
description: A casual game of meat pigeons Dealing different damage to enemies through different skill combinations.

title: MoeMoni Land
description: In"MoeMoni Land",you can see the cub forms of 21 well-known monsters,such as the big dog,the wine swallowing boy,and the white faced fox.They possess unique skills but each has their own devils.You and your friends can play the role of a demon cub and stage a brain burning social reasoning drama.

title: Tank Captain
description: Tank Captain "is a strategic warfare game where players will play the role of commander and engage in different tank combinations to enhance the refined attributes of tanks and artillery. They can enhance their attack or armor abilities according to their preferences and win the war.

title: Nexus Defenders
description: Tower Defense meets a Visual Novel narrative. Place an arsenal of towers to halt the invading enemy. Use special abilities such as napalm strikes, EMP blasts, and orbital lasers. A sci-fi space drama, filled with dialogue choices.

title: Cureocity
description: “People think battles need powerful weapons, but strategy at hand is key."The story follows a rookie adventurer and a new healer in a dungeon quest, with the core gameplay involving hand-picked methods using weapons and items. Fight or purify? Heal or alter? The choice is in your hands.

title: Reptile Chronicles
description: "Reptile Chronicles" immerses players in a vivid 3D fantasy PVP arena where they wield powerful magic, from fireballs to laser beams, battling opponents in real-time multiplayer duels. Dive into the realm of reptiles and prove your dominance!

title: 40 Seconds
description: A hidden object puzzle game inspired by public health issues related to suicide.

title: Survival Fantasy
description: SURVIVAL FANTASY, the most frenetic survival/waves action roguelike with platforms! Annihilate hundreds of monsters with your bow or your sword, collect items to enhance your abilities and demonstrate your skills on a huge map full of enemies with one purpose: kill you.

title: Heroes Wanted
description: 'Heroes Wanted' is a Roguelike Deckbuilding game that follows a unique set of rules. Build your perfect deck, gather Artifacts, and strategically take down your enemies using elements and multipliers!

title: Danny's Descent
description: Pedal through the looping halls to find Room 237 - Hand tracking VR horror game

title: Unreal Mashup
description: Unreal Mashup will test your gaming ability with a solid 3rd person shooter base experience. Fight against bots or join your friends in their personal server automatically created at every login. This high pace futuristic shooter is Fast!

title: Sona-Nyl of the Violet Shadows Refrain
description: The 5th entry in Liarsoft's Steampunk visual novel series is a mysterious fairytale in which fantasy and reality intertwine. The story unfolds from the perspectives of 2 women: one who travels in the ruins of Engine City New York, and one who finds herself in an underground wolrd with a violet sky.

title: Worker Simulator
description: "Worker Simulator" is an open-world video game where you play as Jack, a newcomer to Land No. 6. The game offers the freedom to explore the island, work in factories, trade with other players, earn money, buy or rent a dream home, and raise animals from young to fully-grown adults.

title: Estate Empire
description: Estate Empire is a multiplayer strategic game inspired by classic board games. Compete against your friends and develop your own strategy to win, and try to dismantle your friend's empire. Invest in the same street as your friends, use your cards or become the mayor to create new laws against them.

title: Oh Darling! I Hate To Tell You This...
description: Little Darling makes a wish at the place where all the wishes come true. Then her journey begins. She has to fight against the monsters with the power of light.

title: Raven Simulator
description: Isn't that too complex living as a human being? Then live your life as a raven and enjoy as you can!

title: On the Axis
description: Discover the simplicity and relaxation within On The Axis. An easy and calm puzzle game focused on mirrors and tiles.

title: Cerebral Clash
description: Cerebral Clash is a multiplayer arcade shooter where you take control of a tank powered by an enigmatic sentient brain. Play solo in an intriguing campaign or battle online with friends and foes in thrilling warfare matches!

title: Train Valley 2: Community Edition
description: Drive forward the industrial revolution in this train tycoon micro-management game!

title: Mixx Island: Remix Plus - Legendary Edition
For a Vast Future: Extended Edition
Chicken Attack Deluxe
description: This brick-busting original will turn you into a hen trying to save her chicks from turning into dinner. Shoot bricks and obstacles as you run around the screen collecting your baby chicks; that's the only way to beat each level! Look out for powerups, bonus worms and treasures because they'll be cracking down on you as the levels progress. Get clucking!

title: 1 Penguin 100 Cases
description: After being caught in a fishing net, Pengoo is taken to New Zealand. Journey with him as he struggles to find his way back home. Surprises are in store as Pengoo befriends a colorful cast of characters and mystical creatures, each with their own predicaments. Can you help solve their problems as well as Pengoo's? 1 Penguin 100 Cases features 90 levels of classical I-spy adventure with original puzzles and mini-games for everyone!

title: Excuse Me Sir
description:
Excuse Me Sir is a point-and-click adventure game featuring content creator Molly Moon. Her world is creepy, surreal, and if you're not careful... deadly! Can you solve the mystery of your missing brother? Or will Molly lure you to your doom?

"This game only has one rule: I Always Win."

Excuse Me Sir is an unholy collaboration between Molly, Airdorf Games, Jesse Cox (Scary Game Squad, Monster Prom) and Torple Dook (Chip's Tips, Hand of Doom). ALSO featuring original artwork by Siren Head creator Trevor Henderson!

title: Dave.exe
description: Dave.EXE is a third-person low-poly stealth horror game loosely based off of the video game "Dead by Daylight", which the creator has a love-hate relationship with. You play as Dave Microwave, an everyman trying to live his life, until one day being pulled into warfare by the Berrys against Edgy Dave. You'll travel through timelines and collect soda from five machines while avoiding whichever of Edgy Dave's ranks is hunting you that round.

title: Paperhead
description:
PAPERHEAD is a fast-paced FPS game set in a world where everything is made out of cardboard and paper but is infested with horror!
Use a pencil as a weapon and explore what exactly went wrong in the secret research facility and why suddenly papercut people were able to...bleed.
Paperhead's Main Features

- Cardboard cute style with a horror twist. Cute but horrifying!

- Brutal and fast-paced combat. Slide to throw enemies in the air, kick explosive barrels into them (or enemies themselves!), and jump onto them Mario-style.

- Use a Pencil as a weapon. Draw a bomb to explode enemies!

- Use a Pencil as a reality-warping puzzle-solving tool. Not sure how to get through? Try to draw a door on the wall!

WHY WOULD PAPER...BLEED?

title: Bellatrix e o Palácio do Tempo
description: Bellatrix e o Palácio do Tempo is an educational adventure game that tells the story of the beginnings of the telephone in a fun and interactive way.

title: Gam3rAbduction
description: A Game Made by Gam3rBoy57. Its about a Controller which gets chased by UFOs that try to abduct it.

title: Scherzo
description:
Short RPG Maker game about choices and what happens when you make them, like many other RPG Maker games.

There are 5 unique endings and 4 variations of the same ending, making 9 total. (No secrets)

Although there is hardly any sound, Scherzo is best experienced with headphones for a very specific reason.

title: A Story of Paradise Lost
description: A demon convinces an angel to help rid her of her enemies and create a perfect world.

title: Channel 3
description: Tobias is bored at home, watching TV. Though he's about to have a very unique day...

title: Sex Drive
description: From the sickos behind Minotaur Hotel and Killigan's Treasure comes Sex Drive, a collection of gay interactive erotica about truckers. Prepare yourself for encounters with sweaty hitchhikers, fun times in truck stops, threesomes with hardworking men, long trips wearing nothing but briefs and all other kinds of trucker-related shenanigans.

title: The Rake: Rust Dead Survival
description:
After you successfully defeated Jeff The Killer
and Slender Man,
you are ready for your next mission!
Hunt down and kill The Rake.
Find 8 Rake Voodoo dolls.
Lock and load! Revenge is MY NAME!

Find 8 Voodoo Dolls and Kill The Rake.
Good Luck!

title: Le Sanglot des Cigales: Tomes 1 et 2
description: An officially licensed French release of the first two chapters of Higurashi When They Cry.

title: Le Sanglot des Cigales R: Tomes 5 et 6
description: An officially licensed French release of the first two chapters of Higurashi When They Cry Kai.

title: Utility Vehicle Simulator
description: Utility Vehicle Simulator (German: "Sonderfahrzeug-Simulator 2012") is a simulation that lets you complete communal or private assignments. Repairing street lights, cleaning sewers, grooming trees or cordoning off construction sites. 15 missions and a lot of vehicles are included and can be controlled by you. Maintenance as well as financial management are also your responsibilities.

title: Polarvoid
description: It's nighttime and you are home alone during a rainstorm. You get bored and decide to organize your family's photo album. There are 9 polaroids missing, you go look for them. Though you feel like someone is watching you from outside the house...

title: Slashes
description: Just a casual talk between a girl and a knife.

title: Minecraft: The World Warrior
description: Master the Hadouken and conquer the dark Hadou with this Capcom approved skin pack! Select your character from 35 classic world warriors and fighters like Ryu, Ken, Chun Li, and more.

title: The Amazing Digital Funkin'
description: The Amazing Digital Funkin' is a parody Friday Night Funkin' mod based around The Amazing Digital Circus. In the mod, Boyfriend goes against Pomni and Jax.

title: Point Click Killer
description: You've been driving all day and can barely keep your eyes open, when you finally see the lights to a Motel. Maybe they will have a vacancy? Maybe you will get more than you bargained for...

title: Zarathustra: Cybergeddon
description:
Zarathustra - Cybergeddon is a classic point and click adventure with inventory and dialog puzzles in a scifi futuristic setting.
It's a rather casual experience with no dead-ends or overly difficult puzzles.

"In the aftermath of The Inflection, a momentous event that unveiled cosmic truths and alien technology, two religious factions emerge: the Church of Flesh, embracing chaos and free will, and the Church of Neon, upholding order and stability.

Amy, an FBI agent affiliated with the Church of Neon, carries with her a unique asset: a cybernetic implant housing the consciousness of a past individual—you, the player.

Together, you navigate the complexities of a case involving a book stolen from the Church of Flesh. This investigation is set against the backdrop of a world grappling with the implications of its newfound enlightenment and the delicate balance between these two divergent philosophies."

title: Crescent Satsujin Jiken: Reporter Saotome Kyouko
Do Us Part
description:
Do Us Part is a short puzzle adventure game where the player controls the newlywed Margerita in exploring the estate of her new, somehow very rich, husband. Of course, a normal, peaceful marriage would not make an exciting fairy tale or game, so things do not go as expected. People might've gone missing in this mansion before. Spooky things might happen. Someone might die. Who knows! Margerita doesn't, otherwise surely she wouldn't be in this position in the first place.

The game is loosely based upon How the Devil Married Three Sisters, with an emphasis on loosely.

title: Sweet
description: In Sweet, you play as Pike, a little animal who just wants to go home after work! Explore a collection of odd and dreamlike environments as you head to where you need to be. Encounter strange creatures and become friends with them during combat!

title: Cold and Unforgiving
description: A submission to Ludum Dare 54, Cold and Unforgiving follows four young adults as they venture through the wilds of northern Michigan in search of a rumored ghost town. However, when it starts to get dark, they're left to make a decision that will change their lives forever.

title: Air Aces
description: Take command of various modern jet fighters (F-16 Falcon, Eurofighter Typhoon, Dassault Rafale) and copters (Bell AH-1 Cobra, Eurocopter EC665 Tiger) in this perfect mix between a realistic flight simulator and a mission based air combat game.

title: Jet Ski Mania: Aquatic Adrenaline Rush
description: Dive into Adrenaline: Ride the Waves of Victory!

title: Ziggy Zaggy
description: Switch the sides to go further in the world.

title: The Forgotten Tribe
description: The Forgotten Tribe is a small arcade game with 9 levels to go through and get your fellow tribesmen back. Use a map to navigate the dungeon and successfully collect all of your tribe to unlock a happy ending!

title: Danjigoku
description: Danjigoku is a retro-styled classic arcade twin-stick shoot 'em up game. Shoot through hordes of aliens and collect 7 different kinds of upgrades to survive as long as possible!

title: Pixel Game Maker Series Project Nosferatu
description: A fast-paced Action RPG with a fully customizable arsenal combo battle system.

title: Train Traffic Manager
description: All Aboard the Chaos & Strategy Express!

title: Keep The Fire: Survival Simulator
description: Fuel Your Destiny: Ignite the Game Within!

title: Inertia 2
description: Inertia 2 is a first-person action platformer with free-run and old school FPS inspired movement mechanics.

title: Draw and Go!
description: Draw and create players to defeat the enemy team!

title: Draw and Color
description: Draw, paint, choose your painting tools, and progress with Draw and Color!

title: Resident Evil RPG
description:
Resident Evil RPG is a fangame based on the original Resident Evil (the one released for PlayStation, Saturn and PC), which also includes certain elements from Resident Evil Rebirth (Gamecube).

Resident Evil RPG was developed in RPG Maker XP by Evilbiel and co-produced by Dungeon Master and follows the story of a police team, S.T.A.R.S, who go to investigate a sinister mansion where there have been macabre reports of murders.

The game has extra unlockable modes with new adventures (some fake), with a storyline behind the main one! The project came from the idea of playing Resident Evil from a new perspective, in 2D, but far surpassing Resident Evil Gaiden, from the Game Boy Color!

title: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare III - Vault Edition
description:
The Vault Edition includes:

- Cross Gen Bundle of Call of Duty: Modern Warfare III
- Available in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare III, Call of Duty: Modern Warfare II and Call of Duty: Warzone:
-- Soap Operator Pack*
-- Zombie Ghost Operator Skin*
-- Soul Harvester Tracer Weapon Blueprint*
- Nemesis Operator Pack
- 2 Weapon Vaults**
- BlackCell (1 Season) + 30 additional Tier Skips***

title: Extraordinary: Immortal
description: "Extraordinary: Immortal" tells a story of a 700-year time loop. Karena suddenly receives a mysterious letter, in which the sender informs her that there is one thing she must complete on her own, or else all the efforts to save the world from three years ago will become entirely meaningless...

title: Early-blooming Black Lily: Hana to Itsuki no Naisho no Hanashi 1
description: [Recommended reading after the main story!]You'll be able to play the new scenario, "Hana and Itsuki's Secret, Part 1".After everything, what kind of paths do Hana and Itsuki take...?An event revealing the aftermath of the main story!

title: Yuan Ka Card 2: MetaCard2
description: Hello everyone, this is my second game "Yuan Ka Card 2". Based on the rich card entries of the first generation, it innovatively incorporates the concept of projectiles. Through the strategic combination of cards and projectile targeting, the control of movement is replaced.

title: Wave Dungeon
description: Wave Danjon is a roguelike RPG in which the player is forced to navigate a map that switches at regular intervals. Conquer dungeons that become more powerful and evil with each wave!

title: Tower of Hidden Waifus
description: Discover desire in Tower of Hidden Waifus, a unique hidden object game. Ascend the tower, find over 600 enticing waifus, and unlock sensual encounters with animated passion. Explore secrets, master challenges, and unveil your deepest desires.

title: Touhou Meijinka: Song of Divine Tempest
description: A thunderous concert appears...

title: The Tau Experiment
description: The Tau Experiment is an episodic RPG Adventure game where you play as Sam, an employee with the Tau Corporation. Choose your own adventure as you work to help Sam put an end to the company's plans.

title: The Void Project
description: The Void Project is a fast paced arena shooter that throws you into an arena simulation. Face different kind of demons, overcome their patterns and finish them off in as less time as possible to reach the top of the leaderboard and make yourself worthy of calling ~The Void Breaker~.

title: Titan Station: VR
description: Experience Titan Station in VR.

title: To the Tavern
description: Send Patrons out to quests. Use the class and element triangles to deal critical damage! Serve ale to give your patrons to give them buffs and equip them with the best weapons. Don't let your patrons die or your business will close.

title: TunsTan
description: A cartoon style side-scroller action/strategy RPG. Raise a warband of tumbleweeds to lead into battle and command and fight alongside them. Explore the world, craft items, and lead your warband to the adventure!

title: Two Hands Eggs
description: Two Hands Egg is an emotional egg with two hands...that is, you who play this game. Have fun cooperating with your friends, competing against each other.

title: Wacky Escape
description: Stop trippin' and escape your destiny in this runner action game

title: Vagrient
description: Play as an Armlys alien named Vagrient in this evolving sci-fi action/adventure game, featuring RPG elements. It's full of exploration, combat, character progression, puzzle solving and obstacle clearing!

title: Undergod
description: Take over heaven in this airborne-combat roguelike where you fight hordes of angels while growing stronger every minute.

title: Universal Power
description: Universal power is a fantasy RPG game designed and published by Martia Nouri Namini.

title: The Perplexing Orb: Bounce N' Roll
description: The Perplexing Orb returns in a brand new entry packed with new features! New art style, new levels, and new game play mechanics! Bounce N' Roll through this all new adventure!

title: The Game Of Death
description: Step into the bony shoes of Death in this unique platform game. As the iconic skeleton character, you're one day away from retirement when a sinister thief steals your life savings. Reclaim what's yours and set off on your dream vacation.

title: The Maze Contract
description: The Maze Contract is a single player retro action game with vector-style graphics. It takes a lot of inspiration from the 1980's shoot-em-up arcade games, but with added tactical elements and lots of upgrades for your ship and weapons.

title: Survivor Challenge TD
description: Survivor Challenge TD plunges you into an epic struggle for survival against an oncoming horde of monsters. Arm yourself with the most formidable and thrilling weapon combinations and abilities as you brace for an ultimate showdown against a powerful boss!

title: Synthetic Soul
description: Synthetic Soul is an immersive modern Rags to Riches life sim with an in-depth robot companion. What kind of person will you become once you truly have it all? Discover the secret of your robot, and change the world.

title: Teacher Seduction
description: Math is such a boring thing... Unless you have a hot teacher! In this case, even her angry boyfriend might not be a big problem.

title: The Backrooms: You've Been Here Before
description: You find yourself in Backrooms, and it's up to you to find a way out of this place. You are completely lost, in a world of endless corridors and liminal spaces. And no one knows what's waiting for you around the next corner.

title: Super Laura Up
description: Super Laura Up is a platformer Inspired by retro platformers and precision platformers, this game will take you on a journey through a variety of challenging levels, where you must use your precision and timing to overcome obstacles and reach the end.

title: Super Elastic
description: The girl said that this game is really flexible, come and play together.

title: Suika Shapes
description: Match a variety of colorful shapes in this addicting match two puzzle game in an ever-enclosing space

title: Suika Dish More Plates
description: More plates, more points. More fruits, more points.

title: Sorcevival
description: Sorcerers have nearly succumbed to corruption. In Sorcevival, a horde survivor roguelite, it's time to turn the tide. Choose wisely how to empower your magic spells as you face nightmarish creatures. How far will you go in this battle for survival?

title: SOS Zombie: Survival
description: SOS Zombie follows the harrowing journey of a group of diverse survivors trapped in a city overrun by a zombie apocalypse. Seeking refuge in an abandoned house, the group fights waves of increasingly aggressive zombies while preparing for a rescue helicopter scheduled for evacuation a rescue point.

title: Sovereign Reign
description: Gifted with divine will, establish your Deity's kingdom on Earth. Recruit believers, erect essential structures and vanquish barbarian threats to shape your realms destiny and Reign as Sovereign.

title: Spooky Spins Returns: Crazy Cash Edition - Slots
description: Spooky Spins Returns : Crazy Cash Edition is a 5 reel, 25 payline slot machine (pokie) with a Horror theme oriented from left to right. - with the similar lightning strike feature.

title: Space Miner: Idle Adventures
description: A casual idle asteroid mining game where you fly around mining and make the numbers go UP! A dash of humor, RPG, science and more.

title: Shopping in a Winter Zombieland
description: An apocalyptic Visual Novel from Zombie Zone Germany for Christmas with German voice acting, lots of decisions and six different endings. There is only a version in German language.

title: Sae
description: SAE takes you to a dreamlike yet perilous tropical island chain in the South Pacific. Survive the natural perils, gather resources, and find your way back to civilization.

title: Roxy Raccoon's Pinball Panic: Thanksgiving Throwdown
description: 1 Brand New Table with online leaderboards and unlockable cosmetics! Thanksgiving themed table for the season of harvest.

title: Robots at Midnight
description: Robots at Midnight will have you embracing intense combat, unravelling deep lore, and discovering what it means to be human. In this Action RPG, explore the world of Yob as Zoe, a scrappy hero searching for her past and protecting her future.

title: Really Dog
description: You see a dog. It pees the sea. You smash it! This is a refreshing small single player game.

title: OnCall
description: On Call is a visual novel that takes you through a 3-day rotation at Merritt General Hospital. Build trust with your patients and their families to get them on the road to recovery. Manage your own stress while confronting these challenges or you may just crack under the pressure.

title: Our Life on Water
description: Start your new life as Rivertalker in this magical life-sim RPG. Befriend spirits of the Mekong River to build and protect your floating village. Drift, farm, fish, forge friendships, fall in love. Shape the tale of a world worth saving.

title: Pizza Delivery: Zebaxx
description: You are a young Spanish woman who has just moved to the outskirts of Venice, and has just found a job in a newly opened pizzeria...

title: Plowing
description: Plowing is a point and click simulation game, where you have to subdue the whole town in 13 days to establish order. Shoot. Imprison. Pardon. Hear the visitors out. Keep track of time. But most importantly — keep calm…

title: Psionic Sentry: Infinite
description: "Psionice Sentry: Infinite" is a third-person beautiful girl action shooting and tower defense game. A gameplay focused on combat and skill selection

title: Qwess
description: Qwess is a online MMO survival game set in a Alien like world with a unique game style and design, take control of various creatures and roam around the world, fight and survive among other players and truly make your story unique as you traverse the alien landscape through out your adventure

title: Eye of Nollyn
description: A detective game in which you play as the private eye of Nollyn, the fictional city where money is what counts and what rules. Bribe people for additional clues, solve cases, and experience the captivating story with unexpected plot twists.

title: Fairune: Fragment Isles
description: Where did all the fairies go? Fairune: Fragment Isles is an action-adventure game where you follow Liana through her journey solving mysteries and puzzles from island to island.

title: Khuga Bash!
description: Take control of Kuro, the fearless brawler who's on a mission to prove their combat prowess in the mysterious PAW Labs. In Khuga Bash, it's not just about luck; it's about proving you're the ultimate champion of the Khugaverse!

title: Hunt: Showdown 1896 - Law of Salvage
description: This DLC contains one Legendary Hunter, two Legendary Weapons, and one Legendary Tool: Captain Laffite (Legendary Hunter), Scuttled Glory (Legendary Winfield 1887 Terminus), Knuckle Shunt (Legendary Scottfield Model 3 Brawler), Hagfish Bronze (Legendary Choke Bomb)

title: A Park Full of Cats
description: Welcome to 'A Park Full of Cats,' a hidden object game that invites you to revel in the enchanting world of amusement parks! Experience the thrill and excitement of the rides and give those cats the fun they truly deserve!

title: Damsels in Distress
description:
This is a classic tale of rescuing maidens from dangerous villains such as goblins, trolls, werewolves, harpies, and other dark creatures. You will encounter them across a variety of locations throughout the game world.

Your choices directly influence the story and the progression of the main character. Certain paladin abilities depend on your moral path and personal discipline. Multiple endings await, shaped by the decisions you make along the way.

title: Happy Wonderland Solitaire
description: Enjoy the popular card game with 150 different solitaire variants and a beautiful winter ambiance! The game includes solitaire variants such as Freecell, Fan, Four Seasons, Klondike, Spider, Bakers Dozen, Canfield, Golf, Sir Tommy and many more.

title: Kill The Shadow
description: In an alternate post-war divided city, players take on the role of Detective Lucas. Use your eloquence, intelligence, the ability to rewind time (or even violence) to investigate and deduce various bizarre cases, unraveling a shocking secret behind them. Justice or love? The decision is yours.

title: Minami Lane
description: Minami Lane is a small-scale management game where players build and manage a Japanese-inspired street. The game involves placing and customizing buildings, managing shops by adjusting inventory, recipes, and prices, and ensuring the happiness of the villagers. Each level has specific objectives that guide progression, while a sandbox mode allows for freeform play without goals. Additional mechanics include keeping the street clean by picking up trash and interacting with various animal inhabitants, such as tanukis and cats.

title: Gateway to the Kulikovo Field: The Battle of Yepifan
description: Find yourself in the center of a decisive battle for Russian lands. You are a 16th century Sagittarius. Repel the Crimean army, show valor and ingenuity in battle. Whether the enemy reaches Moscow or not depends on you!

title: Coffee Brakes
description: Battle your friends in an office chair joust to the death! Only one of you can be employee of the month, so battle your friends in a variety of game modes and levels. Get on your office chairs and take your Coffee Brake! Coffee Brakes is a 3rd year project developed at Media Design School

title: Age of Advent
description: Welcome to the Age of Advent! Play four minigames based on the members of Hololive -Advent-! Save the Moai with Bijou, make a soup with Nerissa, try not to crash with FuwaMoco, and avoid the gaze of Shiori!

title: Boba Bar: Bubble Tea Tycoon
description: Boba Bar: Bubble Tea Tycoon is a Kawaii themed pixel art game where you start your journey with a humble drink stand. Learn new recipes and unlock new equipment and locations, manage sales prices and inventory in order to succeed in becoming the largest bubble tea tycoon in town!

title: Forgery Craft
description: Master the art of forgery in this story-driven simulation game. Start with altering documents by changing single signatures and dates. End up forging entire art pieces that could fool any museum expert.

title: Dino Survivors
description: Face hordes of Dinosaurs and prehistoric creatures in this survival game with minimalist gameplay! Dino Survivors is a casual game with Roguelite elements, where you need to be faster and survive several species of extinct animals. Your choices will determine this.

title: Car Mechanic Simulator 2021: BMW DLC
description: Car Mechanic Simulator 2021 - DLC includes 5 licensed BMW cars: - 1974 BMW 2002 Turbo (E10T) - 1979 BMW M1 Procar (E26) - 1988 BMW 635 CSi (E24) - 2002 BMW M3 (E46) - 2016 BMW M4 GTS Special Edition (F82) - R4 M31 - R6 M88 - R6 M30 - R6 S54 - R6 S55

title: Cyber Rush
description: Shoot your way through endless plagues of robots and use the game's advanced parkour and movement system to survive. Purchase special weapons and character upgrades to get stronger and survive more rooms!

title: Garbageman
description: In this retro-style arcade game, help Frank to keep the columns of the Clock Building free of trash to prevent its imminent collapse.

title: Chaperone
description: Chaperone is a first-person psychological horror game. The events are completely real. Supernatural events taking place in an atmospheric and constricting closed house, events of unknown cause. You can enjoy being scared to the fullest.

title: Chinese Culinary Shop
description: Chinese Culinary Shop is a traditional Chinese food simulation cooking game. In the game, players can play the role of a talented Chinese food chef, experiencing the production process of traditional Chinese cuisine firsthand, gradually transforming your small inn into a renowned food paradise.

title: Diamond Dash: Plaid Peril
description: Dive into Diamond Dash: Plaid Peril, a unique rolling ball game for Perspectacles 3D glasses. Conquer the perilous plaid path, collect diamonds, and leap between tracks. Challenge levels and global competition await. Experience gaming in a visually stunning world.

title: Lymbus
description: Descend into a digital labyrinth of our own making. Move around with your keys. Do everything else with your cards. Exercise maximum strategy in building your deck, then throw it out the window in screen-shaking, bullet hell-style battles. Combat happens in real time, meaning every moment matters.

title: Bumper Ball Bash
description: Big ball impact, brothers, come and impact me, and then you can get me.

title: 6N23
description: 6n23 is a action-platfomer-racing game. Rush fast as you can. Use your finger, find path. It has controls similar to a fighting game, allowing you to practice your control skills.

title: Ale & Tale Tavern
description: Get ready for a thrilling mix of genres: a cooperative, first-person, open-world fantasy tavern simulator, action, fishing, hunting, exploration, and completing fun and diverse quests. And, of course, cooking! Play with friends, feed and quench the thirst of the entire world!

title: A Park Full of Cats: Haunted Ride
description: Prepare to be thrilled and chilled on "A Park Full of Cats: Haunted Ride",' the eerie downloadable content for 'A Park Full of Cats.' Embark on a ghostly adventure through six haunting scenarios! Are you brave enough to face the Haunted Ride?

title: Knight in the Maze
description: This is a story-driven Roguelike game. Four knights, while investigating anomalies within the labyrinth, accidentally became trapped inside a sealed maze. They need to work together to navigate the labyrinth, discover the cause of the anomalies, and simultaneously find a way to escape.

title: Lampy
description: Lampy is a captivating puzzle-platformer where you guide the adorable cube, Lampy, through a world shrouded in darkness. Use Lampy warm glow to light up the path, solve challenging puzzles, and uncover the heartfelt story of his quest to find his way home.

title: Bleed Runner
description: Bleed Runner is a 2.5D cyberpunk beat-em-up in which a lone knight fights an encroaching plague! Suddenly stricken with the disease, seek the cure on the mysterious spaceship and survive by grabbing, throwing, and pummeling enemies for blood.

title: Don't Shout Together
description: If you utter a sound, you and your team are doomed. Keep your cool for 30 minutes to flee this ominous forest by contacting the Rescue Crew.

title: I am a Fish Online
description: This is a multiplayer online RPG simulation survival game. You can chat casually, socialize and make friends, collect adventures, and obtain various achievements. Become a hero from a small fish. Fight bosses together. Keep your hunger, happiness, sleep, and unlock more fish. Like character, thanks.

title: Bubble Ball!
description: Combine balls of the same type to create bigger balls and earn as many points as possible without filling up the container in this cheery, casual puzzle game! And if you dare use the Ball Launcher, beware of bouncing balls to the stratosphere...

title: Maza
description: The protagonist does not want to lose his home because of the ambitions of his sister and her cynical husband! Oleg Mazapov wants to get the required amount of money to solve his housing problem, but it turns into unexpected consequences...

title: The Haunted Building
description: A 90s Hong Kong public housing block hides twisted tenants, buried truths, and ghosts. As security guard Lee Shing, your choices shape the story and unlock multiple endings. A mystery full of foreshadowing—some truths can only be uncovered through repeated playthroughs.

title: Battlechat
description: As a content creator you will be able to interact with your followers through this game. Let them compete against each other while you direct the game or be another player.

title: Electoral Dynasty
description: A political-simulation watch-the-clock strategy game. Pass laws, executive orders, and deal with events, all while maintaining the balance of your nation's most important attributes. Will you manage to keep your coalition together or establish a dictatorship? Only you can decide, Prime Minister.

title: Idiots' Fantasy
description: Idiot's Fantasy is an idiotic hack-slash Roguelike in a world where every rule can be changed by equipping various rule books. Fight, explore, buy, switch, and die as you conquer this randomly generated world using the idiotic gameplay you've created yourself.

title: Archive 1985
description: Charlie and his childhood friend Jack go on a boat trip that turns into a nightmare. Trapped in a storm...Charlie washes up on an abandoned fishing island...

title: Mad Jyacer
description: Bring healthy food to the finish line. Help your family lose weight!

title: Magical Monstergirls Academy
description:
You are the most powerful human witch the world has ever known, but your power breeds jealousy and lust. The succubi want your power for themselves, but why? What dark purpose fuels their deceit?

Fortunately you are not alone against this threat and your hot friends are here to take care of you. Between two adventures filled with libidinous monstergirls, they will know how to relax you and make you forget about your worries.

title: Brawlygon
description: A stylized, low poly fighting game, with various warriors from various eras and worlds! Simple controls make it easy to learn, with plenty of tools to play around with for those who want more depth! Also introducing “Piercing” attacks, to shake up the genre, by dealing higher damage on blocking opponents compared landing a clean hit!

title: Pico Sim Date 2
description: Pico Sim Date 2 is a point-and-click Flash game co-created by Moosh and Acromatik for Pico Day, and released on May 1, 2007. It is the second entry in the Pico Sim Date series and acts as the direct sequel to Pico Sim Date. This time, Pico has to save the kidnapped Nene from the psychotic Cyclops, through dating four girls who have information on his whereabouts.

title: Error_Boy.exe
description: The games have mixed up due to an error! Defeat the enemies by using items from various games! 1000101 1101110 1101010 1101111 1111001 100001

title: Ball Pit King 3D
description: Ball Pit King 3D is a fun and addictive puzzle game where you drop, stack and merge quirky 3D balls with hilarious faces to create the ultimate King Ball! Play and see if you can rule supreme over the Ball Pit!

title: CrimeSceneCleaners
description: The protagonist, who has taken a job as a special cleaner, goes to his first cleaning site with his seniors. Witnessing the scene of a gruesome death, he begins to feel something that he has never felt before. He begins to feel the presence of something he has never felt before.

title: Garmm Adventurer Vol.1
description: You play as a young man who lives in a faraway village full of elders and move out to become an adventurer in a bigger city to find some young women to have sex with. VN element with turn-base fighting and animated sex scenes.

title: Battle of BackYard
description: Engage in thrilling household air battles in this wacky game. Choose your role as a skilled pilot or a sharp-shooting gunner, and customize your aircraft to fit your preferred playstyle. Take on daring missions or challenge friends in multiplayer combat. Relive history and dominate the skies!

title: Complete
description: Complete is an online co-op survival game where we kill the robots that attack us.

title: Incarnation
description: A mouse-only reverse roguelike platformer. After each level, you must lose one of your celestial powers until you are completely transformed into a human. Will you be able to reach mortality?

title: Galactic Breakout
description: Return to the classic with Galactic Breakout! This space-themed Arkanoid game challenges players to destroy diverse blocks to conquer each level. Unleash the power of 10 unique upgrades while dodging 10 debuffs. Overcome 75 thoroughly created levels and achieve the max game score

title: Ash and Tor: Yuma's Quest
description: Explore the dungeons and try to find and save the Queen Yuma... but wait: it's almost an impossible dungeon. And why? Because it's easy to say: you must move two knights at once!!! Are you ready to find and save tons of girls without dying?

title: Micro Macro Farm
description: Micro macro farm is a small relaxing and cozy game about farming. Plant seeds, harvest them and create products. Make money and gain experience to unlock more seeds, buy machines and expand your garden.

title: Infected: Outpost
description: Gather resources, refuel the generator, and escape the facility before time runs out! But beware, the infected can steal the skins of their victims. Face your friends in a social deduction horror game like no other!

title: 2D Dogfight: World War II - Eastern Front and Pacific
description: "2D Dogfight - World War II (Eastern Front and Pacific)" DLC includes the following 35 Aircrafts: B-25J Mitchell F4F-4 Wildcat F6F-5 Hellcat F4U-1A Corsair F4U-1C Corsair F4U-4 Corsair SBD-3 Dauntless IL-2 1941 IL-2 1943 IL-10 LaGG-3 La-5FN La-7 MiG-3 P-39N-1 P-63C-1 Tu-2S Yak-1 Yak-3 Yak-9T

title: Big D Randy
description: Randy is not playing around.. Collect all candy's on huge map and don't get caught!

title: 4Tacos
description: Help Mr. PG and Cleto the goose to protect the Divine Taco from the dinosaurs, in this game inspired by the beat em up of the 90s, use special powers, travel the streets of the distant nation Tacotitlan, know its folklore, its food and its secrets.

title: Gilgamesh II
description: Promising hours of broken crafting systems and unfinished, empty dungeon floors, GILGAMESH II is the right product for you this Holiday Season. It is a continuous work- a historical work, which will never be finished. It needs a manual, but does not have one.

title: Deus Ex: Transcended
description: Built largely for first-time players, Deus Ex: Transcended is a mod focused solely around faithfulness to the original, while bringing an unmatched arsenal of bug fixes, paired with key notes of Quality of Life changes.

title: Tamara In The Forsaken Dungeon
description: Tamara In The Forsaken Dungeon is a third-person adventure game with puzzle elements and a dark, atmospheric setting. The story follows Tamara, who stumbles upon a mysterious dungeon deep in the forest while returning to town. Driven by curiosity, she ventures inside to uncover its secrets

title: Risk of Rain 2: Seekers of the Storm
description: A new storm gathers over Petrichor V and with it comes an ancient threat. Master new survivors and wield new items as you fight your way across uncharted regions of Petrichor V. Ascend the Colossus, defeat The False Son, and unlock the true power of his Soul.

title: Kugle
description:
Dash, jump, and evolve your Kugle!

Challenge your friends in worlds where gravity knows no bounds.

title: Dizzy Fight
description: Dizzy Fight is a fun dynamic fighting game with bright effects that you can play against the PC or with friends. Choose your character with his superpowers, and put the heat on all the enemies!

title: Ba Quartet X
description: Ba Quartet X (バカルテットX) is a fan-made Touhou Project Mega Man X series-like action-platformer game, featuring the bakartet: Cirno, Mystia Lorelei, Wriggle Nightbug, and Rumia. It was created by Penpenmushi no Koucha

title: Agatha Christie: Hercule Poirot - The London Case: Deluxe
description:
The Deluxe Edition includes:
- The Game Original Soundtrack
- The Art of: Agatha Christie - Hercule Poirot: The London Case - HD Digital Artbook

title: My Night Sun All Games
description:
A Bundle containing all My Night Sun Games games.
Includes: 3 Xbox games and 3 Windows games.

title: The Fast Journey
description:
In "The Fast Journey", embark on an exciting 2D adventure as a brave frog named Rafa.
Your beloved frog, Polly, is captured by malevolent creatures.

title: Trainz Railroad Simulator 2022: CSD Bap 117
description: Manufactured in 1976 at the "VEB Waggonbau Goerlitz" factory in Germany, these doubledecker cars were and still are used for regional passenger transport in Czech Republic, and many have been modernised. This pack features the CSD Bap 117 version with interior views, PBR textures, and more!

title: Jujutsu Kaisen: Cursed Clash - Deluxe Edition
description:
The Deluxe Edition includes:
• Jujutsu Kaisen Cursed Clash
• Hidden Inventory/Premature Death
• Jujusta 2024

title: Jujutsu Kaisen: Cursed Clash - Ultimate Edition
description:
The Ultimate Edition includes:
• Jujutsu Kaisen Cursed Clash
• Hidden Inventory/Premature Death
• Anime Ending Theme 1 Outfit Set
• Jujusta 2024
• Digital Artbook & Soundtrack

title: The Dragon Prince: Xadia
description: Explore Xadia, team up with friends, and battle evil forces in this hack & slash looter ARPG.

title: Chicken Run: Eggstraction
description: Stealth, silliness, and a whole lot of chaos! Scurry and scramble your way to freedom in this co-op adventure set in the Chicken Run universe.

title: Koko
description:
Seiichi, a boy who has always lived near a forest in the middle of a small town, grew up hearing stories of monsters and fairies. When the time came to start a new life, he moved to the city, unlucky enough to get lost in one of those areas inhabited by non-human beings. Will he get out of there? Or what decision will he make?

"Her fingers looked like little spider legs on my clothes."

title: Spiegel Ei
description: You play as a young girl named Ei Eulenspiegel who is taken into an orphanage. She comes across a large mirror that allows her to explore between two worlds: The real world which is inside an old mansion, and the mysterious mirror world that lies beyond. As she travels back and forth between dreams and reality, her psyche gradually becomes distorted. Will she find herself or will she lose herself?

title: Goober Dash
description: Goober Dash: A 2D platformer battle royale where Goobers Run, Jump & Dash to victory! Customize your Goober, dash to outmaneuver opponents, create your own levels, and compete in global time trials. Unlock exclusive skins and celebrate your wins in this action-packed multiplayer Race Royale!

title: Honkai Impact 3rd: Saha and Rebirth
description:
Version 6.8 of Honkai Impact 3rd, which includes:
• New Valkyrie: Herrscher of Rebirth
• New ELF: Project Bunny
• New Story Chapter XXXIX: Daughters of the Sea
• New Captainverse Event: Before the Endless Dream Ends
• ...and more!

title: Honkai Impact 3rd: Straying Stars
description:
Version 6.7 of Honkai Impact 3rd, which includes:
• New Valkyrie: Sugary Starburst
• New Story Chapter XXXVIII: Lone Tower, Fallen Star
• New Featured Event: ☆Perfect Performance☆
• ...and more!

title: Dead Letters
description: Your mission is to enter the mansion of the dead magnate who killed his family and committed suicide. When still alive, he hid many treasures but nobody knows where. Look for his diary to be able to find them.

title: Honkai Impact 3rd: Woven from Last Snow
description:
Version 6.6 of Honkai Impact 3rd, which includes:
• New Valkyries: Dreamweaver & Terminal Aide 0017
• New Story Chapter XXXVII: Of Salt, Snow, and Sand
• New Featured Event: TeRiRi's Magical Quest
• ...and more!

title: The Way of All Flesh-Again
description: This add-on does not change the history of the episode, it only allows you to play it in an alternate way. There are 8 new levels and new textures from games such as: F.E.A.R., Kingpin, Redneck Rampage, Witchaven (1,2), Duke Nukem 3D, Shadow Warrior, NAM, WW2GI, TEKWAR, Manhunt, etc

title: Final Alone in the Dark
description: This final compilation of BAITD series lets you play (almost) all parts of the mod. BAITD is a pure experimental mod that shows to players new ways to mod the game and dedicated to original Alone In The Dark game series.

title: Honkai Impact 3rd: Hot Sands Escapade
description:
Version 6.5 of Honkai Impact 3rd, marking the beginning of Part 1.5 of the main story, which includes:
• New Valkyrie: Valkyrie Quicksand
• New Story Chapter XXXVI: Hailing from Nagazora
• New Featured Event: Meow Town Escapade
• ...and more!

title: Eviction
description: Eviction (or EVICTION) is a new episode fan add-on released gradually since 2017 by Austin "SpillSomeBlood" Adams. As of 2021, it features four single-player levels and one Bloodbath map. As of the part four iteration, it features five new enemies and custom scripting requiring either the NBlood port or its fork Raze

title: Somewhere Under the Sea
description: A three level level episode released on March 12, 2015 based on Adam's earlier "Rapture" map inspired by the underwater city from Bioshock.

title: Honkai Impact 3rd: From Finality, The Origin
description:
Version Kiana (6.4) of Honkai Impact 3rd, marking the end of Part 1 of the main story, which includes:
• New Valkyries: Herrscher of Origin & Herrscher of Finality
• New ELF: Kiana Kaslana
• New Story Chapter XXXV: Toward a New Tomorrow
• New Animated Short: Graduation Trip
• New Featured Event: Bustling Holiday Symphony ∶||
• ...and more!

title: Honkai Impact 3rd: Symphony of Truth
description:
Version 6.3 of Honkai Impact 3rd, which includes:
• New Valkyrie: Herrscher of Truth
• New Story Chapter XXXIV: The Moon's Origin and Finality
• New Featured Event: Bustling Holiday Symphony ||∶
• ...and more!

title: Blood Chronicles Volume 1
description:
Yet another huge collection of blood maps.

Episode One: Underworld "tells the tale of Caleb's search for the Cabal's newest horror, The Grand Illusion Carnival, with plans to shut it down before it entraps any victims. The rumour is that there is a forgotten teleport back in one of the old Cabal mines that will put Caleb right at its front door."

title: Blood Chronicles Volume 2
description: Blood Chronicles aims to be the best blood map collection. Only the very best of Blood Community!

title: My Sister is Wanted
description: A mouse lost in time and the crimes of their family

title: Banzai's Addon
description: Banazai's Add-On (also known as Caleb's Revenge and previously Game Leader's Unofficial Add-On) is a single episode fan add-on for Blood featuring seven levels, last updated on November 9, 1998 by Team BANZAI. Partly to facilitate its final release and to lower the download size in the days of largely dial-up connections, it features only new levels and does not contain any new textures, weapons or monsters.

title: The Cult
description: BLOOD: the Cult is a new episode that contains 5 single player maps for original Blood.

title: The Dreamwell Enigma: Barlington Estate
description: Explore Master Barlington's estate, also home to his exclusive gentlemen's club including some prominent figures of the area, owners of influential businesses; Cobbleson & Son's Crimson Brewery, Leroux's M'daillon Bathhouse, Ashford's Bank and Trust, etc. Strange activities have been taking place at the estate and these men are likely involved. Rumours also spread about a new religious cult forming and gossip regarding Barlington's mental health as of late. Sudden disappearances have been reported surrounding the area, but no concrete evidence pointing to the club itself. What secrets are they hiding? Break inside, rummage around, seek documents and discover the truth, no matter how far you must dig to find it.

title: The Pandemonium
description: A single map that includes rotating doors, explosive walls ,respawning monsters, and more

title: Hall of the Epiphany
description: A two level mini-episode that chronicles the final battle in the Hall of the Epiphany

title: The Hall of Epiphany
description:
Fight your way through the dark realm and seal the rift once and for all!
You've reached the Hall Of Epiphany, now it's time for revenge! In order to summon Tchernabog's presence, you'll need to fight your way through the "Army Of Darkness". Once you finish the 3 main bosses, T-daddy opens a portal for you to return for the final battle. Once on the other side, you see Ophelia's soul trapped and tormented. You are now face to face with Tchernabog. The only way to set Ophelia free a end the Cabal, is to destroy T-daddy himself!

title: Maniac Mansion 4 Blood
description:
Loosely based on the 1987 point & click adventure Maniac Mansion by Lucasfilm.
If you enjoy running around in a huge house with a great variety of places then you might want to try this one.

title: La Ciudad Fantasma
description: A small city

title: Legends of Iconoclast: Scourge of Humanity
description: Take on the role of Logan, a Romanian gunsmith as he embarks on an epic quest of revenge and redemption as he journeys into an unknown dimension and wages war on the most powerful army to have ever existed: the Scourge, founded by the evil Garibaldi, a power-mad misanthropist hell-bent on the extermination of mankind. Logan must prevent the Scourge from resuming its war on Earth to save humanity and to avenge the deaths of everyone involved, including his own true love. During his quest, he'll uncover the shocking truth about Garibaldi and the plight of this unknown dimension. He must fight his way through Garibaldi's castle and ultimately confront Garibaldi in a battle to determine the fate of both humanity and the realm of Iconoclast.

title: Legends of Iconoclast 2: Unfinished Business
description: This sequel focuses on the protagonist continuing his war on the organization that he was once part of as he seeks to tie up a few loose ends, confront his internal demons, and once more save the world.

title: The Carnage Continues
description: The Carnage Continues is a modification for Blood that was developed over several years, with it being finally released on January 4, 2006, although the author commented that it could never be finished entirely as intended. The add-on was created by Harry, with one level jointly developed with Joel "Reactor" Blackwell (co-creator of Gods, the Epic Trilogy from 1998).

title: The Lost Episode
description: The Lost Episode is a unofficial add-on for Blood that adapts eight level files found in the Blood Alpha release and makes them into a coherent whole; speculated to be drafts by James Wilson III. Put together by Maz/kingmaz and released on November 27, 2014.

title: The Lost Episodes
description: Five dark tales of terror lost to the void of time, now available for your edification. From some of the best creators of Blood maps, this five adventure set promises to challenge the most avid Blood fan! A Collection Of Hard To Find Episodes Gathered Together In One Carnage-Filled Collection Including GODS by Joel & Kurt Blackwell, Journey to Hell by Martin Brintnall, Legend of Ravenloft by Michael Shire, Killing Time by Marc Levesque, Haunted Realmsby Joel Dube with additional maps by Treks, Johnnie Blaster, Craig L. Duckett & Dwayne Anderson. Adding Up To 23 Levels of Hardcore Gorefest

title: Haunted Hill
description: Caleb has bought an old mansion where he plans to settle down. The previous owners died under strange circumstances, and the mansion has been empty for years. But arriving Caleb finds out that his dreamhouse might not be what he expected. He finds it "infested" by the Cabal. And it seems the previous owners were up to no good either. Caleb must rid the house of the "pest" in order to finally get peace.

title: Meat Factory
description: Single player level done in the industrial style of E3M5 or BB3

title: Evil Dwells Within
description: This is the first map in an episode entitled "Crudox Cruo: Fresh Blood" which was never made.

title: Nitemare
description: This map takes place in some kind of huge and complex castle with it's own sewer system

title: Six Keys
description: Caleb must find the six keys by solving the puzzles, then use them to release Tchernobog and escape from the island.

title: The Abandoned Factory
description: Collect all six 6 keys and kills as many bad guys possible

title: The Fallen Priest
description: A short map requiring Plasma Pak

title: The Lost Temple
description:
There are some rumors about a ruin of a temple deep in the woods where strange things are happening. You are about to find out if this ruin really exists and what evil might has manifested itself in there. But first you have to fight your way into the ruin, as you find out that it is heavily guarded by some cultists and hordes of zombies. You wonder what will be inside this ruin, that seems to be reactivated in some strange way.
Will you be able to fight your way into the ruin...

title: The Old Manor
description: This map was going to be in an episode, but the episode is on hold right now and may not fit in very well.

title: Caleb's Dream
description:
Caleb fell into a deep sleep and...
Well, find out what happened next yourself!

title: Cemetary
description: One huge map

title: Count of Wallachia
description: You're at Draculas castle, find him... eliminate him.

title: Bamboo
description:
Bamboo is a fast-paced one-button game.

You are constantly running and cutting bamboo that grows in random places. You score points by collecting bamboo. You can run through yellow bamboo to collect it. When bamboo becomes green, you have to cut it multiple times to stop it and you don't get any points from it. Your goal is to stop bamboo from growing and reaching the top.

The game is over when bamboo reaches the top of the screen.

title: Trainz Plus: CD Bmteeo 124
description: Manufactured in 1976 at the "VEB Waggonbau Goerlitz" factory in Germany, these doubledecker cars were and still are used for regional passenger transport in Czech Republic, and many have been modernised. This pack features the CD Bmteeo 124 version with interior views, PBR textures, and more!

title: Crescent Quest: Furry Home Expansion
description: This expansion adds another room to your house with a furry aesthetic and a few wallpapers for your device!

title: Wars Across The World: Dacia 101
description: Dacia 101 is Emperor Trajan's first campaign against the Dacians, the empire's last sedentary neighbors. The Romans must crush seize their foes and take their cities. The Dacians player must hold his strongholds, while at the same time waging war within the Roman lands to force them to negotiate.

title: Sclash: Pixels
description: A retro touch to spice up your look in Sclash. Wear a mask and carry a weapon with a low resolution! Includes a new weapon & a new mask, directly unlocked.

title: FPV SkyDive: FPV Drone Simulator - Flight School
description: Continue your journey towards becoming a skilled FPV pilot with ORQA FPV.SkyDive Flight School DLC! This educational module covers the topics of FPV flight throughout 5 units packed with theory and practice.

title: Caleb Will Have His Revenge On Toronto
description: Caleb Will Have His Revenge on Toronto is a Blood fan add-on by members of the Russian Blood Community which released its first episode, "Scum of Dallas", on July 29, 2013. A sequel, "Run Like a Villain", was begun, but is now not certain to ever be finished. This includes new animated cutscenes, having the Flag of Canada as the menu background, and replacing the Sawed-Off Shotgun and Aerosol Can with their darker versions from the game's development.

description:
Version 5.7 of Honkai Impact 3rd, marking the beginning of the Elysium Everlasting arc, which includes:
