• ...and more!

title: The Way of Ira
description: The Way of Ira is a fan add-on for Blood by MariusArmand currently featuring two chapters, the first released on September 22, 2019 and the second on July 9, 2021. The title is derived from "ira", the Latin word for "rage" (or "ire"). The add-on features narration and new Caleb dialogue performed by David "Tekedon" Wikström, as well as tracks from the Blood Music Project.

title: Time Episode
description: Time Episode is an eight level fan add-on for Blood created by Pyro on September 17, 1999. The player is a mass murderer who in a fit of remorse, or because the authorities have finally caught up to him, leaps off a tall building to end it all, and is sent to hell. From thereon out it is his quest to escape hell through a time gate and then make it back to his own time.

title: It's A War Out There 1
description: Caleb has been hiding out in his cabin for a long time, getting increasingly bored, but weary of all the dangers that lay beyond. After all "it's a war out there". Eventually however, the protagonist decides to venture outward, figuring that all those things that seek to hurt him he can hurt in return, and thereby find his means to amuse himself. The level features cemetery, urban, library, sewer, water, and cave areas and even a laboratory with portals to both the frozen north and to a temple complex. It is here that the player meets his final challenge: two beasts that guard the exit.

title: It's A War Out There 2
description: Caleb finds an axe zombie carelessly wandering around a cliff-face, falling to its death. Caleb figures this must herald a nearby Cabal stronghold, and so he decides to check it out, again to relieve his endless boredom. First he comes across an old library, which he blasts through, before retreating down into the sewers, and again through a laboratory, finding a similar portal that leads out into a lava temple. There he has a surprise encounter with Tchernobog, whom he defeats before once again heading along his way.

title: Eye of the Blood
description: A three level long episode for Blood by Swedish mapper Christian Green, a member of Team BANZAI, who spent awhile creating the maps; maps date from fall 1997 and were first released on Game Leader, and were re-shared from The Krunatus Blood Page from August 7, 2003.

title: 500 Milliliters of vr
description: 500 Milliliters of /vr/ is a community add-on by members of the /vr/ board on 4chan released on February 1, 2021. It features six levels created by three authors, and features numerous replaced assets. Four levels are available for Bloodbath. It is named as a play on the 200 Minutes of /vr/ and related community projects for Doom.

title: Assassin’s Creed Mirage: Master Assassin Edition
description:
Assassin’s Creed Mirage is a stealth-focused action-adventure game set in ninth-century Baghdad. It emphasizes parkour, infiltration, and targeted assassinations. The game follows a more compact structure than recent entries in the series. Players control Basim, a young thief drawn into a secretive order. The title blends historical settings with narrative elements tied to the franchise’s established lore.

The Master Assassin Edition includes the base game and six additional packs: the Deluxe Pack, the Lightning Pack, the Jinn Pack, the Fire Demon Pack, the Master Assassin Pack, and the Guardian Pack.

title: Your Future 2 Future Prediction
description: All the mysteries that have not been revealed will be solved.

title: Valis: The Fantasm Soldier Collection III
description: A Japanese-only collection of Valis games for Switch.

title: Castlevania 2
description: This is inspired by the NES game Castlevania 2, and kind of a parody of it at the same time.

title: Sacreligious
description: Just a fun little map i decided to release as a new years present to the community.

title: Swim! Sacabambaspis
description: The ancient fish “Sacabambaspis” game! Easy to operate but difficult! Let's compete to see how far you can swim!

title: Lagoon
description: Your mission, should you choose to accept it of course, is to eliminate the scourge from the facility, restore power in the Rosskotek Hydro-Electric station then meet up with "dude" in the escape craft waiting for you anchored in the estuary.

title: Castle of Horrors: The Awful Tortures
description: A huge and disgusting path down to the chamber of horrors. See also the cemetery of the zombies and their ceremonial death party.

title: CRE1M1: Greyvein River
description: First map from my upcoming episode 'Cabal's Return'

title: Innsmouth Corporate Plaza
description: Caleb is in his flat reading a newspaper. Suddenly, he hears an uproar down Innsmouth Plaza. He hears some shots, so he gets his Tommy Gun and decides to investigate.

title: Please (Don't) Touch the Art
description:
Take on the role of an uncultured and unprepared art museum curator in Please (Don’t) Touch the Art, a management sim-slash-visual novel where the only thing less ready for a make-it or break-it museum exhibition than you is the artwork itself.

Get your quarrelsome gallery of talking paintings and moving statues to stop fighting before the grand gala, or watch the museum crash and burn around you – the choice is yours!

title: Wasted Glory
description: Wasted Glory is an old-fashioned fnaf fan game that follows the traditional five nights gameplay with freeroam mechanics.

title: Nezumi Man
description:
Nezumi Man is a homage to/parody of the classic NES Mega Man games, starring a rat who can run, slide, jump and shoot like the Blue Bomber himself. His goal is to stop the plans of Dr. Gyoniku and his henchmen, along with seven other rat and ratlike characters.

The game was an entrant in the 2009 HSP Program Contest. It is notable for its humorous characters and situations.

title: Sigmatica
description: Abstract shooting game on Chiba University Computer ResearchingSociety compilation.

title: Five Nights at Freddy's: Security Breach - The Remains
description: The Remains is a soon to be releasing mod for Steel Wool Studios' Five Nights at Freddy's Security Breach. This mod restores every single scrapped mission, model, map, minigame, ETC. Back into full functioning order!

title: Disillusion ST
description: Strange journey throughout an elaborate labyrinth awaits featuring hundreds of characters and happenings as you try to gather items that once brought happiness to others. An early access glimpse at the prequel to Disillusion, the oneiric dungeon crawler detailing the events leading up to the tower's creation.

title: Shantae Advance: Risky Revolution
description: Shantae is back in an adventure 20 years in the making! The nefarious pirate Risky Boots has a “groundbreaking” new plan that will leave Sequin Land spinning — by rotating the continent, she can move any town right to the coast for easy plundering! As Shantae, turn the tectonic tables on Risky by taking control of the land itself: shift, twist, navigate, and explore by swapping between mix-and-match multilayered levels! Hair-whip and belly-dance your way through scrambled lands, misplaced towns, monster-filled crypts, and daunting labyrinths. Six creature transformations, fierce boss battles, and a 4-player versus mode await!

title: On Your Tail
description: Embark on an intriguing seaside getaway you’ll never forget in On Your Tail, a sleuthy story-driven 3D life sim of relaxation, investigation, and knowing how to play your cards right.

title: Blade Chimera
description: In this exploration-heavy 2D action game, use your demon sword to interfere with the past, create platforms, and shield yourself from danger to explore a dystopian cyberpunk world depicted in gorgeously animated pixel art.

title: Prodeus: The Elder Veil
description: The Elder Veil is a DLC expansion to the retro first-person shooter action game Prodeus. Explore a new Greek-inspired environment with plenty of enemies to dispatch and weapons to use while airborne thanks to a trusty deployable chain for traversal.

title: Dross
description: Dross is an FPS Roguelike set in a derelict facility infested with alien bugs. Travel a procedurally generated world, get powerful weapons and equipment, and upgrade your gear to survive. Fight the Dross, discover and destroy the infestation, and uncover the secrets of this mysterious installation.

title: Cthulhu Keeper
description: In this Lovecraftian real-time tactics game you play as a 1920s cult leader on a mission from the Old Ones. Build your cult, summon eldritch monsters, and undertake stealth tactics missions to spread insanity and amass power! In CTHULHU KEEPER you are the cosmic horror.

title: Keep Those Bugs Away From The Bomb
description: Survive the swarm and clear the arena of alien infestation in this fast-paced bullet hell roguelite shooter. Unlock new heroes, guns, and skills in a never ending quest with one thing in mind. Keep Those Bugs Away From The Bomb!

title: Dragon Quest X: All In One Package - Versions 1-7
description: A new all-in-one package including versions 1 to 7 of Dragon Quest X Online.

title: Resident Lover
description: Attend the prestigious Miranda's All Girls' University, hidden away in Romania. Choose to pursue the Arts, to follow your academic career, or to slack off with your friends. Along the way, face challenges, solve mysteries, and try to stay alive, as it becomes apparent that there is more to this school than meets the eye. Perhaps even find love in the chaos?

title: Honkai Impact 3rd: Inherit the Flame
description:
Version 5.0 of Honkai Impact 3rd, which includes:
• New Valkyrie: Herrscher of Flamescion
• New ELF: Sirin
• New Gamemode: Elysian Realm
• ...and more!

title: Morels: The Hunt 2
description: Morels: The Hunt 2 is the sequel to Morels: The Hunt. It is a simulation game about mushroom hunting and wildlife photography. Explore a diverse range of locations spanning across the globe. Increase your hunter and photographer levels by collecting a variety of mushrooms, photographing animals, and completing weekly tasks.

title: I Dreamed of Dead Stars
description: A short game about a girl trying to process grief and getting into bad habits.

title: Heavensborne
description: The world as we knew it ceased to exist. Now it's your time to rebuild it. Will you do the right thing?

title: Written in Blood on a Mirror
description:
You're a young Victorian lady whose college classmates have branded as a potential witch. They dared you to spend a night in an abandoned mansion where a terrible incident occurred.

At least, that's what you remember. Their laughing faces, judging you.

But now you're trapped and have to work with other women to get out!

Try to gain their trust, romance them, or... who knows?

title: Ned Flanders Kills the Simpsons!
description: Must...Kill...Best...Friend! It was bound to happen. Somewhere deep inside everyone's favorite neighbor-ino, a darkness has bubbled to the surface, and now Ned Flanders is on a killing spree! Hey, they warned me that Satan would be seductive!

title: Bender Kills Planet Express
description: Go insane in the mainframe as BENDER, everyone's favorite alcoholic robot from the year 3000! Give absolutely 0 craps as you bash, knife, shoot or set the Planet Express crew ablaze in this first person robotic murder sim based on the hit show "FUTURAMA"!

title: Snapware ft. Tchabada
description: Snapware ft. Tchabada is a Mini Game Compliation Game

title: 360 Five Nights at Freddy's
description: 360FNAF is an accurate FNaF 1 Custom Night remade with modern technology. Play on your desktop in flat mode or in VR!

title: Zumaji Delux
description: Embark on a perilous journey through the ancient temples of Zumaji, concealed deep within the jungle and teeming with cunning traps

title: Nobunaga's Ambition: Awakening - Collaborating Nijisanji's VTuber "Ibrahim"
Furniture Flipper Simulator 2023: Revive, Restoration & Creative Crafting
description: Craft Your Dream Furniture Empire – From Sketch to Reality!

title: European Expansion + Oceania Expansion
description:
Wingspan is a relaxing, award-winning strategy card game about birds for 1 to 5 players. Each bird you play extends a chain of powerful combinations in one of your three habitats. Your goal is to discover and attract the best birds to your network of wildlife preserves.

Wingspan: European Expansion takes you on a journey to another continent. Explore diverse European habitats and meet charming, beautiful birds with new interesting abilities.

In the adaptation of the award-winning Wingspan: Oceania Expansion embark on a journey through the breathtaking lands of Oceania. Learn about birds from around Australia and New Zealand and all-new resources and mechanics that will enrich your adventure of creating a wildlife preserve.

title: Last Escape: Dead Complex
description: Dead Complex is a 2D Top Down, Survival Horror Game. Sneak, Loot and Fight your way out of an infested apartment complex and begin your final escape from the city.

title: Hoop Shoot
description: Shoot hoops over poles!

title: Highway Moto Racing Rush 2023 Simulator
description: Get ready to burn rubber, experience the rush, and conquer the highway!

title: Drive Hard
description: A fun and addictive driving experience

title: Call of Sniper Combat: WW2
description: Crush the rebels, restore peace, and make the world a safer place. Will you answer the call?

title: Brawl.io 2
description: Destroy, build tactics, and destroy as many enemies as possible on your way!

title: Hoku Shrine
description: A beautiful open world is waiting for you! Learn different fighting styles and magic skills, practice archery. Explore the world, mine resources, create weapons and brew potions, combine combat sets. Fight for justice and restore the Shrine of Hoku!

title: ClearIt 16
description: Try ClearIt 16, an innovative matching game for those looking for a new challenge! Use bombs and lightning to clear any obstacles you encounter. There are no time limits, so relax and have fun.

title: Déjà Drift
description: Stuck alone on a retro-futuristic racetrack, your only choice is to drift. Earn as many points as possible before time runs out, and then do it again and again... But wait, there is someone else here? And why does their driving seem so familiar?

title: Good Pizza, Great Pizza: Countryside Charm Set - Autumn 2022
description: Decorate as a local mom n' pop pizzeria!

title: Good Pizza, Great Pizza: Rustic Retreat Set - Autumn 2022
description: Watch your garden transform into autumn!

title: Good Pizza, Great Pizza: Pumpkin Delight Set - Autumn 2023
description: Get pumpkin spice and everything nice!

title: The Dream Of A Cockspur
description: Stranded on a desolate island with Earth's final researchers, you investigate a mysterious celestial body. The day before departure, the return boat is damaged, forcing an extended stay. Is someone playing tricks, or does the island want to kill all of you?

title: The City Of Hope
description: A light city-building game that combines elements of card games and tower defense, where players must survive daily enemy attacks and gradually grow their strength to ultimately defeat powerful invaders.

title: Math Olympiad
description: In the mysterious continent full of monsters, encounter mysterious creatures, according to the clues left along the way, try to challenge, find the way to the new world.

title: Helle's Undersea City Project: Bringing Air to The Garden - Nakino Mashiro
description: Vtuber "Nagino Mashiro" is moving to the Garden! DLC with resident character implementation is now available.

title: Lost Cat
description: "Lost Cat" is a single-player, adorable, healing, adventure game. Try to collect enough fish while avoiding traps and monsters, and use your wits to clear the levels.

title: Love Poem Written For a Fairy
description: A poet met a beautiful and charming fairy on the edge of the human and demon worlds..... Poets have no other choice but to pursue love poems.

title: Three Thousand Worlds
description: "Three Thousand Worlds" is a massively multiplayer online game (MMORPG). The game provides players with a lot of different quality equipment, and the pursuit of high-level (or best) equipment is one of the most important goals for players in the game.

title: What Games Does Your Dad Play
description: What games does your dad play - It is a management game with the theme of running a game center, and players can replay a variety of stalls, electronic games, etc. from the 80s, 90s, and even 2000s.

title: Zumbido Seele
description: Indie arcade FPS singleplayer shooter where you fight against hordes of monsters and explore the map in search of equipment.

title: Wolf Sheep Cabbage
description: Wolves eat sheep, sheep eat vegetables. Utilize your wisdom to simultaneously transport the wolf, the sheep, and the cabbage to the destination!

title: William and Sly: Classic Collection
description: The world of William and Sly is yours to explore, seeking out collectables and secrets, while soaking in the tranquil visuals and melancholic soundtrack. In this pair of classic Flash games, you play as a fox, running and leaping through an atmospheric ecosystem entirely at your own pace.

title: Yeetus
description: You are YEETUS! Your weapon? The very floor beneath your feet! YEET your surrounding terrain into destructive projectiles. Be strategic, though. A hasty shot may mean a long fall down to your doom in YEETUS, a casual time survivor game with rogue-lite elements.

title: Warpzone Drifter 2
description: With full throttle and no breaks, Warpzone Drifter 2 is a minimalistic, retro-hardcore, physics-based, drifter minigame.

title: Used Cars Simulator
description: Used Cars Simulator - trade used or stolen cars, fix and customize them, drive around, and explore the open world! Grow your business, complete quests, and have fun with a physics-based sandbox!

title: Tower Walker: MMO Grind Simulator - Tower Walker: The Lich
description: TOWER WALKER: THE LICH adds 1 new playable class with a unique set of skills and a special summon to the game

title: Typing Battle
description: "Typing Battle" is a game based on typing speed and accuracy. In this game, players need to use the keyboard to input designated characters in order to defeat their opponents or achieve their goals.

title: Time Loop
description: Time Loop is a 2D platformer with hardcore elements, dynamic gameplay and nice graphics. In this game you need to pass a variety of levels and avoid enemies.

title: Tiny Car Mess

The Pirate Gamer has trapped you inside the Arcade Asylum with other gamers. Play through a variety of reimagined classic minigames from diverse genres with new-age graphics and unique twists. The catch? You have to be the best across all genres of games to beat out all the other inmates and escape the Asylum.

"Arcade Asylum" is the perfect game for online parties, and competitive gamers who crave a blend of chaotic fun and strategic gameplay. Can you prove your skills and smarts to be the first to escape the Arcade Asylum, or will you become another mad denizen of this bizarre world? The Pirate Gamer awaits your attempt to escape!

title: Dreamin' Cat

Use arrow keys to move, Z to jump. Use headphones for a better experience.

The game was made in 3 days for Ludum Dare 47.

title: Neon Clash: Echoes of the Lost
description: Young members of the Mafia fight, rebel, and entrust their hopes to their friends to fight corruption, confront evil, and challenge fate.

title: Sins Of Kaleido
description:
"This is my will. No one else's."

She was once the beloved child of a wealthy family. But those bright days were swallowed by the darkness of a tragic scheme.

Having lost everything, the girl returns to her homeland with ambition burning in her heart. There, she meets a group of heretical men who harbor the power of witches.

Bonds forged by wounded souls warmth flickering in frozen hearts. The miracle of love, now known by the lonesome.

title: The Red Bell’s Lament
description:
The Redbell Tree scrapes the sky, standing proudly in the heart of Hemeria, a land of sunlight. In a land ruled by a monarchy for generations, humans lived in peace and tranquility. That is, until the dawn of the day the world was dyed red.

On that day, vampires laid waste to Hemeria. They preyed on, devoured, and devastated its inhabitants. A great many people would go on to mourn their loved ones, their families and friends, for the rest of their lives. One particular town of Hemeria bore such a tragedy. A single girl was left alone in despair and disgrace. She vowed revenge, and grew into one of Hemeria's finest vampire hunters.

And one day, she became a member of the Elpis 7; those who inspired a light of hope in its people.

One day, she receives a letter from an unknown sender. Upon her arrival to the mansion indicated inside, she finds vampire hunters and a royal knight awaiting her. The hunters assembled receive an order from the monarch.

They are to form a squad and invade Nyx, the world of vampires. A shiver of anticipation crackles through her at the opportunity she's been waiting for her whole life. However, this is but the beginning of a game wherein the fate of her world is at stake. Pawns are sent forth, discarded, hidden out of sight...

And just how many will remain when this all comes to an end?

title: Touhou Houtenkyou: Treasure Castle Labyrinth
description:
A glittering galaxy awaits inside! If you want treasure, get ready to dig! A retro-colorful dark-pop exploration STG fantasy!

Touhou Houtenkyou ~ Treasure Castle Labyrinth is a fan-made Touhou Project game made using the Touhou Danmakufu ph3sx shooting game engine.

Treasure Castle Labyrinth was first conceptualized as a hypothetical Touhou fangame by Iroboshi of iroirodou around the release of Undefined Fantastic Object, and was later made into a music album in 2014 with the help of Pesot.jp/. Development of the Treasure Castle Labyrinth game began in 2018, spearheaded by DOGSDAY. In 2020, the members of both iroirodou and DOGSDAY came together and established a common circle dedicated to the game's development: UWASA Enterprise.

With Skeleport Energy, Skully can become anyone's skeleton! Only problem being, that Skully has no control over, who they'll become and this leads into many problematic situations that you'll have to figure your way out of!

Young children have gone missing in the village, one after the another, during the last few months and as a result the village is in disarray. Will Dust with the help of her newfound friend, solve the enigma surrounding the missing children or will the dark secret of the village of Woodpine be left forever shrouded in mystery?
