description: FutSim was a Brazilian massively multiplayer online game where the user takes on the role of a soccer club manager.

title: Welcome to Paradize
description: Paradise isn't exactly what you hoped for: it's infested with zombies! Thankfully, you can control them. Capture them and teach them to farm or fight. They will help you defend your camp while you explore the world looking for… a new paradise.

title: Buggy Racers
description: Be a different kind of beetle. Grab your turbocharged matchbox and do the most thrilling overtaking. Crazy tracks and crazy opponents. A game with lots of action and fun to keep you glued to your computer.

title: Greenman
description:
When the planets align, and the stars shine the brightest they ever have, a hero shall rise. But this hero doesn't have muscles, isn't a vampire, AND is literally just a box. Meet GREENMAN, the most handsome (note: contest was self-managed) video game hero of ALL TIME!

You must face over a variety of different obstacles, using the magical instrument known as "MOUSE AND KEYBOARD" to control Greenman. Promise you won't die though, right?

title: Brox
description: Brox is a sandbox, scriptable shooter. Play unique game modes againts bots or players and create your own using simple to use JavaScript scripting!

title: Teardown: Time Campers
description: Saddle up and prepare for a wild ride back to a time when explosives were made from dynamite and sledgehammers were... still sledgehammers. Let your destructive imagination run rampant as you execute daring escapades across a fully destructible wild west.

title: Temple Crawler
description: A tactical roguelike dungeon crawler, featuring an intuitive yet deep core mechanic. Acquire powerful artifacts to forge your path through dungeons filled with ruthless enemies and dangerous traps. Embark on this epic adventure and fulfill your quest for glory!

title: The Christopher Redemption: I
description: The Christopher redemption part I is a story-driven action thriller game that explores the intense and original story of Christopher and his sister.

title: The Piece
description: “The Piece” is a simple & fun block puzzle game, train your spatial ability!

title: Tiny Vikings
description: TINY VIKINGS: JOURNEY TO ASGARD is an action adventure game revolving around a gang of Viking children who embark on an adventurous journey to seek the favor of the gods and save their home village from an evil curse.

title: Where are my potatoes 2: Land Of Mystery
description: Kake potato character is coming back. Now Kake trashed in Land of Mystery where his mission is to collect different fruits and find again missing potatoes

title: Unforgotten: Ordinance
description: Face your fears, uncover the secrets of the past and fulfill your own destiny. In the wild impenetrable forests of Siberia you will face those who look beyond our reality and only the right choice will allow you to reach the end. Test yourself in a new psychological ethno-horror.

title: You Got Crabs
description: Watch your crabs live their lives and force evolutionary changes by altering the environment in this calm, relaxing life simulator

title: Spill the Beans
description: A secret recipe has been stolen and you’re charged with finding the culprit…trouble is, you’re the one whodunnit. Investigate, interrogate and manipulate your way to framing the perfect scapegoat in this reverse detective visual novel.

title: Spava
description: Welcome to the enchanting world of dreams, where each location is a unique story. Explore dreams, free them from nightmares, and restore comfort and harmony to this magical area of imagination.

title: SoundTown
description: An accessible one-button music game for children and young people with complex physical and cognitive needs.

title: Sex Massage
description: In the exciting visual novel Sex Massage , you will take on the role of a young massage parlor owner in a picturesque resort town. The main character has inherited this spa and is facing incredible challenges and opportunities

title: Stray Blade: Valley of Strays
description: Sixth months have passed after Farren and Boji's last adventure in Stray Blade. Join both in the next chapter and protect Acrea from a new enemy which threatens to take over the long-forgotten land.

title: Luster Beasts
description: Luster Beasts is a Pokémon Stadium style RPG where the player needs to build a team of Luster Beasts in order to take out as many enemy teams as possible before being defeated.

title: Midnight Margo
description: A narrative-driven roleplaying adventure with a touch of absurdity

title: Plus Ultra: Legado
description: Immerse yourself in a Mesoamerican metroidvania adventure, featuring vivid ligne-claire comic visuals set in the 16th century. Explore the intersection of two worlds in this spellbinding tale base on historical background with rich lore, dynamic combat, and a captivating soundtrack.

title: Probot Soccer
description: Probot Soccer is a third person soccer-style sports game where the player controls a robot. The aim of the game is to kick the soccer ball into the AI robot opponent's goal. The game includes various levels of difficulty that increase the number of rounds to play against the AI opponent to win.

title: Reckless Rally
description: Reckless Rally Is A Small Casual Rally Racing Game. Try And Set A PB On The Two Tracks Or Build Your Own Based Off Real World Roads!

title: Schrödinger's Call
description: When the world is coming to an end, who would you want to speak to one last time? Schrödinger’s Call is a visual novel that lets you experience the pain and salvation of human connection, as if you were turning the pages of a picture book.

title: Rekindling The Flame
description: Rekindling the Flame is an action RPG game. Hack and slash your way through hordes of enemies. Rebuild your town, Upgrade your equipment, and bolster your skills to face even greater challenges.

title: Dimlight Dungeon
description: A dark fantasy dungeon crawler where the player controls a reptilian brawler and travels within the ruins of a once mighty heroic fortress.

title: England in London
description: England in London is a surrealist satirical dark comedy adventure game with an emphasis on atmosphere, characters and mini-games. Featuring weird looking art, hand drawn animation and an ambient score for when you truly want to be left alone.

title: Gruel
description: Go on a rampage in this endless arcade Boomer-Shooter! Gain the weirdest weapons and destroy all the monsters in the never-ending temple of GRUEL!

title: Fairy Carrots
description: Stealth action exploration game in which a "little hater" hides in a shared house where nine girls live and runs around looking for carrots.

title: HardAF
description: A punishing precision-based, speedrun 2D platformer...in the dark. Uncover the level with every death, earn swag and unlock new chapters. Run, Jump, Dash, Die, Repeat.

title: HelloWorldFactory
description: A quick programming language quiz is now available! Just read the code and choose a compiler that can output "Hello World"! A simple game you can play in your free time!

title: HoloParade
description: Collect your favorite characters, nurture them, and have fun just watching in this hololive fan game! It's a 2D tower defense game that offers depth for dedicated players, strategic elements, and easy enjoyment for casual players.

title: Ice Land
description: A game that simulates survival in harsh cold environments, including game elements such as environmental exploration, technology development, and character development.

title: Kill the Reaper
description: Reaper losing control over the taken souls and now all hell breaks loose.Hold back armies of the dead and find out, how long does it take to Kill the Reaper?

title: Jigsaw Advent Calendar
description: Surprise yourself every day leading up to Christmas with new challenging jigsaw puzzles in Jigsaw Advent Calendar

title: In Her Head
description: This is a short visual novel that immerses the player in the inner world of the main character, who suffers from social anxiety and is afraid even of a simple phone call. Experience with her the anxiety, procrastination, and constant struggle with herself.

title: Desolate Realms
description: Desolate Realms is a top down horde mode, survival game with tons of content. Multiple maps and weapons to explore and discover while facing multiple types of enemies. New challenges are created for each run to keep goals in mind when attempting to level up.

title: Dark is the Void
description: Dark is the Void is a combat focused JRPG-inspired roguelike, featuring fast paced, menu-driven battles. Build, customize, and optimize your party of four from a mix of 24 unique classes, spanning a range from Tanks, Healers, DPS, and every hybrid in between.

title: Crescent Quest: Y2K Home Expansion
description: A room with a Y2K aesthetic for your Crescent Quest home and a few wallpapers for your device!

title: Christmas Rocket Pudding
description: A fast-paced 3D platform game. Skillfully control the speed of your pudding to beat the levels fast while avoiding pitfalls!

title: Another Earth
description: We make a highly enjoyable virtual world, where players have the opportunity to be creators, allowing them the tools and ability to expand the world, and create their own stories and meaningful experiences for other players in the evolving world.

title: Anthem#9
description: Combine Gems to unleash Skills in ANTHEM#9, a deck-building rogue-lite puzzle-battler! Customize your Recipes for a wide variety of deck ideas, and explore the thrilling story of secret agents fighting for world order.

title: Apu's Journey
description: Apu's Journey is a retro action RPG, you can complete dungeons, defeat creatures, collect items, and improve your skills!

title: Ball of Poo
description: Help Dung Beetle Chan get the dung ball to the goal!

title: James' Fun House: Episode 1
description: You are a member of an elite strike team employed by the Japanese Americans Against Anime (J.A.A.A). Your mission is to prevent James the Dark Messiah of Anime aka. Jami Kun from releasing real life anime upon the universe. You will infiltrate James' stronghold (The Fun House), combat his cult of anime worshippers and alien allies, rescue hostages, and put an end to the threat of James forever.

title: 3on3 FreeStyle: Battle Pass 2023 Autumn Part 2
description: Experience the ultimate autumn adventure with our new Battle Pass, featuring a progression up to 55 levels with exciting rewards!

title: A Date with Death: Expansion DLC
description:
The expansion DLC for A Date with Death includes:

- Extra character customization options (five hair fronts, five hair backs, three fem outfits + recolors, four masc outfits + recolors, and 13 accessories)
- Adds extra choices and conversations throughout all days (find the ★ symbol!)
- Adds one additional ending (including a new CG!)

title: ADHD Arena
description: Let your ADHD loose and stack gems to accumulate points and get to higher more rewarding tiers, get the highest score you can by pushing gems around to organize and combine them and get lost in the joys of creating chaos the putting it into order.

title: Arcade Archives: Dinorex
description:
Dinorex is a fighting game released by TAITO in 1992.
Choose from 6 available dinosaurs and do battle to win the amazoness queen, and the title of Dino Rex: the king of the land!
Acquiring various types of egg-shaped items and weapons can give you an advantage in a battle.

title: Euro Truck Driver Simulator
description: Open-world Truck Simulator! Discover Europe driving one of the most common European trucks!

title: Lake: Special Delivery
description: Take a trip back to the 1980's and visit the beautiful lakeside town of Providence Oaks, deliver their mail, and meet its charming residence. This bundle includes the base game, Lake, and its festive holiday-themed prequel, Lake: Season's Greetings.

title: Madden NFL 24: Michael Vick 20th Anniversary Edition
description: Get the Michael Vick Edition* to stack your Ultimate Team with Vick's favorite players.

title: Teardown: Ultimate Edition
description:
Prepare the perfect heist in this simulated and fully destructible voxel world. Tear down walls with vehicles or explosives to create shortcuts. Stack objects to reach new heights. Use the environment to your advantage in the most creative way you can think of.

Teardown: Ultimate Edition includes:
• Teardown - The original heist campaign and the Art Vandals mini campaign, along with sandbox and multiplayer.
• Time Campers - A campaign expansion set in the wild west.
• Folkrace - A campaign expansion that introduces new vehicles and a series of destructive racing game modes.
• The Greenwash Gambit - A campaign expansion with space travel, sabotage, and eco chaos on a distant planet.
• Relics of Barkuna - A campaign expansion with exploration, puzzle solving, and a collect-a-thon style of gameplay.
• Quilez R0113R Robot - A spawnable, transformable robot vehicle equipped with destructive weapon systems and a grappling hook.

title: Dusty Derby
description: Dusty Derby is a large online multiplayer party royal game with 32 players. Cute Dusts Compete to be King of Dusts in various places in the house!

title: Devil Slot Machine
description: On a cursed slot machine, you engage in a deadly game of souls with the demons. Devil Slot Machine is a roguelike pigeon tower defense game. Purchase chips as defensive towers and release elemental bullets to destroy your enemies. Enjoy the exhilarating feeling of annihilating demons!

title: Art is Boom
description: Let's create the art of explosions—different characters, different bombs. It's about the art of detonation and the creativity of crafting new bombs. Dive into the joyous game of various explosions!

title: Doom: Damnation
description:
Doom: Damnation (DDAMN10.WAD) is a full four-episode replacement vanilla megawad, for The Ultimate Doom. It was released in February 2021, following an initial three-episode release in November 2016. It was designed by Ofisil, who also composed the soundtrack for it.
This mapset acts as a retelling of the original events that unfolded in The Ultimate Doom; the maps are designed with traditional gameplay in mind, combining action, exploration and atmosphere on abstract and semi-realistic environments, with the custom made OST occasionally adding a slight horror vibe.

title: Chicocos S.A.
description:
Chicocos S.A. is a limit-removing map (complevel 2) set in a shipping/receiving office, featuring a non-linear layout with multiple paths to get to your goal.

Clear out all the buildings and pick up all 3 keys to get into the boss arena: the theater hall...!! (which, fun fact, is a recreation of the actual theater hall where the graduation ceremony will take place!). This is a commemorative map for my highschool graduation.

title: Vanilium
description: This is a simple map, made in roughly 8 hours with speedrunning in mind. This level has also been built and tested with Nightmare! difficulty and is easily beatable. Can you find the fastest exit route?

title: 10x1024
description: Inspired by LunchLunch's 10x10 Project and the Doomworld 1024 community projects, I decided to mash the two concepts together like chocolate and peanut butter.

title: Colour of Ineptation
description: 2 medium to short maps that I made after coming back from my summer vacation back to Taiwan and Japan

title: Didaskalia
description: It's year 1989, you are tired of your life, everything and everyone pisses you off. One day you decide to join the army, as a combat medic. You and your companions are sent to "Phobos". The mission is to get rid of the monsters that took control of the planet. You arrive a bit late, because you had some work to do. Every soldier brutally dies, you are left all alone. You hear in the radio that people from earth have sent help to rescue you. But soon it turns out that they want you DEAD.

title: Doomed: By the Hour
description: A full megawad of speedmaps that were (mostly!) made in an hour or less, for NaNoWADMo 2022! The standard 30 maps are split evenly between us, with Map31 being a collaboration and Map32 being a guest map by gabirupee!

title: Doomed: By the Hour 2
description: Doomed: By The Hour 2 is a megawad with 32 speedmaps created between 1-3 hours by finnks13 & Yumheart, with a special guest map by gabirupee. Maps are generally pretty short & violent, with a nice slaughtery finale in the last two episodes being generally equivalent to Speed of Doom.

title: Exoterrestrial
description: Exoterrestrial is a set of 5 MBF21-compatible maps that use Tango's Minicharge mod (You DON'T need to download it separately). The maps are mostly easy and pretty different from NoReason's standard fare, with the only exception of the final fight of map05.

title: Unternity
description: A map pack of short, linear maps. Episode One is Underclaustro, underground maps which you'll see skybox less often, hence claustrophobic. Episode Two is Unlifely, Snow maps, out doors, concrete building surrounded by heavy snows.

title: Satisfactory: Update 8
description: New Power Tower & Priority Power Switch buildings, new advanced game settings, improvements to blueprints, biomes and more.

title: Super Mario 64 in SuperTux
description: Super Mario 64 in SuperTux is a modified version of SuperTux which incorporates Mario using his moveset from Super Mario 64 into SuperTux using libsm64.

title: Mortal Kombat 1: Invasions - Season of The Spectre
description: Invasions is a dynamic single player campaign with a variety of distinct challenges. With built in progression and RPG mechanics, mixed with MK1’s incredible fighting action, Invasions provides deep, and engaging challenges, and a ton of rewards along the way.

title: The Dark is a Soft, Warm Pressure
description: isitjustmeinhere?

title: Oneirology Online
description: in our dreams/online, are we alone?

title: Rumble Club
description:
Fall into the physics-based massive multiplayer Battle Royale! Join the epic knockout madness with up to 20 clumsy players and punch, push, throw, or trick opponents out of the arena!

Fly in on Captain Punch’s Sky Yacht, get bopped into the arena, find silly Gadgets to battle with, and survive the dropping floor and shrinking battlefield to be the last player standing! Are you ready to punch your way to victory and become the ultimate champion?

title: Escape From Flea Market Montgomery
description: Escape from Sammy Stephens before he catches you and takes you to Flea Market Montgomery which, allegedly, is "just like a mini mall".

title: Super Super Fun World
description: Super Super Fun World is a small but weird 15 minute indie exploration game.

title: Tricky Taps
description: Use the levers to roll and bounce the ball along the twisty roads, without letting it drop or hit the spikes! Keep an eye out for tons of super-cool and tricky obstacles to jump and bounce out off or avoid.

title: The King of Fighters XIII: Global Match: Deluxe Edition
description:
KOF XIII, the final chapter in the Ash Saga—and one of the series’ most acclaimed entries—is back! This enhanced version comes with rollback netcode for exhilarating online play, as well as brand-new online lobbies that allow you to join/spectate matches with multiple players at once. Also features a packed roster of 36 playable characters, including NESTS Style Kyo, Classic Iori, and Mr. Karate! KOF’s greatest-ever 2D graphics come to life as you face off against players online and around the world!

Complete with rollback netcode and overhauled online functionality!

Comes with magnificent must-haves for fans of the series: a Digital Artbook (with 100+ pages of exclusive illustrations, storyboards, and more) and a Digital Soundtrack (featuring the now-elusive melodies of THE KING OF FIGHTERS XIII)!

Includes:
- "THE KING OF FIGHTERS XIII GLOBAL MATCH" Base game
- "THE KING OF FIGHTERS XIII GLOBAL MATCH Artbook & Soundtrack"

title: ASMR Slicing: Joyful Cutting DLC
description: Unlock new unique objects to slice, new funny blades to cut with and get extra coins to spend!

title: ASMR Slicing: Nice Cuts DLC
description: Unlock new unique objects to slice, new funny knifes to cut with and get extra coins to spend!

title: Astro Miner: Moons
description: Explore 12 moons and collect all the treasures using your new vehicles!

title: Attack Strategy: Battle Simulator Accurate
description: Precision and Power Unite – Master the Battlefield!

title: Tobari Dream Ocean: Nightmare
description:
Dive into a nightmarish addition with ' Tobari Dream Ocean' – now featuring nightmarish versions of all stages!

After purchase, you'll have the option to switch to the Nightmare version from the title screen. The story remains fundamentally unchanged from the main storyline.

Nightmare! This is a game that CANNOT be recommended to any normal gamer.
For those who have conquered all of Tobari Dream Ocean's main stages and crave even greater challenges, this content is tailored for the true daredevils!

title: Sunsoft Mahjong Solitaire: Shanghai Legend
description: The 30-Year King of Puzzle Games: Shanghai

title: Spacefarer Mahjong
description: Spacefarer Mahjong is a classic Mahjong game with multiple play modes and styles.

title: Spacefarer Solitaire
description: Spacefarer Solitaire is a beautifully designed and animated classic game for Nintendo Switch, with excellent replay value.

title: Pestersim
description: The complete MSPA Reader Saga in one bundle - Hiveswap Friendsim and Pesterquest

title: Snap Together
description:
Snap Together is a puzzle party game for up to 4 people on a single console! Assemble models with your friends or by yourself.

Play with your friends in Multiplayer mode and solve puzzles together or challenge them in Tournament mode. In Tournament mode, there is only one winner! Use power-ups to mess up other players and win.

title: Heavy Car Battle: Demolition Derby
description: Immerse yourself in the thrilling world of our survival project – a fierce battle for 2 vital points and your very survival! You will have only one mission: collect 2 points scattered randomly across the battleground while dodging, crashing, and outwitting rival vehicles.

title: Drawing Carnival
description:
Unleash your inner artist and create gorgeous paintings made in different art styles!

Grab your neon markers, spray paints, stick-on diamonds or glitter powder and use them to create amazing masterpieces!

Divide your favorite portrait or any painting into four parts. Choose what you're going to paint with, decide which colors you're going to use, create a perfect image and put the painting in a frame to sell it!

title: Draw & Color Maze: Paint Labyrinth Puzzle
description: An exciting puzzle game in which you and a snail will have to go to a mysterious labyrinth and paint it with magic paint!

title: Math, BFF, and Notes
description: Married women are the only women for me!

title: Sugar Lust
description: Embark on a journey through the realm of the cake. As you progress through a series of intricately designed puzzles, you'll encounter a diverse cast of charming heroes and heroines. Upgrade your characters and prepare to face off against the ruler of the land, the Demon Goddess

title: PSI: Pressure Climbing
description: A movement-based climbing game where you ascend on a suicide mission to save an amphibian cargo cult.

title: Bloki
description: BLOKI is an educational game in which you'll transform into a designer of residential building facades from the Soviet era. Using the available set of tools and guidance from the moderator, you'll design facades and develop the nearby area.

title: Sex Milfs
description: Sex Milfs - is the simplest 2D puzzle the final goal of which to give you pleasure!

title: Siegebreaker
description: Conquer the realm in this strategic tower defense game. Build unique towers, unlock powerful upgrades, and master new tactics to overpower your enemies and vanquish the fallen gods.

title: Skuf Simulator
description: Skuf Simulator is a cooperative, humorous simulator of real life skuf, based on a popular meme. In the game, you and your friends can take on the role of a skuf and participate in various fun and absurd mini-games and contests.

title: Slot Shots Pinball: Ultimate Edition
description: Get ready for some good 'ol fashion pinball fun with eleven tables ready for you! Bigger playfields, better physics, longer soundtracks, and more slot machine shots! Prepare yourself for the ultimate edition of Slot Shots Pinball featuring four unreleased tables along with some classics.

title: Snake Galaxy Online
description: Snake Galaxy Online is a 3D game based on the famous Snake. Travel the universe, save the people of the stars and defeat evil in this fun adventure for all ages.

title: Space Detective: The Case of the Rebel Robot
description: Uncover cosmic conspiracies in "Space Detective: The Case of the Rebel Robot," a Sci-Fi Mystery Point-and-Click Adventure with a twist of Yuri Dating Sim. Solve the murder, present your case to the incoming Marshal, and navigate your choices to unlock unexpected lesbian romances!

title: Spiritus 2
description: The survival horror concludes in part two of SPIRITUS, set in a post-apocalyptic city and the depths of pure evil. Survive in classic 90's gaming tropes augmented with modern HD graphics.

title: Swappy World
description: Simply two mechanics: swipe to move and tap to interact in an open-world survival crafting experience made through cards. Handle your energy tactically to survive as long as possible. Craft weapons, build your base and be prepared to explore a world full of secrets.

title: Next Floor
description: Next Floor is a score attack, fast-paced, difficult, gory fps, with a simple objective, reach the highest floor you can. Take all your stress out on enemies and make the most creative kills to get as many points as possible, however, higher the floor, more difficult it will be. How far can you go?

title: Ninja Resurrection: A tale of Kuro
description: Explore "Ninja Resurrection," an intense martial arts game that takes a fresh approach to the genre. This hardcore adventure features a mysterious storyline, demanding combat, diverse moves, and thrilling QTEs. Conquer the challenge, evolve with the game, and become a true ninja master.

title: Northgard: Vordr, Clan of the Owl
description: Subsisting through the ages, the secretive norns of Vördr keep watch over all realms in Northgard and beyond. Protectors of Yggdrasil, the sisters Skuld, Verdandi, and Urdr, use the power of this sacred tree to spread their knowledge inexorably across the land.

title: Not Burned Evil
description: The attractive and terrifying game "Got Burned Evil" is an exciting 2D horror with a side view that immerses the player in a mysterious world of tragedies and riddles.

title: Powers in the Basement
description: A short point-and-click adventure game set in a comedic medieval fantasy world, deliberately reminiscent of the great classics from the 80s / 90s, with a specific sweet spot for LucasArts production.

title: Plagueborn Survivor
description: Plagueborn Survior is a VRs only shooter game set in the present day, after a pandemic that collapsed the global economy, leaving everything in the hands of the military, criminal factions, and politicians.

title: Origin of Storms
description: Dive into Origin of Storms, a visually striking fighting game where elemental warriors clash in one-on-one or dynamic three-on-three battles. Unleash primal transformations, master distinct elemental powers, and compete globally for supremacy in this electrifying arena. Are you ready for the storm?

title: Prelude to Nuss Jump
description: Talking about the year 2022 Before the story of the Eastern Holy Son, we must first know this story When all the memory fragments are connected together, for him, there is only a devastating spiritual blow. But he must go through all this because This Everything is for a great mission!

title: RC Revolution: High Voltage
description: Immerse yourself in the electrifying world of RC car racing! Experience the thrill of multiplayer mayhem, delve into extensive car customization, unleash your creativity with track design, and embark on a rewarding progression system. Get ready, your track awaits!

title: Room
description: I thought it was just an ordinary day, but I accidentally entered this endless cycle of rooms. Among the countless terrifying and anomalous things, there is a girl who seems like she shouldn't exist here.

title: Roxy Raccoon's Pinball Panic: Winter Whimsy
description: 1 Brand New Table with online leaderboards and unlockable cosmetics! Ultra-wide winter themed table with 2 plungers and multi-ball madness.

title: Sanctuary in Time
description: A text-based, adult game with sci-fi & RPG elements!

title: The Key
description: It is a multiplayer, competitive combat game with support for 8 players per game. Your objective is to obtain 3 keys and survive to create your own path to the helicopter on the map which is your victory point.

title: Rogue Glitch Ultra: Upgrade
description: A roguelite action platformer in a vibrant glitch-ridden world. Amass a huge arsenal from over 150 weapon options and face hordes of enemies and tough boss fights. Jump into multiplayer (up to 4 player co-op online or local) to collect, unlock, and upgrade for endless replayability.

title: Witchhammer
description:
Witchhammer is a Real-Time Roguelike Deckbuilding Game.
Play as Clovelin, a card reader who was convicted as a witch and made a deal with the devil to avenge her own death. With the powers of her magical tarot deck, you will battle the Inquisition and try to destroy their most powerful weapon: the Witchhammer.
To master our real time deckbuilding roguelike you will not only learn how to avoid your enemies attacks but also how to play your cards most efficiently.
After every wave of enemies you will improve your deck, making it more powerful and adapting it to your own playstyle.

title: Lilly's Potion Shop
description: A third-person shooter in a bright, colorful world, where dynamic battles are mixed with leisurely exploration of the world in search for ingredients, and a intricate plot. Feel like a wizard, thanks to the unusual mechanics of making potions.

title: Minigolf Galaxy: Green Valley
description: Start your galactical minigolf journey in Green Valley! With courses created by our golf-loving designer team, you will surely be put(t) to the test to finish with a 3-star performance.

title: Manifest Destiny
description: Tired of playing the hero of regular RPG game? This time, Let’s trying to play as a game developer, go deep into the game world created by yourself, kill or solve puzzles with your abilities of programming, art and music, all depends on you!

title: My Dream Setup: Pets
description: Does your pet also live in your room? With the Pets DLC you can add animals, toys and accessories to your room. Choose your furry friend from the 16 breeds of dogs and cats featured in the DLC. In addition to dogs and cats, you can choose from fish, parrots, hamsters and even a lizard.

title: Monster Crawl: Warrior
description: FREE version of Monster Crawl featuring the Warrior & first few hours of gameplay || Horde based roguelite; slaughter them all with overpowering attacks & annihilate entire rooms. Explore diverse builds using heroes, abilities, buffs & relics. Beat Bosses to unlock Uber Relics. 2 player local co-op.

title: Galactic Civilizations IV: Megastructures
description: Advance to Type II civilization in Galactic Civilizations IV with the Megastructures expansion. Harness star power for awe-inspiring constructions like Dyson Spheres and Interstellar Gateways, each offering unique benefits. Think bigger and redefine your galactic scope!

title: Galactic Civilizations IV: Tales of Centauron
description: Explore the 24th-century Centauron sector in Galactic Civilizations IV's DLC, "Tales of Centauron." Discover unique tech, planetary upgrades, and ship parts. Enjoy new events and expanded gameplay for custom civilizations, enhancing both strategy and story in a dynamic universe.

title: Galactic Civilizations IV: Tales of the Arnor
description: Uncover ancient galaxy secrets in Galactic Civilizations IV's "Tales of the Arnor" expansion. Explore the lore of Mithilar and the Arnor, encountering relics and uncovering Precursor Wars history.

title: Galactic Civilizations IV: Warlords
description: Transform combat with custom military doctrines, controlling ship behavior and strategy. Set precise war aims and conquest goals with the War Planning interface, influencing public opinion. Enjoy enhanced combat, intricate ship designs, detailed reports, deepening strategic warfare.

title: Light In Blood
description: Descending into the world of dreams, you are immersed in the ominous atmosphere of the game "Light In Blood". The game is divided into two teams: victims and executioners. The task of the victims is to survive and get out of the coma, and the executioners are to stop them.

title: Into the Grid
description: Become a master hacker in this cyberpunk roguelike deckbuilder. Explore the dangers of cyberspace and fight evil corporations. Build and upgrade a deck of powerful programs. Unlock perks and skills, and unleash digital hell on your enemies. Dive into the grid!

title: Hitler My Friend
description: Hitler My Friend is a 3D third-person shooter where you play as Hitler, fight off top shark predators and catch a turtle

title: Gran Carismo
description: "Gran Carismo" immerses players in an intense and competitive racing environment, combining the excitement of illegal underground races with a compelling narrative. Get ready to navigate challenging tracks, outmaneuver rivals, and claim the grand prize – the Rosso 50

title: Glitch Daddy
description: You have a strange dream where you meet a creature named Glitch Daddy, telling you that the world is ending. Then, you wake up and go to unravel the truth through a wild, abstract psychedelic journey.

title: I Love You Freddy
description: ah the celebrity life, the fame, and glamour, the wealth, and the insane psychopathic fan girl who chases you around an island she trapped you in, isn't the celebrity life wonderful!

title: High Fructose
description: "High Fructose" is a first-person shooter roguelite. As a prophesied hero, wield up to five weapons against monstrous fruit. Use various traits and items to create builds and endure the relentless onslaught.

title: American Isekai: Legends of Nipponia
description: 250 years ago, on the world of Nipponia, twin siblings Taneela and Tanaka seek to become Adventurers like their father. On the day of their registration, they are contacted by Mavis, the Crystal being of their world. Can they gather enough forces to stand against the rising evil in their world?

title: Ancient Rus vs. Lizards
description: An action game about battles with hordes of aggressive humanoid lizards!

title: Assembly Line 2: Mobile Version
description: Build and optimize your assembly line to make the most money possible!

title: Bright Oak
description: Bright Oak is a heavily character-driven visual novel with elements of science fiction. Discover the tragic secrets behind Bright Oak’s preternatural dilemma; find friendship, or possibly love; save the town and make your way home--and if at first you don’t succeed, try, try again!

title: Company of Heroes 3: Hammer & Shield
description: The Hammer & Shield Expansion Pack introduces two new Battlegroups for Multiplayer/ Co-op / SP Skirmish, an all-new Campaign Company for the Italian Campaign, and four premium cosmetic bundles.

title: Corpse Master Carnage
description: Welcome to Corpse Master Carnage!A survivor round-based hell-shooter game where your objective is to survive endless hordes of demons while improving your attributes and gaining more power and new abilities, as well as exploring and progressing through the game's story.

title: Dark Dive: The Last Tropic
description: Join the ranks of skilled duppy detective in a Caribbean town where danger lurks at every corner. Catch or fight monsters, build your deck, and uncover the secrets of the town's mysterious mines in this captivating RPG with turn-based combat and gripping story elements.

title: Die Cook
description: Presenting Die Cook, the first ever dice-based restaurant management game! Open your dream business, upgrade and equip your kitchen, level up employees to customize their dice. Express yourself with a customizable character and indoor decor. Aim for a 5-star rating in this unique relaxing simulator!

title: Detective Hayseed: The Cloning Madness
description: Join the crazy police detective Francis in his search for a kidnapped cloned beauty and go through countless escapades with him in this classic point & click adventure full of comedy.

title: DIY Paper Doll
description: Become a doll stylist and design fabulous outfits for your adorable paper princess!

title: Slave Zero X: Digital Deluxe Edition
description: Slave Zero X is a stylish 2.5D character action game set in the biopunk world of Slave Zero (1999). Run & Slash your way through a dystopian future in this character action game which will resonate with fans of Devil May Cry, Strider, and Guilty Gear.

title: 5:48AM
description: It's 5:48 AM, and everything is about driving back home before the effects of all the alcohol you've absorbed kick in...

title: The Desolation
description: The Desolation brings a complete cross-platform co-op looter-shooter experience to PC and mobile devices. Make your impact across endless procedurally generated worlds via cooperative action combat, deep build customization and richly satisfying tactical gameplay.

title: Cardboard Hero
description: Play as the hero of a young child’s imagination and fight your way through a fantasy cardboard adventure in this 3rd person action-adventure. Fight wacky enemies and find treasure to help you as you explore the vast worlds.

title: Horny Holiday
description: Dive into a festive romance in Horny Holiday! Play as Jack in a holiday encounter with the enchanting Joy at a Christmas party. Engage in a unique water, fire, wood challenge to win her heart, all wrapped up with captivating animations and a sound. Charm your way to a date before the lights dim!

title: The Five Rivers Land
description: Mini campaign in DOOM 3 hell-style with three small to medium sized, dark and scary maps, D3 textures (needless to say) and some ambient sounds.

title: I No Longer Fear The Ranger Guarding My Heel
description: A large prototype-textured map with non-linear progression, slaughter fights, and trick jumping. Runs on the Copper mod, which is included. Originally intended as an entry for SM224.

title: Pale Peril
description: 1 copper map using hundreds of enemies and makkon textures.

title: Hatchepsout: The Hell Temple
description: Small to medium Egyptian temple

title: Cheyenne Mountain Complex
description: Large underground base map with some Quake2 textures.

title: Euclid's Nightmare
description: Venture deep into the darkest depths of my mind. Experience the torture and mental anguish that comes with these dangerous visions from my mind. Hence the title of this mod; Euclid's Nightmare. It features 20 brand-spanking-new maps all hand-crafted by me

title: Vestige of V'othlog
description: Vestige of V'othlog is a short four-level episode inspired by the classic themes of Quake. The pack was designed for 2021 re-release (KexQuake) but it has also been tested with Ironwail.

title: Mortal Kombat 1: Invasions - Season of the Blood Moon
description: Invasions Season of the Blood Moon is underway! Be sure to take down the invading Nitara and add her blood-filled rewards to your kollection before the season ends on December 11.

title: Yip Quest
description: Fantasy comedy point and click game where you have to play three kobolds who have to steal some treasury.

title: Olivia's Bad Day
description: Olivia's had the worst day at work. Do whatever it takes to give her some much needed stress-relief.

title: Long Hike with a Cute Girl
description: Grace asked you to come with her on a quiet early morning hike, but her tight shorts and upbeat attitude make it seem like maybe she has a little more in store for you...

title: Paranormal Inc.
description: After looking for a job for a long time, you started as an operator in a company named "Paranormal Inc." You will watch live CCTV footage and report the anomalies you see.

title: Ultimate General: American Revolution
description: American Revolution is a sandbox strategy game featuring the epic historical period during the rebellion of the American colonies against the British Empire. Take on the role of the British or American Colonists, and fight for territorial control over North America. A gripping real-time campaign awaits you on a detailed 3d map where you can build your army and navy, construct military infrastructure, and fully command your armies on a regimental level. If you want even more action you can fully zoom-in and fight massive battles on a battalion level.

title: Ruindog
description: After centuries of invincibility, it became popular for humans to watch live alien hunting shows, participate in alien hunts, save up money, equipment, and use all the loot you find to move on to new maps and defeat more powerful enemies.

title: Dark City: London - Collector's Edition
description:
Collector's Edition of Dark City: Loudon includes:
- Solve a new case in the exciting bonus chapter!
- Collect hidden dominoes and morphing objects as you play.
- Never get lost with the strategy guide!
- Replay your favorite HOPs and mini-games!
- Enjoy exclusive screensavers, concept art, and music!

title: Liminal Memory
description: Walking simulator, where you finish levels to recover your memories. Firstly started as 1 month visual project, ended up being complete game. Features PSX graphics and liminal aesthetic as main style.

title: Dino Mayhem
description: Cause mayhem in this retro platformer by devouring people and destroying vehicles to earn points.

title: Dream of the Star Haven
description:
Dream of the Star Haven is a 1st person “giant leap” platformer with elements of exploration puzzling and light combat - a magical odyssey through islands in the sky where you soar gracefully and eventually even bend gravity itself to your will, giving you the power to literally turn the dreamlike world upside-down.

Explore awe-inspiring floating islands with gravity-defying agility. Discover the stars scattered across the islands using your magical scanner to reveal hidden celestial secrets.

In this captivating land, you're invited into a serene journey where you to traverse the floating archipelago in search of secrets, to liberate that which has been unjustly taken.

The game introduces a mesmerizing combination of a mighty triple-leap ability and a magical scanner, both essential tools for navigating the world.

Discover the stars scattered across the islands using the magical scanner helps you on your main quest, while other side quests and secret collectibles are more elusive. As you progress through each realm, you uncover mysteries of a lost era.

Immerse yourself in a unique blend of soothing exploration, graceful platforming, and a dreamy atmosphere. Savor the expansive vistas and uncover all that's hidden among the floating islands. With its emphasis on relaxation, exploration, and light combat and puzzle solving, the game provides an oasis of tranquility and is the perfect game-between-games when you need a break from big, noisy and chaotic gameplay.

Cruise through the low-stakes core of the game, or challenge yourself with the more difficult collectathon of secret challenges!

Embrace the joy of a harmonious journey as you leap toward the stars and reach toward a higher Dream of the Star Haven

title: Mall Heist
description: Sneak, hack, and confront guards as a security tester in 'Mall Heist.' Utilize your surroundings to your advantage! From bananas in the supermarket to boots in the clothing store, everything becomes a tool for your heist!

title: Forgotten Knight
description: It's a turn-based deck building RPG based on 2D dots. In an environment where attacks work differently on each turn, set the best strategy to defeat your enemies and upgrade your equipment to be stronger!

title: Life of Thife
description: Try to escape from the wanted city! Gather the necessary supplies by yourself and fend off the guards' pursuit! Cooperative guards are waiting for you at the checkpoints along the escape route.

title: Ace Racers SP
description: Import, build, and export arena courses for space drone racing. Customize your ships thrust and rates, and work on your manual thrust skills.

title: Twistingo: Hummingbird Haven - Collector's Edition
description: Restore paradise in 'Hummingbird Haven'! Uncover hidden nests, rescue animals, and rebuild a sanctuary. Your journey awaits in this thrilling hidden object fun with challenging puzzles!

title: Poozle Mania: Girls DLC #2
description: This DLC adds new mechanics to the game, as well as 3 more girls!

title: Hotel in the Dark
description: That's the day it all started on Sept. 13. 2020. In the early morning of the same day, I was already standing at the bus station, waiting for my bus. I had to travel a couple of three hundred kilometers to a small town. I found a hotel quickly. It was quite a modern building at first glance.

title: Da Da Daungo
description:
A combination of Doubt and Bingo!
Use your brain to win!

title: Never be Afraid: Slam Dunk!
description: Never be afraid to Slam Dunk!

title: New Life of Aged Town
description: Be the mayor of this super aging town and fulfill the wishes of the old people.

title: United Football
description:
United Football is a free to play, multiplayer, 5-a-side online football game.

United Football allows players to play in teams consisting of both human and AI players and boasts a unique control system and viewpoint that puts the gamer right in the action.

title: Cold War 2395: Solus
description: Cold War 2395: Solus invites you to explore an abandoned research outpost on a distant planet. Learn the secrets of the last person to venture there and uncover a galaxy-spanning conspiracy's origin.

title: Little Witch Academia: Project Luna
description: Little Witch Academia: Project Luna is a fan-made role-playing PC and VR video game by Ian JCV, Trota, and OcculusMalus based on Little Witch Academia. The game is currently under development.

title: The Last of Us Part II Remastered
description: Experience the winner of over 300 Game of the Year awards now with an array of technical enhancements that make The Last of Us Part Il Remastered the definitive way to play Ellie and Abby's critically acclaimed story.

title: Super Nin-e Sisters
description: Super Mario Bros. alternative art fangame.

title: Catrina's Halloween Nightmare
description:
It's been three years since the Halloween Party massacre tragedy. Catrina wants nothing to do with Halloween, but her best friend Hope convinces her to attend a small reunion, she can't keep avoiding this night forever. Besides, what are the odds of the same thing happening twice? Grin Pumpkin is back.

The sequel to Jake's Halloween Night, a game inspired by old slasher movies.

title: Alex Jones: NWO Wars
description: Alex Jones: NWO Wars is an arcade-style video game that merges the worlds of political satire and retro gaming. In this title, players step into the shoes of Alex Jones, the well-known figure behind Infowars, as he battles through a series of levels inspired by his controversial broadcasts and political views.

title: Touhou 1: The Highly Responsive to Prayers NES Demake
description:
From the programmer that brought you Chuhou Joutai, Drillimation Systems brings you a port of the game that helped kickstart a global internet sensation.

Once upon a time, there were two races that ruled over Gensokyo (The Land of Illusions): humanoids and youkai. They both helped bring peace to the world. One day, war broke out between the two races. The humanoids were largely unsuccessful, as the youkai dominated over Gensokyo. During the battle, an important landmark in the eastern part of the land was destroyed: the Hakurei Shrine.

Underneath the rubble, a young shrine maiden named Reimu Hakurei emerges. You are destined to go out and punish the one responsible. But, there are two paths to take. Armed with a mighty wand, an infinite supply of throwing amulets, and a yin-yang orb, you must make your way across the Aetherworld (Makai) or the Netherworld (Jigoku). But, once you meet the Angel of Death, be sure to keep your stake sharp. And say your prayers!

Original by Team Shanghai Alice, adaptation by Drillimation Systems.

title: Karasu Meltdown!
description:
Karasu Meltdown puts you into the elephant's foot of hell raven Utsuho Reiuji, who thought it'd be a fun idea to smash up the Palace of Earth Spirits!

But Satori's having none of it and sending all of her pets to stop her!
Shoot, dodge, bomb, and raise bullet hell in this caravan shoot 'em up!
This game was originally made in three weeks for the Gunner Parade '22 Winter League game jam.

title: United Penguin Kingdom: Huddle up
description: This free version of the United Penguin Kingdom covers the content from one-year in-game time. A city-building game where you build a penguin settlement and satisfy the various needs of your penguins while dealing with seals and killer whales.

title: Midnight Blanc
description: A horror game where you pilot a crude airplane over the North Atlantic.

title: The Walking Dead: Empires
description:
Cooperative survival game set in a post-apocalyptic world after a letas virus causes people to turn into zombies when they die and infects the people they bite. Game from the series franchise: The Walking Dead.
The game is web3 and can be found in the Gala Games store. Developed by Ember Entertainment

title: Fast as Duck
description: This is an Indie game developed by AalexDoesStuff. It is a 3d platformer made for speedrunning, and includes intentional bugs as one of the features in the game.

title: Telnet Shooting Collection
description: Experience the iconic cutscenes and music that are synonymous with Telnet titles ( Gaiares, Granada, Psychic Storm, and Avenger), whenever you want! This collection includes convenient features like save/load anywhere, rewind, and other quality of life upgrades.

title: Angel Hare's Learning Adventure
description: Join Angel Gabby and friends on an educational journey through the skies! Will you remember how to behave well with others? Or will you need to be taught an additional lesson?

title: Donny Donut 3
description: Donny's new adventure is taking you to the Cyber Lands, to save the world from the evil Mark Donald. With the help of Pixie, a pixel, Donny's going to travel through cities, data and clouds to find Donno and Donna, his siblings...

title: Shockwaves
description: Shockwaves is a captivating merging puzzle game where strategic placement creates powerful shockwaves, pushing and merging numbers. Challenge yourself with endless scoring or solve intricate puzzles.

title: School Evasion
description:
This small and simple project was made with the intention of being an assessment game for the Digital Games course at FAESA (Brazilian university center).

"What happened at this school?"

It's the first question a curious person would ask. That's why your mission is basically to explore this place and discover the mysteries that surround it, in quick and simple gameplay.

When you pass through these gates, you accept your destiny. You must find pieces that complete the puzzle that this school really is. With simple 3D gameplay, flashlight, batteries, and letters scattered throughout the school, it is up to the player to face their fears and accept this adventure. May the light guide you.

title: Gu-L
description:
While on the road during a school trip, a class becomes stranded in the middle of a derelict forest when their bus abruptly crashes. Fending for themselves, they soon come across a mansion whose lone habitant is a stoic maid. Seeking shelter, they take refuge in the mansion, only for the stay to be anything but restful.

This surreal RPG-Maker horror game was a submission in the March 2001 edition of the monthly contest that Enterbrain would host. Gu-L won first place, with Hyogo's very own Yubu Yakushiro receiving 30,000円 as the prize.

title: Glitcher
description: Glitcher is a Tactical Espionage game where you play as a computer virus.

title: Fiction Fixers: Curse of OZ
description:
The Land of Oz is in great peril. The evil Victor Vile has erected towers that consume the people, light, and energy of Oz itself. Protect Dorothy and Toto as they travel across Oz in hopes of finding a way home to Kansas.

Team up with the Scarecrow, the Tinman, and the Lion and use their powers to overcome great obstacles. But beware of the Wicked Witch and Victor, an Illiterati agent, who will stop at nothing to destroy you.

title: 8bit Wars
description:
The war between 8 bits computers has begun. You are CPC Amstrad models and must defend from Spectrum, MSX and C64 attacks. Place your computers at the best positions to avoid the enemies waves

Made for CPCRETRODEV 2021 contest. Tower defense game programmed in BASIC using 8BP library

First 8BP game in mode 1

And yeah, this is a really hard TD game. You have been warned.

title: Juegue Con Su Amstrad 02: West
description:
This little game came in a standalone cassette as a free game with the second issue of the Spanish magazine "Juegue Con Su Amstrad", which roughly translates to "Play With Your Amstrad".

This time around, it's a duel between two cowboys.

title: Empire of the Golden Witch
description: An Umineko fangame. Dig through records to uncover the truth of a very different Ushiromiya family.

title: The Myth Seekers Collection
description:
This bundle includes:

The Myth Seekers: The Legacy of Vulkan - Face off against the legacy of ancient gods!
The Myth Seekers 2: The Sunken City - Can love revive what hate has ruined?

title: Uzzuzzu My Pet: Golf Dash
description: Swing into action and tee off on the craziest golf course ever with Uzzuzzu pack!

title: Crystal Chip Collector e
description: Fast-paced platforming puzzle game about an ancient spirit that fixes PCs.

title: Icharko
description: Become that military hero - go through step-by-step trials, be tactful and think through every move you make before you go into the open. Experience the taste of military action of the 2000s.

title: Puke
description: Puke... No one loves this town. No one walks by. The departing trains are empty. But why? Listening to the townsfolk and witnessing the events there is your job. Go there as the investigative journalist you are to find out what's going on with the locals' lives.

title: Kagura Genesis: Kuon's Story
description: Vanquish and recruit youkai in randomized dungeons in Kagura Genesis: Kuon's Story, a replayable roguelike RPG!

title: Arena of Faith
description: Win,Team up,Get Rewards and become the eSports King in Arena of Faith.

title: DDS x Narcos
description: Spinoff of the hit game Drug Dealer Simulator and the legendary show Narcos. It’s the 1980s, you are a disgraced CIA agent turned drug dealer. You will run your business in Mexico and the US in this story-driven simulator about the life of crime.

title: Medieval Machines Builder: First Siege
description: Embark on a captivating journey back to the roots of medieval conflict with Medieval Machines Builder - First Siege. This free-to-play simulation game offers a taste of the grandeur and challenges that await in the full game. Design, build, and destroy. Medieval lethal weapons await you!

title: Catting Over It
description: Challenge your jumping skills and immerse yourself in the world of real jumping tactics. The stakes are high, remember, the higher you climb, the harder you fall, every mistake can teach you a valuable lesson, or not, but it will be fun!

title: Barbarous: Family Secrets
description: Help Emyr save the world in a Time Management game full of adventure and comedy!

title: Kingdom Rush Vengeance - Hammerhold Campaign
description: Hammerhold's in for a surprise: Vez'nan sends you with the mighty Dark Army fleet for a lightning strike on the desert shores, catching the Legionnaires off guard!

title: Christmas Nightmare
description: Christmas Nightmare is an atmospheric horror game about New Year's Eve.

title: God For A Day
description: In this 2D, narrative-based simulation game, you play as the Son of God. Your mission: Decide, bless or condemn city residents. Uncover the person's story through their items and secrets before making decisions. Your choices alter the city's destiny, and impact your revelation on Judgment Day.

title: Dimensional Shift Awakening
description: This game is a soul born inspired action adventure RPG game. I want to make each character unique and flesh out their own story, background, personality then all of this will affect the character powers, type, talents, skills, fighting styles, and weapons.

title: Yukiusa
description: A game of bouncing snow rabbits!

title: Necrophoresis
description: Necrophoresis is a co-op horror game for 1-4 players. Explore a haunted morgue to find its dark secrets. Use what you can find to make your way through the morgue and find your way out.

title: Descent from Arkov's Tower
description: Highly moddable retro roguelike. Descent from Arkov's Tower - or die trying!

title: Arcane Blood: The Shattered Star
description: PLAY as Verana, a young witch and master a variety of spells!! DEFEAT bosses sealed away in forgotten dungeons! UPGRADE Verana's health and magic at Angel Maiden Statues! EXPLORE a great forest, dark caves, sandy waste, and even quaint towns!

title: Blood Radiant
description: Blood Radiant is a lovecraftian soulslike action-RPG. Explore a mythical island at the intersection of many space-times while you find weapons, battle eldritch abominations, uncover secrets, and talk to NPCs in a dark quest to achieve ultimate power.

title: Void Guard
description: Follow the Void Guardian as she inspects a space station after receiving a distress beacon from it and help her vanquish the hidden evil.

title: Rise & Reign
description: Washed ashore on a strange medieval land, its up to you to choose your destiny. Harvest resources, craft weapons, and build your kingdom. Raid other players or work together. Serve the king or take the throne for yourself. This land is harsh, can you survive?

title: Panicore
description: Panicore is a survival horror game that mixes permadeath, AI monsters and a co-op experience. Try to escape and don't get caught.

title: Blades and Bullets
description: In 1939 Grand Emperor Hil’Tar a high elf who has set his sights for Poland which would spark the start of the Second World war. Hundreds of miles away across the ocean, you a young American working out of his parent's farm, learns of the fatal news that war in the Kingdom of Europe has broken out.

title: Multiplication Mayhem
description: An educational adventure to learning multiplication! Choose the right platform with the product of the multiplication or fall to the depts. Save animals with each multiplication table completed and use their buffs to your advantage. Experience the visual novel like story to save the realm.

title: The Chronicles of Ezra Blackwell: Episode 1 - Pappi's Peril
description: First Person Mystery Adventure with twisting story and multiple endings.

title: Hazeron Starship
description: Explore and colonize a vast universe. Discover resources. Build cities. Make spacecraft. Walk aboard them. Operate their controls. Command a crew of NPCs. Lift off. Fly up through the atmosphere to outer space. Land on other worlds, anywhere, not at designated places. Build an empire.

title: Homeless
description: Beneath the dazzling lights of New York, a sinister darkness lurks. In the hour when the whole city is sleeping, a strange and terrifying man emerges from the darkness, intent on shattering your mind and spirit

title: Battlecry Berserkers
description: A never repeating dungeon. Fight your way trough waves of enemies and make your own path. Unleash new powers and defeat mighty foes, in order to find and take to the gods' justice the responsible for this attack!

title: Detective Dave
description: A washed-up Detective demoted to graveyard shift has gone rogue and stops going by the book. You play the part of Detective Dave as he explores the dark side of the city. Solve cases, work undercover, or hand out justice the old fashion way.

title: Trois Mouvements Perpétuels
description: Three games about music. One alone is light, short and weak, but the three allow you to enjoy the consistency of ideas.

title: Swing Solver
description: Swing Solver is a physics based action puzzle. Stab the wire and swing to bring the ball to the goal.

title: Northanda Chronicles
description: Master role-driven combat in Northanda Chronicles, a tactical roguelike deckbuilder. Recruit three heroes from countless combinations, craft a shared deck of powerful abilities, and fight to save Northanda from the devouring Void.

title: Warja
description: Warja is a roguelite tower defence game where you collect loot, upgrade towers, and level up your hero to defend against endless waves of monsters.

title: Hidden Cats: Magic Forest
description: Hidden Cats: Magic Forest is a hidden object game where you will search for lost cats while exploring the mystery of the magical forest. Touch the enchanting texture of the forest and interact with other surprise objects. Experience the silence and the discovery!

title: FeastTower
description: Pon a prueba tu destreza en la creación del sándwich más monumental y asegura tu lugar en lo más alto de la puntuación. ¿Te atreves a asumir el desafío?

title: Pump Press
description: You control a robot that is constantly moving forward. Your goal is to pump the balloons that are coming towards you by shooting them. If you shoot a balloon 4 times, it will pop. Press a button to shoot and hold a button to go faster. The balloons will remain behind you once they pass you and deflate again. The enemy will push all deflated balloons to the left border. You score points for every balloon that hits the border. To score more points, chain up the balloons.

title: Slick Slack
description: A simple puzzle game in which you, as a player, will need to use your brain.

title: Revenge of the Ronin
description:
This is a story of two fathers, each trying to save their daughters.
A Tale Of Rage, Revenge, And Redemption.
This is a Third-person hack and slash RPG game.
Fight gods and demons to save the people you love.
Upgrade your character and unlock new abilities to become more powerful and defeat your enemies.

title: Under Night In-Bright II Sys:Celes - Deluxe Edition
description:
Under Night In-Bright II Sys:Celes - Deluxe Edition contains:

- Under Night In-Bright II Sys:Celes - Deluxe Edition
- Under Night In-Bright II Sys:Celes - Deluxe Edition - Season Pass
- 25 Announcer Characters set

title: Yama no Susume: Next Summit - Ano Yama ni, Mou Ichido
Hentai Tales Vol. 2: Hitomi and Sea Trip
description: Continuation of exciting puzzles with a new plot and even more stunning anime illustrations.

title: Charrua Soccer: Pro Edition
description: Charrua Soccer is an arcade that brings you the most fun part of soccer! Play friendly matches, tournaments or create your team and lead it to glory in career mode!

title: Persona 5 Tactica: DLC All in One
description:
The All In One DLC Pack includes the following:

• Repaint Your Heart Challenge Pack
• Weapon Pack
• Picaro Summoning Pack + Raoul Persona

title: AI.Gears: Team Tag Battle
description: "AI.Gears" offers innovative robot combat with diverse, customizable robots and 1v1 matches. Featuring reinforcement learning AI, it provides rich PvP and PvE content for a diverse combat experience. Join the world of varied robot battles in "AI.Gears."

title: Buzz Cut Simulation
description: A Korean man enjoys simulating the process of getting a buzz cut in a game. Click to choose whether to do the buzz cut or not

title: Epic Pizza
description: Epic Pizza - The People of Calzonia are hungry for Pizza. You have to Race against Time to get it to them.

title: Dread Protocol
description: Embark on a thrilling 3rd-person space adventure. Engage in merciless combat, wield a vast arsenal, and explore procedurally generated environments. Take down the Federation, one station at a time.

title: Fan Zhuan 21 Ke
description: You will play an excellent detective with a history of retired soldiers, accidentally wrapped into the case of life and death brothers involved in, and stepped into a life and death of a difficult to predict the maze, and this maze behind the layers of unseen crises and crimes.

title: Girl Gunner
description: Girl Gunner is a fun 2D shooter game with a rich weapon system, exquisite graphics, and beautiful BGM, especially bullets. Currently, there are up to 24 types! Players will play the cute girl Emily, escaping from the deserted island and breaking out of the siege.

title: Jewel Craft Fusion
description: Explore cosmic wonders in "Jewel Craft Fusion." Match gems, solve puzzles, and unlock ancient cosmic secrets. Dive into a celestial odyssey of brilliance!

title: Critter Crossfire
description: A genre-breaking fusion of Turn-Based Tactics and First Person Shooting made by a solo developer. Position your units in a detailed 3D environment and skillfully aim your shots with physics-based weapons. Collect and combine items to build unique loadouts from over 50 wacky weapons and upgrades.

title: Armored War
description: Armored War is a hardcore tactical first-person shooter set in the realities of modern conflict. Take part in ground battles using a full arsenal of weapons and equipment.

title: Only Up Samarkand
description: Only up Samarkand is a parkour game where speed and agility are important so as not to fall and start again! Reaching the end is an important milestone in the game.

title: Ostrich Farm
description: Sunshine graces the farm and your birds are a fashion disaster. Breed vibrant ostriches by matching colors and patterns to complete unique orders. Earn valuable rewards and mutation points to enhance your farm's genetic diversity.

title: United Penguin Kingdom
description: A city-building game where you build a penguin settlement and satisfy the various needs of your penguins while dealing with seals and killer whales. Enjoy the growth of your settlement, become the king, and lead the United Penguin Kingdom.

title: ThroneForge: The Fortress War
description: Throneforge: The Fortress War:Build an arsenal of diverse towers, each with unique abilities and strengths.Strategically place towers along the enemy's path to maximize their impact and create impenetrable defense lines.

title: Grimhook
description: Descend into Grimhook's sunken ruins as Dart, mastering Lovecraftian powers. Bounce, dash, and grapple through flooded caverns, confronting robotic foes in this fast-paced first-person action platformer. Explore, battle, and unravel the mysteries below Miletos.

title: Chimp Quest: Spirit Isle
description: Swing into a heartwarming tale in Chimp Quest: Spirit Isle.

title: Duck's Most Terrible Day
description: A time-bending 2D platformer in the least amount of pixels possible.

title: Notice

As you get home and start to breathe, you take control over your thoughts. By clicking on each object, you start to become aware of everything in your space and what it means to you. Each object has its own style, musical note and meaning - whether that be the can of soda lying on your desk or the guitar gifted to you from a friend back home.

The replicant aid agency tries to rescue him but fails. In the process they stumble on the real secret of the Replicant project...

All the contents included in the Standard Edition (Guidebook, Control Card, and exclusive skin)
An Exclusive Artbook which also includes a comic (in English)

Guiding the character Aylin, players will embark on unique explorations in various time periods, solving intricate puzzles and wielding the power to alter the fabric of time itself. The game delves beyond mere time travel, challenging players to shape the past and change the course of the future. Temporal Odyssey not only encompasses the thrill of temporal exploration but also encourages players to unravel the secrets of time, rewrite history, and craft their own epic temporal saga. Immerse yourself in this captivating experience that reveals time travel as an unpredictable and surprise-laden adventure.

A strange knight sat in front of a fire, darkness surrounding him. His sword stuck in the ground, covered in dried blood. He warns you against going any further, but the intrigue of what lies beyond far surpasses the instinct of self preservation.

Play as a young thief and explore the dangerous ruins of a once-prosperous kingdom. Fight against hordes of terrifying monsters, make your way through challenging platforming sections and discover the secret that lies at the very bottom of the ruins in this handcrafted experience.

Chrysolite is a narrative driven, pixel-art, 2D platformer with Soulslike inspirations.

He holds dearly his time with the mischievous yet friendly wolves, the stories they told, the fertile forest east of town, and the mist that heralded every sunrise. Most of all, he remembers Cadgan: a wolf a bit younger and smaller than himself — an unrepentant troublemaker who left in him a bundle of emotions.

But that was nine years ago, when he was just a teenager. Upon his return, Hector finds the town transformed by the new duke's reign, and a Cadgan that has grown into a cold, distant mountain of a man. As he works as a healer and reignites a long-forgotten passion, Hector notices something other than love in the air.

The trees' roots stir with his every step.

Many historical starting scenarios bring you into the game world and let you bring your empire to glory. The single-resource economy lets the game appeal to casual players too.

title: Space Garbage
description: Do you like Tetris? Doesn't matter. Space Garbage is here to rotate Tetris 90 degrees on its head and add a little car to it. Blast and stack your way to the top of the leaderboard with this farm-to-table, indie, retro, solo, arcade... experience!

title: Christmas Clash
description: Help Santa claus and his christmas elfs to stop the angry babies, toddlers, and kids. Use strategy and management to secure the road to the workshop.

title: Auto Auto: Maximum Autodrive In The Alien Apocalypse
description: Oh no! Aliens have taken over! All of humanity is a hive mind with one goal... to destroy the last person standing! Drive, drift, and shoot your way through the onslaught before the aliens decide to deal with their little problem themselves. How long will your spirit keep the last person alive?

title: System Override
description: System Override is a first-person, single player heist game where you play as a hacker clearing a route through a variety of traps that block the way of your non-playable companion on the field.

title: Inari
description: INARI is a high-speed kunai action platformer set in an Eastern fantasy world. You are an executioner sent to hunt down the Seven Daughters who dared defy the mighty Lord. Engage in rapid, relentless combat using kunai and instant teleportation. Face overwhelming odds with a single life.

title: Wizard's Beard
description: Explore locations, fight enemies, cast spells, and repeat! What more could you want in a game?

title: Sofi Origins
description: Sofi Origins is an adventure, suspense, and horror game in which you play as Sofi, a girl with a very sad past, but who in her world has powers. Alongside Sofi, you will experience fear and sadness in a unique way. You will have to use your skills and stay focused to confront the past.

title: Sympathia
description: 『Dodge × Beat』 Enjoy the world of sympathia in rhythm!

title: The Wizard Party
description: The Wizard Party is a whimsical adventure game where all dialogue options are physics objects that interact with each other!

title: Magnavody
description: Experience the magic and weirdness of the world's first home video console, the Magnavox Odyssey, lovingly recreated for modern hardware.

title: Rivals' Duel
description: Act fast, duels are fierce. Opponents will not wait a second to defeat you, accelerate your mind and face them with your swords and guns

title: Undead Mayhem
description: Undead Mayhem is a survival horror fps game where you will try to survive for as long as possible while fighting waves of bloodthirsty monsters coming to kill you!

title: Gombo
description: Explore, build, fight and survive in an enchanting cartoon world! Take control of Gombo, your very own animated character, and adventure through a beautiful, yet unforgiving world full of dangers and surprises.

title: Hannah VCR
description: Solve the mysteries that are locked within Hannah's videotapes by changing the order and color of obstacles inside a retro videogame.

title: Bubble Chicken Farm
description: Bubble Chicken Farm offers an immersive game experience where adventure, farm management, and magic merge to create a world full of possibilities. Discover the joy of being a pirate farmer and create your own legend at Bubble Chicken Farm.

title: Fimbul's Gemboree
description: Collect Gems, explore worlds, and party hardy. You’ll do it all in Fimbul’s Gemboree- a fast-paced adventure platformer. Play as Fimbul, a little ice dragon, and help him run, jump, and roll across lands to collect items that will let him into the best party on the block.

title: Undertale: Mad Mew Mew Port
description: Undertale: Mad Mew Mew Port is an Undertale fangame by DeadDuck. The game is a recreation of the Mad Mew Mew boss battle from the Nintendo Switch version of Undertale, making it playable on both PC and Android.

title: Terraformers: New Frontiers
description: The ‘New Frontiers’ DLC for Terraformers adds the option to found outposts on other celestial bodies in the Solar System. Explore the dangerous atmosphere of Venus, adapt to the massive gravity field of Jupiter or research the mysterious rings of Saturn.

title: Class of Heroes 2G: Remastered Edition
description: Are you ready to take on dark winding dungeons crawling with magic and monsters? Prepare yourself for a remastered classic dungeon crawler, full of exploration, combat, and endless opportunities.

title: Where the Music Dies: Mirror of Regret
description: Two new supporting characters. Several strange new people to interact with. A new area, the dark twisted funfair, to explore.

title: Niels Penguin Adventure
description: Help Niels save his love, Lisa, from the cunning Professor Travis in this thrilling adventure game! Ready for an exciting chase with the villain? Play now on Steam!

title: Speed-Deus-Ex-Machine
description: "SPEEDUS" is a competitive card battle game based on the classic card game "Speed." Quickly play cards from your hand that follow the numbers on the field! Use skills and abilities! The first player to play all cards from their deck and hand wins!

title: Screw Drivers
description: Crazy physics and high-speed races! Craft vehicles cleverly by combining building blocks and mechanical parts to create powerful drivetrains. Unlock new parts, race for the gold, and challenge your friends in multiplayer.

title: Horizon Springs
description: Live your dreams in Horizon Springs – an open world of limitless possibilities. Build, explore, and shape your destiny in alternate paradise. Make a name for yourself in Horizon Springs.

title: Once First-Person Adventure
description: Once First-Person Adventure is a first-person action adventure game set in a post-apocalyptic setting. As a volunteer, you go to conduct an unscheduled inspection of power plant points.

title: Redneg AllStars Swing-By Edition
description: From the developer of Cosmo Dreamer and Like Dreamer, "Outside", this is a fantastical and comical boss-rush bullet-hell shooting game remade from a free game. Both beginners and experts can enjoy the intense boss rush!

title: Spin Up
description: This is a climbing action adventure game. The player has fallen to a certain planet and must use punching and spinning to reach the top.

title: Waiting in the Lime Forest
description: Face your friend's twisted mind and do your best. You should stay sane until the end.

title: Apocalypse Party
description: "Apocalypse Party" is a 3D top-down action Roguelike game. It's the brand-new sequel to "Plague Project Zero"! A new mission has begun! You will travel to the medieval era, where you'll gradually master firearms, melee weapons, magic, cursed witchcraft, summoning, and more. Through your choices, equip yourself to become the ultimate survivor. Before the apocalypse arrives, have one last wild celebration with your teammates!

title: Roguelike Adventures and Dungeons
description: Do you like roguelike dungeon crawling games? Or exploring Minecraft world for dungeons and structures for loot? Tired of all that tech stuff and just want more fun? Then this pack is for you. It is completely focused on adventuring and exploration, looting and fighting. Fight you way through the dungeons, improve your skills and gear, complete quests and conquer new undiscovered dangerous dimensions. There is no time to relax because as you grow stronger, gathering better equipment mobs will also gain health and becomes stronger!

title: Mitsugasero! Joon-chan!!
description:
Yorigami Joon is a plague goddess who loves money and goods.
This is a game where you just pay tribute to Joon-chan.

title: Drmwrldgrl
description:
Emmett is a regular girl, she lives a regular life and doesn't have many complaints.
Nova is a demon made from ash and bone.
One day they meet.

title: Mamiya: DoomsDayDreams
description: Mamiya: DoomsDayDreams is the thrilling final part of the dark mystery visual novel Mamiya, in which in which a group of young men struggle against existential dread before the end of the world.

title: Novopangea
description: Novopangea is a multi-player economy style strategy game. The game is designed around real world mechanics such as renting land, owning a business and completing jobs. Novopangea is set in a fantasy world comprised of six realms, each with their own story and lore and cast of characters.

title: Noisz: Episode G
description: Noisz Episode G is the second story expansion for Noisz, exploring the tale of Gaius Antiphon long before the events of Ignition and re:||VERSE with 6 brand-new stages! Challenge new and old content with the tricky mechanics of Proto Style, further expanding your Style Lab possibilities, and earn more achivements and titles!

title: Succubus Simulator
description: Succubus Simulator is an episodic visual novel. It is NSFW, very queer, and sex positive. Go in expecting a complete fuckery of gender norms, a bit of plot, an emphasis on consent, and lots of coding bugs. It explores kinks like femdom, pet play, S&M, and more.

title: Rauol
