‎Take the coolest parts from the Five Nights at Freddy's series, put them together and boom- you've got FNaF Ultimate Edition!
With its own story (differentiating from the original series' plot) and some unique game mechanics (on top of the originals you're familiar with), this game is worth giving a try if you're looking for something in the style of Classic FNaF!

title: The Lost Key
description: The task before you is very big, but you are not one of those who give up, it is your time, get up and move and retrieve the key.

title: Return: Unknown
description: Welcome to Return: Unknown, a survival-adventure game set in a post-apocalyptic Manhattan. Once a thriving metropolis, now abandoned by civilization after the outbreak of a global virus, it offers both challenges and countless possibilities.

title: Ja'afar's nightmare
description: Ja'afar is a little kid who is been through an accident lately ... a car accident ... he survived with all his family members for sure but the accident affected him and for the first time of his life he experiences a weird but unique nightmare ... you have to reach the end of this nightmare.

title: Angry Piggies Space
description: Angry Piggies Rio is back with a brand new series! Shoot Angry Bad Piggies on targets and winn all levels! Use different elements to help the piggies reach their destination. Bad Piggies Online is free and no registration needed!

title: Point Click Killer: Act Two
description:
Detective Clarke is on the case and hunting the serial killer from the first Point Click Killer game of the series. Can you track down and catch the killer?

Point Click Killer: Act Two is a horror, point & click, gory adventure game that picks up where you left off in the first game. Good luck!

title: Lar
description: Lar is a horror-themed puzzle game currently being developed by one person using Unreal Engine 5.

title: Fetish Locator Week Three
description: The last chapter of Fetish Locator is finally here! Our girls are returning for one last ride filled with seduction and a lot of sex! Try to uncover all mysteries surrounding the Fetish Locator App. Romance more than 20 girls and discover more secrets as you shape the conclusion of your story in Fetish Locator Week 3.

title: Part Time Job
description: Part Time Job is a My Little Pony: Friendship is Magic Visual Novel developed by Yumi-And-ZB, also going by Samuel Kingsley. You play as pegasus mare Pastel Sketch, who is going through financial issues due to her artwork not earning her enough money. Looking for a part time job, she goes to the town bulletin board; among several choices she decides she wouldn't be good at, there's an ad for working at a hospital. Turns out it's a mental hospital, run by Fluttershy. Deciding she needs the rather large payment of thirty thousand bits, Pastel takes the job. She'll wish she hadn't. The game is based off of the song Wide Knowledge of the Late Madness.

title: Test Test Test
description:
Test Test Test is a retro pixel-art point-and-click puzzle adventure where you must escape a time loop as an overworked office employee.
Find clues, gather information, and solve cryptic puzzles with alternate reality game elements.
Will you be able to release yourself from the clutch of time itself? Or will you be stuck in this reality forever?

title: Goddess of Hentai
description: A mature puzzle game with 4K hentai goddesses, beautiful piano soundtrack and two difficulty modes.

title: Subsurface
description: Subsurface is a 1–4 player online co-op underwater horror game where players dive into abandoned underwater facilities to recover valuable scrap, meet demanding quotas, and survive terrifying creatures lurking in the depths. Explore, scavenge, and escape together—but beware, not everyone makes it back to the surface.

title: Furry Girl Puzzle
description: A logical game in which your task is to collect puzzles and open the pictures with furry girls.

title: Story of the Blanks
description:
Story of the Blanks is a My Little Pony: Friendship is Magic fan-made game made by Donitz in the style of traditional 8-bit games.

It follows Apple Bloom as she wanders away from Twilight Sparkle in the Everfree Forest and happens upon a village full of ponies preparing for a party. She's invited to come in and enjoy herself, and aside from the fact that none of them have Cutie Marks or even know what Cutie Marks are, everything seems wonderful and straightforward...

...until she discovers what lies within the fireplace, and learns of their terrible secret.

title: Cow Life Sim RPG
description: A Life Simulation game with heavy RPG elements where you play as a Cow exploring, leveling up, and completing quests.

title: Journey to the End
description: Stigandr, a man in the winter wilderness, battles the unforgiving cold as he marvels at the beauty of the frozen landscape. His determination pushes him through the freezing temperatures, which threaten to overwhelm him completely. The emotionally driven story weaves through the harsh truths of the wintery wilderness that Stigandr once admired.

title: Grunn
description: A gardener gets hired to do some maintenance work over the weekend. The tall grass needs to be cut, the wild hedges trimmed, and the dead flowers could use some water. A simple task, but strangely some tools are missing…The owner of the garden isn't around, and their house is off-limits. Perhaps new tools can be found in the mysterious town, or maybe some of the reserved townsfolk have seen them?

title: NoisyDiarrhea
description: NoisyDiarrhea is a 32 Map speed megawad made for the 2018 NaNoWADMo challenge, a trial held last November to generate a 32 map megawad in the span of only one month. NoisyDiarrhea is what came out of me during that time.

title: Short Maps for Short People
description: A collection of 32 vanilla speedmaps.

title: Short Maps for Short People 2
description: This is the prequel of SMFSP1 by Datacore. The project consists to 32 speedmaps.

title: Short Maps for Short People 3
description: SMFSP 3 is a megawad of 33 speedmaps made in 10-15 minutes.

title: SeesawC 2
description: Second installment in the SeesawC series.

title: TBmsTF
description: TBmsTF, which stands for The Button Machine Sees The Future, similar to TGsEE and TBmHC, is a teaser game for Five Nights at Treasure Island Remastered 4.0

title: New Vegas Bounties I
description:
New Vegas Bounties I is the first chapter in a series set in the Mojave Wasteland of Fallout: New Vegas. The player is tasked with finding and eliminating the region's most nefarious outlaws, killers, and thieves. Along the way, the player will encounter a collection of unique, fully voiced characters, including the gregarious Steven Randall.

The player can also expect violent confrontations, numerous cultural references, and an abundance of colorful dialogue. New Vegas Bounties also includes a narrative that unfolds as the player completes more missions, culminating in a climactic showdown with a shadowy nemesis.

title: New Vegas Bounties II
description:
New Vegas Bounties II is the second installment in my bounty hunting series, and picks up immediately after the uncertain ending of New Vegas Bounties I.

Deprived of the sponsorship of Randall & Associates, the player must now assert himself (or herself) as a solo contractor for the NCR. As such, the player can now pursue bounties in any order, and is not obligated to follow a linear questline.

Gunfighters, thieves, rapists, and traitors are among the quarries available to an enterprising bounty hunter. However, the player can also expect a new bevy of ambushers and assassins bent on reckoning with the player for past deeds.

With Marko still at large, the player will be compelled to track down former associates and relatives of the nefarious renegade. In doing so, he/she will ultimately find himself/herself in a rugged world space outside the Mojave, face to face with his/her most dangerous target yet.

title: The Inheritance
description:
Having learned of the Courier's exploits, a dying man contacts the player in hopes of employing him/her to deliver a mysterious package. Upon accepting the job, the Courier will soon find himself/herself making unwilling allies and dangerous enemies, all jockeying to claim the same prize.

The Inheritance is a compact, lore-friendly quest mod for Fallout New Vegas, designed to offer new avenues to experience combat and role-playing for high-level characters.

title: Russell
description: When a scarred bounty hunter recruits the Courier to assist in tracking down an infamous scalp-hunter, he/she immediately becomes wrapped up in a prolonged hunt for a ruthless, calculating target.

title: King of the Ring
description: King of the Ring features an ill-conceived, haphazard attempt to render structured, professional pugilism in the Mojave Wasteland. It mostly contains bouts of arbitrary flailing with no particular purpose beyond enhancing the libido of casual observers.

title: New Vegas Killer
description: New Vegas Killer features a zany, compact questline that is geared towards players with bad karma. Specifically, it offers a questline based on the premise that the player has joined Judge Richter at the conclusion of New Vegas Bounties I. It is not an official addition to my quest mod series, but is merely the equivalent of a What If? spinoff.

title: Bad Mothafucka
description: Are you tired of the same old banal blather offered by your current companions? Are you looking for a deep, meaningful relationship with a complex, challenging individual? Are you looking for answers to life's most daunting questions? Then look no further than Bad Mothafucka, the result of years of toil and research, all conducted with one singular purpose in mind: to provide the ultimate companion for Fallout: New Vegas.

title: New Vegas Bounties III
description:
With the Mojave Wasteland purged of its most dangerous elements, the Courier is soon contacted by a mysterious figure, setting in motion a chain of events that will challenge the player as never before.

Largely set in the snow-laden Deep Creek Mountains of Utah, New Vegas Bounties III pits the player against a range of new enemies, all while compelling him/her to work with new and familiar allies alike. The mod concludes with a legendary showdown between the player and the most dangerous man alive: Marko.

title: The Better Angels
description: The Better Angels is a small quest mod that is intended to wrap up various plot threads from the Someguy Series. It includes elements and characters from planned but now-cancelled projects like Sinners and Slaves and The Siege of Firebase Zulu. It is a lean project that I produced in a few weeks, so it is free of side quests and the usual array of dialogue options. It is tight and relatively brief, but it should provide a greater sense of closure for several characters and the series as a whole.

title: Bullring
description: The ring filled with crazy monster and creatures. Chose your fighting style, face off with these brutal things and the real bosses of the arena!

title: The Apple of Our Time
description: An indie RPG where you need to aim your attacks.

title: Raising the Bar: Salvation
description: Salvation sees the player take control of Grigori immediately after bidding Gordon farewell following the quarry holdout. Whilst his journey continues forwards, Grigori must now work backwards in an effort to not only leave Ravenholm behind, but cleanse it such that no parasites remain. You'll tread familiar ground made unfamiliar by the effects of Gordon's path through the town, combined with the riled-up zombie hordes out in full force, and new pathways Grigori will take to complete his exodus. Pyres will deliver some of Grigori's once-friends to a better place, and also play their part in igniting a flame that will sweep through Ravenholm. By the time you've reached the end of the mod, the entire town will be up in flames and scorched by your actions.

title: Coffee Buns
description:
Coffee Buns is an 18+ Transformation Visual Novel set after the events of Mice Tea. It's been two years since since the worldwide release of Kemono Tea, which turns the people who drink it into anthropomorphic animals. Society is still adjusting to the idea of real-life furries, but that doesn't mean you can skip your day-job.

Leonardo Bianco is a barista at a struggling café. His boss feels like hopping on the furry train might be just the thing to attract customers to the floundering business. Via a connection at another local business (which some returning readers might recognize), Leo and his co-workers are offered a chance to try transforming themselves. The tea works as advertised, but for Leo, there's more changes he didn't anticipate.

title: SomnaBuster
description:
If the dream is real to you, it is worth fighting for!

Accounting student Macy is down on her luck and out of her mind, but her life of hum-drum is abruptly interrupted by a visit from a mysterious firefly. After stumbling down a seemingly endless hole, she wakes up in a strange new world. With an explosive broom in tow, Macy sets out discover the mysteries of Esperanto and find her way home.

title: Dream Island: A Skyward Journey
description: Master tricky jumps, outwit prowling lions, and conquer a challenging world across two distinct islands!

title: What Body?
description: 'What Body?' is a short clicker game, where you clear your room and befriend Mr. Policeman! Made for 20 Second Game Jam 2023.

title: Ritual of Raven
description: Ritual of Raven is a cozy farming game that lets you be creative in a witchy world by empowering you to dip your toes into the magic of coding. You will meet lots of quirky characters that you can befriend and trade with. You will be able to enchant magical creatures to help you grow the ingredients for your spells. And of course you can be creative, decorate your farm and explore the magical world around you.

title: Relics: The Recur of Origin
description: Relics: The Recur Of Origin is a remake of Bothtec's original Relics which expands the story of the original game and models the gameplay after CRPGs such as Diablo. Utilizing an isometric viewpoint, the combat occurs in real time and the spirit is controlled via a mouse.

title: Oven Dodgers
description: Oven Dodgers is a third-person low poly arcade platformer inspired by historic testimonies.

title: Playtown 2
description: Playtown 2 is a first person adventure horror game that takes place inside an indoor children's playground. Continue the journey to uncover the mysteries filled with challenging puzzles and deadlier enemies. This time .. you won't survive, as Hump-tump is not someone that takes kindly to strangers.

title: Infestation: Origins
description: A co-op horror in which you're an exterminator treating sinister infestations caused by twisted versions of classic characters and urban legends.

title: HalOpe
description:
An angelic RPGMaker game about breaking cycles, exploration, trading items, slight obtuseness, and finding hope.

Explore 4 colorful worlds and meet dozens of cute characters along the way. Learn about their lives as well as your own. Maybe you can even help some of them... But remember, not everything can be so easily fixed.

title: City 7: Toronto Conflict
description: City 7: Toronto Conflict, is an action packed Half-Life 2 mod with a variety of unique levels and game play. Explore what has become of City 7 in areas like Dundas square, Eaton Center , Mel Lastman square, St. Michael's Hospital and TTC system under the Combine rule. This version features Gordon Freeman as the main character, stuck in Toronto due to a teleporting accident in Kleiner's lab. Try to escape this war torn city by finding any type of teleporting technology and send him back to City 17.

title: Quiet Rehabilitation
description: Quiet Rehabilitation is a FREE Half-Life 2 single-player modification that tells a different story of Gordon Freeman being taken prisoner directly to Nova Prospekt. In this alternate route, without meeting Barney, he must find a way to escape from this old facility heavily guarded by Combine forces and surrounded by unusual creatures.

title: Galactic Foodtruck Simulator 2999
description: Submission to the DOS Games End of Year Jam 2023 on Itch.io. The year is 2999. The galaxy hungers. You heard their cries and you bought the foodtruck. Now you have 40 weeks to establish a thriving mobile restaurant business and begin paying back your creditors, or have your mind erased by the dreaded Repos.

title: To Altare
description: A small platformer fan game where you bounce your way up to find Altare.

title: Carl the Caveman
description: In this arcade game you have to help a caveman find all the mushrooms and collect all the jewels in the maze. This needs to be done as carefully as possible - some levels are inhabited by both monsters and poisonous toadstools, who themselves are not averse to trying to eat a gaping mushroom picker.

title: Carl the Caveman: Christmas Adventures
description:
Every year on Christmas Eve, Santa Claus leaves his house with gifts addressed to all children. But a great misfortune happened: the snowman decided to ruin the holiday and stole every single gift! And to make it more difficult to find them, he scattered them across ice caves and snow-covered rocks.

Now saving the holiday depends only on you. You will control a smiling and cute troglodyte, hit the road and collect all the scattered gifts of Santa Claus. But be extremely careful! You can crash on sharp ice, get caught in a stone bag and a bunch of other troubles.

title: Night Cafe
description: Educational CD-ROM game for Windows 3.1/95 and Macintosh.

title: Truck Driver: The American Dream - Freedom to Roam
description:
Unload your cargo and soak in breathtaking panoramic vistas with the new Freedom-to-Roam mode. This feature offers the perfect escape for those seeking a more laidback truck driving experience, providing an unstructured way of playing Truck Driver: The American Dream.

With the Freedom-to-Roam update, players will have access to new job opportunities they can take on whenever they like, gaining experience and advancing in the trucking world on their own terms. Every town, city, gas station, and rest stop will present randomly generated missions of varying difficulties, sending players to deliver cargo across the map.

title: Gotham Knights: Heroic Assault
description: Heroic Assault is a gameplay mode that is separate from the main story campaign. The standalone mode supports up to four players in online co-op and provides a dedicated arena-like environment with specific objectives to complete and enemies to defeat on each floor (30 floors total).

title: Deep Vault 69
description: Might I say, you're looking fit as a fiddle! And this is not surprising, because you are one of the survivors in a comfortable vault! But it's time to get to the surface to explore the world. Well, or try to do it!

title: Shep Hard
description: Keep your flock safe in this extreme shepherding game. Your goal is to raise 10 platinum sheep. You'll need to grow your plot, smack away wolves, shear your sheep, and eventually lay down mortar towers and turrets to get it done in this insane blend of Tower Defense and King of the Hill.

title: Rage: Anger Management
description: The Realm of Rage was a secret place, hidden from the eyes of mortals and gods alike. It was created by an ancient wizard, whose name was lost to time, as a sanctuary for himself and his fellow adventures. There, they could unleash their anger and frustration on anything they desired, without fear of consequences or death.

title: Body of Work
description:
A short interactive fiction game about the opening night of an art gallery.

CW: Descriptions of gore, body horror, & light sexuality.

title: The Game Maker
description:
The Game Maker is the 18th game in the Carol Reed series.

The game is 100% mouse driven and features a classic adventure game interface.
There is absolutely no need to have played any of the previous games in the Carol Reed series to fully enjoy The Game Maker.

The game takes place is Sweden, but it is in English. All dialogues have subtitles.
The game contains no graphic violence or any swearing. It has no action elements, and is suitable for ages 15 and up.

title: Super Smash Bros. Ultimate: The Alucard Moveset
description: A mod which adds Alucard as a playable character to Super Smash Bros. Ultimate, with a moveset based on Castlevania: Symphony of the Night.

title: Super Smash Bros. Ultimate: Ninten Moveset
description: A mod which adds Ninten to Super Smash Bros. Ultimate, along with his moves from EarthBound Beginnings.

title: On Christmas He Will Return Home
description:
An experimental visual novel about abusive relationships (with prophetic destiny.)

A woman awaits for her love to return on Christmas.

With every day, his return becomes more inevitable.

title: Rat Wars Survivors
description: Rat Wars Survivors was released by industrial noise band Health to promote their sixth album, Rat Wars. It is an homage to Vampire Survivors.

title: Origami Solutions
description: In "Origami Solutions," every choice folds a new path in the clandestine world of power, loyalty, and family ties. Uncover the secrets, confront the dilemmas, and shape the fate of Adam.

title: Project 13
description:
Welcome to Project 13, a unique Walking Simulator that challenges your perception and instincts in a dystopian world. In this immersive experience, you step into the shoes of a disposable Probant, devoid of rights and a future, tasked with navigating a mysterious, repeating Hospital Corridor.

Your objective is clear: report any anomalies encountered during your walks. The catch? A single mistake means starting anew. Only by consistently reporting accurately can you progress through the enigmatic corridors.

title: Pokémon: Abstract Version
description:
Pokémon: Abstract Version is a fanmade game using rpgmaker that features a fully open world region with:
- 11 Settlements
- 28 Wild Areas
- 4 Provinces (Tranquill, Strife, Carnage, and Vigor)
- Gyms/Story Events that can be done in any order
- 18 New Pokémon
- 8 New Megas
- New tiles
- Fully Custom UI
- Level scaling
- Difficulty modes
- HM Items that open up new areas
- A full story

title: Deep Space Waifu: DLC
description: Academy themed DLC for the first Deep Space Waifu game, containing new levels.

title: Night-Runners Prologue
description: Descend into the underworld of Japanese street racing. Set between 1990-2009, join the local street racing crews in their battle for territory control. Explore the real location open world, compete in wager races, battle other crews and upgrade your vehicles with detailed car customization.

title: Freakhunter
description: First person 640x480 resolution throwback dungeon crawler.

title: Double Dragon
description: The explosive NES original game that sparked the worldwide fame of beat them all games: Double Dragon!!

title: Robocop vs. Predator
description:
Robocop is involved in an awesome adventure against Predator, but the terrible alien is not the only problem that he'll face. More troubles from the future are coming, but some friends also, to fight this final war and save the future of the human race!

This game is a lovely tribute to the cult movies of 80s and 90s. If you loved them as my team, you'll like this little gem we made for you.

title: Fourville
description:
On the day of the Great War, the residents of Salem made their way to the shelter of Vault 4. Only those registered in the vault programme were granted entrance. Some refugees reasoned that if they could wait out the twenty-year closure period, which Vault-Tec had advertised, then they would be able to find shelter when the vault opened.

More than two-hundred years later the town had changed a lot. A town grew up inside the cave outside the vault, its houses made from reclaimed Vault-Tec equipment and built into the walls of the cave which have been dug out as generations of residents tried to get inside the vault.

When the Sole Survivor arrives at Fourville the town is in the middle of an election where the vault has become a major point of contention. The town's incumbent mayor believes the vault will open one day, and has made this the focal point of his campaign. His challenger believes the vault is holding the town back and attempts to get inside should be abandoned. The Sole Survivor's involvement can shift the scale and change the face of the community forever.

title: Maxwell's World
description:
Located just a few miles from Boston, Maxwell’s World was once a place of joy. The biggest amusement park in the country, Mister Maxwell dedicated his fortunes and life to making everyone’s time at Maxwell’s World as happy as possible. Then the bombs fell and it all went to shit.

Now, the park lies open, shrouded in legend and danger. A thousand myths say that Maxwell hid a treasure, deep inside the control center of the park, just waiting to be reclaimed by some wasteland.

Unfortunately, a thousand more myths say that something happened to Maxwell’s World. They tell tales of shambling skeletons in the park that attack anything in sight, robots that find you and force-feed you hot dogs, of the rides coming to life and devouring those inside. There are some that say that Maxwell traded his soul to keep the park running, and not even the apocalypse stopped that.

All anyone knows, is that whoever enters Maxwell’s World, never leaves. Because the park isn’t just open. It’s alive.

title: Double Dragon II: The Revenge
description: The PC Engine CD version of Double Dragon II by Naxat Soft is surprisingly modeled closely after the NES game, from featuring mostly the same levels down to the rule of having no more than two enemies on screen at a time. But it does mix and match different types together, and in general extends the stages with additional hoodlums. There are a few other notable structural differences – namely, the fight on the huge moving bulldozer at the end of the forest level is missing, but to make up for its omission, the Lee brothers actually have to fight Willy before they meet their own shadows like in the arcade game. They also get to face the Shadow Master (now without the cape) on any difficulty level, although you miss out on the second round in a church and the good ending with Marion revived unless you beat the game on the Hard difficulty mode.

title: Infinite Labyrinth
description: A rouge-lite video game created for the TSA 2021 State Competition in which you explore a randomly generated dungeon.

title: Hentai Girls: Contact
description: The popular hentai puzzle franchise has reached a new level, now with visual novel elements! More than 20 naked pictures of AAA quality, various mechanics, female moans, three difficulty levels, gallery, 100 achievements, relaxing music and beautiful graphics

title: PUBG: Battlegrounds - Season 27
description: A new rotation strategy after careful consideration of player feedback regarding our map rotation system. Rotations will now vary between map selection and random map regions.

title: The VHS Paradise
description: You are Robert, the cashier from The VHS Paradise. Your job is to serve customers on the night shift, but be careful! There is a lot of crime in the city and all kinds of crazy people on the loose.

title: Deep State
description: Deep State, a first person shooter inspired by classic games such as Goldeneye 007, Deus Ex, and Resident Evil.

title: Gotham Knights: Heroic Assault: The Kelvin Incident
description: The Kelvin Incident is a new Heroic Assault adding a 15-floor raid , Mythic gear, a new suit transmog, 4 new batcycle transmogs, and new stronger enemies.

title: Doom Eternal: The Ancient Gods - Expansion Pass
description:
You pulled humanity back from the edge of extinction, but it came at a cost, leaving an imbalance of power in the cosmos that threatens all of creation. The soul of the universe hangs in the balance.

The Ancient Gods Expansion Pass includes both campaign expansions for the critically acclaimed DOOM Eternal.

The Ancient Gods - Part One
The legions of Hell have razed the heavens, threatening to expand across dimensions. Battle your way back to Urdak and decide the fate of the cosmos. Your mission is now your own.

The Ancient Gods - Part Two
Defy the gods and awaken an ancient evil in the epic conclusions to the DOOM Slayer’s saga. Rally the scattered Sentinel armies, lay siege to the last bastion of Hell, break through the fortress walls and face the Dark Lord himself.

title: Honkai Impact 3rd: Sublime Spring
description:
Version 3.7 of Honkai Impact 3rd, which includes:
• New Valkyrie: Azure Empyrea (Fu Hua)
• New ELF: Book of Fuxi
• New Featured Event: Empyrean Legends
• ...and more!

title: Hate Me Not
description:
A roguelike twin-stick shooter, where you defend the same thing that tries to hurt you.
Venture into the side of darkness to defeat enemies before they reach the Yin-Yang.
Switch to the side of light to gather ammo and upgrades, before the time runs out and the next wave of monsters spawn.

title: A Wolf In Sheep's Clothing
description: A Wolf In Sheep's Clothing is a murder-mystery visual novel that takes place in a French high school. You play as Mercredi, an aloof teenage girl who finds that her life is quickly and continuously going awry when your friend goes missing.

title: Give Up Robot 2
description: This sequel takes the jumping, grappling and swinging insanity of the original and adds jetpacks, conveyor belts, electrified blocks, lasers, rockets, moving blocks, bosses and more. You will have to have patience and perseverance to make it through the 60 levels in Normal mode and the punishing 12 additional levels in Hard mode. Good luck, and don't give up.

title: My Grandparent's House
description: My Grandparent's House is a first-person survival horror experience where you must play as a ten year old boy exploring a horrifying house and unraveling the mystery that lies within. Every game intends to be unique, as puzzle solutions, item placement and a part of the house are randomized. Unlock ten story-driven documents and six unique endings.

title: Sonic CD: Miracle Edition
description:
As the earliest remastered of the classic Sonic Titles, Sonic CD has fewer changes and features compared to later remasters and Origins.

The purpose of this mod is to bring Sonic CD more in-line with the later remasters/Origins by adding several new features/options originally available in other mods.

title: Ground Zero Hero
description: Kill mutants. Absorb their remains. Mutate into something stronger every run. Stack insane power combos and survive overwhelming hordes in this fast, chaotic, highly replayable action roguelite bullet hell.

title: At Night
description: Experience the horror of 'At Night', a horror-survival game where you face creatures and demons. Play online in co-op multiplayer with up to 4 players. Conquer fears, gather resources, and defy the shadows of the night – an intense horror experience awaits!

title: Angry Anna: Christmas Quest
description: You're Angry Anna, the most angriest girl of the world who's having now a very bad christmas and you decided to heist santa for get your real present.

title: My Friend the Spider
description: A small "horror" narrative game about isolation and depression.

title: Angry Anna: Halloween Quest 2
description: You're Anna Price, after your long trip in motorbike, you finally found the place for the Halloween Party, but your journey is not starting well...

title: Horo Nite: MelonMelody
description: Horo Nite: MelonMelody is a free unofficial fan project and a homage to the upcoming Hollow Knight Silksong made in Unity.

title: The Mystic Realm
description: A level pack for Sonic Robo Blast 2 with over 30 stages and many secrets to unlock. Famed for being one of the oldest SRB2 mods.

title: Under the Wakzoo
description:
Under the Wakzoo is side view and Roguelite Shooter game. This game is a fan game by YouTuber Woowakgood.
You can obtain various items and guns. Fight monsters in the underground to obtain items and progress through stages by defeating bosses. Ultimately, you must defeat the final boss to save the world.

title: Sonic Robo Blast 2 Infinity
description: A total conversion mod for Sonic Robo Blast 2 that changes its gameplay to resemble that of Phantasy Star Portable 2 Infinity.

title: Winter Games
description: Get ready for the most fish slinging, gnome hurling, slip sliding Winter Games you've ever seen! From launching gnomes from a catapult to sliding down a treacherous ice-run, theses games are more fun than anything you'll ever see in the Winter Olympics.

title: Pleased Aliens
description:
Short indie game with a few hidden memes!

Human civilization is in danger! Aliens visit the earth, and you must to please them... You must try hard to please them.

title: Fritz 5
description: Fritz is not just a chess playing monster. It is a friendly chess partner for beginners and amateurs. It will teach you to play chess from scratch, and can automatically adjust its playing strength to suit your needs. It will warn you when you go wrong in a game, giving you hints on how to play better. Fritz 5.32 (32-bit) is a great tool for any chess player desiring to achieve the FIDE Master title. The most useful tool is the "Analyze Game" option, which is like having a grandmaster sitting next to you reviewing your game for mistakes and improvements. Combine Fritz with ChessBase Light and you'll be set for your entire chess career short of the IM and GM titles!

title: Fritz 6
description:
Fritz 6 is a chess simulation which can be adjusted for beginners, advanced players and professionals. In comparison to Fritz 5 its graphics were revised and the menu got improved.

For beginners the game features several help functions, e.g. it explains all possible moves. When making a mistake the virtual coach comes up and helps. For advanced players there are many settings for the AI opponent to get the ideal training partner. The key parts of the programme are the extensive analysis functions. The database consists of 320.000 professional games and has an ELO rating of 2825.

title: Styrlitz 3: Agent USSR
description:
Styrlitz 3 is a comedic point-and-click adventure game. It is a parody of the popular Soviet television series Seventeen Moments of Spring about the exploits of a Soviet spy operating in Nazi Germany under the name Max Otto von Stierlitz. This is the third game in the series.

In this entry in the series, Styrlitz investigated a mysterious crash in space involving the soviet spacecraft with the first woman in space and a UFO.

title: Styrlitz 4: The Matrix - A Step to Death
description:
Styrlitz 4 is a comedic point-and-click adventure game. It is a parody of the popular Soviet television series Seventeen Moments of Spring about the exploits of a Soviet spy operating in Nazi Germany under the name Max Otto von Stierlitz. This is the fourth game in the series.

In this entry in the series, Styrlitz, now retired, receives a message from a white rabbit that informs him that not all nazis were defeated. The game mainly parodies The Matrix, but there are also references to other movies and TV shows of the 2000s.

title: Summer Games
description:
The PC-88 port of "Summer Games".

Summer Games allows up to eight players to compete in a series of summer themed Olympic events. The gameplay is similar to the other entries in Epyx "games" series. Each player can choose a country to represent, and then takes turns competing in various events to see who will win the gold medal! The game allows you to compete in all of the events sequentially, choose a few events, choose just one event, or practice an event. The events available vary slightly depending on the platform, and may include:
- Pole vault
- Platform diving
- 4x400 meter relay
- 100 meter dash
- Gymnastics
- Freestyle swimming
- Skeet shooting
- 100 meter freestyle
- Rowing

title: The 3rd Night
description: The 3rd Night was a short 3D experiment made in Construct 2 (using the Q3D plugin). It was made in around 15 days, just in time for the Haunted PS1's Horrifying Halloween game jam.

title: For The Entity
description:
Your designs have caught the attention of an unknown organization. They require you to print 120,000$ for their "client" by midnight. The time is 23:45.

You've printed a lot of cash for a lot of people, but this... What is this?

title: Fallout: Nuevo Mexico
description: Welcome to the Land of Enchantment. The year is 2166 - 5 years after the events of "Fallout: A Post Nuclear Role-Playing Game." Every choice made will revolutionize the future for better or worse. Built on the Fallout: New Vegas engine, this free full-on RPG based Modification brings you a brand-new Fallout experience.

title: Fia's Night Out
description:
Fia's mother just put her to bed, but Fia can't possibly rest like this! There's still so much to do! So many sights to see! So many desserts to eat!

Fia sneaks out to get what she wants and everything is normal.

title: Deep Rock Galactic: Special Edition
description: Deep Rock Galactic is a first-person co-operative sci-fi shooter for up to 4 players, featuring fully procedural and destructible environments to explore, mine, and explode your way through to reach your objectives. As a team of veteran dwarven space miners, you must take on perilous missions for the interplanetary mining corporation Deep Rock Galactic and go where no-one else dares, into the deepest, most dangerous cave systems of the most hostile planet ever discovered.

title: CRW 2
description: CRW 2 is a Strategy Mecha game sequel to CRW (Counter Rebellion Wars).

title: Meme Supreme
description: Welcome to the meme graveyard! Meme Supreme is a simple matching game with nostalgic meme references. Race against the clock to match all of the cards before the timer reaches zero! Do you have what it takes to reminisce these long-forgotten memes?

title: Tentacle Girl
description: Aoi and Sally, a treasure hunter, found a cave during the expedition. They foresee a treasure in it. So I decided to go in and take a look. Unexpectedly, this is a tentacled cave.

title: The F.A. Premier League Football Manager 2002
description: The F.A. Premier League Football Manager 2002 is a Sports game, published by Electronic Arts, which was released in Europe in 2001.

title: Lacey's Wardrobe
description: Lacey needs your help to find the best outfits for every occasion. Play dress-up Lacey and experience amazing moments with her!

title: Is It Wrong to Try to Pick Up Girls in a Dungeon? Familia Myth: Fulland of Water and Light
description: Is It Wrong to Try to Pick Up Girls in a Dungeon? Familia Myth: Fulland of Water and Light is an upcoming game from Bushiroad Games.

title: Hunter x Hunter: Nen x Impact
description:
Hunter x Hunter: Nen x Impact is a Hunter x Hunter fighting game,
Published by Bushiroad Games.

Choose your favorite Nen User characters for the 3V3 Team Battle!
The compatibility and order of the teammates are the keys to victory!
Build the strongest team and battle for victory!

title: Lilja and Natsuka: Painting Lies
description: "What are the colors of your heart?" The heartwarming story of Lilja, a blind painter, and Natsuka, her energetic assistant, who unravel the mysteries behind their clients' requests. An all-new visual novel presented by Frontwing."

title: Lilac
description: A fantasy visual novel adaptation of the stage play by Project Ricoro, about an interspecies academy story between mages and humans that depicts the “ordinary” within the “extraordinary.”

title: Dusk Index: Gion
description: Dusk Index: Gion is an upcoming psycho-suspense adventure game from Tokyo Dark creator Cherrymochi in collaboration with Bushiroad Games.

title: Virtual Girl @ World's End
description: A visual novel developed by HEADLOCK about Virtual YouTubers in an apocalyptic world.

title: Iroiro.
description: Slip out of your monochrome room, and listen to the stories told by the girls of various colors.

title: A Liminal Place Remaster
description: A Liminal Place RMSTER is a solitary game, and relaxing on some levels. ALPR Uses Body-Cam, Analog Horror and Found Footage style. Including realistic Liminal Spaces, and "Backrooms" levels.

title: A Vítima de Ouro
description: A Vítima de Ouro is a point-and-click mystery adventure where you follow Elisabeth Fleur, who's investigating the murder of millionaire Julius Absolom on the isolated Lighthouse Island.

title: Overdrive Warfare
description: Overdrive Warfare is a dark, gritty FPS shooter developed by the indie developer known as Dynamite. Immerse yourself in the gripping narrative of a harrowing modern-day conflict unfolding as global coalition forces unite against an insidious and unyielding enemy.

title: Ultimate Sim Series
description: This is a collection of 3 Maxis titles bundled together: SimCity 2000: Special Edition, Streets of SimCity, and SimCopter.

title: Escalator
description:
Escalator is escape room game like The Exit 8.
This is a horror game in which you must find something unusual while riding an escalator and try to escape from an enclosed space.

title: Kimekyawa: Genkai Beat-chan
description: Flatten cute monsters in a fun way!

title: Hasbro Classic Game Collection
description: A collection of video games based on four classic Hasbro board games: Monopoly, Monopoly: Here and Now, Risk, and Scrabble.

title: PopCap Greatest Hits
description: PopCap Greatest Hits is a physical bundle of Peggle Deluxe, Bejeweled 2 Deluxe, and Zuma Deluxe.

title: Manipulation
description:
Manipulation is a roguelite mini-RPG built like an escape room. It’s designed to be quick but challenging, small but immersive, and easily re-playable when you fail.

You play as a telepath trapped in a small facility whose only means of escape is to take control of the minds of the facility’s staff. The facility is aware of possible telepathic behaviour but is unaware you already have these powers.

You’ll need to be careful who you speak to, what you say, and how you act. Should the facility staff become too suspicious overall, you’ll be discovered. Unfortunately your powers are also very limited in your current state. You’ll have a limited amount of time in each mind. The stronger the mind, the less time you’ll have. Stay in a mind too long and you’ll cause a psychotic break, which will, of course, lead to your eventual discovery.

Balance your abilities to keep suspicion low, explore the facility, and uncover the truth about your existence as you find out how to escape from this unknown predicament.

title: Spatial Savior Biganger
description: CAN YOU EVEN ESCAPE? Battle against the endless horde of robots in the inescapable world inside the black hole! The clock is ticking!

title: Kumitantei: Old-School Slaughter
description: Kill each other...for science! The class of '89 is trapped in an elite school killing game. Investigate, solve, and expose your classmates in Kumitantei: Old-School Slaughter, an episodic murder-mystery ADV card-battler inspired by retro anime.

title: The Lost Signal: SCP
description:
"Lost Signal" agency investigates paranormal events from all around the world. You are one of the agents who participates in the research of various artifacts. Investigate paranormal activities in this 3D game which has great action and elaborate 3D graphics!

Interesting quests and creepy monsters await you! New artifacts or paranormal events in every update!

title: Friday Night Funkin': Random Wees Dave & Bambi Extended
description: Friday Night Funkin': Random Wees Dave & Bambi Extended is a mod directed and created by Sanco the fox, with the participation of juani clowny rabbit, Brick boy, LilyUwU, arten, and THE BIG BOSS lmao. The mod is a fan-made extension of Vs. Dave and Bambi.

title: YouTube Poop World
description:
Welcome to a world unlike ours.

This world is very unusual. It builds from the remains of our own civilization and, in a very odd twist, has many of its people based on characters that have made appearences in YouTube Poops! The world is run by an empire controlled by celebrities in the YTP Community, and its cities based on the ones seen in said poops.

Although the world seems peaceful, it is quite chaotic. I.M. Meen, of all people, has damaged the world's reputation by killing off bronies and making deals with other enemies to take over this fine world! It seems that the world has become a cesspool of sin...

title: Five Nights at Freddy's: In Real Time
description: You work the nightshift at Freddy Fazbear's Pizza looking out for the animatronics, now moving towards you in real time. Relive FNAF 1 with a moving animatronics camera system; but as we all know, the animatronics tend to wander a bit.

title: Mothers and Daughters
description: Mothers & Daughters is an adult visual novel in which you play as 18 year old Max (name customizable). Max worked hard to finish high school and passed with the relevant grades to get into a local college. There was one thing Max failed at in high school – losing his virginity. Can you help him with that?

title: Asha Empire Online
description: Asha Empire Online is a vast and dynamic gaming experience, seamlessly blending elements from strategy, first-person shooting (FPS), and role-playing (RPG) genres. Players initially embark on their journey on the planet Vita Nova, but the game's unique feature allows for interstellar exploration of other planets, space stations, and outposts. Vigilant forces from the empire ensure safe zones for peaceful interactions. In this game, players use Non-Fungible Tokens (NFTs) to represent their characters, with each NFT offering unique attributes and the ability to be traded among players. The primary goal is to complete tasks, gain experience, acquire assets, engage in battles, and explore. Resource production, organization management, and survival mechanics are key elements. All transactions within the game are conducted using the AEC currency, and owning an NFT character is required for full gameplay.

title: Fears to Fathom: Woodbury Getaway
description: In the fifth episode of Fears to Fathom you play as Sydney Harper, a 23-year-old working at a consulting firm plans a weekend getaway to a rental in Woodbury with her college friends. Little did they know what was about to unfold during their stay. Sydney survived as she made the right choices.

title: Cadenza: Fame, Theft and Murder - Collector's Edition
description: It's the height of the Fabulous Fifties in your hometown of Las Vegas, and life is good! Rock n' roll is king, and you're the new king of rock n' roll. You’re on top of the world! But you come tumbling down hard when a stranger crashes your concert and swaps places with you. Trapped in a strange body, wanted for murder, and on the run from the police, you're in a race against time to get your life back before the clock runs out! Can you reclaim your rock n' roll throne, or will this be your final encore?

title: Serapis Online
description:
Serapis Online, an MMORPG, intricately immerses players in the rich cultures of ancient China, Arabia, and Europe. Reviving the historical Silk Road—a vital trade route connecting Asia and Europe—Serapis Online offers a journey through forgotten tales of glory and adventure.

Embark on an exploration of a new world, brimming with engaging and ever-evolving adventures, as players experience the magic of ancient civilizations firsthand.

title: SimMania for Kids
description: A physical bundle of six Maxis games: SimTown, SimPark, SimSafari, SimTunes, Widget Workshop, and SimAnt.

title: EA Strategy Collection
description: This is a physical bundle of five EA games: The Lord of the Rings: Battle for Middle-Earth, Black and White 2, Black and White 2 - Battle of the Gods, Command & Conquer: Generals, and Command & Conquer: Generals - Zero Hour.

title: Artisan TD
description: Artisan TD is a Maze-style Tower Defense where you survive by building mazes on over 40 unique maps.

title: Hachu's Revenge
description: Fan-made game for HAchubby

title: Dogs Club
description: Dogs Club is a challenging parkour game that can be played in Singleplayer and Multiplayer. Complete the tracks in the fastest time and take yourself and your country to the top of the leaderboard.

title: The Sims Medieval: Limited Edition
description: This version of the Sims Medieval adds three themed throne rooms with Barbarian, Dark Magic and Princess themes as well as the Monarch and Executioner outfit sets.

title: 7 Wonders Trilogy
description: This is a trilogy of three games in the 7 Wonders series on one disc: 7 Wonders of the Ancient World, 7 Wonders II, and 7 Wonders: Treasures of Seven.

title: Carbrix
description: Carbrix is a sci-fi inspired multiplayer vehicle-building sandbox game where creativity meets action. Design and construct anything you can imagine—from sleek cars and powerful trucks to futuristic planes, bikes, and rockets.

title: Trampled Flower
description:
The game focuses on Quinn, a young teen wandering and sleeping in their room. But nothing is as it seems.

The plot is kept vague as It's up to the player to make their own conclusion and find the "truth" about these whole instances. A dream? Reality? Delusion? You decide.

title: RockMen X
description: A Mega Man X-style action game in which Iris plays an active role.

title: Resident Evil Demake
description:
Resident Evil Demake its like name says, the first Resident Evil made like running in a NES in 2D, the graphics and music have a 8bit style.
The main mode with Jill is a shooter game, similar to the original game but in 2D.
There's new game modes like one for Chris with some RPG features.
Many graphics are self-made, seeing the original game and making the sprites.
I also made new music for some scenes.

title: Meta-Ghost: The Breaking Show
description: Immerse yourself in the reality show — "Breaking Show", where you engage in real-time battles with various intelligent machines using cybernetic enhancements and weapons. Whether for personal gain or lofty ideals. Fight! Until you reach the final victory on this Roguelike journey.

title: Tamagotchi Adventure Kingdom
description:
From the most beloved virtual friends franchise of all time comes a new and wonderful journey for all the adventurers out there. Welcome to Tamagotchi Adventure Kingdom!

Join our adorable hero Mametchi as he travels far and wide across the world to solve problems, make friends, and use the power of happiness to restore the kingdom. Build and decorate your wilderness camp and invite your most loyal Tamagotchi companions to have fun together.

title: Yokai Ningen Bem: Aratanaru Tamashii No Meikyuu
description: Role-Playing game, developed and published by Vantan International, which was released in Japan in 1995.

title: Northrealm Tribes
description: "Northrealm Tribes" is an exciting strategy game that immerses you in the captivating world of the Vikings. In this game, you take on the role of a tribal leader and delve into the rugged and thrilling era of the Norsemen. Your task is to establish, expand, and protect a flourishing settlement while meeting the needs and desires of your inhabita...

title: The Respawn Banter
description: The Respawn Banter is an adventure and visual novel hybrid where you are bound to die during your exploration. In the afterlife, the goddess of life’s role extends beyond mere revival: she seizes every opportunity to humor the hero’s demise, making each encounter a one-of-a-kind witty exchange.

title: Agricola Revised Edition
description: Enter the life of medieval farmers! Enhance your farms to stone houses, breed your animals and stack food before the cold winters! So prepare yourself to plow, till and harvest your fields in the official digital adaptation of the acclaimed board game!

title: City of Heroes: Homecoming
description: City of Heroes: Homecoming is an officially licensed private server of the defunct game City of Heroes that features a wide variety of quality-of-life features such as custom XP rates, alignment switching at will, all costume parts available on character creation, all vestiges of the Paragon Store removed, and a new player archetype, Sentinels.

title: The Aids Avenger
description: The Aids Avenger is an unreleased educational game by Raya Systems for the SNES and PC. The game was made to teach kids about AIDS and HIV awareness.

title: Summer Night
description: From the creator of FAITH. Run around in your backyard picking toadstools and chasing monkeys in this LCD handheld game where nothing scary happens!

title: The Pay is Nice
description: Discover what happens in an ultra secure facility, as you get ready for work and wander the dark halls of your office. Using old school fixed-camera perspective, they're watching your every moves.

title: Carthanc
description: You play as an astronaut sent to the planet Carthanc on a top secret mission, hidden from the public. Is there life on Carthanc? If so, is it friendly? Can Carthanc sustain human life? Is it a viable candidate to terraform? Time for you to find out! You are tasked with collecting samples, filming footage, deploying tech, and determining if any life exists.

title: Mr Bucket Told Me To
description: The abandoned tools of your existence come back to haunt you in a surreal and terrifying tropical survival adventure.

title: Shopping Clutter 9: Perfect Wedding
description: Help the Walker family plan Mr. Rat's wedding in Shopping Clutter 9: Perfect Wedding.

title: Shopping Clutter 10: The Walkers Take the Stage
description: Shopping Clutter returns with the 10th chapter in this favorite clutter franchise!

title: Thrillville
description:
Experience Thrillville originally released on the PSP (PlayStationPortable) system, enhanced with up-rendering, rewind, quick save, and custom video filters.

Thrillville allows gamers of all ages to easily build and customize the coaster of your dreams. Gone are the days of the complex PC techniques used in other coaster games. Rather, Thrillville's easy to use building mode has been designed specifically for the console platforms and makes building all 75-plus rides from wooden, corkscrew and inverted coasters to merry go rounds, trains and carnival rides, easy, and most importantly, fun. Imagination is the only height limit with Thrillville, where the fun ranges from racing on go-kart tracks you put together and playing mini-golf on courses you designed to dozens of party games, from bumper cars to arcade shoot-'em-ups. You can also tour the park on foot - a first for theme-park titles - chatting and joking with all the guests to help them out and make sure they're enjoying themselves.

• Build, manage, ride, customize and socialize your way through the five theme parks you've created
• The simplest, most intuitive development tools available for all 75-plus ride types, from wooden, corkscrew and inverted coasters to merry-go-rounds, trains and all your favorite carnival rides
• Play classic midway games like bumper cars, saucer soccer, remote-control cars, shooting gallery, mini-golf, rhythm challenges, arcade-style shoot- em-ups and puzzlers
• Interact and develop a relationship with any guests you see - Listen to and address their unique concerns about your park, joke with them, and even help a guest impress his crush by winning that special prize
• Explore 15 different themed areas spread across five theme parks, such as Pirates Gone Wild, Gold Rush, Ancient Treasures of Egypt and Moon Base

title: Dead Rising 3: Day One 2013 Edition
description: This is a version of Dead Rising 3 released alongside the Xbox One as a launch title. This version features a silver background front cover and exclusive tribute packs to Frank West and Chuck Greene.

title: Ski Simulator: Winter Sports
description: In "Ski Simulator: Winter Sports," players are on a quest to earn points and unlock new levels by mastering the art of skiing or snowboarding. Navigate through the exhilarating slopes, collecting checkpoints along the way to progress further in the game. But beware, time is of the essence – the clock is ticking, and every second counts!

title: Upward
description: Try to stay alive for as long as possible, by avoiding various enemies and obstacles while collecting as many apples as your heart desires. Play against friends, unlock cool cosmetics or achieve a new high score. The choice is up to you.

title: Urban Jungle
description: Turn your home into a green haven in Urban Jungle. Find the best place for each plant in your tiny apartment and enjoy gardening without worries. And don't forget to pet the cat!

title: Uncrowned
description: Set sail in Uncrowned, an age of sail adventure where you command a struggling colony under an oppressive monarchy, and chart a course towards independence. Will you seek fortune through cunning trade or brandish the sword as a fearsome pirate? Your choices shape the destiny of your people.

title: UnDuster
description: UnDuster is a fast-paced ultrafastidious retro platformer combining the skill-based dashing from mountain climbing with unadulterated blasting inspired by the best rocket jumping of the '10s. Make your way through multiple areas with varied challenges and collect their stickers to attain your glory.

title: Underground secret
description: This is a strategy game with a cartoon style square grid that looks very fresh and cute, and the exciting background music is exhilarating.

title: Undeads
description: Embark on a risky but exciting journey through the world of Undeads. Search for weapons, armor, supplies and medicine. Survive or hunt survivors. Enjoy unique matches, sell your loot, and fight bloody and challenging battles against the background of the zombie apocalypse!

title: Under The Mask
description: You will become a returnee from the underworld whose soul resides in a mask. Extract the mask, explore the surrounding area, encounter events, and continuously become stronger! At the end of time, use the masks you collected to give the final enemy a fatal blow! ! !

title: Unknown Memoirs: Stormy Night
description: "Unknown Memoirs" is a short horror game series focusing on distressing tales of horror. "Stormy Night" sets the player in a world where an unnatural storm has been going on for days. As the player explores the world around them, things start to take a turn towards the unnatural.

title: Unknown Soul With Me
description: This is a game where you play as a young girl abandoned in a dungeon. who was saved by a mysterious spirit The spirit introduced himself as having lived in this place. But can't go anywhere The young girl wanted to set this soul free. They worked together to find a way out of this place.

title: Up to no Goob
description: Up to no Goob is a reverse tower defense/bullet hell which follows a goblin named Goob. Goob is very hungry and needs to liberate animals from the rather nice evil farmers in order to make himself an omelet.

title: Trust No One
description: You'll need to think outside more than just the box. In "Trust No One,” a point-and-click detective adventure, you play as a journalist who tries to unravel a web of secrets about a mysterious AI-company. Explore the nooks and alleyways of Kyiv to discover the identity of your informant.

title: Trupki
description: The tiniest slide and connect puzzle game.

title: Galaxy Fräulein Yuna FX: Kanashimi no Siren
description: The third game in the Galaxy Fräulein Yuna series, Kanashimi no Sirene picks up where the last game ended. After having successfully saved the Earth, Yuna and her new friend, the ever-hungry female android Yuri Cube, return to their normal high school life – or so they think. Because her old enemies will do anything to destroy her, including wrongly accusing her of world domination plans. This draws the attention of a highly ranked female intelligence officer of the Galaxy Alliance, who operated under codename “Sirene” and who pretends to be an exchange student in the Shiraokadai High School, while her true goal is to arrest Yuna… Kanashimi no Sirene plays similarly to the other games in the series, with the main gameplay consisting of being taken automatically to different screen and making dialogue choices. There are also turn-based battles, during which the player has to choose the right attacks at the right time to defeat the opponents. There are also a few mini-games that appear during the course of the game, such as a quiz show and a slot machine-type game with the purpose of getting new clothes for Yuna. There is an extensive “Extras” menu in the game, which features character album, graphical sketches, photos of various material connected to the series (such as magazines or covers of previous games) etc.

title: Hataraku Shoujo: Tekipaki Working Love FX
description: Tekipaki: Working Love FX is essentially an upgraded version of Tekipaki: Working Love for Turbo CD. It adds several scenarios to the main game, which play mostly like a Japanese-style adventure - the player can choose dialogue options or a location to go to. Those scenarios add more background to the personalities of Naomi, Hikaru, and Edalt, the three extra-terrestrial heroines of the game (for example, in one of the scenarios Hikaru's Martian cat escapes from the zoo, and it's the player's job to find him). The PC-FX version of the game also adds an "omake" option, where it is possible to view pictures of the girls.

title: Bright kingdom
description: Bright kingdom - a strategy game with magic and soldiers, where you defend the kingdom from enemies

title: Himegoto
description: Nevertheless, if you insist on uncovering their special secrets... consider this your warning. You will meet young women, each with their own hidden mysteries, and soon find yourself drawn into a whirlpool of secrets. Oh, do be careful. In this academy, one must never "pry into secrets."

title: Backrooms: Eight Levels
description: "God save you if you hear something wandering around nearby, because it sure as hell has heard you..."

title: Badaboom: Deluxe Edition
description: A match-3 puzzle game with a twist! Play on multiple maps with unique songs — the more marbles you destroy, the faster you advance through the song. Collect bonuses, chain combos and destroy as many marbles as you can!

title: Beast Park
description: This is a bullet screen shooting role-playing game, where players can freely match their decks and have a thrilling battle!

title: Battle for Desert City
description: Battle for Desert City - is great chance to start your journey into TBS genre in wargame settings and test your skills. Learn to think like real soldier on the battlefield and like general in war room at the same time. Achieve hard, well deserved victory fighting overwhelming enemy forces.

title: Ball is Life
description: Ball's a well-rounded fellow, but he soon finds himself in an existential crisis. Take Ball on a challenging and hilarious adventure as he jumps across the globe, scouring the round world for round friends who can help him live his best life.

title: Beer Run
description: Beer Run is an Indie game created to steal beers from supermarkets.

title: Before The Mine
description: Witness the recording of a young individual who, in the 90s, decides to delve into a forest in search of a dark secret in this horror game created with Unreal Engine 5

title: Before The Sun Rises
description: Re-growing a dying land with kindred spirits of the forest.

title: Beltmatic
description: Beltmatic is a casual factory game where you combine numbers using mathematical operations.

title: Botanica
description: Botanica is a short 2D side scrolling platformer game that immerses you in a world of sentient plants. Join the sprout, whose kind is often regarded as incredibly weak, on a journey to test its strength against Botanica and its governors.

title: BMX Gravel
description: Ready to tear up gravel, get big air and pump out the tricks BMX-style? Easy to learn, but hard to master. Hone your skills and chalk up bigger and bigger numbers the harder and faster you go. So put your pedal to the metal and vie for title of ultimate BMX gravel master!

title: Bot Warzone
description: Bot Warzone brings a remarkable 2D platform shooting experience with a high level of action in a world where its destruction is almost certain. Are you capable of saving humanity? ..I don't think so..

title: Broken Lands: Tower Defense
description: Get ready for an epic journey to defend Broken Lands against hordes of goblins, dwarves, elves and other nasty fiends using a vast arsenal of towers and spells! Fight on deserts, seas, forests and mountains, customizing your defensive strategy with different tower upgrades and specializations!

title: Bridges & Docks
description: Build the island of your dreams - either by hand or using procedural generation tools. Adjust the quantity of bridges, the maximum height of the terrain - even how close trees are! Meticulously tweak all the configurations to generate uniquely enthralling island worlds!

title: Bums
description: Bums is a game with a great variety of mini games where funny and scary. Go through them together with your friends or against them, all to win. The entrance to these worlds lies through cassettes, which are hidden all over the map, and some of them are unique and only a few will be able to find them

title: Burning Wall
description: The burning wall is behind you and you will not let go, try to reach the exit by showing skill and accumulating wealth.

title: ByteBurst
description: Welcome to the cutting edge of virtual mayhem in "ByteBurst" - the ultimate hacker's playground. Immerse yourself in a thrilling journey through the digital realm, where your skills will be pushed to the limit, and every line of code is a potential weapon.

title: Burning Dead Reloaded
description: Burning Dead Reloaded is a first person shooter on rails that immerses you in the thrilling saga of Mike Pacheco, a former security chief now branded a fugitive. Mike finds himself at the heart of a zombie bio-apocalypse caused by a genome altered using CRISPR technology

title: Chambers
description: Equipped with cunning and agility, you must navigate through a series of intricate chambers filled with traps, deadly adversaries, hidden chambers and mind-bending puzzles. Your quest? to reclaim the gold that was stolen from you!

title: Cats vs. Ghosts
description: Tower Defense: Cats are towers, ghosts are enemies and humans are target. You must put the correct cat to destroy the ghosts.

title: Catty Cathy
description: This is the story of Cathy. She is very catty and always wants to look pretty, but she always says mean things. When she walks she poops and it may turn to gold. She needs the gold to buy fillers for her face to look pretty.

title: Cat Warrior
description: Cat Warrior is an action-platformer of retro and cute style about a cat knight on his way to recapture his stolen treasure. Deep into the dangerous fantasy world,defeat the challenging big boss with your slash, dash, jump, walljump and other skills to find the treasure back!

title: Cento
description: CENTO is a game where you enter commands in time with music and activate skills to fight. Collect gifts while reinforcing your skills and fight on stages with a wide variety of songs!

title: Chairs
description: A fast-paced action platformer doubling as the most realistic chair simulator money can buy! Have you ever wondered what your chair thinks? What it believes? What it desires? Learn the answers and destroy some dimensions along the way!

title: Monsters Inc.: Scream Team Training
description:
Disney/Pixar’s Monsters Inc. Scream Team Training CD-ROM recreates the feature film experience for kids ages four and up so younger gamers can delve into activities and games with the characters they like best. Kids play as one of six monsters and Monsters Inc.’s newest employee. Their goal is to be the “Top Scarer” by the end of the game.

Ten challenging activities, each hosted by a different monster and featuring 30 different game levels (for a total of 300 levels!), involve kids in the exciting day-to-day life at Monsters, Inc. As they play, they can even strive to become “Employee of the Day,” Month or Year, an important feat in the Monsters, Inc. world.

title: Chaos Adventure
description: Is there a back story? No... The adventure is yours to make! Pick a character, and you are dropped into the fantasy middle ages to start your journey! This game is designed for you to quickly jump right into it and begin hacking and slashing your way through!

title: Charles: The Full Story
description: Expand 'Charles the Bee' with this DLC! Dive into new marsh and mountain areas, adding 6 extra dance battles and story content. Test your skills in the arcade's triple-threat mode with back-to-back battles. It's a buzzing adventure!

title: Choc N Roll
description: It's time to get the ball rolling, but slow down! Be careful what you roll yourself into because too much chocolate can be harmful to you! Prepare to wind down and melt away as you enter the sweet world of Choc N Roll!

title: Chocolatio
description: Create and build your own automated chocolate factory. Freely design and expand your factories to deliver a huge variety of chocolate themed resources.

title: Codedoor
description: In Codedoor, a unique horror puzzle game, you're in an abandoned area with containers, each locked with a random code. Find the right one using the code given to you to survive and advance. Exciting, strategic, and ever-changing challenges await!

title: Clutter Puzzle Magazine Vol. 15 No. 1: Collector's Edition
description: By far, the most challenging and exciting Clutter ever. More fun and challenging than even Clutter RefleXIVe. You will not believe the Spot The Differences Puzzles. And wait until you see the Eyeballs!!!

title: Cyber Strike
description: Cyber Strike is a butt clenching bullet hell dungeon crawler. Navigate through intense shootouts, strategic dodges, and cybernetic boss battles. Save a digital world from viruses and virtual foes. Rewrite destiny as you save cyber space in this thrilling adventure.

title: Daedalus
description: Choose your champion and enter the Labyrinth, survive if you can. Hades has taken over the Labyrinth, forcing souls through an arduous trial to reach the afterlife. Do you have what it takes to succeed, or will you be doomed to guard the Labyrinth for eternity?

title: Grotto King
description: Brave the dungeon filled with monsters and treasures of all sizes. Grotto King is a short first-person action game made for beginners and gurus alike.

title: Danger Ramps
description: Danger Ramps is a 3D platformer driving game. Master the control of your vehicle to advance through colorful environments, collecting stars without flipping over or falling into abysses.

title: Dense forest
description: In this game, you have a fairly simple task - to collect all the fruits to complete the level

title: Desktop Tourney World
description: Desktop Tourney World is a simulation construction, immortal cultivation survival game, you need to collect food, construct buildings, build equipment, and fight with all kinds of monsters.

title: Deep Dark Space
description: Deep Dark Space is a 4 player online co-op horror game in space. Investigate abandoned stations to collect evidence and deduce the monster. Beware betrayal from the team!

title: Underminer
description: Welcome to Underminer, an underground adventure game set in a subterranean world. Mine minerals, earn money, upgrade your drill machine and descend deeper into the earth. The truth about 'legendary minerals' and an exciting underground world are waiting for you!

title: TV Studio Story
description: Create shows, sign stars, and dominate the airwaves in this TV studio sim.

title: Virtue
description: A customizable event display for collider experiments for desktop or virtual reality. Explore electron-proton collisions in the ePIC detector at the future Electron-Ion Collider, or upload your own detector geometry and collision data to be animated.

title: Virtual girl save virtual boy
description: Hidden-object adventure game. The player needs to run around the location and look for objects in secret places, climbing into them along walls and ledges.

title: Visagens
description: Visagens is an action-focused, 2D side-scroller shooter. Ispired by games like Sunset Riders and Castlevania. Play as Bento, a blind cowboy, armed with a mysterious gun and supernatural powers. In a quest to Cleanse the lands from the demonic scourge of the Visagens and avenge his family.

title: Void Inside
description: Void Inside is a first-person psychological horror that immerses you in a supernatural reality. Remotely resembling the human world, this place is filled with horrifying entities incomprehensible to the human mind. Your goal is to survive and maintain your sanity

title: Voids Vigil
description: Blast your way through robotic hordes in this auto-battler arena shooter. Use auto-firing guns and drones, timely dashes and special abilities to reach The Void where a randomly constructed final Conservator awaits convergence. Spend your Cogs wisely among the shops to create unique builds!

title: Void Wars
description: Dodge, shoot and free the galaxy of the evil space mega corp. Use a variety of different weapons and spaceships, each with different playstyles to overcome many challenging levels.

title: The Tale of (Your Name)
description: Embark on a procedurally generated dungeon, make choices to craft your own narrative. Select your hero and confront monsters, solve puzzles, and make decisions that shape your unique story as you play.

title: The Street 10
description: Caught in an infinite alley, look for Street 10 to find your way out.

title: The Skirmish
description: Fight in online battles for one of two teams or play with bots.

title: The Seven Betrayers
description: This is a pixelated casual action game, the adventure of finding the seven betrayers, in which you collect the fruits of plants to strengthen yourself, defeat monsters to find the betrayers, and finally leave this continent for a new world!

title: The Road of Heroes
description: A game for rapidly shaping heroes, featuring randomized equipment attributes and combat maps. After leveling up, you can customize attribute enhancements and learn skills of your choice, with the goal of defeating bosses upon entering combat.

title: Thousands of Heroes
description: This game is a roguelike where item management is crucial. Since almost all items have a limited number of uses, the choice of whether to use or save each item becomes important. You can also cooperate with other users by sharing dungeon IDs!

title: Thin Way
description: Thin Way is an exciting platformer that combines parkour and intense fights. You are an experienced traceur in a world where towering skyscrapers, crowded high-rises, and abandoned buildings create a unique playground for your art. No opponent will halt you and no obstacle will slowdown your path

title: They Came From Venus
description: You are alone at your uncles remote mountain estate, when a mysterious package gets delivered to his doorstep. Soon after, things get out of hand and the house becomes your last bastion of survival.

title: The Valley of the Architects
description: A puzzle game, narratively grounded around architecture, adventure and elevators. Follow architectural writer Liz on a journey through Africa to uncover the secrets of a lost and forgotten Architect. Using your problem solving skills, overcome each puzzle and slowly unwrap the story of a lifetime.

title: The World Has Gone
description: The World Has Gone—a fast-paced zombie shooter couch-co-op game!

title: Tidebound
description: Tidebound is a fishing and inventory management game with a relaxing, casual atmosphere. Catch, sell, upgrade your boat, and sail further to catch more expensive and exotic sea animals. Casual yet engaging, the game offers a sense of progress with tons of equipment and hundreds of species to catch.

title: Tilted Tennis
description: A competitive paddle and ball game, with a twist! As you hit the ball around the arena, the camera follows it. Spin the ball to disorient your friends and win the match, but take care not to lose track of which way is up yourself...

title: The Moon 2044
description: Explore a secret NCIS facility and discover its dark secret. Take on the role of the XV-11 unit and face hundreds of enemies in a dark sci-fi shooter inspired by old school hits!

title: PJ Masks Power Heroes: Mighty Alliance
description: Team up with the Power Heroes and rebuild PJ Power HQ.

title: Outcast: A New Beginning - Adelpha Edition
description:
Key items of the Outcast - A New Beginning: Adelpha Edition

High-detail 24cm/9.5inch Sai statue
Exclusive collector's steelbook
Game copy
3 audio CD's soundtrack with game music
Hardcover artbook featuring over 50 pages of concept art from the game

title: South Park: Snow Day! - Collector's Edition
description: Keep warm with Cartman’s Knit Beanie, enjoy your bathroom time with the Cartman Talking Toilet Paper Holder, or get into the holiday spirit with the Cartman Snow Globe. The Collector’s Edition also includes a select set of tarot cards, the original soundtrack, and the game SOUTH PARK: SNOW DAY! on the platform of your choice.

title: Contraptions Collection
description: Contraptions is a physics-based puzzle game with a fun cartoony look. This game takes 3 games; Contraptions 1, 2 and 3 and combines them into one value pack of FUN!

title: Popmoji
description: A casual Suika game-inspired arcade experience where you merge emojis to create even bigger emojis until the cycle is completed! You use special abilities, and battle for the biggest score on the leaderboard while enjoying the juicy visuals and sound effects.

title: Mr. Run & Jump + Kombinera Adrenaline
description: Features 2 characterful games with beautifully illustrated visual aesthetics bursting with vibrant and approachable graphics. Both titles have a wide variety of puzzles and platforming adventures, as well as challenging levels, collectibles, and additional game modes.

title: The Cost Of Bliss
description: Force to spend a month in a psych ward to cure your addiction, you fight yourself going through painful levels of withdrawal. To cope, you make friends with a man who helps ease your pain, in exchange for unsettling favours.

title: Panzerkampf
description: Panzerkampf is a team vs team World War II and modern era tank battle game for PC. You play with historically accurate models of tanks, their armor, weapons and all their parameters. The game includes a full ballistics model with realistic calculations of penetrations and projectile ricochets, an observation/detection and surveillance system, and a physically realistic model of the motion of the tank and its wheels and tracks down to the level of individual track-links.

title: Glitchspankr
description: After a hard day of existing you just want to relax and play your favorite game, Big Booty Slapper 6! Unfortunately, there seems to be a rogue virus eating and corrupting your precious game! Using the GlitchSPANKR Antivirus software, dive into virtual worlds and Spank that Glitch! Or befriend him.
