Or spare his poor, ugly, miserable life. Maybe give him a smooch... fall in love... Oh, uhem. Well there are a lot of options. Just... get in there and figure it out.

title: A Mallard's Song
description:
The game’s main mechanic makes use of a timer. This allows the player 60 seconds to find the level exit. If the player fails this task, the landscape becomes consumed with glitching visuals and strange folkloric characters, telling stories of England’s dark underbelly.

The game questions the English nationalistic love affair with politicized traditionalism and the toxic side effects this has had on individuals and marginalized groups.

Through storytelling and allegorical visual narratives, I wanted to explore my difficult past experiences of English nationalism and identity and the history and legacy of English environments and folklore.

title: The Mouth Of The Woods
description: Search for a friend missing in the woods.

title: Everything You Didn't Get to Do
description:
You woke up on a desolate island up north, and your only company is a talking seal that insists on having you build cairns.

Everything you didn't get to do is a first-person cairn-building game about commitment and validation.

title: Stretchmancer
description: STRETCH THE WORLD, SAVE THE GALAXY! In this smartly funny First Person Puzzler, you are THE STRETCHMANCER. Squash and stretch your environment to solve fiendish puzzles and defeat the Claustro Empire... in an epic voice-acted adventure inspired by 90s Saturday Morning Cartoons!

title: CopyPasta with Cheese
description: 1. Select, 2. Copy, 3. Paste

title: Super Assfuck RPG
description: The game follows the story of a pink-haired boy who wants to get some chips but will need to use the power of friendship to achieve his goal! Follow him in his quest to reach the chips with the help of his friends and try to stop his evil frenemy(?) from ruining his plans!

title: GalaxyWak
description:
Fan games of "woowakgood"
Year-end contest entries for the year 2023

title: Tut's Tomb
description:
Tut's Tomb is a variation on "Pyramid", a patience or solitaire game of the Simple Addition family, where the object is to get all the cards from the pyramid to the foundation.

The object of the game is to remove pairs of cards that add up to a total of 13, the equivalent of the highest valued card in the deck, from a pyramid arrangement of 28 cards. When using the standard 52-card deck, Jacks are valued at 11, Queens at 12, and Kings at 13.

title: Proximate
description:
PROXIMATE is a dread-driven narrative game where you investigate a deep sea laboratory and piece together the events that lead to the research team’s demise.

You'll be required to wear an image recognition visor that only tells you the bare minimum information you need to succeed — and sometimes less. Use text information, proximity data and audio clues to form a mental map of your surroundings and pray that your technology won't fail you when you need it most.

title: Conway
description:
Step into the year 1791 as a freshly enlisted sailor aboard a merchant ship. You've cast aside your former life to chase your dream of life on the open sea.

With an abundance of free time aboard your new home, the choice of how to spend your days rests solely in your hands. Immerse yourself in the lives of your fellow crew members, delving into their motivations for joining this voyage alongside you, and discover the roles they'll play in your life as the journey continues.

Conway is a relaxed, non-linear and (to our best efforts) historically grounded slice-of-life story. There are no epic battles, no destiny to fulfill, and no swashbuckling adventures under a Jolly Roger. Instead you'll find yourself forging friendships and intimate connections with a cast of unique characters as you sail port to port on the high seas.

title: Snap! A Cerrado Adventure
description: Explore Brazil's beautiful Cerrado region, meet the creatures who live there, and experience a future made possible by conservation and habitat restoration.

title: Decks of the Damned
description: Raise an undead army by night, while by day, fend off human attacks on your lair. Enhance your minions by crafting and looting gear. Discover powerful crafting recipes. Explore lost ruins in quest for rare artifacts. Raid human villages. Shroud the land in darkness under your control.

title: Dead by Daylight: Gold Edition
description:
Embrace terror with Dead by Daylight’s Gold Edition, which includes the base game and 12 Chapters for a total of 16 Killers and 19 Survivors.

Whether you’re starting your journey in The Fog or looking to take things to the next level, there’s no better starting point than the Gold Edition. Experience a sprawling roster of horror characters in the quintessential Dead by Daylight experience.

In addition to the base game characters, the Gold Edition includes:

- The Clown and Kate Denson
- The Spirit and Adam Francis
- The Legion and Jeff Johansen
- The Plague and Jane Romero
- The Oni and Yui Kimura
- The Deathslinger and Zarina Kassir
- The Blight & Felix Richter
- The Twins and Élodie Rakoto
- The Trickster and Yun-Jin Lee
- Mikaela Reid

title: Yatagarasu Enter the Eastward
description: Following the success of "Yatagarasu Attack on Cataclysm," the new game introduces a parallel world filled with fresh characters and meticulously optimized gameplay. The game combines high-quality pixel graphics with a straightforward gameplay style accessible to all players. Key features include a core blocking mechanic, a simple yet deep game system, a live commentary feature, and robust network battle support.

title: Controlled Climate Chaos
description: You are elf man. You are sensitive to heat score. Try to survive.

title: Aeon Nightmares
description: Aeon Nightmares is a story focused horror themed platformer inspired by Cave Story, LISA, Yume Nikki and Haibane Renmei.

title: Rocket League: Game of the Year Edition
description:
Rocket League Game of the Year Edition is a digital download-only release of Rocket League, collecting three DLC packs along with the original game.

Unlike the Collector's Edition, no individually-released cars are included.

It was not made available for Xbox One, as the standard edition was updated with the GOTY Edition DLC.

On 2019-10-23 Psyonix announced the GOTY Edition would be removed from storefronts and no longer sold.

title: Jigsaw Puzzle: Delicious Foods
description: Jigsaw Puzzle: Delicious Foods is a puzzle game that challenges your puzzle-solving skills with mouth-watering images of dishes from around the world. With over 50 beautiful images and 5 difficulty levels, this game is a visual feast for foodies and puzzle enthusiasts.

title: Mega Man X3
description: The PC port of Mega Man X3 expands upon the PlayStation and Saturn versions by adding a difficulty select option.

title: From Nava
description: In From Nava, you are equipped with only a seemingly ordinary pen, but it possesses the extraordinary ability to unleash magic attacks by drawing specific patterns. You must escape from this abandoned research laboratory by gathering all the keys and polaroids left behind in the aftermath of an unknown incident. Various monsters and puzzles are all that stand in your way from fulfilling a stranger's final wish and unravel the mysteries of the world and yourself.

title: Survival Raft Simulator: Lost at Sea
description: Master the Ocean's Challenges: Craft, fish, defend against sharks, and expand your raft into a thriving haven in this immersive and unforgiving survival simulator.

title: My Life: Farm Vet
description: They need you on the farm – examine and treat lots of animals!

title: Genie Reprise
description:
Take the role of Lula and explore a vibrant fantasy world as she journeys to discover the meaning of the Genie and fulfill her destiny! GENIE Reprise is an atmospheric fantasy adventure told through fully voiced poetry and 3D first-person exploration.

Immerse yourself in mystical towns and the surrounding countryside as you collect crystal shards to reveal the next part of the poem that adds to the Genie’s lore, scattered across 15 chapters that span multiple eras and transform the environment around you. Meet intriguing and enigmatic characters and discover how their stories are intertwined as you seek a final truth.

title: Grimoire Organizer
description:
Grimoire Organizer is a game about flicking books into the bookshelves.

The books come in 3 colors - red, green and blue, with 3 cover designs for each of the colors. Take books from the stack, aim and launch them into the bookcase where they belong! If you mismatch the color of the book in hand with the place in the bookcase, or try to place it where there is already a book, you lose 1 try. You start with 5 tries and the goal is to keep at least 1 try under the timer.

Try a different configurable time - either 52 or 200 seconds!

Good luck!

title: TriPeaks
description: TriPeaks is a patience or solitaire card game that is akin to the solitaire games Golf and Black Hole. The game uses one deck and the object is to clear three peaks made up of cards. It was created by Robert Hogue and popularized as a result of being included in Microsoft Solitaire Collection 3.

title: Dungeonoid 2: Awakening
description: Classic dungeon crawling gets a block-busting twist in Dungeonoid 2 Awakening, a top-down adventure presented in retro pixel art style!

title: Arcade Archives: Solitary Fighter
description:
GOGOON!
Struggle for No. 1 quarreler in the Violence Fight!

title: Arcade Archives: Mystic Warriors
description:
Tranquil death and rebirth,
GOKURAKU OUJOU on a mystic night.

title: Anime RPG: Isekai Journey
description: Anime RPG: Isekai Journey is an addictive roguelike RPG puzzle game.

title: Alisa: Developer's Cut
description: Can you survive the Dollhouse? Alisa is a Horror-themed Action Adventure game, and a genuine throwback to the golden age of 90's 3D games.

title: Survival Guide 2
description: A survival narrative puzzle game. A linear game with a comprehensive and rich storyline. Offers three distinct gameplay styles: stealth, direct assault, and strategic intelligence.

title: Esports Godfather Origin
description: Esports Godfather Origin is a Deck-building game simulating MOBA e-sports. You will play a role as team coach and build your team. You need to train players and make strategies in various game versions, beat other teams and finally, take the Champion of the World. Be nobody, or lead your team to dominate!

title: Hisa and Yomi
description: "Hisa and Yomi" is a magical adventure RPG. The protagonist, Yomi, wakes up in the "Tower of Water Mirrors," where time flows eternally. Explore beautifully illustrated maps in a side-scrolling format to rescue your friend Hisa.

title: Imaginary Future
description: Embark on the journey to your envisioned future! In this Japanese-style role-playing game infused with elements of microcosm and yuri, you will take on the perspective of Koushuki, a former gang girl. Experience the profound changes unfolding in the Serbian town through a series of events.

title: Imaginary Future: Expansion
description: This expansion pack features a brand new main storyline, new maps, and new companions. Players will join forces with the enigmatic character Yerl, known as the Oracle, to embark on a journey of exploration and prevent the impending destruction of the underground world.

title: Ming Imperial Guards
description: "Ming Imperial Guards" is an adventure game based on the history of Ming Dynasty. You will incamate as Imperial Guards, explore various kinds of unsolved cases, cooperate to break up the conspiracies of the turbulent ruling and opposition parties.Your choice determines a different path from others!

title: Tragedy in Reality
description: This is a plot oriented pixel style visual novel game. In the game, you will play the role of a young graduate who faces multiple challenges from job seeking, work, and life in the complex modern society.

title: Meguru Dungeon
description: A roguelike RPG in which you explore a randomly generated 3D dungeon, collecting items and aiming for the goal of each level. You are free to choose your character's name, looks, stats, etc. Use more than 50 skills and over 200 items to completely conquer the 10 layers of the Lost Forest.

title: Dungeon Adventure Island
description: A relaxed and casual 2D adventure game with the theme character of a bankrupt miner. A game that appears incredibly childish, with very simple controls that require simplicity, fun, and easy to get started.

title: Early-blooming Black Lily: Hana to Itsuki no Gojitsudan 1
description: [Recommended reading after the main story!]You'll be able to play the new scenario, "Hana and Itsuki's Future".After everything, what kind of paths do Hana and Itsuki take...?Two fun and exciting events involving swimsuits and wedding dresses!

title: Really Dog: DLC
description: Really Dog's DLC. It unlocks 3 contents: Paku Mode, Mini Mode, and the Endless Level.

title: Campus Shock Night
description: This game is a psychological horror decryption game, where players need to use a series of props such as lighters, mobile phones, basketball, etc. to find key evidence from the game and piece together a complete storyline.

title: Edge of Death
description: Edge Of DeathIt is a first-person horror survival adventure game. Players will experience various illusions between life and death with the protagonist, and experience a journey to the edge of death.

title: Suibotsu Haikyo no Piano Droid
description: Half a century has passed since wars broke out over land due to rising sea levels. Two shadows walk through the submerged ruins, moving from house to house in order to survive. Along the way, they arrive at a concert facility. There was a woman with long chestnut hair playing the piano.

title: Eternum Dreamland
description: This is a third-person beautiful girl fighting zombie game. Elements such as shooting, changing clothes, and shelters are included. The heroine is a high school student in the countryside, in a constant cycle, looking for her former friends alone, and taking refuge in a small villa.

title: Endless Immortal Journey
description: This is a casual strategic placement game. In the aerial world set in ancient China, players will play the role of a descendant of the Immortal Cultivation Sect. Travel through the barren continent, obtain various resources, build your sect, and ultimately ascend to the immortal realm.

title: Three Kingdoms Chronicle
description: A real-time strategy game based on the history of the Three Kingdoms. The player can experience the fun of conquering cities, directing the country, and ultimately ending the Three Kingdoms disputes and uniting the world through their own efforts in the simulated historical background of the game!

title: Sword Dance
description: The Chinese style new era game "Sword Dance" is hot! Cute riders take flight to explore the immortal realm, enjoying the thrill of loving clouds and mist. Adventures in cultivating immortality, wielding swords to walk across the world, come and enjoy this exciting time of cultivating immortality!

title: Counter Mark 2 Saga: Seven Sacred Heroes
description: Counter Mark 2 Saga: Seven Sacred Heroes is a 2D tactical strategy game and the sequel to "Countermark Saga Frozen sword." The game tells the adventurous story of a modern-day youth who travels through time.

title: Adventure boy
description: Adventure Boy is a pixel style 2D board adventure game. The character will automatically move and attack enemies, and skills need to be manually cast. Job transfer provides professional weapons and skills, paired with different weapons and skills to create your own professional genre.

title: The Legend of Liu Bei of the Three Kingdoms
description: It's a traditional turn-based Japanese RPG! The game starts with the "Liu Bei" Yellow Turban Uprising, goes through the battle of Chibi, collects Xichuan, and ends with the end of the world as the story line... The overall gameplay is about 20 hours!

title: Vampires and Afternoon Tea
description: Crossing Death and Achieving the End

title: Za češtiny ve hrách!
description: It is a retro-pixel arcade game in which the player must transport his ships with ships with Czech flag to the island and the computer or the other player prevents him from doing so. There are sharks in the way, which the ships must avoid.

title: Yokai City
description: Walk the streets of a 1980s Tokyo where humans and yokai live uneasily side-by-side, trying to keep the peace between them in a tale full of love and hate, life and death.

title: You Can Save Everyone
description: A game about anxiety. You Can Save Everyone is a story-driven first-person horror puzzle game. Designed for Arcade Sticks and Controllers. Trapped in a strange facility, solve unconventional puzzles and, just maybe, save everyone.

title: Learn Japanese: Yuke and the Book of Yokai
description: Learn Japanese in this roguelike deckbuilder adventure brimming with Japanese flavor! Defeat yokai with your knowledge, gather omamori, and befriend the local guardian, Myōkun the Tanuki. Embark on your language-learning adventure and have fun!

title: Wizard of foam Magic
description: Your task is to destroy all the monsters on the floor, and at the same time not to die, or else wait for the end of the timer counter and manage to survive.

title: Witches, Wishes and Whispers
description: Witches Wishes and Whispers is a "Einstein"-style elimination puzzle where you sort ingredients to make potions. Based on the card clues, you must pick the correct ingredients so all the clues remain true!

title: Writer's Rush
description: 24 writers, and you're one of them. Challenge yourself to become the best writer in the world. Write books, create characters, choose endings, team up with rivals, answer letters from readers, and don't let other authors beat you!

title: World War: An Age of Industry & Magic
description: A collectible card game with a setting that draws from historical elements of the late 19th and early 20th centuries such as Spiritualism, the Victorian Era, the Industrial Revolution, psuedo-science and quackery of the time like Galvanism, both World Wars, and the sentiment of fin de siècle.

title: Wolf Peak: The Case of Ruth Choi
description: In 1991 Ruth Choi was murdered and it was whittled down to 6 suspects, but the case was never solved. Watch interviews, go through evidence and build your case. A game where you are never told outright who the killer is. Use your own deductive skills to find out, who killed Ruth Choi.

title: World Tour
description: This is a simple and fun elimination game.

title: Yard Sale
description: Yard Sale is a charming hidden object game where you assist a family in organizing a yard sale to fund their dream trip to Paris, while also uncovering buried treasures and reliving precious family memories.

title: X4: Timelines
description: An expansion to a 2018 sandbox space simulator. X4: Timelines introduces various scenarios and many unlockable rewards.

title: Yarimono
description: The protagonist's life takes a turn after their partner Yarimon learns the ultra-invincible 'cheat Tackle' Constantly challenging various trainers to participate in the Yarimon tournament, the protagonist unexpectedly discovers the secrets of this world in the process.

title: Whispering Lane
description: Uncover the dark secrets of the abandoned house on Whispering Lane in this psychological horror game. Navigate through perilous twists, where each turn reveals a blend of horror and mystery. Can you unearth the truth before darkness consumes you?

title: Whispering Breeze
description: Whispering Breeze is a fantasy brewing simulation game with different storylines. along with the characters Listen to problems and stories inspired by your imagination. And help them out by serving them a drink or two.

title: Wild Angels: Episode 1
description: An interactive visual novel about a mysterious gang who decided to break the law.

title: Wildsite
description: Crash-landed on an unknown planet filled with plasma and toxic weather. Your only hope? Bob, a sarcastic-genius AI who will question your every survival decision. Explore, build your mobile base and try to avoid death alongside up to 3 friends in Co-op.

title: Who Wants To Be A Millionaire?: Geography II
description: Challenge yourself and your friends with this brand-new theme/ Geography II

title: Who Wants to Be a Millionaire: US Movies 80s
description: Challenge yourself and your friends with this brand-new theme: US Movies 80s

title: Who Wants to Be a Millionaire: US Movies 90s
description: Challenge yourself and your friends with this brand-new theme: US Movies 90s

title: Weefager
description: Guide this pink being with the power of the ether in a metroidvania where nothing is as it seems. Infuse souls into objects, create minions to help you, and explore vibrant landscapes with a great soundtrack. Shape your destiny on this captivating journey.

title: Webshooters
description: Midway City is in a chaos! A new type of criminal needs a new style of justice... Battle for the streets as a hero or villain, on or offline, in screen space or VR!

title: Weapon Meister
description: Weapon Meister is a turn-based game focusing on fighting and combining combat moves. Numerous skills, several play modes and roguelike mechanics will make every adventure unique.

title: We Need More Steam!
description: We Need More Steam! is about strategizing and creating as much electricity as possible for a town's people always demanding more!

title: Wheelborn
description: Take control of Arback in 'Wheelborn,' a gripping 3D indie beat 'em up adventure set in a world where the Wheelborn, car-like creatures with a unique lifecycle, face corruption. Engage in intense combat, explore, make narrative choices, and shape Arback's destiny.

title: Whacking Hell!
description: The gates of hell have opened: whack all the monsters before they whack you! Collect their souls, ramp up your weapons and your spells, and become a slaughtering machine in this frantic roguelite top-down 2D shooter!

title: Werewolves 3: Evolution's End
description: In the wake of a horrific military raid on your woodland camp, the werewolf pack has become fractured and divided. When fate brings these disparate parties into contact once again, will your allies be able to put aside their differences long enough to survive the myriad dangers lying in wait?

title: What's Up There?
description: A simple journey but which requires enormous concentration. Will you be able to reach the Light above or will you stay forever below? Fake and true game endings for the most curious players.

title: Where Jellyfish: +450
description: The body is free, with 100 jellyfish. DLC adds 450 jellyfish on top of the original 100. A total of 550 jellyfish. DLC does not include achievements. You only need to pass the ontology to achieve full success.

title: Where is Johnny
description: Johnny still hasn't come home. But where is he ? Who is this Voltaire? Fight to discover the truth.

title: Where Ferrets
description: Search for 100 Ferrets. A carefully hand drawn 4K scene filled with cute characters. The process is short and won't take up too much player time. You can choose your favorite dyeing for the convenience of color blind players. Extremely easy to achieve.

title: Where's the Boat
description: Where's the Boat is a sandbox open world survival game set on an archipelago of deserted islands. Gather resources, craft tools, tend to your needs and travel from island to island in search for a way back to civilization.

title: Break Arcade Games Out
description: What if Breakout was the only arcade game people could make? An open-source game, written entirely on a live stream.

title: Hide
description: Hide is a Survival Horror PC game by Andrew Shouldice.

title: Gus Goes to Cybertown
description:
This educational game is aimed at kids under eight. You are playing as the dog Gus who searches the town after his 15 "CyberBuds".

The town consists of four houses and one park. In every house you encounter a puzzle-based educational game. This includes a spelling game, and game where you have to recognize letters to avoid asteroids. Also you have to count the bubbles in an aquarium or recognize and match shapes.

In the park you can see typical clothes and items from different timelines starting at the neanderthals up to spacemen. There are also a few songs included.

title: Gus and the Cyberbuds: Sing, Play & Paint-A-Long
description:
Gus and the Cyberbuds: Sing, Play & Paint-A-Long is an educational music game for children between three and eight. It features six songs (Animal Shenanigans, Down by the Bay, Imagination, The Ants Go Marching, Old MacDonald's Farm and I Am A Fine Musician) with three game modes:

Sing: The song is played and is accompanied by an animation. The lyrics are also shown, karaoke-style, so the player can sing along.
Play: The player can add a variety of icons (e.g. animals, trees, etc.) to the background. When playing the song, those icons stay on the screen.
Paint: The player can use simple painting tools to paint over the background while the song is optionally playing in the background.

title: Kaiki Sando
description: "Kaiki Sando" is a horror game exploring ancient secrets and yokai in Japan's mountains. Players encounter supernatural events and choose paths at mysterious torii gates, affecting the story.

title: Wall Ball
description: Welcome to the Future, Welcome to WallBall.

title: WaterMelon Mosikkaeng
description: Combine watermelon and friends to make bigger fruits.

title: War Of Castles
description: Lead your own soldiers to conquer all castles on the island! Create your own map and challenge players from all over the world! Play online games with friends.

title: Warframe: Cumulus Collection
description: Amplify your Arsenal's flair with the extravagant Cumulus Collection. Become the envy of your enemies and fellow Tenno alike with the stunning Cirrus Armor Bundle, Cumulus Syandana, Stratus Pistol Skin and more!

title: Warlocks Deeds: Desolation horde
description: In Desolation Horde, you are cast into a barren world devoid of any structures. This survival-driven variant demands meticulous resource management to stay alive. Periodical waves of ferocious, ever-increasing enemies will descend upon you, determined to claim your demise.

title: VTuber Manager
description: Embark on a management odyssey with 'VTuber Manager', a sim game where you build a virtual entertainment empire. Scout talents, customize avatars, produce content, and make strategic choices to lead your VTubers to stardom!

title: Wake Up: Liminal
description: How far are you willing to go?

title: UFO Sightings Simulator
description: UFO Sightings Simulator is a survival mystery game about shooting photos of paranormal phenomena. Take photos, sell them and buy rations, tools, decorations and more, while discovering the island(s)!

title: Ultimate Match 3D
description: Exciting puzzle game

title: Ultimate Ball: Fire Ball
description:
-Added small ball fire skin.
-Added small ball scrolling effect.
-Contains more challenging levels
-New challenges are waiting for you to fight!

title: Until It’s Undone: Unmastered
description: A forgotten oldie returns with a full makeover. Control some lost idiot by typing commands. Unmake puzzles to progress. Bump into several lovely weirdos along the way. Discover a wonderland of disturbing nonsense and industrial amounts of sarcasm.

title: Urbek City Builder: Trains
description: Build an intricate web of trains and stations to connect your population for heightened productivity in work and science. Link key buildings like iron mines to steelworks for maximum industrial efficiency.

title: Vagneria
description:
Vagneria is a platform game that blends elements of RPG, item crafting, scenario exploration, and village expansion. Here, your goal is to assist in the construction of the village of Vagneria by completing missions for its residents and protecting the inhabitants from threats that may arise throughout the story.

Dive into an immersive gaming experience with randomly generated stages, exciting exploration, building mechanics, and thrilling battles. Get ready to become the hero the world needs!

title: Valkyrie Squad: Siege Breakers
description: "Valkyrie Squad: Siege Breakers" is an exhilarating top-down shooter survival game. The mission is to break through the enemy's fortified defenses and face extreme survival conditions. you will lead this brave squad, utilizing each member's unique skills and defeat powerful enemies!

title: Van Life Simulator
description: Get ready for Camping & Vanlife adventure in Van Life Simulator! Dive into the ultimate mobile lifestyle, renovate iconic vans, and craft your own masterpiece. Hit the road, explore open-world landscapes, face wild challenges, and live the dream in the freedom of van life and camping.

title: Veilslash
description: In this action adventure, generate and phase terrain with various tools. Carry a massive communication device to the apex of an alien planet, but don't drop it. It's a long way down...

title: Vincent the Vampire
description: Vincent the Vampire is part cathartic animated story and part point and click adventure. Talk to the locals and collect and combine items to solve puzzles as you travel through this unique world.

title: Virtual Jigsaw Puzzles
description: Jigsaw puzzles based on photos of beautiful landscapes.

title: TriviaQuest: Mythic Conquest
description: TriviaQuest: Mythic Conquest is a game where you battle mythical monsters by answering true/false to questions. Utilize unique abilities and progress through challenging levels.

title: Trinity Survivors
description: Choose three characters with different styles to team up and combine their skills. Experience the amazing synergy of three characters. Play two-player co-op online with a friend. Defeat hordes of orcs and achieve high scores!

title: Tricky Madness
description: Tricky Madness is an upcoming arcade snowboarding game with a focus on speed and big air inspired by classics like SSX and 1080. Race down the mountain, explore secret areas, catch big air and perform Uber tricks.

title: Tribe Nation
description: Tribe Nation is a roguelike strategy with real-time battles set in the Gallic Wars era. Lead your Celtic tribe across Europe to a new homeland. Strategize on a randomly generated hex battlefield, adapt to unexpected events, craft, improve, and equip. Make your tribe a nation.

title: Typing Simulator
description: Typing Simulator is not a game, it's the future. Learn to type. Get fast. High scores, leader-boards and speed running, all in VR.

title: Twizzle Puzzle: Reptiles
description: Twizzle Puzzle: Reptiles - is the perfect puzzle game for a fun and rewarding pastime.

title: Twistingo
description: Explore three captivating games in one free package! Bird Paradise, Turtle Bay, and Hummingbird Haven await with an array of puzzles, adventures, and mini-games. Dive into a world filled with challenges and exciting discoveries!

title: Turbo Golf Racing: Furry Friends Kit
description: This one is for our furry friends!

title: Turbo Golf Racing: Buffet Ball Selection
description: A delectable assortment of treats for the food lovers! After purchase, these items will appear in the Garage section of Turbo Golf Racing.

title: Trash Top Down Racing
description: Top down 2d racing game. Race against AI opponents in different racing tracks

title: Syllogism
description: Explore an open world full of beautiful views and locations, and enjoy a relaxing atmosphere while immersing yourself in unique challenges that will challenge your imagination and logical thinking.

title: Slenderman: Evidences
description: Slenderman is back, and he wants to play. Find 8 pages that have evidence of your innocence and dont look to Slenderman.

title: Tabletop Hero
description: is a roguelike deck-building game. With a variety of heroes and classes, hundreds of cards and treasures, and a rich array of genres to explore, there's plenty to discover. Additionally, card enchantment and fusion mechanics help you build a stronger deck.

title: Tale of BaGua
description: Stack BaGua spells and travel through space and time! Tale of BaGua is a mind-bending top-down puzzle adventure where you guide a Chinese teenager on a quest to recover his family's lost treasure, the BaGua mirrors. Overcome obstacles along the way to unveil the secrets of his ancient lineage.

title: Tactic Boxing
description: Tactic Boxing is a hardcore boxing simulator with ragdoll physics and a career mode.

title: Tails of Iron: Crimson Knight
description:
Arise, young squire, and become a legendary protector of the realm with the exclusive Crimson Knight DLC Pack, containing:

- 3 armour Skins
- 3 weapon Skins
- 3 shield Skins
- 3 helmet Skins

The land is awash with danger, but the sigil of the Crimson Knight is sure to strike fear in the hearts of even the most formidable of foes. Wear it with honour, and do your Kingdom proud.

title: Tales of Old: Dominus
description: The Battle of Brides is over, the kingdom lies in ruins. The corrupt rule, the just die or flee. As one of the defeated, forge your path of vengeance: Master warfare, claim and manage camps, villages, strongholds, become a noble, rebel - live through a dark medieval story in an open-world RPG.

title: Takeuma 2D
description: This is a 2D action game in which you take a boy on Takeuma to the top of a tower. The boy cannot stop because he is on Takeuma, but the controls are very easy. This game is perfect for those who enjoy challenging actions and the sense of accomplishment that comes after many attempts.

title: Tachyon Dreams Anthology
description: Time itself is breaking up, and Dodger, the dishwashing dude onboard Penrose Space Station, is the unlikely fixer. Join the chaos in this 80s-style comedy, sci-fi text-parser adventure as Dodger tackles a cosmic crisis like no other! This version includes all three episodes + new extra content!

title: Taboo Trial: Hildr
description: This content requires the base game Forbidden Trials on Steam in order to play.

title: Taboo Trial: Rossweisse
description: This content requires the base game Forbidden Trials on Steam in order to play.

title: Sunset Motel
description: Ready for the transformation of neglected rooms? Ensure customer satisfaction, renovate interiors, design entertainment spaces! Manage your motel in your own style and provide travelers with unforgettable experiences!

title: Sunflower Pie
description: A short story about a parasitic sunflower and her loyal son. Eat everything you can. Enjoy the sunshine. Do whatever it takes to make her happy.

title: Summon Masters
description: "Summon Masters" is a fair online turn-based strategy card game , allowing players to construct their own decks based on various card skills for free battles.

title: Supernatural Shenanigans
description: Supernatural Shenanigans is a 2-player online co-op game where you take on the role of a supernatural detective that investigates dark rituals. Get together with a friend, gather as much evidence as you can, solve puzzles, revert the magic, and most important: survive!

title: Supersonic Bridge Racing
description: A fast-paced racing game where the player controls the track. Fight against Friends on a global leaderboard or in the local multiplayer. Supersonic Bridge Racing is a mix between a flying and reaction race.

title: Supreme Fighters
description: Supreme Fighters is a beat ‘em up combo style fighting game set in an urban fantasy environment . With enough playable characters you are guaranteed to find your own preferred fighting style and become The Supreme Fighter!

title: Surmountable
description: Your ship is shot down while engaged in a space battle. You land on an unknown planet. With your battleship damaged and no way of contacting your mother ship, you must survive on the planet until you find a way back home.

title: Starlight Scouts
description: Pure physics-based rocket-powered fun. Solve puzzles, fly fast, crash hard. Become a Starlight Scout...

title: Steam Trigger
description: A riveting steampunk 2.5D platformer set against the backdrop of the sprawling metropolis. Immerse yourself in a mesmerizing fusion of industrial progress and Victorian aesthetics as you embark on a journey throughout the city.

title: League of Masters
description:
League of Masters is a multiplayer Autochess strategy game.

The game takes you to the distant past, the times when magical creatures lived on Earth together with people: elves, orcs, dwarves, jinns, and many others.

Explore the world of the auto battler League of masters in the PvE campaign mode, join the crusade against chaos, and jump into battlegrounds with new allies in your battle squad! You have 12 commanders and over 50 fighters with unique abilities to strengthen your tactics in the strategy game, defeat your enemies, and save the world from Evil.

Prepare to dive into adventure, flashy battles, and spectacular clashes! There’s much more than just a PvE campaign: raid enemy castles, enjoy flying solo, or take up PvP team fights in the battle arena.

Plunge into the unique atmosphere of autochess, and savor its fascinating story and vibrant graphics. If nonstop adventures, legendary battles, and spectacular victories are your thing, this auto battler is just what the doctor ordered!

title: Cute Knight Deluxe
description: This version of Cute Knight has updated features including several new items, secret bonuses, the "Wizard's Challenge" minigame was entirely re-designed, and all the artwork for the monsters and endings was re-drawn.

title: Adventure In XX City
description: Fan game for the "Of The Killer" game series by thecatamites (aka @garmentdistrict)

title: Guntouchables
description: Guntouchables is a 1-4 player co-op survivor-like shooter. The world has fallen and is overrun by an endless horde of ever-evolving mutants. You and your ragtag group of gun runners must find and deliver crates of classified military supplies before the enemy can take advantage of their content.

title: Rocket!!
description: You are Rocket, a Fox-Rabbit from out of this world! Strange monsters have begun to appear & are causing chaos wherever they go, it's up to Rocket to put a stop to that!

title: Gendai Daisenryaku 2002
description: A war simulation strategy game which has simulations take place on real geographical locations.

title: TicTactics
description: A Tic-Tac-Toe game played against the computer. Can be played in 3x3, 3x3x3, or 4x4x4 configurations. Was included in the 1990 release "Microsoft Entertainment Pack".

title: Pegged
description: Pegged is a puzzle video game developed by Mike Blaylock and published by Microsoft in their Microsoft Entertainment Pack for Windows for Windows 3 in 1990. It is a video game version of various layouts of peg solitaire.

title: Jigsawed
description: JigSawed is a puzzle video game developed by Tito Messerli and published by Microsoft in Microsoft Entertainment Pack 2 for PC in 1991. The game is a simple jigsaw puzzle, only it uses primitive shapes instead of standard fully-interlocking jigsaw shapes.

title: World of Solaria: MMORPG 2D
description:
Embark on a thrilling 2D pixel art MMORPG adventure. Immerse yourself in a vast fantasy world filled with epic quests, intense battles, and endless exploration.
Very simple and easy to handle!

title: Dragon Ball Terraria
description: Dragon Ball Terraria is a mod that adds several aspects from the Dragon Ball series to Terraria, including transformations, items, bosses, and a new ki system.

title: Doom Infinite
description: A single-player roguelike action FPS for GZDoom.

title: StarRupture
description: StarRupture is a first-person open world base-building game with advanced combat and tons of exploration. Play alone or in a group on this sublime and ever-changing planet, extract and manage resources, create your complex industrial system and fight off hordes of alien monsters.

title: Calmed by the Dark
description: Discover a parallel dimension to ours in Calmed by the Dark, a dimension filled with mysteries, monsters, and survivors. Learn how to master your powers and join a group that will shape your destiny.

title: Calmed by the Dark: Complete Edition
description: An update to Calmed by the Dark that brings new features and some changes to the overall experience, such as the new campaign: Episode 0 Otherside, where you take another look at the story of Calmed by the Dark, with a new campaign and a different protagonist, the player must once again venture into the mysterious world of Zeitlos to return home; as well as new social events, new constructor mode, and five new endings for the game.

title: Perished World Merchant
description: You play as Red "the Merchant" Hunter, who has to explore a desolate world looking for supplies to use and sell to travelers so that they can follow their journeys and complete their quests. Every trade that you lose means that the chances of that buyer coming back are low. So is up to you to find what they want and to sell at whatever price you want.

title: Calmed by the Dark: Neon
description:
Set in 2046, you play as Tommy Hunter, who works hunting monsters and dealing with problems in the city. His biggest battle is waiting for him!

Calmed by the Dark: Neon is an open-world action RPG where you do missions usually related to hunting monsters. The combat consists of using a sword for melee attacks and dual pistols for range attacks. It is also possible to dodge enemy attacks by dashing.

title: Calmed by the Dark: Aftermath
description: Set 4 years after a catastrophic event, Calmed by the Dark: Aftermath is an open-world action RPG where, in a city corrupted by power, Kadmos has the mission to rescue a girl and fight a horde of vampires that control the city. Looking for redemption, Kadmos must grow strong and obtain more powers as the player decides his fate.

title: Gus and the Cyberbuds: Stellar Game Center!
description:
Gus and the Cyberbuds: Stellar Game Center! is a collection of six mini-games divided into four sections:

Clam-o-Rama: a Concentration variant with sea animals.
Create a Creature: The player can choose various facial features and clothing to create a face.
The Write Stuff: the player has to complete a partially written letter by dragging icons on the blank parts. There are no right or wrong choices.

The last section, Melody Madness, evolved around numbered bottles which are filled with different amounts of water. The three mini-games are: - Clicking on the correct bottles (the correct numbers are written out) to re-create a song. Alternatively the player can use the bottles freely to create a new melody. - A Simon Says variant. - Filling the bottles with the correct amount of water in order to match the given music notes.

All mini-games were already included in previous entries of the series.

title: Calmed by the Dark: Purgatorium
description: Calmed by the Dark: Purgatorium is a dark-action roguelite dungeon crawler where your objective is to head to the top floor. Defeat the Gods of Infinity to acquire more power and progress further through the tower.

title: Calmed by the Dark RE:iterate
description: Across the city, people are being mysteriously kidnapped and they are never seen again. Eve, the protagonist, was just looking for a job and somehow ended up discovering a strange world where she awakens her powers and learns the truth behind the kidnappings...

title: Calmed by the Dark In:Finity
description:
Set XXXX years in the future, a woman wakes up in a cyber world with no humans in sight, she begins her quest to search for other survivors and understand what is happening in this new reality.

Explore dungeons, collect monsters, and uncover what happened to mankind in In:Finity.

title: Ash Echoes
description: Ash Echoes is a Real-time Sci-Fi Tactical RPG. As the Chief Officer of S.E.E.D., you will encounter otherworld Visitors uniting to fend off unprecedented threats and uncover the origins of the turmoil.

title: Halloweens
description: Hecate's bag of Halloween candy was taken by Saetn! Help Hecate get the bag back by safely navigating her through the lair of Saetn! Collect keys to open doors and wands to smack ghosts!

title: Resurgence of the Storm
description: Resurgence of the Storm is a Starcraft 2 arcade map that is currently being developed by zeroLamberg inside the Starcraft 2 Galaxy Editor. It is designed as a successor/recreation for Heroes of the Storm. It launched with 15 playable heroes, most of which are redesigned versions of their Heroes counterparts.

title: Stones
description: Stones is a game developed by Michael C. Miller and released in 1991 as part of Microsoft's Windows Entertainment Pack. The object is to place 90 tiles, or "stones", on a board. A tile can only be placed if it shares two of three attributes - background color, character color, or character shape - with every adjacent tile. Wild tiles may be placed anywhere regardless of attributes. The game is won when all tiles are placed or when there are no valid spaces to place the next tile.

title: Klotski
description: Klotski is an ancient Polish game that provides mathematical problems in the form of a small wooden game board with various sized blocks. The object of the computer game is to free the "master block," in as few moves as possible. The computer scores you on the number of moves it takes to solve a puzzle. 24 puzzles are included, as well as a puzzle editor.

title: LifeGenesis
description: The object of the game is to remove all the red cells from the grid. The computer will try to remove all the blue squares. You and the computer take turns adding and deleting cells.

title: Go Figure!
description: In "Go Figure!", the player is given a selection of four numbers and they must use addition, subtraction, multiplication and division to devise a calculation that will match a target number. The player scores points for every equation they solve within the game's time limit. There are skill levels, a hint function and a high score table.

title: Tic Tac Drop
description: Tic Tac Drop is a puzzle video game developed and published by Microsoft in the Microsoft Entertainment Pack 4 for Windows 3 in 1992. The game is a rendition of Connect Four but with several additional features like the ability to customize the size and shape of the play field as well as the length of line needed to win.

title: Dr. Black Jack
description: Dr. Black Jack is a computer game featured in the Microsoft Entertainment Pack for Windows. It is based on the popular card game Blackjack (aka Pontoon, 21 etc.). The minimum bet is 10 points per deal.

title: Incremental Adventures
description: A minimalistic Idle game where combat is fully automated.

title: Maxwell's Maniac
description: Maxwell's Maniac is a computer game originally part of the Microsoft Entertainment Pack series. Loosely based on the concept of the Maxwell's Demon thought experiment, the object of the game is to separate the red and blue molecules into their respective color-coded chambers using a sliding door. It is superficially similar to JezzBall in layout.

title: Dead Estate: Assignment Anya
description: Assignment Anya is the fifth update in the six part update series for Dead Estate. Featuring a whole new campaign accessible from the get-go, inspired by classic survival horror games and set prior to the events of the main game. Also featuring several brand new challenge modes, new curses and more.

title: Dance Hero: More Jiggle
description: Dance Hero: More Jiggle is a Dance/Rhythm/Twerk and Customization Simulator with many unique features. Twerk through the story, hire many interesting characters to dance with, explore a huge city and even customize your main character with clothes from real-world fashion brands!

title: Augustus: Im Auftrag des Kaisers
description:
Augustus: Im Auftrag des Kaisers is a licensed game based on the TV movie Imperium: Augustus. The player takes the role of gladiator Titus Gladius who has to rescue Rome from insurgents. Since he is outnumbered, he mainly uses stealth to avoid his enemies or kill them unnoticed. Similar to Thief: The Dark Project, the player uses shadows and a light meter to his advantage. Light sources can't be extinguished.

When there is no way around the guards, the player also has the possibility to distract them with a coin or to kill them with one of his five weapons (e.g. throwing spear or sword). The fights are action oriented, the player can only stab or block. There are also switch puzzles to solve. The game features eleven missions with cutscenes taken from the movie.

title: Moorhuhn präsentiert 10 Fun Games
description:
A compilation of advergames:

PoodleERazor
Moorhuhn Tennis
Don Horn
Rettet die Kühe
Ede Kowalski
Ski-Cross
Mordillo's Jungle Fever
Nanuk
Original Moorhuhnjagd

title: Super Jolly RPG
description: It's Christmas season and our pink-haired protagonist needs to buy a gift for a friend. Luckily for him, the newest mall in town has just opened! Together with his other friend, he decides to shop there. However, the mall's owner has an evil plan for that place...?! When a blackout occurs and locks our protagonists inside just as they finish buying gifts, they must venture further into the mall to find out what exactly is going on, and how to get back home in time for Christmas!

title: Calmed by the Dark Re:Boot
description: Experience a brand new storyline in Calmed by the Dark Re:Boot, set 20 years after the events of Calmed by the Dark Leviathan. Play as AJ, a new protagonist, and face new enemies and bosses, and explore new areas. With updated weapons and enhanced gameplay, Re:Boot takes the Calmed by the Dark experience to the next level!

title: Towelket 0: Maiden Bomb Invaders
description: Maiden Bomb Invaders is a free JRPG made by Kanao (Kanashimi Hocchikisu). This game serves as a retelling of Towelket 5, with a primary focus on the Bomb Maidens from the earlier entries. The narrative takes a slight twist to introduce new plots and characters. As a spin-off of the main series Towelket One More Time, it references elements and features characters from the previous entries. It is suggested to play at least Towelket 1 and Towelket 5 to fully understand it.

title: Moorhuhn präsentiert Die Funbox
description:
This is a compilation of games by phenomedia. Most of them are short versions or demos, marked by the suffix XS in their title.

Moorhuhn 2: Die Jagd geht weiter
Moorhuhn Tennis
Bull Run (a Pac-Man style game)
Höllenjob XS
Moorhuhn: Wanted XS
Moorfrosch XS
Moorhuhn: Kart 2 XS
Moorhuhn X: Schnecken Trainer
Gütertrennung XS

title: KinitoPet
description: KinitoPet is a psychological horror experience that takes place through Kinito, an early 2000s virtual assistant. Kinito is able to walk, talk, browse, adapt, and play games as Kinito is like no other with its adaptive technology!

title: One Piece: Pirate Warriors 4 - Koby's Combat Chronicle & Soul Map 2
description: Join the Marines' young hero, Koby, as he endures a journey of intensive special training!

title: Misfortune Possession
description:
Bitz, a clumsy cat with bad luck discovers by accident that he is actually possessed.

Let's see if he can get rid of it or become demotivated by his "bad luck".

title: Arcade Archives: Cosmo Gang The Puzzle
description:
"COSMO GANG THE PUZZLE" is a puzzle action game released by Namco (Bandai Namco Entertainment) in 1992.
Make sure to line up the cosmos and containers that fall from above to eliminate them.
Containers disappear when lined up horizontally, and cosmos can disappear when hit by the blue ball.
The key to strategy is to rotate the parts well and create a good path for the ball.

title: The Bonerooms
description: The Bonerooms is a goofy horror-themed multiplayer game about surviving in a living maze while being pursued by skeletons. Last one standing wins!

title: The Big Blue
description: A rouge top-down bullet screen shooting game

title: Honkai Impact 3rd: The Wings to Mars
description:
Version 7.2 of Honkai Impact 3rd, which includes:
• New Valkyrie: Fenghuang of Vicissitude (Fu Hua)
• New Story Chapter: The Star Which the Moon Gazes Upon (Part 2 Prologue)
• New Featured Event: Wild Phoenix Chase
• New Featured Event: Realms of Battle
• ...and more!

title: Mangetsu no Yume
description: Mangetsu no Yume is an English fangame made by Sekiranun in RPG Maker 2003. You play as a girl named Aotsuki, who is unable to leave her room because her house is flooded.

title: StarCraft II: Wings of Liberty - Collector's Edition
description:
In the distant future, in the darkest regions of space, the ghosts of the past whisper your name. You are Jim Raynor, a marshal-turned-rebel on a vigilante crusade to bring down the Dominion and its nefarious leader, Arcturus Mengsk. Haunted by betrayal and remorse, some believe you may have given up the fight. But you have promises to keep... and a need for vengeance that’s long overdue.

This special Collector's Edition comes with the following in addition to the game:

The Art of StarCraft II - Wings of Liberty, a 176-page book featuring artwork from the game
An exclusive 2GB USB flash drive replica of Jim Raynor's dog tag, which comes preloaded with the original StarCraft and the StarCraft - Brood War expansion set
A behind-the-scenes DVD containing over an hour of developer interviews, cinematics with director's commentary, and more
The official StarCraft II - Wings of Liberty soundtrack CD, containing 14 epic tracks from the game along with exclusive bonus tracks

title: The Deepwater Witch
description:
"What wish would you ask the witch to grant?"

In a world ruined by pollution, the oceans have swallowed the lands. Ramil is a scavenger, a lowlife who digs through the trash littering his once idyllic hometown. One day he finds a mysterious girl on the beach. She can't speak, and she says that she doesn't remember where she came from. When Ramil meets her, he is dragged into a surreal dreamscape...but are they dreams or delusions?

As the mysteries surrounding the girl's identity unravel, Ramil is forced to answer a question: What price is he willing to pay to be happy?

title: Give Me All Your Love
description: A small MBF21 mapset with castle theme and some medium-to-hard combat. And lots of purple. But sadly without love... maybe you can give it?

title: Dum-Dum Thoughts
description:
Sometimes thoughts are too loud
This is a set of 6 vent-y speedmaps that was made in 4 days. Mostly they're focused on atmosphere, so spending a bit of time on the map while listening to midi after killing the monsters will be worth it

title: Subterror
description: At the bottom of the ocean floor lie The Biospheres. These weather-controlled domes once supported vast arrays of lifeforms, but have since been abandoned. Explore arid deserts, dark forests, and frozen tundras. But don't stay too late, as you are not alone out in the great abyss.

title: Astral Abstraction
description: Astral Abstraction is an atmospheric 5 episode total conversion that aims to advance the formula of Doom's gameplay, bringing it more in line with the modern entries in the series. The vertical aspect of gameplay is expanded and more fleshed out, and the pace of gameplay is faster. ﻿

title: Flash of the Blade X
description:
Flash of the Blade is a first-person slasher with a high level of difficulty due to its one-hit-kill mechanic. Described by testers as unforgiving, brutal, and thematically on-point, the game has gone through extensive balancing to get it to a stage where it is no longer unfair, but FUNfair.

The game is purposefully light on story, basing itself around a battle between a lone ninja and an Evil Ninja Clan helmed by a diaper-wearing Sumo. Expect to suffer not just due to the game's difficulty, but due to seeing the boss in a giant diaper.
The story effectively boils down to - See Ninja, Fight Ninja, Be Ninja.

Flash of the Blade contains 11 fast-paced, ferocious levels, 5 deadly weapons, and 6 grueling enemy types.

title: Ace Combat 7: Skies Unknown - 8 Popular Squadron Emblems
description: This DLC pack includes eight emblems from older Ace Combat games: Aquila, Wardog, Garuda, Gryphus, and low-visibility versions of each. It can only be purchased directly in Japan (all platforms) and Asia (PS4 and Xbox One); in all other regions, it is only available in special editions.

title: Ace Combat 7: Skies Unknown - Strangereal Edition
description: The Strangereal Edition of Ace Combat 7: Skies Unknown contained the base game, the Season Pass, the Aces at War: A History 2019 art book, a 40 cm diecast figurine of the Arsenal Bird, an emblem pin, and two emblem patches all within a collector's box. In Europe and Oceania, the Strangereal Edition also included the 8 Popular Squadron Emblems DLC.

title: Ace Combat 7: Skies Unknown - F-4E Phantom II + 3 Skins
description: The F-4E Phantom II + 3 Skins DLC contains the F-4E aircraft, the Yellow 13 skin for the Su-37, the Razgriz skin for the F-14D, and the Pixy skin for the F-15C. This DLC was available for free when pre-ordering the base game or purchasing the base game within the first month of release.

title: Ace Combat 7: Skies Unknown - ADF-11F Raven Set
description: The ADF-11F Raven Set contains the ADF-11F Raven aircraft, the Mobius 1 skin for the F-22A, and a set of bonus emblems.

title: Ace Combat 7: Skies Unknown - ADF-01 FALKEN Set
description: The ADF-01 FALKEN Set contains the ADF-01 FALKEN aircraft, the Sol skin for the Su-30M2, and a set of bonus emblems.

title: Ace Combat 7: Skies Unknown - ADFX-01 Morgan Set
description: The ADFX-01 Morgan Set contains the ADFX-01 Morgan aircraft, the Mihaly skins for the Su-30SM and X-02S, and a set of bonus emblems.

title: Ace Combat 7: Skies Unknown - F-104C: Avril
description:
The F-104C Avril DLC adds a unique F-104C based on Avril Mead's restoration seen in the game's intro cutscene. No weapons are included, so it can only be used in Free Flight mode.

This DLC is automatically included with every digital purchase of Ace Combat 7: Skies Unknown, regardless of edition or base game. It was also included in the Strangereal Edition in Europe and Oceania. It can only be purchased for physical versions of the game in Japan and Asia.

title: Moorhuhn in Südafrika
description: An updated version of Crazy Chicken Soccer. Specifically, the selectable teams (and thus, the chicken's player jerseys) as well as the background (now savanna-based) have been adjusted to resemble those of the 2010 FIFA World Cup in South Africa.

title: Ace Combat 7: Skies Unknown - Deluxe Edition 2022
description: The Japan-exclusive 2022 Deluxe Edition of Ace Combat 7: Skies Unknown includes the base game and most of its DLC: the Season Pass, the Original Aircraft Series, the Experimental Aircraft Series, the Cutting-Edge Aircraft Series, and the 8 Popular Squadron Emblems DLC.

title: Ace Combat 7: Skies Unknown - Ultimate Edition
description: The Japan-exclusive Ultimate Edition of Ace Combat 7: Skies Unknown includes the base game and nearly all of its DLC: the Season Pass, the Original Aircraft Series, the Experimental Aircraft Series, the Cutting-Edge Aircraft Series, the Top Gun: Maverick Aircraft Set, and the 8 Popular Squadron Emblems DLC.

title: Sanctity
description: Sanctity is a Hack & Slash RPG with platformer elements where you travel between the Real and Virtual Worlds in fast-paced combat against swarms of enemies and boss fights inspired by MMO raid design.

title: One Night Heaven: Aka to Kuro no Hitobito ni Sasagu Hommage
description:
High school at Shinjuku, Tokyo, but in imaginary world created by human brain.
Fates of 18 people are intertwined there. A girl is in love with a boy, but he only plays with her heart. One day illusion of the girl appears at school, and rumors about her suicide start to spread. At the same time Ryusei creates "Misuzu" and tries to infest people's minds with "Misuzu" through the internet.

title: Smite 2
description: Become a god and wage war in SMITE 2, the Unreal Engine 5-powered sequel to the legendary third-person action MOBA. If you love challenging competition, intense action, ability-driven combat, rewarding teamwork, or godly mythology, you’ll see why 40+ million players love SMITE.

title: Detective Kiwi
description: "Detective Kiwi" is a free to play multiplayer puzzle game that designed up to 6 players, featuring a simple rule: There will be 4 images every round. You need to find them as fast as you can.

title: To Tell the Truth
description: A non-linear FMV detective story following Marcus and his story to help his girlfriend understand why he's been acting so strange.

title: Ace Combat 7: Skies Unknown - CFA-44 Nosferatu Set
description: A next-generation carrier-based stealth fighter optimized for solo raids. Nicknamed “Nosferatu” (meaning undying), its acceleration and mobility far outclass other fighters. Equipped with versatile weaponry, this aircraft is formidable against both air and ground targets.

title: Ace Combat 7: Skies Unknown - ASF-X Shinden II Set
description: A cutting-edge support fighter built to handle a variety of situations. Its two-tiered jet engine and variable forward-swept wings give this aircraft excellent versatility and flight stability. Its nickname is “Shinden II”.

title: Ace Combat 7: Skies Unknown - Bonus Emblem Set
description: A free set of emblems containing the "Free Erusea -Bonus-", "Three Arrowheads -Bonus-", and "Three Arrowheads (Low-Vis) -Bonus-" emblems. These are included by default in the Steam version.

title: Ace Combat 7: Skies Unknown - F-16XL Set
description: An add-on for ACE COMBAT 7: SKIES UNKNOWN.

title: Ace Combat 7: Skies Unknown - F-15 S/MTD Set
description: An add-on for ACE COMBAT 7: SKIES UNKNOWN.

title: Ace Combat 7: Skies Unknown - FB-22 Strike Raptor Set
description: An add-on for Ace Combat 7: Skies Unknown.

title: Narrative Nightmares: Trilogy of Terror
description:
Narrative Nightmares: Trilogy of Terror is a collection of 3 narrative-driven, text-based adventure games & visual novels. The goal was simple, 3 friends creating a game each centered around the old-school visuals of simple storytelling.
Each game in the collection in the collection is hand-crafted, telling a story while offering simple gameplay mechanics that anyone can enjoy.

title: Ace Combat 7: Skies Unknown - F/A-18F Super Hornet Block III Set
description: An add-on for ACE COMBAT 7: SKIES UNKNOWN.

title: Ace Combat 7: Skies Unknown - F-2A Super Kai Set
description: An add-on for ACE COMBAT 7: SKIES UNKNOWN.

title: Ace Combat 7: Skies Unknown - MiG-35D Super Fulcrum Set
description: An add-on for ACE COMBAT 7: SKIES UNKNOWN.

title: Ace Combat 7: Skies Unknown - Cutting-Edge Aircraft Series
description: This is a special set that contains 3 cutting-edge aircraft. As a bonus, it also includes 10 emblems and 13 skins.

title: Dr Ludwig and the Devil
description:
Join esteemed mad scientist Dr Ludwig as he faces the greatest challenge of his nefarious career: making a deal with the Devil and coming out on top.

Research demonology! Read legal documents! Face off against the world's least effective torch and pitchfork-wielding mob! All this and more!

title: Ace Combat 7: Skies Unknown - 3rd Anniversary Update
description: To celebrate its 3rd Anniversary, a free update is available now to all #ACE7 players! This update features a payload of new cosmetics, including fourteen new skins, a new callsign, and seventeen new emblems!

title: Siblings
description:
SIBLINGS is a turn-based action game where you react to enemy attacks in real time.

You need to time your parries and dodges to overcome your foes.

title: Its Snowing
description:
Yesterday was quite messy…

Its time to clean up.

title: Outpost Auriga IV
description: Originally it was meant to be a speedbase map but quickly turned into a mixture of textures.

title: Last Voyage of the Aqualus
description: Large adventure map, primarily 19th century themed, with some scifi elements.

title: Info Player Start: A Dope (Challenge) Map
description: A quick map made by spootnik with some small challenges.

title: Fortress of the Arcane Conduit
description: Battle your way through the halls of the eldritch font of arcane power. Collect all four silver keys to escape the citadel and return to a more hospitable dimension.

title: It Is Over 2024
description: A map made for a new year 2024. Map is runic and metal themed multi-floor compact layout map designed to work well in both single player and deathmatch settings.

title: The Trickster's Domain
description: M.C. Escher's Relativity was providing the theme and it's featured prominently in the main area of the map. There is also a progression in which certain areas are only accessible with a certain weapon, similar to what the Metroid games are known for.

title: The Dismal Silhouette
description: Single player map for Quake, using the Arcane Dimensions mod. Based on E2M6: The Dismal Oubliette, by John Romero.

title: Realm of The Lieutenant
description: A repackaged episode of maps done by Kendrick "The Lieutenant" Curtis from 1998-2008.

title: Enter: The Grinch
description:
The Grinch seeks to steal Christmas from Arlia Village - a locale from a JRPG called Star Ocean 2! This has homages to other IP's such as Doom, as well - so you could say it's a four-in-one crossover (even a five-in-one)!

Anyway, as Ranger comes to think of it - the Grinch looks kinda like an Archvile. And seeing that he's up to no good, it's time to put a stop to his evil plans - whatever that entails!

title: Adventures in Lestoria
description:
In this action dungeon-crawling RPG experience, you take on the role of a fighter: Explore and travel through the lands and surrounding countries of Lestoria in search of adventure!

Your quest begins in search of slimes in a nearby forest to restock on potion-making supplies, to soon discover that bandits have attacked the locals and have caused hysteria and chaos. Who would do such an awful thing, and can you put an end to their crimes?

title: Space Station Escape
description: Space Station Escape is a simple find-the-difference game.Players take on the role of an astronaut wanting to escape from a spaceship running out of oxygen.

title: The God Heroes
description: The God Heroes is a 2.5D metroidvania filled with challenges and intense combat. You play as Fezuki, a warrior searching for his lost memories, destined to become a Guardian and protect the universe from the Entity of Darkness.

title: Danganronpa V3: Killing Harmony Demo Ver.
description: The demo version of Danganronpa V3. Having a completely original story from the full game, it features characters from previous Danganronpa games having to solve a murder case together.

title: Over The Phone
description: Over The Phone is a talking sim about a photographer named Jake who meets a girl in the unlikeliest of places, on a customer support call with his internet service provider. The game is akin to a visual novel, in that it's primarily reading / listening to the conversation and periodically making choices about what to say.

title: Rogue-Like: Evolution
description: You are a new Mutant who has the ability to be immune to all other Mutant powers including the girl with the deadly touch Rogue. She's intrigued and susceptible to your influence so you can either play nice and show her the love she's been missing or train her to be your lap dog.​

title: DMB
description: ДМБ is an adventure game developed by Студия "Парус". It was originally released in 2004.

title: A Steamboat Willie
description: Sail as Mikey Mouse with steamboat willy. Move and sell cargo for money but look out for customs officers as they are out to confiscate your illegal cargo.

title: Super Luigi Odyssey
description: A mod of Super Mario Odyssey that retells the story with Luigi, even as far as a stuff being reworked to accompany Luigi.

title: Sonic Nebulous
description:
Sonic Nebulous is a fan-game based on the Sonic the Hedgehog SatAM TV series and includes elements from the original Sonic the Hedgehog games and comics.

It was released in 2009 by qwerty919 (AKA ironrind).

title: La Statuette maudite de l'oncle Ernest
description: You and Chipikan embark again on an adventurous journey through Asia in order to find a secret formula that is needed to save Chipikans people. Together you will unveil the mysterious discoveries of the great adventurer Uncle Albert by solving many riddles and overcoming obstacles with courage, dexterity and logic thinking. You will do this by navigating through Uncle Alberts Notebook where every new page yields a new surprise.

title: Nik Super Gunventure
description: A 2d pixel art rougelike made in GDevelop.

title: Kommissar Kugelblitz: Vermisst am Mississippi
description: Kommissar Kugelblitz needs your help! The daughter of a diamond merchant has disappeared without a trace. You and Kugelblitz travel to New Orleans where you have to find the missing person by using clever logic and good observational skills.

title: Goblin Cleanup
description: A co-op cleaning game where you have to clean and rearrange a dungeon before the next adventurers come to complete it again.

title: Match Tree
description:
Match Tree is a breathtaking puzzle experience (...it's actually a match 3 game).
Embark on an epic journey with pixie, gnome and witch full of adventure, mystery (huh?) and sheep.
Become the master of combination and create magnificent mansions from trees, flowers and carrots (I swear, it's fun!).

title: Soundless: Final Verse
description: An update of Soundless that adds a new epilogue, text tweaks, new art and better accessibility features.

title: Love Live! Nijigasaki High School Idol Club: Tokimeki Roadmap to the Future
description: An upcoming visual novel based on Love Live! Nijigasaki High School Idol Club by Bushiroad Games.

title: XIX
description:
A free adult game based on "Teen Titans (2003)". Game set on alternate timeline Where Terra joined Titans instead of Slade. Game begins after Titans defeated Brotherhood of Evil in the show.

You play as a new Titan trainee, who wants to prove himself and become a better titan. On your way towards the goal you develop friendship with 6 Titan girls.
You can either turn the friendship into Relationship or Become a friend with benefits. It's your choice.

title: Sonic Robo Blast 2: Top Down
description: A mod for Sonic Robo Blast 2.

title: Football Club 2019-2023
description: Latest update for the old version of Football Club which will be considered as a separate outdated version of the game

title: Davy Jones Dating Simulator
description: Davy Jones Dating Simulator is a comedic dating sim where you date the man who posts seven videos or more per day, Davy Jones himself.

title: RWBY: Grimm Eclipse - JNPR
description:
Four (4) new playable characters come to RWBY: Grimm Eclipse. Includes all of Team JNPR - Jaune Arc, Nora Valkyrie, Pyrrha Nikos, and Lie Ren.

Features:
* 4 new characters playable in all game modes including the story campaign.
* Fully voiced by the show's cast

title: 100 Capitalist Cats
description:
Join the cutest adventure in the Wall Street, New York, heart of capitalism! Explore the charming hand-drawn artwork of architecture as you embark on a quest to find 100 adorable cats hidden throughout the game.
Test your attention and observation skills in this cozy and delightful hidden object game.
Each cat is more charming than the last, and every discovery brings a smile to your face.

title: 100 London Cats
description:
Join the cutest adventure in the London, United Kingdom! Explore the charming hand-drawn artwork of architecture as you embark on a quest to find 100 adorable cats hidden throughout the game.
Test your attention and observation skills in this cozy and delightful hidden object game.
Each cat is more charming than the last, and every discovery brings a smile to your face.
Can you find them all?

title: Dragon City X Shitei
description: An erotic game about a man who is taken to a fantasy world full of women.

title: Dragon Eyes
description: Dragon Eyes is a "space opera" kind of story, focusing on a young girl named Ines, who lives on the planet Miu of the Phi Sun. She grew up together with a space agent named Klind, to whom she refers as "brother". One day, her superior from the planet Garudoria informs her that Klind has disappeared during one of his missions and might be in danger. Ines travels to Garudoria to find additional information, and soon becomes involved in a vast space conflict... Dragon Eyes plays like a traditional Japanese adventure, with commands such as Examine, Talk, Think, and Move appearing on every screen. Choosing one of those commands usually leads into a sub-menu of objects. There is also limited usage of items, which is sometimes required in order to advance in the game.

title: Dennou Gakuen
description:
You have been selected as one of the few lucky male pupils to go to the famous Cybernetic Hi-School. But before you can enroll, you must undergo three tests executed by fellow female pupils. Each test has three rounds of 25 questions, of which 20 must be correctly answered. As you finish a round, your exam proctor takes off some clothes. The questions are decidedly nerdy, pertaining mainly to science fiction, comics, animation and toys, as well as the technology used in such genres and media.

An updated version, sold as Dennou Gakuen V2, was released for the PC-9800 series and included full screen graphics and faster load times.

title: Slendrina's Freakish Friends and Family Night
description:
Granny and Slendrina are hosting a get-together for all their family and friends, and the best news is, you're the main star of the attraction. You've been invited (read: taken) to their humble abode, where you'll spend countless nights meeting (and hopefully keeping your distance from) all your new friends.
Every night has you questioning if it could be your last... Can you survive the challenges they've prepared for you? Or will you meet a grisly end at the hands of one of the many killers wandering the dark corridors...?

title: Adivinhe a Cor!
description: Get the right color based on random RGB! Earn 3 points each time and make your best score!
