title: Mega Man Dongs
description:
Mega Man Dongs is a fan-game with two main characteristics: parody and difficulty.
The authors are Robot Goat and Dectilion.

title: Nobody Sleeps Tonight
description: A co-op survival horror about finding your friend who disappears at night in a strange forest hiding a sinister secret.

title: Concrete Visions
description: Concrete Visions is a first-person lo-fi art house psychological thriller video game with survival horror and FPS beat’em up elements. There are two main components to the gameplay - melee & lite arms combat and environmental exploration

title: Learn The Heart
description: Learn the Heart is a dating sim RPG. Experience the game by exploring the main character's hometown, dating a partner, playing minigames, learning about the partner's story, and making use of the feature-rich H-mode.

title: Goomba Racing
description:
Nyoom! It's time to race and drift with the SmoloMyth girls!
Goomba racing is a mario-kart like game where you zoom around in KFP on Roombas!

title: Mandela Invasion
description: FNAF like game inspired by Mandela Catalogue

title: Nifty Island
description:
Nifty Island is a community-driven gaming platform where players can build and play games together, explore player-created islands, and compete for compelling rewards.

Build your own island. Invite your friends. Win rewards. Play any game that you can imagine and engage in prize-fueled competitions. The internet's best communities play on Nifty Island.

title: The King is Watching
description: The King is Watching is a roguelite kingdom builder. Rule by the power of your royal gaze! Decide between producing resources, training armies, or balancing both, while adapting to unique events every run.

title: Neon Dan
description: I built this in Scratch in Highscool during 2021 for my final project, and wanted my friends to be able to truly show off their love for it.

title: Desperate Escape
description: Your character wakes up in a warehouse, armed with a torch. Navigate through the complex to find car parts to fix up a truck to escape, but watch out for the monsters around every corner.

title: The Blood of Dawnwalker
description: The Blood of Dawnwalker is an open-world dark fantasy action RPG set in 14th-century Europe. You play as Coen, human by day and vampire by night, fighting to save your family in a story shaped by your actions and the secrets you uncover.

title: Kalia and The Fire Staff
description: A fiery top-down dungeon crawling adventure.

title: 100 Capitalist Cats: Extra Content
description: By purchasing DLC, you will get extra content in the game 100 Capitalist Cats.

title: Forgotten 13
description: A freelance reporter goes to a quiet suburban neighborhood to investigate the disappearances of 13 people between 1963 & 1987. Despite the case being cold, it's about to get very, very warm.

title: Formidolosa Nocte
description: A young lady is walking home from a Halloween party at a local bar. However, you soon come to find out that this Halloween, is one she will NEVER forget. Will you be able to solve the mistery surrounding the neighborhood killings and get our heroine home safe?

title: Parasites
description: Jonathan's son, John, is kidnapped in the middle of the night and his father chases the people who took him to save the boy and find out why he was captured. Along the way, you'll uncover a web of secrets and plot twists that will challenge everything you thought you knew.

title: Crosswords and More
description: A CD-ROM game featuring thousands of crossword puzzles.

title: Immortal Snake Nest
description: A visit to the hospital goes awry.

title: Miodesopsia: Whispering Stories
description: A short game/interactive experience where you follow the wandering soul of a roach.

title: Maiden's Banquet
description: This is spellcard collection for Danmakufu Ph3. There are 46 spellcards in script. You need Danmakufuph3 [.1 pre6] to play.

title: Divine Journey 2
description: Divine Journey 2 is a Minecraft 1.12.2 Expert modpack that is the spiritual successor to the 1.7.10 Divine Journey modpack. It features a unique progression line and a lot more mods to go through than its predecessor.

title: Intertwine
description: A recurring dream. A flash of deja vu. An undeniable connection. Some say these are remnants of our past lives—echoes of the memories we’ve made in centuries past. When I ran into you on that fateful day…

title: The Vambrace of Destiny
description: A light dungeon crawl. Tap spell gems to defeat monsters!

title: Bloodstained: Curse of the Moon Chronicles
description:
Bloodstained: Curse of the Moon Chronicles is the ultimate bundle for fans of retro-style action games. This Japanese version of the game includes both Bloodstained: Curse of the Moon and its sequel, Bloodstained: Curse of the Moon 2, in one package. Experience classic side-scrolling gameplay with modern technology that harkens back to the days of 8-bit and 16-bit games.

With retro-style gameplay, stunning visuals, and intense action, Bloodstained: Curse of the Moon Chronicles is the ultimate gaming experience for fans of classic side-scrolling action games. Whether you're a long-time fan or new to the series, this game will provide hours of exciting and challenging gameplay.

title: Shanghai Blood of War
description: This game is a first-person shooter set during the Sino-Japanese War, focusing on a Chinese protagonist who leads a civilian resistance against the Japanese invasion of Shanghai in 1937, featuring historically accurate weapons and intense combat experiences in a meticulously recreated 1930s Shanghai.

title: Homegrown Pet
description:
Your pet has unfortunately turned back into shape of tiny cute blob.
You need to feed him fast in span of 60 second before the authorities arrived!
Easy control! And with 21 different endings to get!
How will you raise your pet in span of 60 second?

title: U4iA
description:
You are heading to an exotic island (a large one with several cities/locations, not the beach and palms only type).
While on this island you run into quite a few girls.
You all have your own backstory to how you ended up there,
and there's a reason you're all there. u4ia tells the story of what's happening on that island,
the backstory to how you all got there, bonding with these people,
getting ready for something you don't even know will happen.
Try to befriend these girls and make the most of it.

title: Etherscape
description: Etherscape is a multiplayer online rogue-lite action RPG with a crypto backend that allows users to own and trade their items. It gives players the control to mint NFT's based on the randomized loot that they find while playing. This enables a player driven economy in which the players control the creation of NFT's directly.

title: PSP1G: The Incident
description: A fan game made for PSP1G the streamer.

title: DMB 2
description:
DMB 2 is an adventure game and a sequel to the original DMB. The game takes place some time after the first game. Alex Chaikin has finished his service in the army and came back home with the girl he met there. They got married and had 2 kids. But Alex, being a lazy guy, didn't look for work and lived off the money he got carrying out a special mission in the army. Soon afterwards, the young couple ran out of money and Kate, his wife, sent him off to find a job.

It didn't take too long to find a job as Alex received a phone call from his friend asking him to join the ranks of the Police. Thus, getting his first job to investigate a burglary, players will begin the adventure game.

Being a point and click adventure game, players will need to find, pick up and use various objects in different situations. Alex also has access to a police database, where he can find out extra info about the important characters in the game.

title: Eggconsole Marchen Veil PC-8801mkIISR
description:
The tale of a prince transformed into an ugly monster and cast to the ends of the world. Overcoming numerous challenges, he must now return to the princess!
This action RPG was released by System Sacom in 1985.

This game is the first part of the "Märchen Veil" series. The story of the first part is until you meet Neptunus, the god of the sea.

title: Eggconsole Silpheed PC-8801mkIISR
description:
The best 3D shooter game of the 80's. Drive the Silpheed fighter jet and crush the ambitions of the Xacalite who have sacked Gloire.

"SILPHEED" is a vertical scrolling 3D shooter game released by Gamearts in 1986.
The player boards the air fighter SA-08 Silpheed and sets out to crush the insurgency.

The game consists of a total of 20 areas, including outer space, inside the base, and above the planet, and players advance while destroying enemies who fly in one after another. Silpheed can be powered up by collecting items placed in each area, and weapons are added according to the score.

At the end of each area, players will be confronted by large enemies with unique attack methods, such as attacking with ring lasers or reflecting our lasers.

title: Eggconsole Relics PC-8801
description:
This is an action-adventure game released by Bothtec in 1986. The main character is drifting as a spirit in the ruins that suddenly appear from under the sea. There is no explanation as to why he has become a spirit or what he has to do, but by exploring the ruins, the situation becomes dimly apparent.

One of the highlights of this game is the spirit ride system, in which the player possesses a defeated opponent. The attack methods and durability vary depending on the possessed body, so the key to the strategy is which creature you possess as you continue your search. In addition, the items that can be obtained change depending on the player's actions, and the storyline and ending change, so it is up to the player to decide how to proceed with the exploration of the ruins. The ability to experiment with this and that is a unique aspect of this game.

The cinematic elements of the game, such as the rich sci-fi character designs, the profound movements of the humanoid characters, and the effective sound of the waves, will add to the excitement of the game. The opening and ending music was composed by Crystal King, which was a big hit at the time.

title: Interaction Isn't Explicit.
description:
What counts as interaction in video games? This short study debates different aspects of game design, pros and cons, and why such questions are essential for the language of computer games.

Explore a visually stunning world accompanied by a simple but effective third-person shooter combat and magnificent music, composed by FRENCH 79.

title: Escape Floor Zero
description:
Trapped in an infinite parking lot, your only escape is through Floor Zero.
Detect subtle anomalies and make crucial decisions in this mind-bending, psychological horror experience.
Dare to escape the unescapable?
If you see an anomaly... turn back.

title: Slave Zero X: Episode Enyo
description: Episode Enyo is a six-level campaign that takes place before the events of Slave Zero X, played from the perspective of one of the game’s main antagonists. The elite assassin Enyo is armed to the teeth and on a warpath to take down her most formidable target yet: the Sovereign Khan.

title: MLB The Show 24
description: Swing for the fences, experience game-deciding moments, become a legend and live out your baseball dreams in MLB The Show 24. Earn your call up from the minors to the big leagues and prove you’ve got what it takes at the top. Learn about known and unsung legends of the sport and take inspiration from their heroics. Hold your nerve when it matters and earn the right to be called World Series champions.

title: 15 Awesome Card & Puzzle Games
description: A collection of card and puzzle games for PC.

title: Fun with Shapes Patterns & Music
description: Fun with Shapes Patterns & Music is an Australian edutainment game targeted towards kids aged 3 to 6 that is made to teach children about shapes, pattern recognition and music.

title: David Jones: Merry Christmas CD-ROM
description: David Jones: Merry Christmas CD-ROM was a promotional PC game sold at David Jones during the early 2000s. The game is a compilation of Christmas themed games, alongside an ecard creator.

title: Super Cosmic Heist Plus
description:
"Fierce The "Bandit King" returns once again and has gotten himself roped into a full scale invasion of the world he dwells in!

As he was trying to catch some Zs after defeating Plague and trapping him inside a giant jewel from his previous outing, he is ambushed by an intimidating android who makes off with his jewel and witnesses a horrific space station looming in the sky.

As Fierce (Now joined by his trusty partner in crime - Moofie The Chu-Chu Snake) tries to find out what the cosmic heck is going on he sees a girl getting captured by a drone guard, perhaps she will know what's the deal about these invading jerks and help get his treasure back!"

title: Dross Adventure
description: It is the current era, in our current galaxy. We hear the dull sound of space, we perceive beams of light in the distance that draw constellations on a dark spatial background. Being conscious witnesses of the magnitude of our planet and what we really are in comparison with the rest of the universe, but we only find one more overwhelming sensation, and that is that somewhere , Dr. Cojona has something prepared for the world

title: Prison Architect 2
description: Welcome Architects! Design and develop your own personalized penitentiary in Prison Architect 2. The classic prison-builder has broken out into 3D, and it's up to you to contain it!

title: Transportando o Brasil
description:
In Transportando o Brasil, players can experience what it's like to be a truck driver. He doesn't just drive a truck, he also has many objectives to fulfill while carrying out his hard daily routine.

Making a living and a better life for his family is one of them, which is why Transportando o Brasil is a different kind of game that gives a glimpse into the life of a truck driver.

title: Blazing Food
description: A short text adventure about food, ahoges and alcohol.

title: Piecing It Together
description:
Piecing It Together brings jigsaw puzzles to a whole new dimension!
Reassemble beautiful handcrafted dioramas in 3D!
Enjoy a quick puzzling session with just a handful of pieces, or challenge yourself with many!

title: Sea of Thieves: Season 11
description:
Access the adventures you crave more quickly than ever before with Season 11's overhaul of Voyages and encounters!

Explore a redesigned Quest system, major expansions to most Trading Companies, new loot items and more with the Sea of Thieves at your fingertips.

title: False Dream
description:
You find yourself trapped in a dream. Capture anomalies, meaning locations or phenomena that deviate from reality, with a camera. By doing so, you might be able to return to reality.

There are two modes: Normal Mode and Nightmare Mode. In Normal Mode, an anomaly will always occur at each time. However, in Nightmare Mode, there are instances where no anomaly occurs. You will find themselves wondering whether there are no anomalies present or if they simply haven't been discovered yet. I recommend playing in Normal mode for the first game.

title: Day of the Sandwich
description: Day of the Sandwich is a short graphic adventure in the visual style of Lucas Arts titles Day of the Tentacle and Sam & Max: Hit the Road. A very short and simple puzzle adventure where the player is required to make a sandwich.

title: Genshin Impact: Vibrant Harriers Aloft in Spring Breeze
description:
Version 4.4 of Genshin Impact, which includes:
• New characters: Xianyun and Gaming
• New area: Chenyu Vale
• New story quest for Xianyun
• New outfits for Xingqiu, Ganyu and Shenhe
• New main event: Vibrant Harriers Aloft in Spring Breeze
• New quality of life features
• …and more!

title: Room Escape
description: Helen is a young woman who hardly ever leaves her home. Bored one night, she turns on the TV only to see a broadcast announcing an evacuation for her neighborhood. Locked inside, she must solve puzzles in order to find the key and escape her house.

title: Wakerunners
description:
Wakerunners is a 4v4 & 5v5 team action game set in a near-future Earth, now a relic of its past. Glide through arenas with a top-down view, employing a unique speed mechanic. Unleash swift combat in diverse landscapes for an immersive experience.

Are you ready for battle? It is too late to stop. In order to protect the team and secure victory, get yourself ready to dive into the battlefield.

According to a final news post before the game's page was removed from Steam, development was halted and the game was permanently canceled after feedback from the Steam Next Fest playtest indicated that significant improvements were needed to achieve the core gameplay quality the developers were aiming for.

title: Zoochosis
description: Zoochosis is a bodycam horror simulation game. You’re a night zookeeper. Identify infected mutant animals, make a vaccine and cure them. Will you save all of them and survive?

title: The Mandela Experience
description: Experience The Horrors From Mark's Perspective In This Short Visual Novel RPG Maker Game

title: The Great Sea Battle
description: The Great Naval Battle is a traditional naval combat strategy that probably everyone knows, but in a 3D computer format.

title: Skullman Kills
description:
A boss rush game based on the Megaman series.

Skullman has attained full sentience and has decided he's had enough with Dr. Wily. Now, Wily's out to stop him and bring him back for reprogramming! Are you a bad enough skeleton to defeat Wily and his gang of minions?

title: Manor Madness
description: In Manor Madness you take on the role of the ghost Ghustav and unleash mayhem. Ghustav has been accepted to the most prestigious school of Polter High where they will study how to possess objects and fling them across the room. Of course, traditional haunting can't be missed. Turn on any electrical appliances, flick the light switch, or play a spooky tune.

title: RPG Survivors
description:
The game involves continuously facing new enemies, defeating them to acquire weapons or skills, and striving to survive for 20 minutes.

You can choose from 5 characters and explore several stages.

It's a log-lite genre game, where you can collect gems or coins through gameplay to become stronger.

title: Umineko Project
description: The Umineko Project is an unofficial fan port that brings the PS3 remaster of Umineko no Naku Koro ni to the PC platform, with a newly-edited English translation as well as support for Russian.

title: The Boss Gangster: Criminal Empire
description: Rule the night, become the city's boss! Manage your own nightclub, explore the dazzling nightlife, and stand against rival gangsters. Walk the fine line between the business world and the criminal underworld, dealing with corrupt police and authorities

title: Cats Hidden in Germany
description: Find 100 cats hiding in the cozy medieval Germany in this cute hand-drawn hidden object game.

title: The Clockwork Prince
description: The game follows Ian, a clockwork robot whose job is to repair the great clock tower in which humanity resides after a great tragedy forced them to seek shelter within its walls. After finishing up his repairs for the day, Ian heads home and meets with a mysterious robed figure.

title: TopSpin 2K25
description: The worlds of tennis and 2K have collided. TopSpin 2K25 is the next must-play sports game from 2K that fully immerses fans in the world of tennis. For more information on TopSpin 2K25, including release date, game features and more, stay tuned.

title: RoboSync
description: RoboSync is a puzzle game where you will need to use logical reasoning and precision to complete the challenges. Release and lock passages at the right time to synchronize your robots' movements and achieve perfect synchronization to release all the locks at the same time.

title: College Slam
description:
College JAM takes place in the killer future of 198X when a mysterious meteor crashes on earth. It's time to SLAM!

Originally made for GameJolt's BadBoxArt Jam, College Slam is 6 level runner game where you must escape several colleges.

title: Splodey
description: The platformer without a jump button! Master the art of potion propulsion in this fast-paced adventure where strategy, precision, and creativity meet explosive fun.

title: Skull Man Kills 2: Mega Man 2 II - Blood Vengeance
description:
The official sequel to Skull Man Kills. Features full levels, Mega Man X-style dashing and walljumping and more.

After Wily's defeat, Skull Man has returned back to Cossack's lab, only to be stuck doing menial labor. But, as fate would have it, Skull Man must return to action after Wily threatens Earth once more with a strangely familiar band of robots... and Mega Man is nowhere to be found!

title: Oh My God! It's Joseph Joestar In Subarashii: X-Mas Mode In July
description: Sonic Uncovers Banning And Realizes Anime Spoilers Hurt Intricate Ideas is... a mouthful. I mean, it's the sequel to Sugoi, a community project that ended up way more successful than I had ever anticipated! So I thought, why not make a sequel? Turns out, this also became more successful than I had ever anticipated! If you missed out last time, here's what went down: I gave everyone a month to make a level, tied them together with a hub level and a final boss, and released it! It's the result's a mod by the community, for the community! None of this would've been possible without the massive contributions I received. While the basic format is the same as last time, I tried to do some extra stuff to make this one unique in its own ways.

title: Dusty At Home
description: In this game you play as the little potato man, Dusty. He is a really chill and relaxed streamer, but things are gonna change for him. He is gonna fight himself trough a set of nightmares a which originated from his brothers disappearance. You have to survive 7 nightmares and after there is a custom night with challenges. There even are multiple endings to this game.

title: The Legend of Zelda: The Wheel of Fate
description: The game follows the epic story of Din, last daughter of the dying Goddess Tribe. Her tribe alone knows the truth of Hyrule's past, that Ganon, Zelda and Link are locked into an endless cycle of reincarnation, dooming Hyrule to continual recurring war. Din can break the cycle by finding and rejoining the three pieces of the broken triforce. Unfortunately, they are contained within the living bodies of Ganon, Zelda and Link, and the only way to get them out is to kill all three of them. Din must also find her two sisters, Nayru and Farore, who have gone out into Hyrule and never returned, for they hold the key to defeating the mysterious force that has kept the Goddesses from saving their world.

title: Grimoires & Guns
description: Grimoires and Guns is a free-to-play multiplayer online competitive card game in the auto battler subgenre.

title: Placid Plastic Duck Simulator: Ducks, Please
description: Placid Plastic Duck Simulator - Ducks, Please is a large sprawling expansion pack with 27 additional ducks! Each and every one of them is a brand new, never before seen, original duck that will be added to your collection.

title: Placid Plastic Duck Simulator: Duck Addiction
description: Placid Plastic Duck Simulator - Duck Addiction brings 27 additional ducks to the pool! Each of them is a brand-new duck you have never met, with a unique personality and, in some cases, new interactions.

title: The Legend of Zeldo: Lonk's Awakening DX
description: Prince Zeldo's been kidnapped... again. Looks like a job for Lonk, the Heroine of Thyme! Grab your sword and... oh, you forgot it at home? Uh, that's fine. Probably.

title: Placid Plastic Duck: Hippospace Download
description: With this additional location, you'll enjoy a funfair experience in space, a lazy river of lights, and a calm, solitary ride in orbit. Come check the cockpit and meet 3 special spatial ducks!

title: Last Dino Standing
description: Last Dino Standing is a fast-paced game where you control a T-rex to avoid crazy elements.

title: Nephew's Vendetta
description: Embark on a relentless journey, vanquish powerful bosses, and wield incredible upgrades in this intense action-packed game. Do you have what it takes to conquer the shadows and emerge victorious?

title: Shin Megami Tensei VX
description: A previously japanese-only fan remake of the first Shin Megami Tensei made in RPG Maker VX and translated into english by TeaTimeSpooks. Includes all new routes, altered gameplay, new demons, and more. .

title: Pony in Backrooms
description: Pony in Backrooms is a My Little Pony fangame based on the backrooms.

title: Pikupals: Picross + Aliens
description: A short gameboy-themed nonogram game with helpful alien creatures.

title: Doom: The Lost Episode
description:
A semi-official 5th episode for The Ultimate Doom.

This project's aim is to bring the official and relatively obscure console-exclusive maps together in a single playable episode. Maps consist of levels from PSXDoom, Jaguar Doom, and the Doom Alphas, re-mastered in a surreal yet fitting "neo-classic" style.

Prepare for Evil Unleashed.

title: The Cookie Project
description:
The holidays are a busy time for the tiny bakery you run in the Last City, and you're used to all kinds of unique customers frequenting your shop during these days. What you didn't expect was a handsome awoken—a guardian no less—carrying a strange contraption and sheepishly requesting your help with his... holiday baking?! In the midst of winter's dreary cold, the blossoms of friendship (or romance ) may soon yet bloom!

The Cookie Project is a Destiny 2 fangame in which you can romance or befriend Vanade's Guardian OC, Cepheus, but the game has been made accessible and enjoyable for non-Destiny players too!

title: The Snow Queen is Uncool
description: It's winter solstice, and Berta should be out there doing her job as an arbiter of mortals, but she prefers to laze around at home instead. This terrible character flaw has almost led to her disappearing from humanity's radar! On her own, she'll have no idea how to fix this... Thankfully, her loyal, brilliant, enterprising and very humble manager knows just the way to save her from obscurity.

title: GameChanger: Episode 1
description: Take on the challenge to close the four Portals in this varied 2D-Action-Adventure with shoot 'em up elements! Explore the open Interworld, solve tricky puzzles in complex dungeons, shoot your way through the hordes of counter viruses and stop the dragon!

title: Arcade Archives: Mighty Guy
description:
"Mighty Guy" is an action game released by Nichibutsu in 1986.
Use your PSYCHO GUN in addition to superhuman actions like punches, kicks, and beams to take down enemies and stop the massive supercomputer "ZELDA" in its schemes to genetically modify humanity and take over the world!

title: Arcade Archives: Super Contra
description:
ALERT! ALERT!
The aliens are back!

title: Urban Thief Simulator: The Ultimate Heist
Rally Cross
description: A port of Rally Cross, enhanced with up-rendering, rewind, quick save, and custom video filters.

title: Moon Lander
description: Embark on an exhilarating lunar mission where precision and finesse are your keys to success. Your spacecraft is equipped with limited fuel, and your mission is to land safely on the lunar surface to score points.

title: Mystic Academy: Escape Room
description: Today is the day of your final exam to become a wizard. Within this enchanting escape room, you'll navigate a wizardry school, unravel puzzles, master new spells, and put your magical skills to the ultimate test. Will you emerge triumphant?

title: Farm Knight Adventures
description: Build up your farm,grow fruits, cook food and grab your sword and go on epic adventures!

title: If we meet after the ending
description: "Long time no see. You've grown up a lot." 10 years ago, a lover who left me in an accident appeared as a ghost. Can we undo the belated regret?

title: Try if you can 100
description: Defence enemies with a variety of charactersEnemies are coming.Defend your enemies with your own strategic placement

title: Kepler-2100
description: Kepler 2100 is an interstellar-themed strategy game

title: 100 Hidden Kooky: Sand & Sun
description: Find 100 hidden silly characters with unusual behaviours in the beach and an additional 100 sunscreen bottles to complete the game. Also play mini challenges to get help with your quest.

title: 100 lil jumps
description: Nara the frog has been cursed and can only make 100 jumps. Complete the challenge and break the curse

title: 100 Ninja Cats
description: 100 Ninja Cats - Join the cutest adventure in the Ninja themed locations full of cats! Explore the charming hand-drawn artwork of the Ninja places and Cats as you embark on a quest to find 100 adorable cats hidden throughout the game. Can you find them all?

title: 100 Paris Cats
description: 100 Paris Cats - Join the cutest adventure in the Paris, heart of France! Explore the charming hand-drawn artwork of the Paris and Cats as you embark on a quest to find 100 adorable cats hidden throughout the game. Can you find them all?

title: 100 Pirate Cats
description: 100 Pirate Cats - Join the cutest adventure in the Sea with PIRATES! Explore the charming hand-drawn artwork of the Sea Pirates and Cats as you embark on a quest to find 100 adorable cats hidden throughout the game. Can you find them all?

title: 100% Plasma Vitae
description: Point and click game, with emphasis on narrative, time management, and luck on the dice!

title: 100 Rooms
description: An online cooperative horror game for 1-4 players. Find useful items and get as far as you can. Until you complete all 100 rooms!

title: Winter Cats
description: Hidden Winter Cats - Find and paint 100 hidden cats in this big snowy location! Test your attention and relax in this cozy and free game

title: 1001 Nights
description: This is an AI-native game. Start a journey in the ancient Persian Empire as Shahrzad. Use magic to turn language into reality, collect unique weapons from the tales, and get revenge on the evil King! The fate of the world is yours to rewrite!

title: 100 Cats Greece
description: Find 100 Cats hidden in Greece! Can you find them all?

title: 100 Cats London
description: Find 100 Cats hidden in London! Can you find them all?

title: 100 Cats New York
description: Find 100 Cats hidden in New York! Can you find them all?

title: 100 Hidden Cats in China
description: 100 Hidden Cats in China - Join the cutest adventure in the China! Explore the charming hand-drawn artwork of China Landscape as you embark on a quest to find 100 adorable cats hidden throughout the game.Can you find them all?

title: 100 Cats Mexico
description: Find 100 Cats hidden in Mexico! Can you find them all?

title: 100 Asian Cats: Extra Content
description: By purchasing DLC, you will get extra content in the game 100 Asian Cats.

title: 101 Cats
description: Find and discover 101 cute cats hidden throughout the landscape in this hand-drawn hidden object game. Can you find them all?

title: 24 o 'clock
description: It has been impossible to study when it began, but it is gradually accepted by more and more people with its unique mathematical charm and rich connotation. This kind of game is simple and easy to learn, can strengthen the brain puzzle, is a very beneficial activity.

title: New Immortal
description: A text placement game with a cultivation theme, featuring 64 cultivation systems, 24 independent dungeons, multiple interactive modes, and various combat economy modes.

title: Escape From The Test
description: I hate studying, it's too much trouble. If you think so, you might be attacked by "him" too...? Let's escape from the "zero point test" together with the main character!

title: Bug darake no Mura
description: バグを探して、村を元通りにせよ！

title: Stellar Realm Voyage
description: A high degree of freedom space shooting game for Spaceship Modular Editing, Like building blocks. Weapon sequence, branching, and inheritance, constructing weapon systems like real magic. Build a unique spaceship and freely form a fleet to battle or pass levels like a meat pigeon.

title: Ranch Battle
description: Ranch Battle is a top-down arena shooting light ROGUE game where players take on the role of a character who simultaneously uses four weapons to repel swarms of aliens. Choose from various features and props until rescue arrives.

title: Ano-chan wo Byouin ni Tsuretette
description: A game that was actually produced for the TV show "Anochan no Sasayaka na kimochi Desuga..! Take Anochan to the hospital!

title: Falcon 2023
description: You will play the role of a new special police officer who arrives in the dangerous city of Flora. Various violent incidents continue to occur, and the sheriff hires and trains personnel from the outside world in an attempt to fight the terrorists to the death. This operation is codenamed Falcon

title: Time Treker
description: Time Treker is a 2D top-view shooter game. Players engage in constant combat to achieve achievements, activate abilities, and unlock heroes, weapons, and plug-ins. Customize with different combinations of weapons and plug-ins, and play your own combat genre.

title: The Yanus Plan for Escape from the Void
description: "The Yanus Plan for Escape from the Void" is a first person perspective escape room game where you lose your memory and don't know where you are. You have to keep moving forward and explore the truth.

title: Knight Party
description: As a lord on the continent of Oren, lead your knights on various adventures!!

title: Rokumenhappi
description: Dice are fun! Everyone knows the rule that if you roll it, the position of the surface will change. This geme is a puzzle game that arranges such dice.

title: Fragmented Leaves: Before the Storm
description: The two former enemies gathered together because of the same enemy. Their task is to prevent the outbreak of a war. However, their efforts were destined to be in vain, and all of this was just a prelude to the outbreak of the great war.

title: Tunshi Unifying Plains
description: "The Conquest of China" is a RPG role-playing game centered around Liu Bei of the Shu Kingdom. Unlike other Three Kingdoms RPGs, the game does not start with the usual storyline, but instead begins with the murder of Liu's mother by the Yellow Turban Rebellion, setting Liu on a path of revenge.

title: Sun-shot Legend
description: What kind of game is this?This is a role-playing game. This work tells the follow-up story of the ancient Chinese myth of shooting the sun. Every nine Yang in the sky, shoot down eight Yang, save the world. The player controls the protagonist to kill monsters to complete the level.

title: Kosaka-san: Remaster
description: “A meteorite will fall in three days. That's why I want to commit suicide proactively before then.” The girl who told me this upon our first meeting was someone I encountered on the school rooftop—a place that should have been off-limits.

title: Little Heroes
description: A real-time strategy game where you build your own army to consolidate your territory.

title: Mark's Power
description: Mark's Power is an adventure game that combines elements of many genres. You will have to interact with the locals of an unknown planet in order to repair your ship and fly home.

title: 9000 Years Ago
description: What would you do if you went back to a time when the land didn't belong to anyone?

title: 77th: The Game
description: 77th: The Game is an abstract representation of the experience of joining an online community. Walk through the community and solve the puzzles to progress as a community member.

title: 3D Puzzle: Factory
description: Collect a 3D puzzle, transferring things to the right places to create a beautiful place.

title: 24H Stories: The Rule 7
description: Recently, people in Japan have been talking about an urban legend: a mysterious program is circulating on the internet. The person who activates this program must follow 7 rules within a week, or they will face punishment, even death. In 7 days, various maddening supernatural events will occur.

In this 2D pixel RPG, 24 navigate battles, puzzles, and quests in a war-torn world devoid of color. Your choices dictate the non-linear plot, with multiple endings and an open world hanging in the balance. Will you bring back color as the savior or succumb to darkness?
A horror visual novel about urban legends of Russian town in 2007.

"1991" is an exciting game set in the USSR in 1991. Your main character, Leshka, has recently turned ten. He made a bet with his friend that he can spend a whole hour in an abandoned building. But things don't go as he expected...

title: 18Hell: Lost
description: "18 Hell:Lost" is a psychological horror indie game set in 1930s Shanghai. Players awaken in a grand hotel, trapped as fate and soul intertwine, leading them deeper into the unknown.

title: 12 Labours of Hercules XVI: Olympic Bugs
description: Help Hercules stop Olympian-created sentient machines’ rebellion, uncover the cause, and protect humanity from imminent danger!

title: Unheim
description: UNHEIM is a psychological horror surveillance game of exceptional difficulty in which you must not only report anomalies, but also learn to survive paranormal attacks. Every night is a fight for survival against lurking horrors.

title: Moses & Plato: Last Train to Clawville
description: A murder mystery where you are the main suspect! An ambassador on a peace mission has been killed on board the Clawville Express. Time progresses as you sniff out clues, eavesdrop on conversations, and interrogate passengers. Can you solve the case before the train reaches the last station? Or else.

title: Toxic Tomb
description:
Toxic Tomb is an action platformer with the spirit of a SEGA Master System game.
Crawl along each level and destroy all the generators to force the opening of the reactor. Then attack the reactor to release the ghoul inside it and kill it. Move fast, chain enemy kills and get stars to obtain bonuses. You'll get an extra life every 75.000 points. Finding the right place to attack and dodge is the key. Also, playing gracefully from the beginning will help you in the final stretch of the game.

title: Honour & Freedom II Power Enhanced Edition
Exiled
description: Charlotte is missing. Decode an ancient language, investigate a mystery, and stay away from ancient monsters in this compact puzzle thriller.

title: Hope with Island
description: Hope and Island is a simulated production game with adventure solving elements, integrating survival, role playing, strategy and other elements.

title: Rocket Knight Adventures: Re-Sparked
description:
The mightiest mammal to ever rocket to stardom is back in a three-game, Carbon Engine-powered collection that includes:
- Rocket Knight Adventures
- Sparkster: Rocket Knight Adventures 2
- Sparkster

title: Disappearance: Takeshi. You were right. That Abandoned Village is Too Bad
description: Shissou: Takeshi Omae no Iu Toori datta Ano Haison ha Yaba sugiru is a first-person horror comedy game that explores an abandoned village in Japan to find your lost best friend.

title: Kawã na Terra dos Indígenas Maraguá
description: Kawã na Terra dos Indígenas Maraguá is an educational platformer developed by the Federal University of São Carlos, under its LEETRA laboratory. It tells the story of a young indigenous boy who goes through the Wakaripé ritual. According to the tradition that marks the transition from childhood to adulthood, when boys turn ten, they must pass some tests to demonstrate their bravery. Then, at the age of 15, they face the even more challenging Gualipãg ritual, which entitles them to become "chief hunter-warrior".

title: Everstorm
description: Everstorm is a PVP roguelite extraction game. Each match you will choose your class, level up, choose upgrades, evolve your abilities and fight other players. Defeat the final boss and extract, then upgrade your character and go back in for more!

title: Diablo IV: Season of the Construct
description:
Ancient forces threaten Sanctuary. Aided by your Seneschal Companion, hazard the many traps and devastating Constructs beneath the deserts of Kehjistan.

Deep beneath the swirling sands, elemental forces are amassing for malicious whims of the demon Malphas. Only by descending far below the surface will you be able to cull this cursed threat from its root.

Prepare to uncover the powerful secrets of Zoltun Kulle’s Loom with a new Dungeon type called Vaults, a seasonal robotic Seneschal Companion, and Weekly Leaderboards in The Gauntlet. Several key quality-of-life features—including almost constant Helltide events—arrive to help aid your conquests while fighting in the Vaults.

title: Resident Evil 2: Source
description: Enter the survival horror. Explore, solve, and fight your way through Raccoon City and it's police department in this source engine remake of Resident Evil 2.

title: Shark's Song
description: Hilda, a sentient bipedal shark, lives with her creator at the bottom of the sea and tries to avoid public attention... but is this what she really wants?

title: Something Unlimited
description:
Something Unlimited is a comic-based parody brothel management game. You play as Lex, seeking to concoct a way to rid the world of superheroes while simultaneously placing yourself on one of its thrones. Unfortunately though, plans of world domination tend to cost a lot of money and you’re practically broke. When Roulette comes to you with the idea for a “meta-bordello”, you think up the perfect way to supply her with incredibly enticing workers – as long as you get a fat cut of the profits, of course.

Will you be able to “convince” enough heroines, henchwomen and villainesses to work for you? Can you grow the bordello enough to bankroll your final plan for world supremacy? Will you finally be able to take down the heroes/heroines once and for all, as well as your villainous rivals?​

title: Monke Island: Rise of the Beast
description: Monke Island: Rise of the Beast is a spiritual successor and parody of Skull Island: Rise of Kong. Iterating upon everything that made that game a masterpiece but with a new IP. This is the definitive Monke experience, leave humanity and become a giant Monke.

title: Ghost Recon: Heroes Unleashed
description: Ghost Recon: Heroes Unleashed, the ruthlessly unforgiving tactical shooter experience. True hardcore realism, with nonlinear play, real-world physics, and ultra smart AI. Infinite replayability, with tons of worldwide maps, missions, game types, international special forces units, and a massive arsenal of authentic weapons and equipment.

title: The Elder Scrolls Online: Gold Road
description: A forgotten Daedric Prince has returned, bringing chaos to West Weald! Explore a new zone and defend the city of Skingrad, now beset by a dangerous Daedric cult and the jungles of Valenwood. Customize your skills like never before with the new Scribing system.

title: Warhedz
description: Challenge your friends, on-line or locally, or play against AI to rule the world! In this epic strategy game, invade territories and devise of tactics to defeat your opponents and take over the world.

title: Disgaea 7: Vows of the Virtueless - Limited Edition
description:
The Limited Edition of Disgaea 7 includes:
- The Deluxe Edition of Disgaea 7
- "The Art of War" hardcover art book
- "The Songs of Honor" 2-disc original soundtrack
- Steelbook
- Mini Byoubu Art Display
- "Netherworld Warriors" Yunomi Tea Cup
- Collector's Box

title: SCP-087-B Unity Remake Edition
description: ''SCP-087-B is a small experimental horror game loosely based on SCP-087. You find yourself inside dark hallways and staircases with something lurking below you, and the only way you can go is deeper into the darkness. How deep can you go?''

title: Landy Land
description: The reckless daughter of famous hero Randall "Randy" Land, Landyssa "Landy" Land spends most of her days terrorizing the countryside under the guise of being a hero. One day, while visiting her friend Mandy, she discovers that her brother Dandy has once again let loose a bunch of evil monsters on Mandy's hometown. Unwilling to let this aggression stand, Landy coerces--er, convinces Mandy to join her on a quest to defeat her evil brother Dandy.

title: Wagotabi
description:
Wagotabi is an educational journey that will teach you Japanese from the zero. It relies on a new methodology which prioritizes which Hiragana, Katakana or Kanji you should learn and will help you dive deeper in the language immersion from the very start.

Embark on this transformative journey through real Japanese prefectures, immersing yourself in the culture, language, and daily life. Connect with locals, navigate new surroundings, and witness the surprises that unfold at every turn. Feel the sense of belonging as you make strides in understanding and interacting with Japan's rich environment.

title: Nothing to Declare
description: You are a Federal Police officer at Brazil's largest airport. Check passports, interrogate, expose lies, and hunt down fugitives—decide who gets in. The law is real, the bills are pressing, and the bribes are tempting. 22 days, 5 endings. Inspired by the real-life inner workings of Guarulhos (BRA).

title: Fuga: Melodies of Steel - Ultimate Edition
description:
"We have to fight! If we don't, everyone we love will be taken away!"

One fateful night, a peaceful village is thrown into the flames of war. Determined to save their families, a group of children boards a giant tank and begins an offensive charge!

Fuga: Melodies of Steel is an RPG where you place children, each with their own unique characteristics and skills, at different gun turrets in a tank to fight against the enemy.

Living inside the tank, the children show emotion and gain affinity amongst each other. Manage these both to change the outcome of their journey!

title: For a Vast Future: Definitive Edition
For a Vast Future: Premium Edition
Fuga: Melodies of Steel 2 - Ultimate Edition
description: The sequel to the captivating tale of Fuga: Melodies of Steel has arrived! This turn-based RPG is back with a ramped up battle system for more strategy, as well as a brand new event system that gives you more thrilling choices to affect your experience!

title: CrashMetal: Drift Racing Car Driving Simulator - Premium Edition
Cynthia: Hidden in the Moonshadow - Complete Edition
description: Emotional, 3rd-person, story-driven, adventure game focused on solving puzzles and using stealth mechanics. Use your bow to interact with environmental elements. Sneak, climb or distract guards to move further unnoticed. Solve light puzzles alongside your path to rescue your loved one.

description:
"Even at the cost of my life—there is someone I want to protect."

It is said that there once existed a civilization on this earth more advanced than the current one. This rich civilization was built using the power of "magic" granted by the spirits. However, this long-lasting civilization rapidly declined after the spirits disappeared and eventually perished.

There were those who were interested in this ancient world. The protagonist, Hyde, travels around the world seeking the legacy of the old world. During his journey, he happens to visit the town of Arville. There, he hears rumors that something resembling ancient ruins has been found in a nearby cave. Hyde heads to the cave and meets a girl who holds the key to the truth.

The game was developed over a period of more than two years. It features a wealth of content, including around 800 types of items and modes where the enemies' strength is doubled or tripled, providing substantial replay value.

Unlike the original PC (Windows) version released almost two years earlier, the Dreamcast port does not feature any adult content. A couple of years later, DVD PG Edition release came out which also includes adult content.

The events of the game takes place 500 years before those of "Castle Fantasia", and tells the story of a two hundred year long religious war between the Inshiera Empire and the Ruushiera Republic. The Empire worships the God of Light and considers the republicans followers of an evil god. The army of the empire has seven holy squads, and you command a knight named Hyuui, the leader of one of them. "Seimadaisen" is a strategy RPG with erotic content. You fight on large battle screens, navigating your party in turn-based mode, attacking when enemies are in range. Enemies drop hearts when defeated, and collecting those hearts can heal you and raise your parameters. Between battles, there are parts in which you'll have conversations with girls and will be able to choose different answers, leading to different endings.

title: Curse of Babylon
description:
The country of Babylon was once a thriving community, enjoying peace and prosperity. However, all that changed when monsters invaded the land. Eventually, the entire population was wiped out and Babylon became an enclosed area no one dared to enter. Only one brave adventurer traveled to Babylon in an attempt to destroy the evil that dominated it.

Babylon is a side-view action game with light platforming and role-playing elements. The game takes place across interconnected screens, often arranged in maze-like patterns, with vertical shafts that required climbing, dropping down, or jumping over chasms. The jump key is also used for attacking, which requires gaining momentum and repeatedly "bumping" into the enemy. There are no experience points or any type of currency, but defeating enemies may yield healing potions or better weapons and armor. These items can also be found in the numerous treasure rooms found in the game. The player is given considerable freedom as to which area to explore first, but many areas are initially blocked, requiring the player to procure a key or return with better equipment in order to defeat a stronger enemy guarding the location. title: Quick Quest
description:
Explore a pixelated world steeped in nostalgia with our retro roguelite game. Conquer procedurally generated levels and survive with just one life in this thrilling challenge. Master the jump, attack, and charged attack in a classic platforming view.

What sets our game apart is the epic boss battles. Dive into strategic showdowns, blending the essence of Zelda 2 and Megaman, with the addition of a tactical wall jump for intense boss fights. there are approximately 10 bosses along the run.

As you traverse the procedurally generated levels, you'll regularly discover a variety of equipment in special rooms throughout your run. Equipment come in various types, including swords and helmets, each enhancing or modifying your attack and potentially adding special moves. Be cautious, though, as these can be lost during the run, and the compatibility of certain helmets with specific swords adds an extra layer of strategy.

In addition to traditional weapons, there are throwable items and consumables to aid you in your journey. Use these strategically to gain the upper hand in challenging situations.

Try also more roguie patches that, unlike other equipment, cannot be lost during the run. introducing distinctive functionalities.

Every death means losing your hard-earned equipment, but persevere to unlock permanent feats and new game modes. Get ready to face the challenge and beat your best progress in this nostalgic retro world. Will you manage to complete the run?
