Each of the main quests issued by the Alchemists' Fellowship involves different methods of playing the game. Will you brave the dungeon area and all of its turn-based RPG action to bring the fellowship proof of your prowess? Will you elect to go the farming route and grow mythical crops in your garden? Will you gather the resources you need to expand your home beyond what contemporary craftsmanship allows? Or will you spend your time fishing for a legendary lunker?

No two routes play exactly the same, and you can take on whichever you want—or even all of them at once—while also completing optional quests for a variety of townsfolk.

title: Anji: Implication
description:
Anji: Implication is a horror walking simulator where you just go down the stairs.
The in-game screen has a 16:18 layout, and when you play on the 16:9 screen, a black belt appears on the side, and the game is played in a layout similar to a smartphone.

title: Atlyss
description: Enter the world of ATLYSS, a single-player/online RPG where you can fight with or against friends in a surreal world filled with creatures beyond comprehension. Customize and progress your character(s), complete quests, and discover strange locations.

title: Hakuoki Shinkai Reimeiroku - Limited Edition
description:
The Hakuoki Shinkai Reimeiroku - Limited Edition includes:
- Switch game "Hakuouki Reimeiroku"
- Special illustration box
- Original soundtrack with bonus radio drama
- Special cloth poster
- Badge Character acrylic stand

title: Banana Fighting
description: The banana warriors defeated the invaders, and are living a peaceful life. At the time the banana king is getting old, the village is ready to hold a trump card banana contest, the winner will succeed as the new king, get ready banana warriors, a game of wits is about to begin.

title: Fear For Sale: The Curse of Whitefall - Collector's Edition
description: Paranormal occurrences are spooking the workers and halting construction at a hotel site in Alaska, so you’re sent to investigate. Things quickly turn dark as apparitions try to keep you away and you’re transported into the past! Nothing is as it seems in this old mining town. Can you keep history from repeating itself and save yourself in time? Find out in this haunting hidden-object puzzle adventure!

title: Solbrain: Knight of Darkness
description:
The old gods have forgotten this land (Cannae). No one could save our people when darkness began to spread and collect the souls of men for his army.
Solbrain - Knight of Darkness is a 3D exploration game.

title: Slendytubbies: Dipsy's Workshop
description:
Welcome to Dipsy's Workshop!
This is an official Slendytubbies game, play as Dipsy and slash and dash your way through hordes of innocent tubbies to get high scores! How high can you get?. Have fun! :)

title: Slendytubbies: Anniversary Edition
description: Slendytubbies: Anniversary Edition (known simply as Slendytubbies and among mobile android users as Slendytubbies: Android Edition) is a remake of Slendytubbies — it was made to celebrate the third anniversary of the first game.

title: Heroes of Eternal Quest
description: Welcome to a never-ending adventure full of challenges. Gather resources, build all sorts of buildings, unlock mysterious cards, and lead a group of heroes destined for greatness. Explore the unknown, climb the Tower of Shards, and break free from a destiny we never chose.

title: A Long Goodbye
description: A Long Goodbye is a short narrative game centered around two old friends who have to say their final goodbye over a phone conversation. The game focuses on using a realistic conversation structure, with each reply moving the conversation down a new winding path. Play through multiple times to explore new topics and learn more about the characters, their shared history, estrangement, and the things left unsaid.

title: Kokusai Shitei Kaii 123-gou Haison
description: Every year, in the strange, abandoned village known as the "Haison", a single girl is always imprisoned as a sacrifice… You control three special forces members who infiltrate the village, as well as the lone imprisoned girl, as they attempt to escape.

title: It Paints Me
description: It Paints Me is a short Gothic horror visual novel about art, pain, and love.

title: The Last Winter Knight
description: Haunt a suit of armour. Explore an abandoned castle. Recover your memories... and bring the ghosts of the past to rest in this melancholy visual novel about love, family and regret.

title: Shmoup
description: Endless shoot'em up in space! With controller support

title: xNetHack
description:
xNetHack is a fork of the dungeon exploration game NetHack. It is a distant descendent of Rogue and Hack, and a direct descendant of the development version of NetHack 3.7.

The main goals of xNetHack are to take vanilla NetHack and:

1. Fix gameplay balance issues.
2. Remove tedious and frustrating parts of the game.
3. Make uninteresting parts of the game more interesting.
4. Experiment with new ideas from the community.

title: Honkai: Star Rail - If One Dreams At Midnight
description:
Version 2.0 of Honkai: Star Rail, which includes:
• New characters: Black Swan, Sparkle and Misha
• New Trailblaze Mission: Long Day's Journey Into Night
• New planet: Penacony, the Planet of Festivities
• New enemies: Dreamjolt Troupe, Memory Zone Memes and more
• New quality of life updates
• …and more!

title: Nibansen
description: If something unusual happens, return to the opposite passage! A mysterious respect-based escape game from the subway station to the exit "Line 2 | Nibansen"

title: Hero of Minotaurs
description: Hero of Minotaurs is a story of how one injured hero accidentally encounters many friendly minotaur...

title: Knights of Fresco
description: Raise your own band of Knights and fight beasts from medieval paintings. Knights of Fresco is an open world party building RPG with auto-battling combat that tries to emulate medieval depictions of battles and wars.

title: Slendytubbies: Worlds
description: Slendytubbies: Worlds is the sixth and last game of the Slendytubbies series developed by ZeoWorks.

title: Nowhere
description:
Nowhere is a Nordic inspired narrative mystery/horror game, revolving around Nordic mythology and what happened to these Gods after Ragnarök and how the rise of Christianity impacted them and their worship.

Featuring the mixing styles of detective gameplay and survival horror, It's going to appeal to people who love a good mystery and also love to be scared, wandering through these haunting atmospheres, feeling something watching them at every turn while the tension builds and builds until the world turns into a nightmare and its fight or flight.

title: Mystery Case Files: A Crime in Reflection - Collector's Edition
description: Just when you thought it was safe to take a vacation, the Crown calls you back into action! While burglary cases aren’t the Master Detective’s typical area of investigation, the police are stumped when a royal coronation scepter is stolen from one of the most secure museums in the world in the latest of a series of similar incidents, and they’re turning to you for help. The thieves have proven to be careless but crafty, somehow able to get in and out of the most secure locations in seconds and disappear into thin air! But what starts as a simple series of heists quickly spirals out of control when the criminals awaken something that will put them, the Master Detective, and even the world itself in grave danger! Can you unlock the bloody secrets the thieves discovered and save the day? There’s only one way to find out, Detective! Crack the case in this all-new Hidden-Object Puzzle Adventure!

title: Undiscovered Technology of the Pharaohs
description: Undiscovered Technology of the Pharaohs is a map pack using a new yet unreleased Alkaline devkit. It features 3 egypt/techbase themed maps (start, main map, end).

title: Ghost Party
description: There is a killer on the loose! In Ghost Party, you play as a lonely ghost who wanders the halls of a haunted mansion to collect random items and help save its various inhabitants from an unknown murderer.

title: Project U
description:
Codename "Project U" is a new kind of session-based cooperative shooter, in which players unite in massive battles against overwhelming legions of machines.
Ubisoft will have a PC-only Closed Test from February 1-6 in Europe and North America.

The game’s plot revolves around an invasion from the “machines”, who have one goal to ‘machineform’ all life. Players play as the ‘immune’, who are hero characters that seemingly can’t be machine-formed. A total of six characters currently exist, which are; Summer, Tau, Z-Rex, Lodestar, Swei, and Gallowglass.

title: Star Stable: The Spring Rider
description: Star stable: The Spring Rider takes place in the Jorvik Bay during spring and its main equestrian orientation is dressage. During the quests you are learning more of dressage and improve your horse riding. You also help different characters. You’re preparing yourself for prestige dressage competition in Rodilla Riding School and to be chosen as riding instructor for the spring horse camp.

title: Chocolate Cage
description:
This was the last Valentine's Day of my high school life.

I, who had no luck with love, thought Valentine's Day would end uneventfully like it always does, but...

"Everything was going just as I planned."

title: Frostrain
description: Be the last train conductor roaming the postapocalyptic frozen world! Expand, strengthen, and build synergies on your train. The promised land beyond the toxic zone awaits you and your passengers.

title: Stellar Wanderer DX
description: Stellar Wanderer DX is an old-school space combat sim set in a vast open-world universe. Follow the story or choose your favorite side missions as a mercenary fighter pilot. Explore the galaxy, upgrade your ship and weapons, trade resources and fight outlaws.

title: Enupishi
description: It was a forbidden love, something that was against the rules of the game. One night, they decided to escape. How far could they go?

title: Sora to Muku no 6-ki
description:
You are the commander and train 6 boys and girls as pilots of "Muku Airplane".
While building the deck, you use cards in your hand with various effects to teach the children the three statuses of "piloting," "shooting," and "support," as well as "special skills.

In this title, you select one of three countries to begin play.
Each country has its own play style and scenario, allowing for a variety of ways to play.

title: Paw Patrol: Grand Prix - Complete Edition
description:
No track is too big, no racer too small!

Join your favorite PAW Patrol pups, and up-to 4 players at once, in their fastest paced adventure yet! Including every track from the original game and all the PUPtastic features from the DLC packs - RACE IN BARKINGBURG and PUP TREAT ARENA!

title: A Space for the Unbound: Special Edition
Asterix & Obelix: Slap Them All! 2 - Gold Edition
Asterigos: Curse of the Stars - Collectors Edition
Class of Heroes 1 & 2 Complete Edition
description: Swords, Magic, School! The beloved JRPG dungeon crawler returns!

title: Way of the Hunter: Hunting Season One
Bullet Hell Collection: Volume 1
description: Get ready to blast everything that stands in your way with this great compilation of 3 Shoot’Em Up! Bullet Hell Collection: Volume 1 is a bundle of 3 great Shoot'em ups developed by Panda Indie Studio: Void Gore, Project Starship and Z-Warp.

title: GT Manager
description: Take charge as the ultimate racing manager, leading your GT racing team to victory. Build your team, improve your car, and deploy winning race strategies across 5 official GT leagues, including the pinnacle of endurance racing: the hypercar category! Are you ready to dominate the world of GT racing?

title: WWE 2K24
description: Experience WWE 2K24’s bevy of spectacular modes, which includes a tribute to WrestleMania in 2K Showcase of the Immortals, MyRISE, MyFACTION, MyGM, and all-new match types like Guest Referee and Gauntlet.

title: WWE 2K24 Deluxe Edition
description: Grow your MyFACTION card collection with the WWE 2K24 Deluxe Edition, including the Deluxe Edition Bonus Pack, Nightmare Family Pack with MyFACTION content, and the Season Pass!

title: WWE 2K24 Forty Years of WrestleMania
description: WrestleMania is the biggest event in sports entertainment, where Superstars become WWE Legends. Experience a gripping retelling of WrestleMania’s greatest moments in 2K Showcase of the Immortals, where you can relive a collection of some of the most unforgettable, career-defining matches.

title: Ame's Happy Happy Dating Game
description: A retro-style visual novel where you get to experience a rare date scene that can't be seen in the main game. Take Ame to a nice place and give her the time of her life!

title: Don't Die, Kangel!
description: Don't Die, KAngel! is a shooter mini-game featured in Petit Game Collection vol.1. The premise of this game revolves around KAngel trying to survive against nerds and avoiding hazards by attacking them using pellets and various items.

title: Vivat Sloboda
description: In minigame Vivat Sloboda, players will experience the period of the Velvet Revolution from the point of view of a taxi driver of the state taxi service, who accepts orders from staunch party officials, but also from students demanding change. Players will thus hear vastly different opinions.

title: Rearview Mirror
description: Rearview Mirror is a narrative videogame in which most of the events take place inside a car. From a first-person perspective, the player interacts with the passengers through the rearview mirror.

title: Dragon Ball Super Card Game Fusion World
description: Dragon Ball Super Card Game Fusion World is a trading card game where you battle players with Leader cards and supportive Battle cards in order to drain the opponents life points to 0 and win the game.

title: AMQ: The (Actual) Game
description:
A bad AMQ game about guessing songs and being a booli
Includes over 300 songs, and a variety of (bad) gamemodes!

title: Tainá
description: In this game, adapted from the children's movie Tainá, the player controls the character that lends her name to the movie and the game, leading the little native girl through the Amazon forest, trying to escape enemies and dangers.

title: The Telwynium: Book Three - The Shadow of Spring
description:
The Summer King walks! The fellowship from Willows Dene has been split asunder, each a prisoner in grave, tomb or cell. Each faces their own peril, with only their wits to guide them against merciless brigands, the living dead, shadowfell, and the witches of Targoth.

The Telwynium: Book Three is an early 90s style point and click, with Sierra SCI0 style graphics, but with a fancy new-fangled point 'n click interface.

title: Demi Daggers
description: Take the cursed dagger, use its power to dispatch the horrors from this hellish place, score the best time! A fan game based on Devils Daggers for PICO-8.

title: Lost Lands: Sand Captivity - Collector's Edition
description:
Lift a mysterious curse, explore a fantasy world, and solve dozens of puzzles!

After the peace in the Lost Lands was restored, Susan decided to restore her own world. She had become a dedicated mother and a grandmother. All that reminded her of her previous adventures were the stories she told to her granddaughter under the guise of fairytales. But like mother, like son. Jim couldn’t walk by the artifact of the Lost Lands that was found on Earth. Accidentally, he unleashed an ancient curse. So now Susan has to return to the Lost Lands one more time to save her family.

Find a way to lift a mysterious curse with the help of the Lost Lands inhabitants, welcome familiar characters and meet the new ones to find solutions together with them!

title: Mysterious Island
description:
The storm appeared suddenly, tossing Robin's ship against sharp cliffs.

Shipwrecked and lucky to be alive, he finds himself on the beach of a mysterious island inhabited by strange friends...and enemies. Now, to find a way home, he must explore, make allies and master the mysteries of his new surroundings. Mysterious Island offers a unique mix of adventure, role-playing and real-time strategy, with control of up to 5 characters. Danger lurks around every corner, as well as adventure. Are you ready to discover if the last of the dragons really lives somewhere in the islands?

title: Flashback 2: Collector's Edition
description:
The Collector’s Edition releases on Nintendo Switch, Xbox Series X and PlayStation 5, will include:

- Limited Edition
- The original Flashback video game in digital version
- An 8-inch (20cm) figurine of Conrad
- 3 lithographs
- A unique badge
- 2 stickers sheets

title: Star Stable: The Autumn Rider
description:
Star Stable - The Autumn Riders!

- Care, train, compete, and master the art of horsemanship

Autumn.

Summer sheds its skin and the landscape begins to prepare for winter.
The trees shift their colors from summer greens to fiery red, warm yellow and sparkling orange.

In this time of change and opportunity a young girl arrives at the stables.

All her life she has loved horses. She has dreamed of being around them, caring them, nurturing them and feeling the freedom of riding horseback.
It is a beautiful dream, but that is all it has ever been.

Just a dream.

She is excited, but scared at the same time. In a world filled with strangers she has nothing to hold onto but her dream.
And she hopes that will be enough.

Thar girl is you.

Now live your dream!

title: Star Stable: The Winter Rider
description: The slowly falling snow drapes the landscape in a white veil, hides the bareness of the trees that long ago lost their leaves, and gives the land a sense of serenity. The world is quiet. Most singing birds have long since migrated to warmer places and animals have gone into hibernation, shielding themselves against the cold. But winter doesn't stop people and horses. Stables still need to be mucked out, horsed still need to be groomed and fed. Riders are getting ready for the Decker Horse Show -- the most prestigious jumping competition in the country. Only a few riders from the finest stables are selected to compete. Now all that is needed is a champion. Could that champion be YOU?!

title: Star Stable: The Summer Rider
description:
Warm days have finally arrived in Jorvik.

The sun sends it warming beams dancing across the ripe fields and blossoming meadows. The summer breeze sweeps in from the sea, soothing man and beast; hard working farmers, lazy dogs, sneaky cats, and horses. School's out and the seemingly endless summer vacation has just begun. There is no more homework, no more dusty history classes with Mrs. Corkwood, or mind-numbing science experiments with Mr. Flagstaff.

Just day after day of working for Herman who runs Jorvik Stables, riding and caring for the

horses. Life simply couldn't be better.

Then Coyote arrives.

He is Herman's brother, and he's decided to come home after two decades out West, where he has been a professional rodeo performer. Now he plans to build a Western-style riding park in Jorvik.

And he wants your help!

Soon there is fierce activity on Jorvik's northwestern peninsula, where farmland and swampland are rapidly being converted into paddocks and trails, and where you and the rest of the crew have a very limited time to learn barrel racing, pole bending, trail riding and show jumping. It is hard work and you have never had more fun in your life. But something is lurking beneath the surface. Strange rumors and intriguing gossip are spreading among the people on the farms and at Jorvik Ranch.

Is there more to Coyote's return than just homesickness?

And will you be able to uncover his secret?

title: Fisher-Price: Time To Play - Pet Shop
description: Time to Play Pet Shop gives kids the chance to feed and care for animals in an interactive setting. They can choose names, groom and bathe the animals, and play pet vet. There are nine activities in all. Along the way, they will learn about over 40 species of furry, feathered, and scaly animals while enjoying paw-stomping original songs.

title: Five Nights at Freddy's: Into the Pit
description:
Jump into the pit and immerse yourself in a new chapter in the Five Nights at Freddy’s universe. Oswald wishes his town, and his life, weren’t so boring. That all changes when he explores the ball pit in a rundown pizzeria and finds himself in the past. However, Oswald’s deepest desire will have an unexpected cost…

Survive five nights of terror in this chilling adventure game. Travel between time periods, gather clues, and outrun the threat relentlessly pursuing you. Move swiftly and stay hidden, and you may just survive. But be careful—it’s not just your own life that’s on the line. Oswald’s father and children from the past could all meet their end if you don’t save them.

title: Super Chroma Bots: Season One
description: Control a team of color based robots in the technologically advanced city of NeoTechropolis. As the robots harness the power of their unique colors to overcome challenges, they must unite to stop an imminent global threat.

title: GrimGrimoire OnceMore: Limited Edition
description:
The GrimGrimoire OnceMore Limited Edition includes:
- The Deluxe Edition of the Game
- "Witches & Wonders" Hardcover Artbook
- "Spellbinding Symphonies" 2-disc Soundtrack
- "Magical Mayhem" 17" x 24" Cloth Poster
- "Once More Upon A Time" Acrylic Display
- "Portable Spells" Keychains (Set of 4)
- "Mythical Portraits" Art Cards (Set of 5)
- Collector's Box

title: Miss It!
description:
Miss It is a homebrew Atari 2600 game developed by Alan W. Smith and initially released online in 2009. The game went on to receive a limited cartridge release through Good Deal Games in 2011. Miss It was later included in the Atari Flashback series of plug-and-play consoles, starting with the Atari Flashback 5 in 2014, and most recently in the Atari Flashback X Deluxe in 2019.

In Miss It, the player must move a black square to avoid touching colorful squares that bounce around the screen, the number of which increases over time. The longer the player manages to avoid contact, the higher the score they achieve. The left difficulty switch can toggle the functionality of the score counter, either to go up 1 point every second, or to only increase when the the player is moving.

title: Photo Genic
description: In Photo Genic the player controls a young boy that got a job as a photographer. The main goal of the game is to improve the boy stats and photograph skills to make him win the heart of one of the girls of the town.

title: The 2030 Proto-Interfacer's Guide to House-Oriented Emotional Exploration
description: The game is an educational interactive computer software package adaptation of the New York Times #1 Bestselling book of the same name. Made by interfacers, for the means of enhancing the transitory period of the ones that may, or may not, come before. It lets you emulate the beautiful experience of being invited to a party, and then being at the party, in an unsafe environment.

title: Idol Project
description: In Idol Project, the player takes a role of a young man named Takashi, who works for a company called Mobius, an agency whose goal is to turn young Japanese girls into famous singers.

title: Idol Project 2
description: Unlike the first Idol Project, the story of the sequel is directly related to to the anime series Idol Project, starring the same characters, with the young and ambitious Mimu Emilton as the protagonist.

title: The Witcher 3: Enhanced Edition - Redux
description: The Witcher 3 Enhanced Edition is a total overhaul mod for The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt. It aims to enhance the game's experience by revamping combat, alchemy, economy, character progression and other mechanics. It introduces changes to make the game more challenging and realistic.

title: Ramen no Megami
description: A PC and mobile game where you manage a ramen restaurant.

title: Swingers
description: Navigate the beautiful—and sometimes dangerous—rainforest, swinging by your tongue and bunny-hopping with your tail in this precision platformer.

title: Top Web Search 23
description: What is more popular?

title: Zombie Football Simulator
description: Are you ready to kick off the apocalypse?

title: Sweets Drop
description: Drop and merge sweets into bigger ones but do not touch the red line!

title: Silver Falls: Guardians And Metal Exterminators S
description: Monsters ruin a blind date in this 80s action thriller

title: MeowMatch
description: Merge cats, discover new adorable kittens and reach the highest score possible!

title: Goo Fighter
description: Combine as many powers as you can to wipe out all the Goo around you! Sounds simple, right? Let's see if you can get past stage 16!

title: Beach Boys 2: Zodiac Date
description: Discover the fascinating world of the zodiac signs as you embark on a journey to win the heart of the boy of your dreams.

title: Brain Memory Training Academy
description: Flip, Match, Conquer: Unleash Your Mind's Highest Potential!

title: Farm Day Simulator 2024
description: Embark on a journey of growth, discovery, and endless fun in Farm Day Simulator 2024.

title: Forklift Simulator 2024
description: Experience realistic forklift operations, diverse environments, and challenging missions.

title: Come To Dust
description: Takes place inside of a corrupted castle while you are being watched by an evil entity.

title: Doomed Urbex
description: Doomed Urbex is a community project first started last year by RastaManGames, with the concept of being a wad focused mainly on city maps

title: Naughty & Nice
description: PUSS XXXIV brings you 30 Doommas maps split evenly into two episodes."The Nice List" features more easy-going maps that heavily feature our cuddly bunny friends running amok as we slay demons. Perfect for those who want to enjoy a "chill" Christmas-themed wad. "The Naughty List" provides some intense maps that are generally more "cooked". If micro-slaughter, slaughter, lots of Cyberdemons and Archviles, and combat puzzles are your jam, this is the episode for you.

title: V64
description: A vanilla-compatible community mapset inspired by dotQLL's GADOLINIUM, where maps don't exceed the limit of 64 vertices.

title: Voice in the Abyss
description:
Voice in the Abyss is an 8 map CL9/Boom megawad where doom guy hears voice calling him deeper into the the madness. Fight your way through the demonic hordes
to the end to see what surprises await you.
After the end of the games you will be sent to a new game pulse version of the maps where the difficulty is increased or start at map 09 to start out on the new game pulse difficulty.

title: Specter Spelunker Resizes
description:
Specter Spelunker Resizes is a demake of Specter Spelunker Shrinks by Ken Grafals.
Your goal is to get to the moon once again.. but this time it hides a prize!

title: MadnessMadnessMadness
description: Escape the wall, in a bizarre, circular world where the path comes at you through 360 degrees and disappears underneath. Survive as long as you can. Includes online highscores. Made for Game Jolt Minimal Contest.

title: Acid R[ai/eig]n
description: In Acid R[ai/eig]n, you are in control of the growth of a tree. You can use Z and X to rotate the curvature of branches currently growing. Every three seconds, branches will split into two separate ones. As the tree ages, or as acid rain makes contact with it, it begins to die. Holes will start to form in branches, which need to be patched up. The game ends when 100 droplets of acid rain hit the floor.

title: Confusion Readily Achieved Perspectively Through Unrealistic Relative Dimensions
description: Fake-3D 3D platformer designed to be rather confusing but perfectly playable in its presentation. Looks kinda snazzy though.

title: The Cat That Got the Milk
description: The Cat that Got the Milk is a reflex action game inspired by the Art of past Masters.

title: Metro.Siberia
description:
A very simple and addicting game inspired by the well known helicopter game, but unlike the helicopter game this game contains do not contain randomly generated levels, so your skill is all that counts.

The game (and editor) was built by Tommy Salomonsson, and the art and music was created by Simon Stålenhag. The game has been played more than 10 million times since it was released in late 2007, and they have released one spinoff of the game called “People in planes”.

title: We Are Infinity
description:
A short game trying to mimic the gameplay and atmosphere of "This Is Infinity", a game by Cactusquid / Jonatan Söderström.

If you find yourself confused, the best thing to do is to stand still for a moment and let the view settle.

title: NetWalk
description: NetWalk is a puzzle game developed and published by Gamos in 1996.

title: Keep It Running
description:
It's the time of the Industrial Revolution and you're a worker whom just applied to work at a mysterious toy factory. Unfortunately for you, this factory is unlike any other, its machinery and lack of safety being the lesser dangers to your life. And every day gets more and more challenging...

You're tasked with keeping the production of mysterious toys going at any cost. Your many tasks include keeping the boiler at a good pressure, making sure the steam engine drives the machinery at the right pace and keeping the machinery itself in working order. All whilst your boss constantly keeps an eye on you.
Displease your boss in any way and this will be the last day you did anything, ever.

Can you deal with the stress of working for this monster?

title: Manbomber
description:
An explosive homage to the old-time multiplayer classic made with PICO-8! In this game, your goal is to drop bombs on the battlefield to eliminate all other players in time and be the last manbomber standing.

The game can be played with up to 4 players battling each other. While in the 2-player mode, both players can use the same keyboard to control their manbomber, a controller for each player is required for all other modes. Any Controller which can be connected to your device will do!

title: Lizard Tower: The Abyss
description: Throw flares at the beacons. You know how it is.

title: Hellfire Poncho
description: Hellfire Poncho is a western rogue-lite isometric shooter. Shoot little demons with your upgraded weapons, die, and try again stronger. Bet your upgrades against the creatures you meet in the saloon, and develop your best build. Don't push your luck....

title: Aprende con Horacio: La Gran Aventura de las Palabras
description: "La gran aventura de las palabras" (The Great Adventure of Words), also known as "Aprende con Horacio" (Learn with Horacio), is an educational game by the Anaya publishing house where you play with the great Horacio, Rodolfato, and Alfabeto, crossing their entire labyrinth house full of puzzles, reading challenges, and all sorts of language-related games.

title: Tekken 8: Launch Edition
description:
The Launch Edition includes:
• The game
• Burning chain metal plate
• Corporation stickers
• Steelbook

title: Black Mesa: Classic
description:
This is a GoldSource project aimed to recreate Black Mesa: Source feel within Half-LIfe 1 and its assets.

Our main goals for this project is to give a new feel, look to the original Half-Life, with adding more features, improved level design that many people love from Black Mesa remake but with additional things, to make it a bit more unique. Black Mesa: Classic aims to be capabile on any PC without high requiremnts, with better visuals and effects to make your Half-Life 1 campaign experience the best!

title: Qubit's Quest
description: You and up to three friends are on a quest to protect the loyal robotic canine, Qubit, in this action platformer. Play a co-op adventure campaign or compete with others in 10 fast-paced minigames!

title: Moussacre
description: Imprisoned for nearly a century, MouseTrap finally breaks out and goes on a rampage to steal color... by any means necessary. Experience fast-paced 2D platforming mayhem while slashing apart legions of victims who stand in your way.

title: Run and Gun
description: Run and Gun is an action roguelike shooting game where you mow down thousands of enemies while unlocking newer and deadlier weapons. The enemies won't stop spawning, and your guns won't stop firing. Earn gold each run to unlock permanent upgrades to make your next run deadlier.

title: Undertale: Chara Boss Fight
description: A fanmade Undertale boss fight of Chara.

title: Game Grumps: The Video Game
description: Game Grumps: The Video Game is an unofficial 2D platformer developed by GLWuffie and released on the GameMaker Studio Steam Workshop based around the YouTube channel Game Grumps.

title: The Dark Debt
description: The Dark Debt is a deep web horror-survival game developed by Voidlight Games.

title: EigenGauge
description: EigenGauge is a high speed retro racing game.

title: Shikhondo: Youkai Rampage
description: Popular vertically scrolling shoot'em up game Shikhondo is back and powered up! One day, the soul-starved Youkai escape from the depths of hell. Now, the story of the Grim Reaper and the girl who has fallen into this land begins!

title: Humankind: Definitive Edition
description:
The Definitive Edition includes the base game and all previously released add-ons:

- HUMANKIND - Digital Deluxe Upgrade
Which Includes the Notre-Dame Wonder, Victor Hugo Avatar set and exclusive narrative events.

- HUMANKIND - Together We Rule Expansion Pack
Unite HUMANKIND with a new feature, a new currency and a new affinity all tied to Diplomacy! This pack also includes six new cultures, new wonders and narrative events.

- HUMANKIND - Cultures of Africa Pack
Expand your HUMANKIND experience with six new cultures, new wonders, narrative events and independent peoples.

- HUMANKIND - Cultures of Latin America Pack
Push HUMANKIND even further with six new cultures, new wonders, narrative events and independent peoples.

- HUMANKIND - Cultures of Oceania Pack
Set sail for new horizons with six new cultures, new wonders, narrative events and independent peoples.

- HUMANKIND - Para Bellum Wonders Pack
Fire up a whole new approach to conflicts with six new war-themed wonders.

title: Capital Dilemma
description: Navigate corporate chaos in this minimalist management game. Swipe to make decisions, increase your stock price, and balance metrics to stay in power.

title: Space Mutants
description: Your name is Arlo, Arlo P. Barnaby. Make your escape attempt from this evil moon! Single Player-Action-2D Platformer! Reminiscent of those games that used to be played on those 8 bit consoles of yesteryear! Space Mutants has nine different levels, featuring six different boss fights!

title: Crappy Game
description: Crappy Game is a small independently developed multi-directional shooter action game, released on itch.io in 2024.

title: Snow Moto: Racing Adventure
description: Rev your snowmobile through crisp mountain air, conquering treacherous terrains with thrilling speed.

title: Our Long Walk Home
description:
'Home; a dying breeze, in the peripherals of my vision, to chase until the end of time.'

Our Long Walk Home is a surreal, horror RPG about a student caught in an infinitely repeating walk home as their world crumbles around them. A story about expectations, reflections, and a missing half.

title: JunkMetal
description:
JunkMetal is a MMOFPSRPG developed by Metro and published by Enix in 2003.

It features a high degree of customization, allowing players to mix and match various parts and weapons for their robots, as well as different operating systems and software.

Also, it emphasizes PvP (player versus player) combat, where players can join one of two rival factions, POF or Infinity, or remain as freelancers.

title: Daughters of the Stars
description:
Evelyn Lima is a 15 year old sophomore who's simply trying to get by in high school. All she wants is to spend time with her best friends in peace, not be bothered by bullies, and get through high school without any incident. That all changes in the new year of 199X, as she awakens to magical powers from the cosmos, and now has to figure out why she of all people has them.

Daughters of the Stars is an episodic visual novel starring Evelyn Lima, which takes place in New York in 199X. Play as her as she navigates school, daily life, hanging out with friends, and going against bullies and bad guys.

title: Daughters of the Stars Episode 1: When A Star Burns Out, A Flower Blooms
description: Evelyn Lima is starting the second semester of her Sophomore year of high school. When she discovers magical powers and has to fight a monster, everything she thought she knew changes.

title: Daughters of the Stars Episode 2: Face the Setting Sun: A Fierce Flower Stands Strong!
description: It's been a week since Eve first transformed into her magical girl alter ego, but she hasn't been able to transform since. When a fierce enemy attacks her and her friends after school, one she can't stop on her own, a new magical girl stands up to stop it.

title: Sea of Stars: Early Backer Limited Edition
description:
Comes with an exclusive booklet, available only for early Kickstarter backers.

Sea of Stars is a turn-based RPG inspired by the classics. Promising the Sabotage touch in every system, Sea of Stars aims to modernize the classic RPG in terms of turn-based combat, storytelling, exploration and interactions with the environment, while still offering a hearty slice of nostalgia and good old, simple fun.

Early Backer Limited Edition includes:
- Sea of Stars physical edition
- Acrylic Standee
- Silver Enamel Pin
- Original Soundtrack 2-Disc Digipak
- 12"x16" Poster
- Instruction Booklet

title: Touhou Shifuujou: The Alternative Age
description: Touhou Shifuujou ...the Alternative Age is a fanmade Touhou Project shoot 'em up game developed by danmaq, best known for his later fangame Concealed the Conclusion. It is one of the earliest games made using the Danmakufu engine, as well as one of the earliest fanmade Touhou-style STGs.

title: Terror Mansion
description: Terror Mansion is an exciting first person Horror video game that catapults you into a frightening Mansion. Your main objective is to escape the infested Mansion, finding objects and challenging riddles while exploring incredible scenarios.

title: Table Letters
description: Words

title: Ominous Tales: The Forsaken Isle - Collector's Edition
Hooligan Crusoe
description: You encountered a storm at sea and unexpectedly arrived at this small island. On this island, you can start a new life through activities like planting, construction, fishing, and more. Experience the storyline with various NPCs as you join the team to build and develop the small island!

title: Hitou Dungeon
description: This is a roguelike action adventure that takes you to a hidden hot spring at the far end of a dangerous dungeon.

title: Firework Survivor
description: "Firework Survivor" is a SurvivorLike game with the theme of fireworks. In the game, you will enter the dreamland of a kitten, which is full of dangers, but the only thing that can help it is - fireworks!

title: The Vanished Sister
description: This game delivers classic horror gameplay with innovative additions like an AI emotional system and variable item generation. It has a one-death rule, numerous escape methods, and levels with unique designs.

title: Mechanical Siege
description: Time control looking down Angle shot through the game

title: Cubic Defender
description: The core gameplay of Cubic Defender is strategy planning and resource management, with the aim of deploying heroes and defensive towers to eliminate invading enemies.

title: Otokonoko Fishing
description: Become a boy and go fishing in a city with rivers all around you! Cross-dressing Fishing is an action game-like fishing simulation! Your ultimate goal is to find your missing brother in the distant sea. Equip yourself for this with "Fishing and Cross-dressing"!

title: Tenka Touitsu SSB: Scenario - Ryuuko Aiutsu
Tenka Touitsu SSB: Scenario - Mouko Houkousu
Hello New World
description: A simple adventure about your life in the new world.

title: Footage of the Battle
description: This is a light ROGUE game that triggers card battles by eliminating batteries. Players will use dice to randomly advance on a circular map full of various events. In addition, there are multiple elements such as skills and props. Try to train yourself to defeat powerful enemies.

title: Kaiki: Okujou no Yuurei to Akuma no Gishiki
description: Maybe nothing happened... Or maybe something did. A fleeting moment from an ordinary high school day. A exploration horror game set in a school at night.

title: Imitate
description: A game sketch with only a fifteen-minute process

title: Jungle Ranger
description: The storyline is clear and easy to understand, and can interact with multiple NPCs. The gameplay is easy to learn and suitable for leisure and relaxation.

title: Yamafuda! Summit
description: Enjoy casual mountain hiking using cards, the latest in the "YAMAFUDA! series. This time, you and your friends will hike the mountain in a party. Let's enjoy many more mountains!

title: World of Dark
description: This is a very fun shooting game, hoping to bring glory to the country?

title: 100 Cats Argentina
description: Find 100 Cats hidden in Argentina! Can you find them all?

title: 100 Cats Berlin
description: Find 100 Cats hidden in Berlin! Can you find them all?

title: 100 Cats Pakistan
description: Find 100 Cats hidden in Pakistan! Can you find them all?

title: 13 Seconds
description: [13 Seconds] is a hardcore bullet hell roguelike game.Use both hands to control two robots at the same time and fight your way through a barrage of bullets and death rays from merciless machines of destruction!Will you be able to reach the ultimate level 13?

title: 50CK3T
description: A story-based indie platform puzzler set in a post-apocalyptic city. Socket and Birdie jump, swing, and build their way through increasingly difficult puzzles as they're shared battery continually drains.

title: 99 Waves
description: 99 Waves is a casual platformer rogue-lite game about a vengeful young man who challenges a god. Can he defeat countless monsters, the greatest warriors, and mythical beings to reach the despicable god and become a legend?

title: Abnimality
description: Abnimality is a platformer game with racing elements, explosions and a physical world, where the player uses explosions to control his character, who must jump to the end of the level before the others.

title: Abstract Code
description: Embark on a unique gaming experience that delves into thought-provoking themes... this SHMUP/Visual Novel hybrid offers a compelling narrative interspersed with addictive arcade gameplay.

title: Abstracto
description: Abstracto is a Retro-Inspired, Hack N' Slash, Combat-Oriented Platformer, with a deep combat system that lets you play your way. Play as Forte a blue square on a quest to defeat the evil Immotus and save the strange land of the Abstract.

title: Abyssal Frontier
description: You just wanted to finish your cargo run. The universe had other plans, Abyssal Frontier is a choice-driven cosmic horror visual novel with light RPG elements, time loop mechanics, and dating sim suggestions.

title: Abyss of Light
description: In a near-future interstellar mission, our vessel is shattered by asteroids, leaving you as the sole survivor. You land on a mysterious celestial body, facing unknown challenges and hidden secrets. Will you persevere?

title: Ace Pilot Pacific
description: Ace Pilot Pacific is a top view air combat game. The action takes place during the WW2 Pacific war. Fly in 6 different planes against the Japanese. Dog fight with the help of your wingmen and become an Ace.

title: Abyss: New Dawn
description: Dive into the enchanting world of Abyss: New Dawn - A cozy game that combines farming, town-building, and adventure in which you explore the ancient wonders with many mysterious Abyss floors alone or with your friends.

title: Afallon
description: Explore the dynamic world of Afallon as one of eight powerful classes, each with three specializations, in a 40 square kilometer open-world singleplayer RPG that evolves with your progress, offering challenging dungeons, crafting professions, and unique companions for your adventure.

title: A Fascinating Story: Wedding Night
description: This is a very simple card flip game where you turn over a card and then try to find another matching card. You only need to click on the card to find the same card as the image that appears, and the identical ones will be eliminated.

title: Age of History III
description: Grand strategy wargame where the destiny of Civilizations rests in your hands - will they stand united under your leadership or fall divided in conflict? Journey through the entire saga of human civilization, from its earliest days to the futuristic era, crafting your legacy age by age.

title: Agrarian developer
description: "Agrarian developer" is a simulation business game where players can construct farms, ranches, workshops, and castles. It is important to pay attention to penalties in missions and manage gold coins wisely to avoid bankruptcy.

title: AlchePot
description: A fantastic but difficult Bullet Hell. Shoot enemies all around. Experience the unique 'Bullet Absorb' system by stop firing, change threaten to your energy. Get ability upgrade through 8 levels with well-designed atmosphere.

title: Alaa: Mogus Must Die
description: This is a historical action game from 3rd person based on Yakut mythology. Alaa-Mogus the devil has come to seize our land! Uraankhai Sakha, let's take up our weapons and drive him back to the dungeon! Uruy-Aikhal!

title: AirportSim: Rovaniemi Airport
description: Welcome to Rovaniemi Airport! This new airport for AirportSim, which is nestled in the heart of Finnish Lapland, is not just an ordinary airport; it's the gateway to the magical home of Santa Claus and a bridge to the Arctic wonders.

title: Aim Zen
description: Aim Zen combines classic aim training with musical innovation to elevate precision. Dive into an unparalleled FPS experience, designed for all skill levels, where rhythm and gameplay merge for an engaging challenge.

title: Aim Down Screen
description: Aim Down Screen is the Gun Smith for your Screen! Go beyond putting clear tape with a dot in the middle on your monitor and customize your reticles and HUD with Aim Down Screen!

title: Super Algebrawl
description: Add up, multiply, clone, and divide your party members to beat the monsters on your path!

title: Ace Triad
description: Get involved in an adventure full of strategic challenges and exciting twists and turns as you seek to win the title of dueling master.

title: Adorimon: Arena of Ancients
description: Explore fantastic creatures called "Adorimon" in a new 2D turn-based strategy game! Collect and train your Adorimons to discover the world, climb Challenge Tower, and duel other players in Arena.

title: A Difficult Game About Climbing
description: This is a difficult game about climbing.

title: Adapta Solva
description: Absorb elements from magical shrines to solve puzzles and overcome obstacles in this cute and short little adventure where you follow a magical creature in a world laid to ruin by an unknown cause.

title: A Christmassy Christmas
description: "Beneath the festive cheer, Santa's wrath draws near. Naughty souls, tremble in fear, for judgment day is finally here." A Christmassy Christmas is an arena roguelike survival game where Santa disposes of naughty children.

title: Aery: Stone Age
description: In Aery – Stone Age you play as a little flying spirit that watches humanity in its early states evolve. You will discover a long-forgotten land with beautiful environments, and you will be able to enjoy the feeling of flying while exploring a whole world filled with beauty and little secrets.

title: Aery: Cyber City
description: In Aery Cyber City you play a little bird on its journey to find a home after losing its dear friend. You will discover unknown, giant, and beautiful environments and you will be able to enjoy the feeling of flying while exploring a whole world filled with beauty and little secrets.

title: Aery: Ancient Empires
description: In Aery - Ancient Empires you play as a little bird-like spirit that watches ancient civilizations evolve. You will discover unknown, giant, and beautiful environments and you will be able to enjoy the feeling of flying while exploring a whole world filled with beauty and little secrets.

title: Advaria: Chronicles of Immortality
description: Welcome, my Lord, to the cursed kingdom. A land plagued by black magic and creatures that crawl out of the darkness. Once this was a great kingdom. It could be great again. That's all up to you. Enter the world of Advaria - a hero defense game set in a world of fantasy and adventure.

title: Adventure Mansion
description: Explore Adventure Mansion with friends—dynamic mysteries, changing landscapes, and unexpected roles. Every twist unveils new challenges in this blend of horror, suspense, and fantasy. An immersive experience awaits—grab a friend or gather a group for a unique journey each time!

title: Adventure Trip: Amazing World 3 - Collector's Edition
description: If you are a virtual bird but love adventure too, this game is just for you.

title: Ancings: The First Tournament
description: Ancings is a dynamic turn-based strategic fighting video game. As you win battles, you gain levels, new powers and new evolutions. Each enemy is unique, so they all have different attacks and different ways of approaching battle. Plan your strategy well to win.

title: Dungeon Automata
description: Dungeon Automata「Algolemeth」is an "autologic": a JRPG dungeon crawler meets auto battler where you control your party with visual node-based programming. Program your party and conquer dungeons automatically. Master the dungeon through trial and error!

title: Alterhavoc
description: Alterhavoc is a Rogue-like Bullet hell game where players have to survive and fight monsters with an Inventory system where the resources can be arranged in a limited area to receive additional buffs.

title: Alpha League
description: Alpha League is a free-to-play, hero based Auto Chess. In Alpha League, simply pick and build your favorite hero in a Roguelike fashion with 10 different combat genres, and then battle the other 7 Bots or Players to be the winner.

title: Baron
description: Baron is Turkey's first RPG Themed, Realistic Mafia game. Growing up in the seediest underworld, Alparslan vows to fight all his enemies until he becomes the most respected bully in Ankara. An action game with a Deep State Mafia storyline set in Ankara from a TPS perspective.

title: All-Mountain Hucker
description: In All-Mountain Hucker, the player performs Stylish tricks in the post-apocalyptic Alaskan mountains while gunning down enemies with an arsenal of ranged weaponry. Go down the mountain on your snowboard to wipe out the enemy faction and take revenge on their leader.

title: A Million Murder Mysteries
description: Step into the thrilling world of "A Million Murder Mysteries," where every second counts and every word holds the key to solving a gripping case. This intense text-based detective game challenges your analytical skills and deductive reasoning as you race against time to unravel a million mysteries.

title: American Truck Simulator: Kenworth T680 2022
description: The moment we've all been eagerly waiting for is finally here! We're thrilled to announce the release of the much-anticipated Kenworth T680 100 Years Anniversary Edition for American Truck Simulator.

title: Anominal
description: A 2D platformer with a twist: instant teleportation! Solve brain-scratching puzzles, engage in adrenaline-pumping traversary, and discover the purpose within.

title: Another Farm Roguelike: Rebirth
description: Another Farm Roguelike Rebirth is a strategic farming roguelike where you craft, build, gather, and manage to earn money for the increasing rent. Level up, raise animals, and buy new lands. Everything is possible with a bit of money.

title: Another Hardest Game
description: Welcome to the skillful world of "Another Hardest Game," where you control a small ball-shaped robot, aspiring to break free from a mysterious place.

title: Antimatter Drive: Duel
description: Dive into a strategic space odyssey! In this hex-based board game, build your starship, navigate through a dynamic universe, and make critical decisions. Featuring asymmetric gameplay with unique alien races and an innovative board design. Conquer and unravel the star mysteries!

title: Antiquarium
description: Prepare to discover hidden artifacts in an extraordinary antiquarium. Attend to customers, put enigmatic object fragments together, and solve bonus puzzles. Immerse yourself in the Antiquarium's ancient ambiance for hours of enjoyable and entertaining exploration!

title: Antishoot
description: ANTISHOOT is a first-person action, fast-paced shooter where your only goal is to defeat the creatures that come to kill you. Shoot and rocket-jump through enemies to gain glory on the leaderboards

title: An Unusual Cadence
description: Join Airia, a small town bard, as she summons all her courage to save the land in peril. Can you uncover the secret of The Legendary Instruments in time?

title: Ani-Chess
description: Join a delightful and leisurely turn-based game with adorable cartoon animals, embarking on a puzzle-filled adventure. Challenge opponents and progress on the game board. Form a formidable team and navigate through challenges together.

title: Animal Game
description: A 2-4 player rogue-lite party brawler where dying makes you evolve. Pick a cute animal. Grab a weapon. Wreck your friends. The catch? Last place gets the wildest upgrades. No lead is ever safe.

title: Animalistic Worlds
description: An Open-World RPG that takes place in a world where anthropomorphic animals try to live like humans used to in modern society, but often fail miserably due to their animal instincts.

title: Animal Race Party
description: In Animal Race Party, the main objective is to race through tracks, collecting gold stars to secure victory. Each player can choose from six cute animals, each possessing a unique skill that can be strategically used to gain an advantage.

title: Animal Shelter 2
description: Welcome back to the heartwarming world of Animal Shelter 2! Provide a loving home for every four-legged friend in need – play with them, pet them, even dress them up! Get to know them and find them a loving family. Play with your friends and manage your shelter together in co-op!

title: Area 51: Beyond The Wall
description: Join the top-secret mission to defend Area 51, the world's most enigmatic military base. With fast paced action, realistic combat, and a dynamic environment, 'Area 51: Beyond the Wall' will immerse you in a thrilling and challenging experience. Play now and see if you have what it takes!

title: Area 37
description: Area 37 is a 16-bit retro action platform game, set in a post-apocalyptic world dominated by machines, where the protagonist, Pink, risks his life performing dangerous missions to earn money.

title: Arkanoid: Eternal Battle - Battle Royale F2P Edition
description: The Iconic Block-Breaker Returns! Embrace for free the intensity of the Battle Royale, thanks to the Eternal Battle Mode, up to 25 players online. Play now for free and try to reach the top of the leaderboard. Additional modes are available for separate purchase.

title: Archons
description: Archons is a roguelite / survivor where you control two characters at the same time, the Archons. Upgrade your Archons with different weapons to blast your way through the hordes of parasites and gigantic bosses. Customize your upgrades to build your own unique playstyle.

title: ArcaneOutpost
description: A strategy game that combines MOBA and Tower Defence, You would control guardians with different skills，building your outpost to fend off enemy attacks.

title: Arcane Weave
description: Embark as an Apprentice Wizard in a spellbinding puzzle platformer. Engage in turn-based combat against the malevolent Queen Witch, solving puzzles, navigating enchanting landscapes, and using spells strategically. Unravel magical threads to bring lasting peace to your kingdom.

title: Archers on the Hunt
description: In this game, you will have to fight off crowds of enemies that are coming in large numbers. You play as a ranger, who with the help of a magic bow shoots off the evil.

title: AquaRevive
description: Dive into AquaRevive, a VR game in a glass dome battling algal bloom pollution. Armed with a dynamic chemical ball, you must destroy illuminated targets to save the ecosystem. Face waves of challenges, testing your speed and accuracy in a race against time.

title: Apple Hero
description: Apple Hero is a puzzle game in which you lead the hero to the goal. Create a path for the hero by placing apples, BUT the twist is that the hero always moves only to the closest apple. Avoid dangers, collect coins and solve all the puzzles!

title: Apocalypse Party & 20 Minutes Till Dawn: Free Thanking DLC
description: This thrilling free DLC combines with "20 Minutes Till Dawn's" strategic depth. Cross-game heroes infuse "Apocalypse Party" with tactics and abilities. With three innovative weapons and talents, players now have more ways to combat and strategize in this end-of-days showdown.

title: Armored Brigade II
description: Armored Brigade II revolutionizes real-time tactical warfare in 3D, focusing on the intense combined arms combat of the Cold War era, from 1965 to 1991. Boasting a meticulously researched database and huge real-world terrain maps, this game offers an unparalleled combat simulation experience.

title: Arrowstorm Ascendant
description: Defeat hordes of dragons and wyverns using your outstanding elvish archery skills. Create the most insane combination of upgrades and get your name into the leaderboards, showcasing all your might and glory!

title: Atomic Owl
description: Atomic Owl is a pixel art-based single-player, side-scrolling roguelite that combines fast-paced platforming with dynamic hack-and-slash combat and a variety of weapons, powerups, and a demonic blade. Journey through eight roguelite zones, save your friends, and take up arms against Omega Wing!

title: Atlas Wars
description: Join the epic world of Atlas Wars, a fast-paced skill-based multiplayer brawler! Choose unique heroes, master awesome abilities, and battle in crazy and unique arenas. Atlas Wars offers an action-packed brawl experience!

title: Atlas Ablaze
description: When 16 year old Andi falls for the last person her parents would approve of, she seems to have trouble processing the severity of her girlfriend's situation. Cute visuals and crude humor helps to mask dark topics in the way that puts you in the headspace of a teenage girl trying to shut it all out.

title: At His Grave
description: Time backtracking secret room decryption game, analyze the character dialogue, find the key to decryption, complete the needs to leave the room. In the end all regret, go back to the past, looking for clues to make up for regret.

title: Aussie Rules Coach
description: Aussie Rules coaching game, setup your team and watch them play!

title: A Winter Haunting
description: Everlyn Sterling, a young woman tasked by her grandmother to take care of a historic mansion, finds herself entangled in a mystery involving supernatural forces. Join her in this point-and-click style game to uncover the secrets behind this landmark!

title: Avalanca: Mythos
description: Explore the mysteries of Odonis Orphane in the bonus DLC for Avalanca. Equip cutting-edge weaponry, face new alien threats, and unlock extraterrestrial powers. The cosmos awaits – are you ready for the alien odyssey?

title: Avalanca: Divinity - Belfy Bastion
description: Dive into the enchanting realm of Avalanca once again with the thrilling DLC expansion, Belfry Bastion. This immersive tower defense game seamlessly blends the captivating characters and lore of Avalanca with strategic gameplay, offering players a fresh experience within the beloved universe.

title: Automobilista 2: Circuit des 24 Heures du Mans
description: The mecca of Endurance racing arrives to AMS2! Modelled with the aid of detailed laser scan data this DLC features the modern 24h track along with its shorter Bugatti layout.

title: Ascend Factory
description: Welcome to Ascend Factory, a factory simulation game that challenges your ingenuity and resource management skills. Immerse yourself in a world of automation and strategic planning as you progress through levels of increasing complexity!

title: Ash the Cat
description: A dark-humor 3D platforming adventure in the style of Conker's Bad Fur Day.

title: Astra Strike
description: Astra Strike is a team-based first-person tactical shooter set in the near future. Players play as one agent In the main game mode, players are assigned to either the attacking or defending team with each team having five players on it. Players have abilities.

title: Atan
description: Atan is an action-adventure game where you traverse a massive colossal. Use your climbing skills together with your bow and anchors to journey over the massive giant. But beware, because this rough terrain contains many challenges, for the colossal itself is still alive and in need of your help.

title: AstroForge: Space Pirates
description: Build your unique spaceship and explore space. Travel between planets, fight different opponents, trade and develop. Build the most efficient ship and fight with other players in multiplayer. 17 languages available.

title: Axona
description: Axona is a grid-based puzzle game which requires 3-dimensional thinking and careful planning. Pick up the keys with the correct face of your cube and unlock the glyphs to open the gate in each level.

title: Backrooms: Steps into the abyss
description: You are a member of the B.E.I. research team. You have to find a lost report.Your task is to explore these primitive spaces, find the report and return them to the base for further analysis. Use your ingenuity and skills to avoid danger.

title: Backrooms: Realm of Shadows - Full Version
description: Embark on a thrilling odyssey through the Backrooms: Realm of Shadows and discover what lies beyond the veil of reality. Are you prepared to face the shadows and unravel the mysteries that await in this dark and unforgiving realm? The adventure begins now - if you dare.

title: Backrooms Game No. 999999
description: Backrooms #999999999 is a singleplayer/4 player co-op horror exploration game. Unlock the puzzles, survive the entities, escape the deadly geometry and try to reach the final level in one piece. Good luck, wanderer!

title: Baderna: Um Conto de Barro
description: Face the mob with your clay dolls! Baderna: Um Conto de Barro is an action-adventure game set in the magical universe of Northeastern clay dolls. Help Cleiton save his village from the corrupted dolls in insanely challenging levels!

title: Baklava Simulator 2
description: In Baklava Simulator 2, you're in control of your baklava shop. Upgrade, create delightful treats, and serve customers strategically. With customizable features, security, and entertainment, this game is where flavor meets management. Dive into Baklava Simulator 2 and build your baklava empire! 🥮

title: Battle Clash
description: Battle Clash is a medieval multiplayer PVP game. On spawn, each player is randomly assigned a medieval class and forced to battle against other players. Reach a kill streak to unlock your class's ultimate attack, and dominate the battlefield. When the timer ends, the player with the most kills wins!

title: Battle Drive
description: Survive on a dying world by taking on the most dangerous missions that no one else can handle; overcoming natural disasters, nefarious opportunists & PVE challenges, while using your skills, strategies & reflexes to save money towards customizing the vehicle that will see you through the apocalypse!

title: Bass Invaders
description: Infinite Rhythm Action. Join Ace and PZO-116 as they repel alien invaders whose only weakness is music. Battle using any song from local files or online video with automatic beatmap generation. Nail the perfect run and top the leaderboard on your favourite tracks. Your music will save the world.

title: Beacon of Havoc
description: Post-apocalyptic city builder, where you Build, Defend, and Thrive in a desolate landscape overrun by enemy attacks. Manage resources, production and manufacturing to expand your settlement.

title: Battlefall: State of Conflict
description: Engage in a post-apocalyptic RTS showdown between three factions in Battlefall: State of Conflict.

title: Battle Echoes
description: Take command of the mech and become the ultimate strategist. Construct impregnable defense facilities, handpick potent skills, lead your troops, and defy relentless enemy assaults. Will you emerge victorious in this thrilling battle for supremacy?

title: Bearly Delivered
description: A 3D physics-based package delivery game

title: Beetle Nest
description: Try yourself as a commander in the new Rouge-lite shooter with a top view! Upgrade your clones, explore planets, unlock new weapons and costumes. Don't let the waves of hostile creatures defeat you!

title: Before I Go
description: Explore the haunting, dreamlike fantasy world of BEFORE I GO, a punishing Metroidvania where you embody the innocence of an inner child on an allegorical odyssey towards death acceptance. The end is inevitable, but will you brave the journey?

title: Being John
description: In the RogueLite-based life simulation game Being John, you help John to return to his old life after the events that have happened to him.

title: Be Not Afraid, But Run
description: Polluted with our better angels the ways bear hazards few dare challenge go, o messenger and heed these words: be not afraid but run.

title: Beyond Doors
description: Caleb woke up in a mystical dimension after experiencing burnout in his job. Door-to-door, guided by enigmatic musical notes, he needs to be reminded of his true calling. Immerse yourself in this mind-bending platformer.

title: Big Adventure: Trip to Europe 6 - Collector's Edition
description: AVIs new game "Trip to Europe 6" offers an exciting Christmas journey through the snowy European countries. Playing the game you will be able to find hidden objects in historical places in Europe and Scandinavia, play exciting mini-games and collect souvenirs.

title: Bike Ride 3D
description: Racing, cycling and horse riding have never been so much fun!

title: Bingle Bingle
description: Bingle Bingle is a 'Roulette Builder' game where you can create your own Roulette. Strategically combine various betting options and unique balls to create synergies, earn extreme scores, and beat the casino

title: Bionic Rebirth
description: Classic arcade first person shooter, survive the depths of a overrun facility controlled by power AI. Can you escape?

title: Birds vs. Dragons
description: Embark on an epic adventure in Birds vs Dragons, a breathtaking third-person shooting game. Tame birds and battle lethal dragons threatening to eliminate you from stunning platforms. Unleash your skills, save the planet, and experience the thrill in this action-packed saga!

title: Bioguard
description: Bioguard is a tower defense roguelite with a biological theme. Help the immune system using a variety of towers, skills and special cards. Develop your strategy to protect your body from invading pathogens and prevent their passage to vital organs!

title: Birdtale
description: Ancient Chinese tale set during the fictitious Tianqi era of the Ming Dynasty, where the government madly hunts all birds. Assist common bird Shaohao in solving mysteries to discover the truth behind the madness. Some puzzles utilize computer system functions, posing no real threat to your machine.

title: Bisyntho
description: Bisyntho is a casual physics-based arcade game about combining orbs. Use and abuse the few tools provided to you in order to last as long as possible and push your high score to its limit.

title: Bitosphere
description: Embark on a Galactic Adventure in Bitosphere a Captivating 1-bit Clicker Game

title: Black Abyss
description: This is a super fun puzzle game where a white balloon bounces rhythmically up and down.
